publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the probabilistic evaluation of the optimal power-water flow (OPWF) of the integrated electricity-water system (IEWS) composed of the power system and the water distribution system (WDS). Most of the existing OPWF studies are limited to deterministic analysis, which cannot address the effects of the uncertainties, such as renewable power and loads, on the operation of the IEWS. Therefore, in this paper, the deterministic OPWF problem is first extended to a comprehensive probabilistic optimal powerwater flow (P-OPWF) problem by considering uncertainties in loads and photovoltaic (PV) power and their correlations. First, a piecewise linear approximation method is used to reformulate the original nonlinear OPWF problem into a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Then the third-order polynomial normal transformation (TPNT) technique is applied to deal with the probabilistic uncertainties and correlations, and finally, the probabilistic evaluation framework based on the Monte Carlo simulation is developed to provide an idea for solving the P-OPWF problem. Simulations based on a sample IEWS are performed to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Energy Storage System to Three Defense Lines of Frequency
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous development of UHVDC transmission and renewable energy power generation, large number of synchronous generators have been replaced, and the risk of transient frequency security after faults has increased. Electrochemical energy storage is developed as a flexible control resource. Based on the fast power regulation characteristics, the function of energy storage in the prevention, emergency, and correction control of frequency stability for three defense lines is analyzed. The technical points of capacity allocation for electrochemical energy storage to support transient frequency security are discussed. Meanwhile, this paper researches the optimal configuration of energy storage adapting to multiple application scenarios and optimal operation modes of energy storage power stations.

articleTitle: Identifying the System-related Conditions and Consequences of Power-to-X Solutions for a High Renewables Penetration in Denmark
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There is a high demand on development of Power-to-X solutions in Demark to achieve the targets of its government's 70% greenhouse gas emission by 2030 and fossil free in the whole energy system by 2050. Based on exploring historical renewables data and electricity market data, the balancing needs in the Danish electrical power system are emphasized in this paper, which provide favorable conditions for new technologies, such as electrolysers and fuel cells, to participate in the balancing markets. This paper also summarizes the experiences and lessons learned from the hydrogen-related demonstration projects in Demark and their prequalification recommendations. An economic study on reversible solid oxide cell-based plants on Bornholm island shows new optimal designs on system conriguration and control strategies are still needed for more economic benefits.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatch of a Multi-energy Residential Microgrid With Flexible Multi-energy Loads
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the widespread installation of smart meters, more and more residents are signing long-term contracts with the grid for demand response (DR) scheme. As an effective way of managing energy consumption about energy prices and system energy balance conditions, the DR scheme contributes to the system cost-saving. In this context, the optimal operation of a multi-energy residential microgrid (MERMG) is studied considering the multi-energy DR scheme. The objective is to minimize the net operating cost under the system's operational constraints. In the multi-energy DR scheme, the price-based DR (PBDR) is used for power consumption and thermal (heat or cooling) inertia is for the thermal energy consumption. Besides, to guarantee the solution quality as well as relieve the computation burden, the original nonlinear items are linearized to make the operation model a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Then it can be then efficiently solved by commercial solvers like Cplex and Gurobi. Finally, by applying the proposed method in the test MERMG and comparing it with the one without the multi-energy DR scheme, the validity of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Post-arc Transient Characteristics for DC Vacuum Circuit Breaker With Diode Connected in Series
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Experimental investigations have been carried out on the rapid high current commutation interruption (CI) process of a $10\mathrm{k}\mathrm{V}$ DC vacuum circuit breaker (VCB). The VCB arc restriking and breaking failure phenomenon appeared frequently in $23\mathrm{k}\mathrm{A}$ CI tests with arc current fall rate of about $300\mathrm{A}/\mu \mathrm{s}$ for a single VCB, while the VCB CI reliability has been improved a lot under the same conditions with diode connected in series. After a detailed analysis of the vacuum gap (VG) post-arc transient characteristics, it was found that it lasted about $450\mu \mathrm{s}$ before the VG finishing the ion sheath development for the single VCB in the post-arc stage. Meanwhile, the VG electric field intensity (EFI) and power density (PD) would quickly rise to the peak values of $12\mathrm{M}\mathrm{V}/\mathrm{m}$ and $45\mathrm{M}\mathrm{W}/\mathrm{m}^{2}$ separately in about $1\mu \mathrm{s}$ after the arc zero-crossing. As a result, the VG electrical or thermal breakdown were very prone to come out when the plasma concentration was still high in the sheath development stage. With the diode in series, the VG power injection path was cut off effectively by the diode reverse blocking, the initial transient recovery voltage rising very fast would be avoid and the plasma concentration was promoted to decay significantly, by which both the EFI and PD were decreased greatly when the VG began to get insulation recovery in the post-arc phase. Under the most extreme condition that the VG started to build dielectric strength at the end of the diode reverse blocking, the simulation results revealed the EFI and PD peak values were substantially reduced to $130\mathrm{k}\mathrm{V}/\mathrm{m}$ and $1.4\mathrm{k}\mathrm{W}/\mathrm{m}^{2}$ respectively and delayed for about $30\mu \mathrm{s}$, which were very beneficial to reduce the VG breakdown probability and improve the dielectric recovery performance in the post-arc transient.

articleTitle: A Multi-energy Virtual Power Plant Model Based on Distributed Energy Resource Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the visibility and controllability of distributed energy resources, an MVPP equivalent model has been designed. Firstly, the appropriate parameters are selected to describe MVPP equivalent model after analyzing the characteristics of distributed resource model. And based on a simple aggregation example, an equivalent parameter calculation method for MVPP aggregating distributed resources is derived. To improve the robustness of MVPP equivalent model, a robust calculation method of MVPP parameter deviation is further studied and proposed, in which the parameters of MVPP equivalent model are modified by the results of robust optimization. The robust optimization process is decomposed into the main and sub-problems, and solved by Column and Constraint Generation Algorithm. Finally, the results show the form of MVPP equivalent model. Through comparison, it shows that the cooperation of resources and equipment in various forms of energy can bring more flexibility to MVPP and the integrated energy system it belongs to.

articleTitle: Robust Economic Optimal Dispatch Method of Wind Power System considering AC Power Flow Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The economic optimal dispatch model that took into account the uncertainty of wind turbine output usually only considered the DC power flow constraints, and cannot accurately obtain the changes in voltage amplitude, phase angle and generator reactive power output of each node of the system. To this end, this paper first derived the general form of a robust optimized economic dispatch model based on the optimal power flow model considering nonlinear AC power flow constraints, and used the cardinality uncertainty sets to describe the uncertainty of wind turbine output. The column and constraint generation algorithm and the duality theory were used to divide the robust optimization model into a master problem and a subproblem. The interior point method was used to solve the problem, thereby the optimal economic scheduling results when the system is subjected to the maximum disturbance of wind power can be obtained. The optimization results of the IEEE RTS 24node system proved that the model adopted in this paper can more accurately and comprehensively characterize the impact of the fluctuation of the output of the wind turbine on the optimal scheduling results.

articleTitle: A Demand Side Industrial Aluminum Load Control Scheme based on Output Regulator Theory for Wind Power Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper investigates the short-term wind power fluctuation issues in an actual grid-connected industrial microgrid for aluminum production. As a type of energyintensive load, electrolytic aluminum load (EAL) presents great potentials for smooth the wind power fluctuation due to the large capacity and the load characteristic. In this paper, the detailed equivalent circuit and control model of EAL are discussed. By regulating the power consumption of EALs, a demand side control method based on the output regulator theory is proposed in the paper to smooth the wind power fluctuation. The effectiveness of the proposed control method is validated through the simulation on real-time digital simulator (RTDS) platform. The results demonstrate that the proposed demand control method is able to guarantee the positive dynamic performance of smoothing wind power fluctuation.

articleTitle: A Novel Cross Iteration Method for Dynamic Energy Flow Calculation of the Hot-water Heating Network in the Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The state information of district heating network (DHN) is significant to the secure operation and control of the integrated energy system. This paper focuses on the dynamic energy flow calculation method of the hot-water heating network under variable flow rate conditions, i.e. under the quantity regulation mode. First of all, known inputs, desired outputs and mathematical formulation of the energy flow calculation model are clarified. For the partial differential equation describing the temperature dynamics in each pipe, we apply the finite difference method to convert it into a group of algebraic equations for standardized solution. After that, a cross iteration method is proposed to solve the high-dimensional nonlinear model, where the global mass flow rate distribution and the temperatures of return water at each load are alternately updated until both converge to their acceptable precision levels. One nice feature of our method is that the temperatures of return water at each load do not need to be known inputs. Instead, the dynamic response of them can be fully captured, which is crucial for identifying the thermal conditions at each load. Test results of a DHN in the Barry Island demonstrate the validity and effectiveness of our method.

articleTitle: A New Integrated Heat Storage and Heat Load Control Method to Erase the Wind Power Curtailment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The coexistence of high penetration CHP(combined heat power) and large-scale wind power generation may cause severe wind power curtailment. However, in the north areas of China, particularly during winter, the application of the thermal energy storage(TES), the elasticity of CHP units operation and the heat load can help to reduce the curtailment. Hence, a new 3-level optimization model is built to realize the collaborative operation of CHP unit, TES equipment and heat load management. Then, On the basis of the two-phase transaction mode composed by traditional energy market and the peak shaving market, the optimal operation mode of CHP unit is proposed to provide peak shaving capacity for wind power curtailment, under a certain approved peak shaving price. At last, the typical influencing factors, including the capacity of TES equipment, different operation modes and peak load shaving price, are analyzed to show the economic benefits of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Joint Optimal Deep Peak Regulation of Renewable-rich Power System with Responsive Load Heating Storage Enabled CHP and Flexible Thermal Llants
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing installed capacity of renewable energy such as wind power has put tremendous pressure on peak regulation of system. In order to promote wind power accommodation, a joint optimized peak regulation method for combined heat and power (CHP) units with heating storages and deep peak regulation is proposed in this paper, considering demand response. The power-generation side installs heat storage devices on CHP units, breaking the tradition of power determined by heat Also, the deep peak regulation technology of thermal power units is applied to increase the space for wind power accommodation. The load side considers demand response, and users are guided to actively optimize the load curve through peak regulation compensation incentives and time-of-use electricity prices, alleviating the phenomenon of anti-peak regulation of wind power. The joint optimization model aims to minimize the total dispatch cost of the system. Constraints on heating storages, costs of life loss of thermal power units and constraints on user satisfaction with electricity are all considered comprehensively. The model is solved by CPLEX. The results of the case study show that the proposed method can maximize the peak regulation effect of the system with the lowest dispatching cost while ensuring the user's power consumption satisfaction, and effectively reduce the wind power curtailment.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Frequency Response Technology and Device Development of Photovoltaic Power Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional photovoltaic power plant doesn't participate in grid frequency regulation, as the increasing proportion of photovoltaic power in the whole power system, it may have a great impact on the frequency stability. The new standard DL/T 1870-2018 "Technical Specification for Power System Network Source Coordination" issued in 2018 puts forward the requirements for fast frequency response performance of photovoltaic power plant. At some regions with high proportion of photovoltaic power in Northwest China, relevant departments have released documents successively, which claim the photovoltaic power plant should have the ability of fast frequency response. In this paper, according to the requirements of standard and local documents, the key technical indexes of fast frequency response of photovoltaic power plant are analyzed. Several typical schemes of fast frequency response renovation of photovoltaic power plant are listed. A high precision fast frequency response device is developed, the principle and control strategy of the device are introduced, this device is used in laboratory and photovoltaic power plant respectively. As shown in the field test, the fast frequency response performance of photovoltaic power plant is much better with this device, both the frequency regulation response time and power control accuracy are much better than conventional hydro-thermal power plant, this device has a high application value.

articleTitle: International Hydrogen Energy Policy Summary and Chinese Policy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study investigates and analyzes the current state of hydro gen and fuel cell vehicle technologies and policies, comprehensively summarizes the hydrogen and fuel cell in the United States, Japan, the European Union, and China in terms of technologies, products, markets, and institutional mechanisms, and provides an in-depth analysis of the causes of the above-mentioned problems. It clarifies the position of fuel cell vehicles and hydrogen refueling infrastructure in international and Chinese national policies. This paper analyzes the overall development goals and policy priorities of China’s future hydrogen strategy and summarizes the policies, regulations and subsidies in North China, East China, South China and Southwest China. It summarizes the main policies and development goals of hydrogen energy in North, East, South and Southwest China from the perspectives of technology innovation, industrial development and key policies, and makes policy recommendations for the development of hydrogen energy in China.

articleTitle: An Interval Programming Based OPF Model Considering N-1 Security Criterion for Hybrid AC/DC Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an interval programming based optimal power flow model is proposed to consider the interval uncertainty of wind power in the operation of hybrid AC and DC power systems. In the proposed model, the prediction error of the wind power and the uncertainties of the realistic limits of the branch flow are treated as interval numbers. Also, both the post-contingency short-term and long-term security operation are considered to achieve a more secure power system operation by the fast control of voltage source converters. The proposed uncertain optimization model is transformed into a deterministic optimization one by using the interval order relationship conversion. Finally, the proposed model is validated by the simulations on the modified IEEE 14-bus system.

articleTitle: Detection of Abnormal Data of Gateway Energy Meter Based on User Dynamic Behavior Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the quality of measuring data of gateway energy meter has significant impacts on the fairness and impartiality of trade settlement, detection of abnormal data is of great importance. However, recent related researches of meter measuring data focus on the abnormal causes and the design of an on-line monitoring system, the value of data mining itself is ignored. For this reason, this paper proposes a method of detecting abnormal data in the gateway energy meter based on user dynamic behavior mining. According to the regularity of power load data, a detection method for random abnormal points based on time series decomposition and autocorrelation analysis is proposed. At the same time, for the continuous abnormal situation of the data caused by the user’s power theft behavior that the power grid company is concerned about, the line loss rate and the continuous decline trend of the power consumption are extracted. Then, a detection model is established to realize the detection of abnormal data in the gateway energy meter. Finally, the validity of this method is verified based on the measured data of the power grid. The result proves that the proposed method can accurately detect the abnormal data of the gateway energy meter and meet the needs of engineering practice.

articleTitle: Small Signal Modeling Method for VSC-MTDC System with Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-terminal high voltage direct current transmission system with wind farm connection is prone to instability, it is necessary to construct an accurate small-signal model to analyze the stability of small disturbances in the system. However, most of the existing literature does not considering wind farm models when establishing a small-signal model of an DC system with a wind farm. Accordingly, a small-signal model of the DC system including the wind farm was established based on the average model. In order to reflect the converter's power loss, the DC side equivalent bridge arm impedance will be considered, so that the dynamic response of the converter can be reflected more accurately. Moreover, a small-signal model of the full-powered wind farm is established to improve modeling efficiency, which can be constitute a single state space with wind farm side converter. The small-signal model of the four-terminal VSC-HVDC transmission system with wind farm is built in the case study, this model's step response and stability margin are compared with the PSCAD. The results indicate that the proposed small-signal model can accurately simulate the small disturbance dynamic response as well as system stability.

articleTitle: Threat Assessment for Power Industrial Control System Based on Descriptive Vulnerability Text
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of information technology and Power Internet of Things, the increasing number of networked terminals presents new network security threats. Industrial control equipment and systems have vulnerabilities in hardware, software and firmware, and advanced persistent threat against ICS has become more complex and diverse. However, most of the research are aimed at the detection of single vulnerability, and lack attack mechanism analysis and threat assessment for attack chain. We proposed a threat assessment method based on vulnerability descriptive text and described the attributes of attack samples according to the classification results in attack targets, methods and consequences. We constructed attack graphs based on attack sample attributes and cyber-physical topology to quantitatively evaluate the feasibility and benefits of each attack path from vulnerability capabilities and the impact of devices in the physical world. Finally, we took the substation device status monitoring system as an example to verify the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Decentralized Combined Heat and Power Dispatch Using the Communication-Censored ADMM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Decentralized methods are recently employed in combined heat and power systems (CHPS), because the electric power systems (EPS) and distribute heating systems (DHS) are controlled independently by different operators. However, most of them only focus on the accuracy of computation results but neglect the cost of communication in computation. In this paper, we develop a communication-censored alternating direction method of multipliers (COCA) to solve the CHPS dispatch problem. Different from the ADMM, the boundary information is allowed to transmit to neighbors in COCA only when its value is significantly changed as compared to its previous value. The censoring function is utilized to measure the difference to improve the efficiency of communication. Experimental results demonstrate that COCA can not only reach the same solution as the centralized method but also reduce communication costs.

articleTitle: Optimal Allocation of Distributed Generations Considering Demand Response and Multi-agent Benefits
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Traditional power planning takes the distribution network as the only agent without fully considering the environmental cost and demand response. However, environmental cost, demand response and multi-agent benefits have begun to receive attention in power planning with the increase of new energy penetration, the development of active distribution networks and the reform of the power market. Firstly, considering three different agents including the power supply side, the distribution network and the users, the optimal allocation models are established with the goal of the maximum net income, respectively. Secondly, according to the relationship of the multi-agent interests, the objective function that considers the net income of all three parties is constructed, and the original model is transformed into a second-order cone programming problem by using the second-order cone relaxation technology. Finally, taking the IEEE33 bus distribution network as a simulation case, the simulation is carried out based on the actual data of loads, wind power outputs and photovoltaic outputs in a regional power grid. The result verifies that the optimal allocation model can effectively improve the overall economic benefits of each subject, and considering environmental costs and demand response in power planning can make the obtained schemes pay attention to both economy and environmental protection, which is in line with the future development trend of power grid.

articleTitle: Research on the Damage Experiment Model Design and Metal Magnetic Memory Testing of Wind Turbine Tower in Service
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the prototype of a massive wind turbine tower is simplified into a mechanical test model by using the similarity theory, and the relevant similarity coefficient is derived. On this basis, the stress concentration of two typical defects, such as groove and hole, is simulated to simulate the early damage under different wind loads. The stress distribution of the tower model under different loads is calculated by the finite element method (FEM). Meanwhile, a particular metal magnetic memory testing device is made to detect the stress concentration area of the tower. The experimental results are consistent with the simulation results, which verifies the effectiveness of the magnetic method to detect the early damage of the tower. Finally, the empirical formula and vector synthesis method are used to analyze the magnetic memory signal, and the evaluation index of stress concentration is proposed.

articleTitle: Hierarchical Game Trading Model for Multiple VPPs Considering the Interaction with Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual deepening of power market reform, a large number of emerging market players swarm into the market and launch fierce competition. In the future, there will be a pattern of multiple virtual power plants participating in market transactions. In order to give consideration to the interests of distribution network operators and virtual power plants, this paper constructs a layered game interactive trading model in which distribution network operators participate. The bidding subjects of each virtual power plant fully consider the demand response and energy storage units as operational constraints and study the operator dynamic pricing behavior and the internal energy management model of virtual power plant. In the game process, each virtual power plant chooses its own minimum operating cost as the goal, and by transforming the model into a mixed integer linear programming problem, the optimal solution of game equilibrium with distribution network operators is obtained. Finally, the paper gives an example analysis of the multi-virtual power plant system integrating different distributed energy sources, and provides ideas and reference for the market transaction of virtual power plant.

articleTitle: Edge IoT Agent Design Compatible with Sensor Equipment of Complex Distribution Terminal and Communication Task Optimization Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The intelligent perception of field power equipment is characterized by a large number of bottom terminals, a large amount of data collection, and a complex communication interface, which causes great obstacles to the online monitoring and safety diagnosis of power equipment. In this paper, based on the demand of power equipment intelligent perception communication networking, an end-toend, side-cloud intelligent perception architecture based on universal edge IoT agent is designed. At the same time, considering the AD hoc network and network topology characteristics of the field acquisition equipment, this paper designed the edge object connection agent compatible with the underlying complex sensor equipment, in order to improve the field data quality, improve the execution schedule and efficiency of the field perception task of power equipment. The AD hoc network communication method and data transmission queuing model under the end-side-cloud intelligent perception architecture are established, and the communication resource scheduling optimization is carried out considering the QoS service quality of intelligent perception. Aiming at the data transmission characteristics and data service response characteristics of power equipment intelligent perception, this paper sinks the data calculation container to the edge layer network close to the data source to realize efficient and fast edge data response and processing. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the communication scheme are verified by simulation examples.

articleTitle: Fault Location Technology of Transmission Line and Asynchronous Phasor Measurement from PMUs
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous expansion of the modern power system, when the transmission line fails due to various factors, it will have a serious impact on the social economy and people’s lives. This paper proposes a fault location method for transmission grids based on the real-time synchronous measurement data of the Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU). The algorithm is based on the data measured by the PMU device. First, according to the measured real-time synchronous voltage and current data, the characteristic impedance and propagation coefficient of the line are solved online; the voltage and current data at both ends are used to perform equations on the voltage at the fault point. Column writing, through the equation relationship, and then solve the fault distance, realize the fault location function. Because there are certain errors in the process of measuring data, such as the asynchrony of the data at both ends and a certain low delay in the data communication process. To make the solved fault distance more accurate, in the synchronous measurement method, the method of data asynchronous fault 10-cation is proposed, the theoretical formula is derived, and the measurement error caused by the communication delay is analyzed in detail. At the same time, this paper uses PSACD software to build a model to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the method.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Service for “5G” in China: Market Prediction and Case Study
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: China has entered 5th generation mobile net-works (5G) era. As an important part of China’s “new infrastructure”, 5G will create huge economic and social value, helping China achieve high-quality economic development. While bringing better communication experience and creating more new application scenarios, 5G is also facing the reality of a substantial increase in the number of base stations, which brings huge energy consumption challenges. As an emerging industry in the energy field, Integrated Energy Service can significantly save energy cost and promote energy management of the 5G industry through energy variety combination, energy system integration, energy technology upgrade, and business model innovation. It is foreseeable that 5G Integrated Energy Service will become an important market, attracting enterprises to enter and compete. In-depth research on the scale and development trend of the 5G Integrated Energy Service market is of great significance for formulating economic policies, planning industrial investment, and adjusting corporate competition strategies. Based on the industrial life cycle theory, this research predicts the market scale of 5G Integrated Energy Service. The forecast results show that the 5G Integrated Energy Service market will be in a period of rapid growth before the year 2023. The market scale will reach its peak plateau around 2022. The peak value of the 5G Integrated Energy Service market scale under the high, medium and low scenario is 204.9 billion yuan, 153.3 billion yuan, and 102.8 billion yuan respectively. Meanwhile, this research predicts the 5G Integrated Energy Service market in different regions of Chin a, and analyzes the economic and environmental value of 5G Integrated Energy Service by studying typical cases.

articleTitle: Research on the Development Path of Urban Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the energy transformation is accelerating worldwide, and State Grid Corporation of China has also put forward the strategic goal of “building an internationally leading energy Internet enterprise with Chinese characteristics”. In the context of the new era and new strategy, the deployment of energy Internet in cities plays an important exemplary and leading role. Driven by urbanization, low-carbon development and technological progress, cities such as Shanghai, Beijing and Xiamen will take the lead in developing clean, low-carbon, efficient and electrified energy systems. Based on the complexity, high constraint and high target of urban energy Internet, its development process needs to carry out the top-level route design scientifically. From the perspective of development path, urban energy Internet will go through three development stages: the development stage at the level of energy subsystem, the development stage at the level of trans-regional system and the development stage at the level of a comprehensive platform, which also reflects the law of constant evolution of energy system.

articleTitle: Loss Reduction Strategy for Low Voltage Three-phase Unbalance Distribution Network Considering Load Phase Adjustment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid improvement of load level, the problem of three-phase imbalance in distribution network has become prominent, and the additional loss caused has been gradually increasing, the potential of loss reduction is huge. In this paper, the load intensive substation-area represented by urban residential quarter is taken as the research subject. Based on the root mean square current method, the quantitative method of three-phase unbalanced additional loss is constructed, and a real-time automatic load commutation strategy is proposed to realize the optimization of three-phase unbalance and loss reduction in substation-area with intensive load. The simulation results show that the loss quantization method and optimization model established are scientific and feasible.

articleTitle: N-1 Security-constrained Integration of Distributed Generators in Active Distribution Grids With Energy Storage Support
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a distributed generator (DG) allocation model in active distribution networks considering energy storage support and system N-l security. Uncertainties associated with renewable energy generation, component contingency and load variation are considered using a set of representative scenarios. Active distribution network management schemes, i.e., on-load tap-changer voltage control, renewable DG curtailment and demand side management, are also inherent. Energy storage devices are integrated into the network to increase the energy utilization efficiency and improve more renewable energy accommodation. The system N-l security is quantitatively evaluated using the security distance defined in this paper. The original non-linear model is relaxed into a convex model using second-order conic programming, which is bearable with off-the-shelf solvers. Case study carried out on a 104-bus distribution grid validates the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis of Power System with Integration of DFIGs Based on Complementary Cluster Center of Inertia-Relative Motion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Increasing levels of wind penetration is requiring an effective analysis and assessment of the influence of wind machine on power system transient stability. This paper tries to clarify how integrated doubly fed induction generators (DFIGs) affect the transient dynamic of a power system based on complementary cluster center of inertia relative motion (CCCOI-RM). With the coordination of CCCOI-RM, the influence of integrated DFIGs is divided into two parts corresponding to the complementary cluster. Key factors that affect the complementary cluster dynamic motions with respect to the different DFIGs integration conditions are investigated. For further validate the analysis, comparative simulations of four different DFIGs integration conditions in varying DFIG capacities and synchronous generators replacements are conducted. The result shows that the generators in different cluster are affected by the integrated DFIGs in different way, which is correlated with the DFIG’s access location, capacity and inertia of replaced synchronous generators.

Author Keywords: Complementary Cluster Center of Inertia Relative Motion (CCCOI-RM)

articleTitle: A Review of AI and AI Intelligence Assessment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The design and application of AI systems have witnessed rapid development in various fields over a period of three scores, accompanied by researcher’s increasing interest in developing a more intelligent and humanoid AI system. Naturally, it becomes more essential to assess the intelligence of AI objectively and quantitatively, as related researches are still limited and the quantitative methods lack. In this paper, we first comprehensively review the current studies on AI systems, and conclude that these studies could be classified into two groups, i.e. the design as well as development of AI systems and the intelligence assessment of AI. Reviews finds the need and urgency for the quantitative intelligence assessment methods for AI. We also believe that a more efficient assessment method is to establish an index system to estimate and score the intelligence level of AI quantitatively.

articleTitle: Optimized Configuration of Integrated Energy System Considering the Access and Operation of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the process of China's energy system revolution, integrated energy system is the key way to solve low utilization rate of fossil energy and renewable energy consumption. This paper studies the operation characteristics of the core equipment and the utilization process of renewable energy, and establishes the energy supply scheme of the integrated energy system based on the gas-fired combined cooling, heating and power system. A double-layer optimization method for the capacity configuration with consideration of operation strategy of the integrated energy system is proposed to solve the optimized problem. Firstly, a comprehensive energy system with CCHP as the core and considering renewable energy access is proposed. The energy coupling relationship and operation characteristics of various equipment are analyzed. Secondly, The operation characteristics of the equipment are analyzed, and the constraints of the optimization model are constructed. The optimization objectives are investment operation and maintenance, renewable energy consumption, resource consumption and so on. The genetic algorithm combined with the mixed integer linear programming solver is used to verify the economy and environmental protection of the conventional integrated energy system considering the energy storage device and renewable energy consumption.

articleTitle: Capacity optimization Configuration Method of CSP-PV Power Generation System Considering Regulation Demand
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of flexibility regulation demand caused by the random fluctuation of photovoltaic (PV) output and load, the concentrating solar power (CSP) plant is used as a flexibility regulation source in the CSP-PV power generation system, and an optimal configuration method of the thermal storage capacity of the CSP plant considering the regulation demand constraints is proposed. First, the constraint conditions for flexibility regulation demand in respond to the fluctuation of load and photovoltaic output are defined. Then, with the goal of the loss of power supply probability, investment operation cost and PV penetration rate, a multi-objective optimal configuration model of CSP power storage capacity are established. Finally, the non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm (NSGA-II) with elite strategy is adopted to optimize the storage capacity of CSP plant. Taking northwest China as an example, the effectiveness and rationality of the optimal configuration scheme proposed in this thesis considering the regulation demand is verified. The results show that the reasonable configuration of the storage capacity of CSP plant in the system can effectively ensure the reliability of power supply while improving the economy.

articleTitle: Research and Application on Renewable Energy Assessment Method of Absorptive Capacity Considering Adaptability of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual establishment of the monthly bidding market, the spot market and the auxiliary service market, China's power retail industry has shown a rapid development trend, but there are big differences in the risk factors of different types of power sales companies. The risk management of power sales companies is a research point with important practical significance. This paper builds a power-selling company to bundle the electricity demand of power users, and considers the power-supply system purchase model of energy storage system and distributed renewable energy optimization to reduce the overall deviation of power and assessment costs, and increase total profit. The economic loss caused by the control deviation assessment policy and the load forecast deviation risk.

articleTitle: Research on Power Grid Fault Diagnosis Method Based on PMU Data and Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of the power system, it becomes more and more complex, and the safety and stability performance is also facing severe tests. Therefore, it is urgent to explore a fast and accurate method for power grid fault diagnosis. The wide application of synchronous phasor measurement technology has laid the foundation for accurate fault diagnosis in the power grid. Therefore, based on the measurement data of the synchronous phasor measurement unit (PMU) simulated by digsilent simulation software, a sample set with a time series of 8 seconds and characteristic parameters of three-phase current and zero sequence current amplitude was constructed. Proposed a power grid fault diagnosis method using one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN), which realized the end-to-end “timing feature extraction + fault type classification”. The verification of simulation and measured data shows that compared with the traditional power grid fault diagnosis method, the proposed method can make more accurate fault type diagnosis with shorter response time.

articleTitle: A Convolution Neural Network Method for Power System Oscillation Type Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The identification and suppression of oscillation are very important for the stability and security of modern power system. The commonly used oscillation identification methods assume the types of oscillation according to experience. For example, FFT and Prony that are used to identify low frequency oscillation, regard the measured signal as a stationary and time-invariant signal of low frequency oscillation. These are not fit for the modern power system with high proportion of renewable energy, where the types of oscillation are diverse and the system status is fast time-varying. In this paper, a convolution neural network method is proposed for identification of oscillation type in the modern power system. Firstly, obtain the training data of neural network by modeling multi-order mixed exponentially damped sinusoid with random parameters and strong time-varying property. Then, transform the problem of frequency parameter estimation into a classification problem by establishing convolution neural network. Finally, consider average loss index based on cross entropy error function as the accuracy index and testing networks trained with different signal noise ratios and time-varying characteristics to acquire the optimal neural network. Simulations show that the proposed approach can identify oscillation types quickly and accurately.

articleTitle: Influence of Peak Shaving and Frequency Regulations Earnings on the Forecasting Model of Electric Vehicle Charging Demand
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of Electric Vehicles (EVs), the planing and design of charging stations is becoming more and more important, and the prediction of charging demand for EVs is an important prerequisite for the study of EV charging station planning. China's provincial and municipal power companies continue to issue incentive policies for Peak Shaving and Frequency Modulation (FM) in the auxiliary service market, which will affect the planning and development of EV charging stations. This paper considers some scenarios of EV charging station and EV as a whole to provide Peak Shaving and Frequency Regulations service. And puts forward the forecast model of EV charging demand that considers Peak Shaving and Frequency Regulations benefits, combines the travel probability matrix, uses Monte Carlo to simulate EV travel, and thus considers the impact of Peak Shaving and Frequency Regulations revenue prediction on the EV charging demand model. Based on the results of XiangZhou District of Zhuhai City, it can conclude that if some charging stations participate in Peak Shaving and Frequency Regulations, it will significantly affect the charging decision of EVs and change the income ranking of EV charging stations in this area.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimal Dispatch of Microgrid Combined Cooling, heating, Power and Gas
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the epitome of the energy internet, the microgrid can realize the complementary and alternative energy consumption of multiple energy sources. Therefore, the composition and scheduling of the microgrid are complicated. In this paper, the multi-energy microgrid combined cooling, heating, power and gas is analyzed to reflect the actual operation of the system. Power to gas (PtG) and ice-storage air-conditioning (ISAC), which could improve the operating performance of the system, are added to the multi-energy system as well. Then, in order to balance the operating costs, carbon emissions costs and primary energy costs, a multi-objective optimal dispatch model is presented. Furthermore, a maximum fuzzy satisfaction method is adopted to transform multi-objective scheduling problem into single-objective scheduling problem. The accuracy of dispatch model and the effectiveness of the method are verified by the simulation of an actual microgrid example in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Design of Real-time Message Synchronization cross Smart Grid Dispatching System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the integrated operation mode of the smart grid dispatching and control system, there is a large amount of real-time data such as important alarms and manual operations that need to be shared between systems. How to synchronize these real-time data across systems with high reliability and performance becomes a problem to be solved. This paper studies the application scenarios of cross-system message synchronization and proposes a scheme based on redundant dual networks, including hardware and software architecture. The key technologies and important functions were implemented, reliability and throughput verifications were performed, and the expected results were achieved.

Author Keywords: cross smart grid dispatching and control system

articleTitle: A Decentralized Robust planning Approach For Smart Buildings Considering Bilateral Transactions With Fair Market Clearing Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of smart buildings,bilateral transactions can be conducted among multiple smart buildings for optimal investment and operation. This paper investigates the optimal planning of interconnected smart buildings with bilateral transactions. A two-stage decentralized robust planning approach is presented. The first stage is a multiagent coordination planning problem to min imize the social cost. The analytical target cascading (ATC) and column-and-constraint generation (C& CG) methods are introduced to consider the privacy protection and uncertainty of photovoltaic and loads. The second stage is a market-clearing problem to balance the investment and operation cost among multi-stakeholders. To ensure a fair benefit-sharing, the Nash bargaining solution (NBS) is adopted to achieve the Nash equihbrium (NE) in the second stage. The simulation results show that the proposed framework can minimize the social cost and benefit all smart buildings through bilateral transactions.

articleTitle: Microgrid Dynamic Economic dispatching Considering Wind-Solar Complementary Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The microgrid(MG) was widely concerned to solve energy pollution and scarcity crisis. A dynamic economic dispatch model considering wind and solar complementary characteristics is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the wind and solar complementary characteristics is modeled based on copula theory. Secondly, based on the correlation index of wind and solar, the complementary characteristic sample is obtained by copular function, and then eliminated based on the probability distance to obtain error scenario. So that the 24 hour dynamic economic dispatch model of MG considering uncertainty and complementary characteristic is established. Finally, an example of grid-connected MG containing various types of distributed power sources such as wind turbines (WT), photovoltaic (PV) and electrical energy storage verify the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Planning Software for Cascaded Hydro-Photovoltaic-Pumped Storage Hybrid Power Stations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The in-depth development of hydro-photovoltaic complementary power generation technology has posed many new challenges for the planning and software system development of cascade hydro-photovoltaic-pumped storage (CHPP) hybrid power stations to adapt to multi-time scales, multi-complementary modes, multi-dynamic stochastic complex operating conditions. Based on the research results of the national key R&D program, this paper has developed the planning software for CHPP to meet the new homogenized requirements faced by cascade hydro-photovoltaic complementary planning. The software introduced matured B/S hardware architecture mode and software layered architecture modular design combined design ideas, and focused on three key issues of multi-time scale planning of CHPP hybrid stations that adapt to complex dynamic and static operating conditions, and realized the core planning functions such as characteristic analysis and prediction of water, solar and loads, grid-connected and off-grid planning and rolling revision, 3D visualization. Application case has verified that the software can meet real-time application demand with high value, and provide technical support for the promotion of the joint development of cascade water and solar resources.

articleTitle: Comprehensive SustainabilityAssessment of China’s Electric Energy System Based on Emergy Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The green and healthy development of the energy system is related to the sustainable development of economic activities. The quantitative sustainable evaluation of the energy system is the guiding principle of the current energy structure transformation. Therefore, this paper adopts the emergy analysis theory, based on the development forecast of the power supply structure in different stages of China, firstly, the environmental loading ratio, emergy yield ratio, emergy sustainability index and emergy investment ratio are used to carry out the five common power generation modes, including wind power, photovoltaic power, coal power, gas power and hydropower, and it is concluded that under the current conditions, the emergy sustainability index of wind energy is optimal. Thirdly, considering the four dimensions of power generation efficiency, installed cost, full life cycle cost, and emergy sustainability index, a comprehensive evaluation system of China's electric energy system based on emergy analysis is proposed, which quantifies the development trend of the structure has shifted from coal-based to diversified with clean energy and scenery from 2020 to 2050. The comprehensive evaluation result has increased from 0.2 to 1. The comprehensive evaluation results continue to increase with the year, indicating that China's electric energy structure is more optimized, showing a higher vigor of sustainable development.

articleTitle: Estimation of Solar Power by Combining Ground Measured and Satellite Data Using Artificial Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The inherent intermittency of solar energy requires better understanding of its characteristics for the planning and operation of power systems. Solar energy measurements are normally collected at the ground level or using satellite data. Ground measurements are accurate but with limited coverage, in terms of location and covering period. Satellite data is usually available for any location and with decades of records but lacking the accuracy needed. To merge and align these two sources of solar energy measurements is rapidly becoming part of the chores for system planners and operators. To tackle this issue, this paper proposes a series of multi-layered backpropagation neural network (MLBPNN) to estimate historic or future ground measured data from overlapping existing satellite and ground measurements. The study successfully demonstrates that the proposed method can indeed achieve accurate projection. We also demonstrate the sensitivity of the mismatch between satellite data and ground measurements is highly depending on geographical and seasonal factor. Finally, we present a summary of analysing the mismatch comparison amongst different locations in Asia Pacific and discuss various applications using such method in system operation and planning.

articleTitle: Electricity User Consumption Feature Selection and Behavior Portraying
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The stable operation of China's AC/DC bulk power grid and the accommodation of renewable energy put forward high requirements on the demand response. Electricity user portraying is of great significance to the implementation of the demand response. A method for electricity user consumption feature selection and behavior portraying is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the optimal cluster number is obtained automatically by constructing a novel clustering return index taking into account the degree of aggregation and separation. The K-means clustering algorithm is used for user consumption samples clustering. Then, the maximal relevance and minimal redundancy (mRMR) criterion is applied to the selection of electricity user consumption features for balancing effectiveness and simplicity. A high-quality feature set is obtained by using the enumeration method. Finally, the high-quality features are quantified by using the scoring method, then the radar map and the histogram are used to show the electricity user consumption behavior portraying. The results of an example show that the proposed method is effective.

Author Keywords: maximal relevance and minimal redundancy criterion

articleTitle: Investment Optimization Model for Distribution Networks Projects With Risk and Efficiency Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the penetration of new energy, electric vehicles and others, distribution networks (DN) nowadays are facing the increasing uncertainties. investment competition in the DN is intensifying. Investment efficiency and investment benefits have become the focus of consideration for power grid companies. A proper investment portfolio model is required for the investor to choose better candidate between different functional and cost candidates. Hence, this paper proposes a two-tiered index system by integrating the development diagnosis index of DN and assessment of the investment efficiency of an individual project. Moreover, the distribution characteristics of the project yield into investment risk caused by project uncertainties are considered by conditional value at risk (CVaR). So, a multi objective optimization model of DN portfolio investment solved by fuzzy satisfaction to get precise investment strategies is established to cooptimize the trade-off between efficiency and risk. The proposed model is validated using 20 projects in a package of investment plan of a power grid company as case study to verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Robust Optimal Dispatch of Power Grid Considering Wind/PV Power Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the grid connection of large-scale wind farms and photovoltaic (PV) power stations, it is difficult for traditional optimization scheduling method to fully consider the influence of the random and volatile characteristics of wind/PV power generations on the power grid. In this paper, a robust optimal dispatching model considering wind/PV power uncertainties is established, aiming to implement the total minimum system cost whilst meeting corresponding system operation constraints. In particular, an analytical technology and the scenario-based method are leveraged to describe the costs of wind/PV output and their uncertainties, respectively. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) is applied to solve the robust optimal dispatching model proposed in this paper. Finally, the numerical simulations and corresponding comparative analysis are conducted on the IEEE 30-node test system to demonstrate the effectiveness and validity of the proposed optimization model and method.

articleTitle: Intra-day Rolling Dispatch Considering Large-scale Wind Power Participation in Primary Frequency Regulation and Unit Fast Start-up Capability
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper considers that wind turbines participate in Primary Frequency Regulation (PFR) by deloaded operation mode together with conventional units. At the same time, it further taps the fast start-up capability of power resources and warm and hot thermal power units are also considered as part of the intra-day emergency reserve. Based on the above, this paper proposes an intra-day dispatch model considering coordination of both steady state and transient state, which evaluates the transient frequency security of system in a variety of high-risk stochastic scenarios. Besides, interruptible load is also used as one of the PFR reserve sources. In this paper, an inner-outer iterative method is proposed to solve the above model. The outer layer selects out high-risk scenarios for transient optimization. The inner layer carries out coordination optimization of steady state and transient state to determine the unit commitment result, the amount of interruptible load to be shed and forced wind curtailment. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on the improved New England 10-machine 39-bus system. The results show that the proposed method can achieve full coverage of the system's intra-day reserve requirements, while taking into account the security and economy of the system.

Author Keywords: coordination optimization of steady state and transient state

articleTitle: Analysis and Assessment of Power System Source-Network-Load-Storage Intrinsic Safety Risk
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the development of source, network, load and storage, a series of risks have been brought to the power system, whose safe and stable operation is threatened. It is of great significance to study the intrinsic safety risk assessment of power system for risk management and control. First, according to the concept of intrinsic safety, the definition and connotation of the essential security of the power system were put forward, emphasizing that planning is the fundamental guarantee for improving the intrinsic safety level; Then, based on the probabilistic load flow and Monte Carlo simulation method, a power system risk assessment methods and processes that takes into account the uncertainty of new energy and load were proposed; Next, safety and economic risk indicators and weighting methods were proposed to establish system risk calculation methods; Finally, the case analysis was carried out based on IEEE-39 node system for risk assessment, and the impact of changes in source, load, and storage on risk was discussed in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Assessment of Design Parameters Affecting Trigeneration AA-CAES System Performance
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Advanced adiabatic compressed air energy storage (AA-CAES) is proven to be valuable in multi-energy application scenarios, with the merits of combined power, cooling and heating supply, fuel independence, reliable operation, and high efficiency. We present a novel trigeneration AA-CAES system, where the residual compression heat is comprehensively utilized according to the energy grade (temperature) during charging, discharging and heating process. The proposed system is capable of power and space cooling supply, and with the ability of flexible domestic hot water provision and district heating supply. Thermodynamic model is then set up, and system performance analysis is further carried out based on an AA-CAES with three stage compression and two stage expansion whose electrical and energy efficiencies are 54.4% and 100.85%. The impact of design parameters, including the number of compression and expansion stage, the isentropic efficiency and pressure ratio of compressors and turbines, and the inter-cooler and inter-heater effectiveness, on system efficiencies and multi-energy supplying are investigated.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Considering Wind-Solar-Pumped Storage Economy and Fairness under Non-cooperative Game
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the fairness and economy of power system dispatching, considering the maximum profit of each generation unit, a non cooperative game model with wind power, photovoltaic power and pumped storage power station as game participants is established. This model takes the income of power generation unit as the optimization objective, uses Gini coefficient to represent fairness and takes it as one of the constraints to establish a mathematical model. CPLEX is used to solve the models in three different scenarios and verify the correctness and effectiveness of the models. The results show that the addition of pumped storage power station can not only improve the utilization rate of renewable energy, but also increase the system income; when the Nash equilibrium condition is reached, the total system income is higher than that under general conditions; the increase of Gini coefficient will lead to the increase of generation cost of dispatching system, while the economic benefit will be relatively reduced.

Author Keywords: hybrid wind/ PV/ pumped-storage system fairness

articleTitle: Location of Multi-harmonic Source Based on FAJD Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a large number of non-linear load connecting to the power system, power quality problems such as harmonics become increasingly serious. Hence, accurately identifying the location of the harmonic source is of great significance. Since the existing location methods display poor accuracy and the prior conditions of the location are difficult to obtain, this paper presents a new method of harmonic source location. First, fast-approximate joint diagonalization method (FAJD) is used to estimate the harmonic current. Compared with the independent component analysis (ICA), it does not need to whiten the measured data, so the error during this process is eliminated and the solution accuracy of the source signal as well as the mixing matrix is improved. Then, through the sequence identification, the precise location of the harmonic is obtained by matching the mixing matrix with the columns of the matrix which is related to the system topology. The IEEE 39-bus system is used to verify the method and compared it with the ICA algorithm. The simulation results show that the proposed method has high accuracy in harmonic source location.

articleTitle: DLR based Preventive Dispatch for Mitigating Wind Power Uncertainty Induced Line Overloads
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind energy has been widely integrated into power systems because of its clean and sustainable characteristics. Meanwhile, the uncertainty of wind power also introduces some new risks into power systems, such as line overloads. And the dynamic line rating (DLR) is recognized as a good method to mitigate the line overloads caused by wind power uncertainty and improve the integration of wind energy. To address the risk of wind power uncertainty, we in this paper propose a trilevel preventive model considering the DLR to mitigate line overloads caused by wind power uncertainty. And we also present a Bender like decomposition method to solve the tri-level optimization problem. The simulation results on the IEEE 118-bus system prove that the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Cooperative Optimal Operation of Multi-Area Integrated Electricity and Natural Gas System Based on Bargaining Game Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Natural gas-fired generation units have seen a rapid increase in recent years. Thus, issues regarding the operation of the integrated electricity and natural gas system (IEGS) have drawn great attention in studies. In this paper, a cooperative optimal operation model is proposed for the large-scale multi-area IEGS from a Nash bargaining game-theoretic perspective. Compared with the traditional optimization model, the new model redistributes additional social benefits in the cooperative operation, taking into account both individual rationality and social welfare. To protect the privacy of each participant, a decomposed method is applied to solve the problem with a novel two-stage ADMM approach proposed. The case study demonstrates the effectiveness of the new cooperative operation model.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prospect of New Energy Utilization Technology for Ships
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce the world greenhouse gas emissions every year, International Maritime Organization has set up Emission Control Area in the world. Ships sailing to the waters of these areas need to be replaced with cleaner oil with sulfur content no more than 1% and the requirement has been improved to 0.5% in globally since 2020, it is very urgent and necessary to study the replacement of ship new energy in the large emission of ships. This paper focuses on the new energy utilization technology of ships. Firstly, it introduces the necessity and urgency of new alternative fuels. Then, it makes a comparative study and analysis of new alternative fuels for ships, focusing on the technical research from liquefied petroleum gas, LNG, hydrogen, biofuels, and methanol. Finally, it makes a detailed comparative analysis of each energy source and puts forward the realization path. The results of this study are helpful to the utilization and development of new marine energy, and have important role for the greenhouse gas emission reduction of international shipping.

articleTitle: Short-term Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Model Based on Improved BP Neural Network Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic power generation is an important part of the global energy system and energy internet. Accurate photovoltaic power forecasting is beneficial to the optimization of power grid scheduling and the promotion of clean energy consumption. This paper analyzes the seasonal and daily characteristics of the photovoltaic power, uses self-organizing maps (SOM) to dig out the inherent disciplines and essential properties of data, clustering sequences with similar characteristics. Then the MEA-BP model is established which applies mind evolutionary algorithm (MEA) to improving BP neural network. MEA coordinates the local and global values by introducing the evolution mechanism of convergence and dissimilation to optimize the weight and threshold of BP. Next, neural network error correction model is proposed to fix forecasting error. Based on the data of a 50MW photovoltaic power station, the numerical results show that the model can improve the accuracy of photovoltaic power forecasting effectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Smart Grid Simulation Framework Based on Software Defined System and Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, there are still many problems in the construction process of the smart grid simulation platform, such as limited simulation resources, tight coupling of power simulation equipment and simulation scenarios. According to the characteristics of software-defined networking(SDN), this paper proposes a software-defined based smart grid simulation platform(SDGS) construction framework to solve this problem. The framework uses software-defined system(SDS) and cloud computing technology to achieve rapid and flexible construction of simulation platforms, centralized and efficient management of simulation resources. The SDGS solution provides a new way to build a smart grid simulation platform in the future, that is, the simulation platform can also be built like a software-defined data center(SDDC). Users only need to pay attention to the design of the power simulation business, without wasting too much time studying simulation software and configuring simulation environment. The complex simulation environment generation and configuration process will be automatically completed by the SDGS platform in the cloud, thereby ensuring the convenience and accuracy of the simulation environment development.

articleTitle: A Novel Detection Method of Power System Subsynchronous Oscillation Based on Sample Entropy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to detect the sub-synchronous oscillation(SSO) in power systems rapidly and accurately, a novel test method based on sample entropy(SEn) is presented in this paper. By analyzing the variation trend of SEn value of the rotor shafting torque in continuous time period, the complexity of the original signal during different time window could be acquired to judge whether SSO occurs and what kind of SSO has happened in the system. This method has better anti-noise ability and real time property while it does not need large sets of data. Simulation results of the IEEE first standard model test system verified the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of Breakdown Characteristics of Rod-Plate-Rod Gap Under Impulse Voltage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In power system, there is a special kind of gap composed of floating objects and air gaps. Its main characteristic is that some conductors are in the state of floating potential. For example, during live operation of transmission lines, the operator is in a potential floating state during the process of entering the working potential from the ground potential and forms a combined gap with the conductors and tower. The breakdown characteristics are difficult to summarize and more complex compared to the simple air gaps. The influence of floating conductor on breakdown voltage is different, and the factors are very complex, including size, position, electric field distribution, applied voltage type, humidity and so on. In this paper, an experiment device with the Rod-Plate-Rod gap is designed, the breakdown characteristics of the Rod-Plate-Rod gap under the lightning impulse voltage is studied. The effects of voltage polarity, plate size and position on breakdown characteristics are analyzed. Based on the experimental results, the plate influence on the gap breakdown characteristics is summarized, and the mechanism of the plate on the gap breakdown process is analyzed. Research results have shown that metal plate could enhance the lightning impulse breakdown voltage when the metal plate is in the middle of the gap. In particular, when the metal plate got closer to the rod, the breakdown voltage became lower than the Rod-Rod gap and this phenomenon is related to the polarity of the voltage. In addition, the plate increased the dispersion of breakdown time and changed the flashover route. The research results will have some guiding significance to practical application. The research results will have some guiding significance for the design of combined air gaps with conductors of floating potential.

articleTitle: Optimal Dspatch of Itegrated Eergy Sstem in a Small high-tech Idustrial Park
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the development of China's integrated energy system has attracted much attention. The research work of many scholars and many demonstration projects show that integrated energy has great application potential in future energy use scenarios. However, most of the current integrated energy and multi-energy complementary related businesses have unsatisfactory operating results. Most parks have the shortcomings of high operating and scheduling costs, and the disadvantages in economic benefits greatly limit the promotion and development of integrated energy. This paper takes the integrated energy system of a small high-tech industrial park in south China as an example, studies its economic analysis from initial investment to optimal dispatch, and uses intelligent optimization algorithms to calculate its detailed dispatch strategy during typical summer days. Through the comparative analysis of various schemes, the calculation results of this paper show that the application of integrated energy system in this type of park has good economic and environmental benefits, which provides a certain reference value for follow-up research.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Aging Indicators for Distribution Network XLPE Cables
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the practice in the diagnosis of distribution network XLPE cables, accelerated thermal aging tests have been carried out for a 10 kV XLPE (cross-linked polyethylene) cable to obtain the aging samples. Then, the Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FTIR), X-ray diffraction (XRD), differential scanning calorimetry(DSC), hermogravimetry (TG) and derivative thermogravimetric (DTG) tests have been carried out to characterize the aging state of the XLPE samples. Further, canonical correlation analysis (CCA) and PCCA (probabilistic CCA) have been used for the correlation analysis of all the test results. The correlation analysis indicates the similar trends: as the aging time increases, the correlation degree of the characterization curves decreases. All the FTIR, XRD, DSC, TG and DTG results can characterize the aging state in different degrees.
