Among them, the TG test cannot fully distinguish the aging state of the XLPE samples, and the DSC test has a relatively better linear distinction for the aging state of the XLPE samples.

articleTitle: Sliding Mode MPPT Control Based on Fuzzy Exponential Approach Rate for PV Cells
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the output characteristics of photovoltaic (PV) cells are affected by the environment, it is necessary to employ maximum power point tracking (MPPT) techniques for higher working efficiency. In view of the nonlinear characteristics of PV cells and the shortcomings of existing MPPT control methods, a sliding mode control method based on fuzzy exponential approach rate (SMC-FEAR) is proposed. In this paper, the principle of using Boost converter to realize MPPT is introduced in detail, and a PV power generation system with Boost converter as the main circuit is established in Matlab/ Simulink. The simulation results show the feasibility and high efficiency of the method, and it has good dynamic performance as well as reducing power oscillation significantly.

articleTitle: Research on The Influence of Photovoltaic Low Voltage Ride Through Characteristics on The Operation Characteristics of Receiving-end Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper first establishes a photovoltaic generator electromechanical transient simulation model considering low voltage ride through (LVRT) and its recovery process dynamic simulation, and then studies the impact of photovoltaic low voltage ride through characteristics on the transient voltage rise of new energy generator under large disturbance impact. Based on the analysis and summary of the model structure and corresponding mechanism of distributed new energy in China, the influence of photovoltaic low voltage ride through characteristics on the operation characteristics of receiving end power grid is studied.

articleTitle: Judgment of Transformation Rate for Electric Energy Meter Based on BP Neural Network and Adaboost Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transformation rate for electric energy meter is the premise of accurate metering. The meter for electric energy measurement in the distribution network provides the basic data for the calculation of the line loss. It is shown in survey that nearly 3% of the energy meters' transformation rate in the database are different from their actual rate. An inaccuracy transformation rate of electric energy meter will cause errors in calculating power and the line loss rate of low-voltage distribution network. However, it is not easy to find out the inaccuracy transformation rate in a database in daily management. To solve this problem, this paper presents a method based on adaboost and BP neural networks, and proves the feasibility of the method. BP neural networks serve as the weak classifiers. The weights of the sample and the weights of the weak classifiers are calculated based on adaboost algorithm. In the BP neural network for classification, the sample weights are utilized to adjust the error function of BP neural network to optimize the classification. A strong classifier is combined with weighting output of the weak classifiers. Computing results show that this method can precisely pick out electric energy meter with inaccuracy rate based on the power energy data. Accuracy of BP-adaboost classification is higher than that of the BP neural network, and the training time is greatly shortened. This method can improve the efficiency of line loss management in low-voltage distribution networks and greatly reduce consuming the manpower and material resources.

articleTitle: Research on Voltage Command Optimization Strategy of Chain-Circuit STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the transient voltage control method of cascaded STATCOM is studied, and the response characteristics under three-phase grounding short-circuit fault are analyzed, including bus voltage, DC system and control module under the condition of constant voltage command of STATCOM. Aiming at the problem in STATCOM transient voltage control that constant voltage command may be result in the voltage steady-state value deviation of converter station after short-circuit fault, a voltage command optimization method is proposed based on system state variables to change the transient voltage command value in real time in this paper. The simulation result shows that by adding voltage command optimization control, the voltage difference is not obvious and the effective value of the converter bus voltage basically the same pre-and post when occurred three-phase grounding transient fault.

articleTitle: Positive-Net-Damping Stability Criterion in Subsynchronous Oscillation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the subsynchronous oscillation has arouse wide attention, and the oscillation of turbo-generator will cause serious influence. In general, the eigenvalue method and time domain simulation method are often used to analyze. The two methods focus on the system overall stability, and detailed structure and parameters of each element are required. However, the influence of components on oscillation is often difficult to obtain. In this paper, the positive-net-damping method is used to analyze the influence of the line on the torsional vibration. This method combines the complex torque coefficient method and Nyquist criterion, and divides the whole system into mechanical and electrical subsystems. Then the influence of each component on the damping coefficient can be obtained explicitly. After derivation and simulation verification, the system stability becomes worse at complementary frequency of line resonance frequency, and the line resistance may lead to poor stability.

articleTitle: Transformer Capacity Selection Method for Transformers in Heavy Overload Area
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the demand for national electricity grows, the selection of distribution transformer capacity becomes more and more important. The economics and safety of distribution transformers directly affect the economic benefits of the entire power sector. Reasonable selection of transformer capacity can effectively guide the reasonable economic investment of relevant departments, and also plays a key role in the energy-saving operation of distribution transformers. This paper first clusters the distribution transformers working in different scenarios, and then performs load forecasting based on gray theory for each type of scenario to obtain the load forecast value after thirty years. A full life cycle cost model is established, taking into account all costs in the actual selection of transformers. After the actual data test, this method has good guiding significance for the selection of actual transformers.

articleTitle: Modeling and Optimization Design of a New Type of Electric Energy Actuator Based on Dielectric Barrier Discharge
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems in current electric power systems, such as too many moving parts, large parasitic energy loss and high failure rate, a clean-energy-based electric drive actuator-dielectric barrier discharge plasma actuator (DBDPA) is proposed in this paper. Compared with the existing electric drive system, its structure is simpler, the parasitic is smaller, and the failure rate is lower. The theory analysis and multi-physics coupling simulation for DBDPA are carried out to study the influence of the amplitude and frequency of the applied AC voltage on the driving force. It is found that the driving force of a small structure model shows a nonlinear growth trend with the increase of voltage, which can reach 13. 786mN at 10kV, meanwhile there is an optimal driving frequency, around 300Hz. By improving the traditional multi-DBD actuator and optimizing the three-electrode design of the driving force system, the results prove that the new optimized design is beneficial to reducing the interference between electrodes and effectively increasing the driving force by 36.67% to 67.10%. This research can provide reference and help for the improvement of ion drive performance and its application in the field of electric drive system.

articleTitle: Profit Loss Risk Modeling and Avoidance Decision of Power Selling Companies for Medium and Long-term Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the new round of electricity marketization reform, the opening up of the sales side market marks that the operation mode of China's power market has started the transformation from wholesale competition mode to retail competition mode, and also means that the competition risks that were borne by the generation side alone in the past transaction process now need to be shared by the sales side. With the aggravation of market competition in power selling side, the risk of profit loss of power selling companies is becoming increasingly prominent in medium and long-term trading. On the basis of considering the different scenarios such as the annual long-term alliance and clean energy market, aiming at the risk factors such as collusion of power generation companies, instability of clean energy power generation output and uncertainty of actual electricity demand of users, the risk degree is determined by conditional value at risk method, the design of risk aversion factor is proposed, and the risk aversion model of profit loss of multi types of power sales companies is constructed, and the decision of avoiding is given.

articleTitle: Research on Coordinated Control Strategy Considering stability risk of DC Sending and Receiving End Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of large-capacity ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission greatly improves the large-scale resource allocation capability, while also increases the complexity of security and stability control of the power grid. With the wide application of cross-region DC control strategies such as DC frequency control and power emergency support, the determination of DC control strategies must consider the influence of DC power changes on the stability of the sending and receiving end power grids. After analyzing the defects of existing control strategies for high power loss accidents, a coordinated control strategy is proposed that utilizes a variety of control resources in the entire power grid after the DC blocking happened, as well as considering the dynamic coupling characteristics of the DC sending and receiving end power grids. The actual power grid simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed control strategy.

Author Keywords: sending and receiving end power grids

articleTitle: Unbalance Response Analysis on the High Speed Flywheel Motor Supported by Active Magnetic Bearings
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rotor dynamics model of a composite flywheel storing energy of 25MJ driven by permanent magnetic motor with power of 400kW supported by active magnetic bearings running at the speed of 12000-24000rpm was built to carry out the unbalance response from Dyrobes. The flywheel shaft was lumped to 21 elements, and there are several major assumptions involved in the basic modeling of the rotor bearing system. There are three critical speeds of 1350rpm, 2650rpm and 13450rpm below 24000rpm. The forward whirl mode shapes are translational, conical and bending. The maximum amplitudes of the rotor under different unbalance conditions were obtained. The maximum vibration amplitude is at the speed of 13450rpm near the motor rotor magnetic bearing. These data are necessary to guide the design of AMB and protective bearings.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Control Strategy for Grid Connected DFIG System Based on Dissipated Energy Coefficient
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the low frequency oscillation of grid connected doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) system, a damping characteristic analysis method is proposed by dissipated energy coefficient (DEC). Based on energy function method, DEC shows the relationship between the dissipation of oscillating energy and system damping. Furthermore, it can be applied to analyze damping characteristic of multi-machine system. In a typical two areas & four machines system, damping characteristic among generators is studied by DEC. From the perspective of damping compensation, a fuzzy control strategy is proposed based on DEC. The optimal fuzzy control parameters are determined by DEC, which can maximize the system damping under inter-area oscillation. Finally, time-domain dynamic simulations verify that the additional damping control has a good effect on suppressing inter-area oscillation on a grid connected DFIG four-machine system under constant and random wind speed.

articleTitle: Research on Circuit Parameter Configuration of DC Superimposed Impulse Voltage Test on UHV DC Cable
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transient impulse voltage is an important threat to the insulation of UHV DC cables in operation. The selection and parameter calculation of equipment in the 800 kV DC cable voltage superposition test system were carried out. Studies have shown that, the specifications of the DC power supply and the impact power supply of the DC superimposed impulse voltage test system shall take into account the requirements of type test and pre-qualification test. The superposition of DC and different types of impulse voltage has different requirements for isolation resistor. Different DC blocking capacitance and cable sample length will change the impulse voltage amplitude and waveform obtained by the sample. The impulse insulation withstand level of the DC blocking capacitor and isolation resistor shall be equivalent to the cable sample. The research results provide a reference for the selection and configuration of the DC superimposed impulse voltage test device for UHV DC cables.

articleTitle: Adaptive Maintenance Technology for Abnormal Operation of Equipment / Working Condition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the operation and maintenance process of large pumped storage power station, the hidden defects are difficult to find in advance, which characterized by the mismatch between monitoring signal and equipment working condition / equipment state, or abnormal operation efficiency of equipment working condition / equipment state. And the computer monitoring system can only be used as a tool for fault confirmation. Adaptive intelligent maintenance technology for abnormal operation of equipment / working condition is proposed in this paper. The changes of multiple monitoring signals is got in the statistical period according to the specified action conditions. This statistical period is adaptively compared with the change time of the previous statistical period. It provides an important automatic detection method for the computer monitoring system to identify the hidden defect in advance. In addition, the standard methods of the command action test for the feedback loop, the execution loop and the command loop of the monitor equipment are provided in this paper.

articleTitle: Effect of Fluorinated Nano-Composite Coating on the Flashover Characteristics of Epoxy Insulators
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, plasma fluorination method is used to treat nano-TiO2 and SiC. After the coating is applied by dip coating, charge dissipation and flashover tests are carried out to study the effect of the coating on the charge dissipation of epoxy resin insulating material. The results show that the fluorine-containing functional groups grafted onto the nanofiller can change the charge distribution in the interface region, and at the same time increase the shallow traps of the composite material, reduce the deep traps, accelerate the dissipation of charge, reduce the accumulation of charge, and thus improve the flashover voltage of the composite material. At the same time, the increase in filler content and coating thickness can also increase the flashover voltage of the material. When the coating thickness is 600 μm and the fluorinated nano-SiC content is 5%, the flashover voltage is increased by 18.7% compared to the uncoated sample.

articleTitle: Customized High Reliability Power Supply Service Strategy for Smart Factories
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High-reliability power supply is of great significance to smart factories. An instantaneous voltage sag may cause damage to the control board and cause huge economic losses. For a long time, China's distribution network planning has divided different power supply reliability standards according to the administrative level or load density, and then proposed corresponding planning and construction principles. It does not consider the differentiated power supply reliability require-ments of regional end users, and it can not provide customized services. This paper first analyzes the main technical measures and existing problems to improve the reliability of distribution network power supply, then puts forward customized high-reliability power supply service strategies with power grid companies as the main body, and discusses its construction mode and business models. Finally, combined with the demonstration project, the specific implementation case is given in detail.

articleTitle: The Development of Smart Low-Voltage Distribution Network in Shenzhen
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Along with the development of the smart grid, Shenzhen has constructed a grid adopting the “three-phase energy gateway + metering master station”. This paper comprehensively introduces the construction of the smart grid in Shenzhen. Based on the practical operation, both benefits and disadvantages of the current network are summarized. This work presents valuable experiences when constructing the smart grid and is useful for future smart grid development.

articleTitle: Research on Identification Approach of Coherent Groups of Generators Based on Elbow Judgment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the large-scale power system transient stability analysis, dynamic equivalence approaches can be adopted to simplify the system in order to reduce the amount of numerical simulation calculation. However, the traditional dynamic equivalence methods mostly judge the number of clusters of coherent generators based on experience. For this reason, according to the gap static algorithm (GSA), an approach of coherent groups of generators based on elbow judgment was proposed in this paper. This approach can effectively identify the optimal number of clusters of coherent generators, thereby providing the basis for dynamic equivalence. The results from PSD-BPA based simulation of IEEE 39 bus test system showed that the clustering results were reasonable. The equivalent system was able to fully reflect the dynamic characteristics of the original system, and the effect of dynamic equivalence was ideal, which verified the effectiveness of this approach.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Optimization Method in Distribution Network Feeder Reconfiguration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Feeder reconfiguration is one of the most important method to optimize the distribution system operation. The efficiency of finding the solution by optimization is the key point for solving feeder recontiguration problem. However, different optimization methods have its own Pros and Cons. Such as, the local search ability of the discrete particle swarm optimization is weak and the global search performance of the ant colony system is also not strong. Furthermore, it is difficult to avoid their disadvantages only by modifying the rules. In this paper, a hybrid optimization method based on ant colony system and particle swarm optimization method is proposed. The proposed method applies a novel combination theory to combine the ant colony system and the discrete particle swarm optimization together rather than use them separately in different stages. The selection rules in the proposed method not only based on the pheromone trails like ants but also consider the velocity and position such as particles. The conclusions of the tests are verified the good performance of the hybrid optimization method.

articleTitle: Study on The Characteristics of Reactor Core Vibration Acoustic Signal under Different Excitation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The vibration and noise produced in the operation of power reactor contain a lot of state information of the equipment, and the deformation of its internal structure will cause the abnormality of vibration signal and acoustic signal in the abnormal working state, which provides important characteristic parameters for the uninterrupted detection of the equipment. Starting from the vibration and noise of the reactor core, the vibration and noise signals of the core under the normal working conditions of power frequency and the excitation of harmonic and DC magnetic bias abnormal working conditions are measured by establishing the vibration and noise test platform of the core model, and the correlation analysis and comparison of the vibration and noise data after the Fourier transform are carried out by using the three-dimensional waterfall diagram. The test results show that the frequency-domain distribution of the noise signal of the iron core under different excitation varies significantly. The noise signal can represent the operation state information of the iron core reflected by the vibration signal, and the Pearson correlation coefficient of the vibration and noise data reaches 0.701, showing a strong positive correlation.

articleTitle: A Method of Fault Diagnosis for Secondary System Based on Multi-Source Fault Information
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy and maintenance efficiency of fault diagnosis for secondary equipment in active distribution networks, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on multi-source fault information. The multi-source fault information used in this paper includes Real-time fault information and historical fault information. Firstly, the proposed method extracts the fault features from multi-source fault information. Secondly, the probabilities of the suspected components are obtained based on Directed Bipartite Graph and Bayesian algorithm. Thirdly, the confidence coefficient of the suspected components is obtained by data mining based on Apriori algorithm. Finally, a fault component diagnosis model is established, and the output of the diagnosis model is the certainty of the target components. The target component with the highest certainty is considered as the fault component. In order to detect the effectiveness and the feasibility of the proposed method, this paper conducts a fault diagnosis case and the diagnosis results demonstrated that the proposed fault diagnosis method can obtain good discriminant result even if the information completeness is insufficient.

articleTitle: Impact Suppression Method for PV Power Generation Grid-reconnection Based on DC Voltage Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic(PV) power system plays an important role in emergency control as well as fault restoration of power systems by its fast power control capability. Nevertheless, despite a lot of methods for low-voltage ride-through(LVRT) of PV power system, the disconnection of PV under certain degrees of failure and duration cannot be avoided due to the limitation of impact resistance of power electronic devices. In order to avoid the deterioration of the operating status of power grid and give full play to the control ability of PV, PV should be quickly reconnected to the grid after the grid impact is eliminated. Since there is a certain delay in restoring the power output after the shutdown of PV, the shutdown should be avoided after PV is grid-disconnected. Whereas, the operating status of the disconnected and non-stop PV changes continuously with the output of the PV panels, the control of the inverter, and the duration of grid disconnection. Its output may fluctuate greatly after reconnecting to the grid, causing an impact on the power grid. At present, the impact of PV reconnection and the measures to address it have not received much attention. Therefore, the disconnection and reconnection process of PV power system is theoretically analyzed in this paper. The mechanism and influencing factors of current impact caused by PV reconnection are studied. An impact suppression method for PV reconnection based on DC voltage control is proposed. The simulation results are used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. The proposed method realizes the stable restoration of power after PV reconnection by suppressing the DC voltage of PV during disconnection, and effectively avoids the current impact of PV reconnection.

articleTitle: Seamless Transfer Control Strategy of Multi-Energy Complementary Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this study, a simple modified droop-v/f control strategy is proposed for the master inverter of a multi-energy complementary microgrid. Which can realize no impact seamless transfer, and enhance the power quality. By the simple change of the droop coefficient gradually, the system can relize seamless transfer between two modes. Which to provide voltage and frequency support for the slave inverters in island mode. Pre-synchronization provides a more friendly way for the system reconnection when the grid fault eliminate. The proposed control strategy is described in detail, and its effectiveness is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: The Protection Scheme for the Novel Flexible Short Circuit Current Suppression Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper discusses on the protection scheme for the novel flexible short circuit current suppression technology, which applies the new-type fast circuit breaker. The challenges of rapidity, selectivity and reliability for the protection are analyzed. The technology principle of the protection is formulated. The improvement project and the logic coordination under different space levels and time scales is proposed. These new method is to guarantee the safe and sound operation of the power system in the new scenario that applies the novel flexible short circuit current suppression technology.

articleTitle: Development and Characteristic Test of a 500kV Wideband Highvoltage Divider
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A 500kV wide-band high-voltage divider for transient overvoltage measurement was developed. To improve the accuracy of the overvoltage measuement, the high-voltage arm of the developed voltage divider is based on a standard capacitor. By arranging equalizing electrodes reasonably inside the standard capacitor, the field strength distribution inside the voltage divider is optimized, and the overall size of the voltage divider is reduced. In order to optimize the dynamic performance of the voltage divider, it is equipped with excellent low-voltage arm components. The consistency of scale factor under AC voltage and impulse voltage for the divider is good. It can measure AC voltage with linearity of 0.2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> under 500kV and measure lightning impulse voltage with linearity of 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">00</sub> under 1200kV. The difference between AC voltage scale factor and impulse voltage scale factor is less than 0.01%. It can be used to measure transient overvoltage in substation and calibrate the noncontact transient voltage sensor and electric field sensor for field test.

articleTitle: Energy System Time Series Data Quality Maintenance System Based on Data Mining Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With improvement of science and technology, energy system becomes more intelligent and data scale becomes larger, so an efficient and reliable quality data management has implications for energy system. This paper proposes a grid time series data quality maintenance system based on data mining technology. In view of different characteristics of data structure in different systems, decision tree algorithm and data outlier detection methods are combined to improve efficiency of data detection while quickly locating issue type, which is convenient for data repair and improvement.

articleTitle: Identification of Abnormal PV Output Power Based on kernel Density Estimation and Consistency Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The accuracy of PV output power is essential for the performance improvement of PV electricity station. Facing the fact that the original dataset of PV output power contains a lot number of abnormal data, an identification method is proposed based on kernel density estimation. First, the main factors that can influence the output power of PV system are recognized, i.e. solar radiation and module temperature. And then, the kernel density estimation method is applied to derive the joint distribution function of PV output power, solar irradiance and module temperature. Finally, according to the narrowest interval principal, the rational range of PV output power is given. With the real operational data from a PV power station in Qionghai, Hainan, the superiority of the proposed method identifying the abnormal PV output power in terms of precision, effectiveness and practicability is demonstrated by comparing it with the traditional 3-σ method.

articleTitle: Research on The Transient Characteristic for Typical Wind - Thermal - Bundled System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the transient stability problem of the wind - thermal - bundled system, the wind power absorption capacity and the delivery capacity are seriously insufficient. In view of this, firstly the impact of the wind power on stability characteristic and stability mechanism of the wind - thermal bundled system are analyzed. Then combined with the planned delivery channel and the optimal stability control strategy, the simulation is conducted with PSASP. The results show that the planned delivery channel and the optimal stability control strategy can significantly improve the wind power absorption capacity and the delivery capacity, and effectively improve the voltage stability and the system damping.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment of HVDC Receiving-end System Considering Wind Power Output Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The ever-increasing proportion of HVDC and wind power has a great impact on the reliability of the receiving-end power system. It is essential to consider the HVDC transmission system power flow when assessing the reliability of the receiving-end power system integrated with wind power. Considering the symmetry characteristic of HVDC system, a novel HVDC system reliability model, which uses the number of available converter units for equivalent failure, is used to assess the reliability to reduce the complexity of the calculation. The uncertainty of wind power will be modelled based on the wind speed which follows to Weibull distribution. Then, the AC-DC coupling equation considering converter units and the optimal power flow model of AC-DC coupling system are introduced. Moreover, based on the optimal power flow model of AC-DC coupling system, the EENS is calculated by Monte-Carlo method. Furthermore, the reliability of receiving-end power system and nodal reliability is assessed with five different scenarios in a modified IEEE-RTS-24 system.

articleTitle: Research on Wind-Photovoltaic Output Power Aggregation Method Considering Correlation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the computational efficiency of power system time series simulation, the redundancy of wind power and photovoltaic time series data should be reduced. At present, the time series data of wind-photovoltaic are aggregated separately, wind and pv correlation is not involved, reducing the accuracy and reliability of high-proportion renewable energy power system simulation. For this reason, This paper presents a aggregation method involving wind power and photovoltaic correlation. Based on wind and photovoltaic power historical data, firstly, based on kernel density estimation method and Copula theory, generate the wind-photovoltaic kernel density function and the joint probability density function, by sampling the joint probability density function to obtain N groups of typical daily curves. Take a provincial power grid as an example, a comparative analysis was made between the proposed wind-photovoltaic correlation aggregation method and the separate wind-photovoltaic aggregation method, The results show that the aggregation series can not only accurately reflect the characteristics of original wind-photovoltaic output power, but also maintain the correlation between wind-photovoltaic output power, which has certain engineering application value.

articleTitle: Measurement of the Resistive Component of Grounding Impedance by Square Wave Excitation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The resistive component is the main component of grounding impedance, and yet there is no direct measurement method for it. Based on the square wave response of grounding systems, a direct measurement method for the resistive component of the grounding impedance is proposed. Firstly, the upper limit of the inductive component of grounding impedance has been derived theoretically. Moreover, a simplified estimation method has also been proposed with examples. Secondly, the effectiveness of square wave to measure the resistive component has been analyzed by Laplace transform. Moreover, verification in both laboratory and field has been carried out. The results show that the square wave method accurately measures the resistive component of the grounding impedance, which avoids the interference of mutual inductance during measurement. The square wave method serves as a good complement to the traditional measurement of grounding impedance.

articleTitle: Sensitive Load Identification Method Based on Voltage Sag Monitoring Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage sags have a huge impact on high-end companies with sensitive loads. The quality of the power supply affects the quality of the company’s products. However, the current research on the identification method of sensitive loads is more subjective. In order to qualitatively analyze the proportion of sensitive load, a sensitive load identification method based on voltage sag monitoring data is proposed. According to the change and recovery of active power before and after the sag of the electric transmission line, the active power segmentation method based on singular value decomposition is used to accurately locate the start and end moments of active power drop. The proportion of recoverable and non-recoverable sensitive loads on the line are obtained. The voltage sag monitoring data in a certain province and MATLAB/Simulink model were selected for simulation verification. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper has a certain ability to identify sensitive loads.

articleTitle: Identification of Voltage Sag Sources Based on Wavelet Transform Sample Entropy and Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate identification of voltage sag sources is the basis for the allocation of responsibilities and governance decisions for voltage sags. In order to solve the problem of voltage sag sources identification, this paper proposes a voltage sag sources identification method based on the combination of wavelet transform sample entropy and extreme learning machine. First, wavelet transform is used to decompose the voltage signal, and the sample entropy is extracted from its approximate coefficients and detail coefficients to form a feature vector; then based on the extreme learning machine theory, a voltage sag sources identification model is established, and the feature vector is input into the identification model to identify the type of voltage sag source. Through simulation analysis, the performance of the proposed method is evaluated by the confusion matrix and its evaluation index, which proves the correctness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Strategy for Mode Transition of Energy Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As more and more renewable energy source connected to the grid, ratio of renewable power is becoming higher. So renewable power may provide power for local load in grid when the utility grid malfunctions. To achieve this, renewable power converter or energy storage converter should be able to transit mode between grid-connecting mode and islanding mode seamlessly and smoothly. This paper proposes a method of mode transition that meets the above requirements. The method is based on integral value preloading and voltage pre-synchronization. Effectiveness of proposed method is demonstrated through simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Data Driven-based Operational Risk Control System for Whole Process Risk Prevention
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Mobile Internet and its applications have greatly promoted the process of social development and facilitated people's production and life. However, the dark industry chain attached to the network is also undermining the dividends brought by the Mobile Internet to the whole society, bringing risks that cannot be ignored by the operation and application of the Mobile Internet. Therefore, it is very necessary to establish a sound risk control system by Mobile Internet operators to avoid and resist the risks that may occur in the operation process. In this paper, a certain type of App is taken as an example to elaborate the elements and significance of establishing an operational risk control system based on big data. Through the study and discussion of data architecture, model, rules and flow involved in the process of operational risk control, the method of operational risk warning and prevention through data analysis is proposed.

articleTitle: Efficient Operation of Electricity Market Considering the Flexible Load Based on Improved PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The flexible load is becoming the popular in electricity market. As the participants from the demand side, the flexible loads submit bids about the price and the quantity. These flexible ones don’t have to be satisfied completely. They are cleared according to the generators’ offering and the optimal power flow. The network constraints and the stability constraints also have to be taken into consideration. It has been formulated as a complicated optimization problem which doesn’t reach the convergence efficiently. In this paper, the improved PSO (particle swarm optimization) is proposed for the global optimization problem. The integrated simulated annealing market can make the PSO searching converge to the global best point in a gradually stable process. The simulation has confirmed the feasibility and the efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Fast Inductance Extraction for Sweeping Coil Positions Based on Nonconforming Finite Element Method and Dual Formulations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Computing inductance parameters of electromagnetic devices for different coil positions and angles is a practical problem commonly encountered. Typical applications include finding the mutual inductances for different relative positions of the coils of a wireless power transfer system. Due to a lot of sample relative positions of the coils need to be swept, it is really a time-consuming process for obtaining all the inductance values for each position. In this paper, firstly new efficient dual formulations are proposed where the global finite element matrices are totally the same thus the global assembly process needs to be performed once, which is also the case for the factorization when using sparse direct solvers. When sweeping different position parameters of the coils after translation or rotation, a sliding mesh technique is adopted to greatly save the CPU time to avoid regenerating different finite element meshes. Two test cases are illustrated using the proposed dual formulations and remesh-free nonconforming finite element method, a great acceleration can be achieved and the computed inductance parameters are also accurate.

articleTitle: Fast Power System Dynamic Simulations Based on Differential Transform Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Differential Transform Method (DTM) is a numerical method to derive the analytical solution of the initial valued dynamic equations. It is used to get the coefficients of power series by the transformation rules instead of calculating the high order derivatives. In this paper, a novel dynamic simulation method for power systems based on the DTM is proposed. Variables of power system differential algebraic equations (DAEs) are derived into the form of the power series, whose coefficients are solved by the DTM. More importantly, the nonlinear algebraic equation (AE) can be derived as power series of network variables whose coefficients are linear. Meanwhile, a MATLAB simulation program for power system dynamics (MATDYN) is developed, which includes the models of generators, motors and ZIP-loads. Verified by the IEEE New England 39-bus power system, the DTM can significantly improve the speed of power system dynamic simulations.

articleTitle: Research on Clustering Algorithm of Load Decomposition Considering Harmonic Characteristics in Power Safety Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of smart grid, power grid security monitoring is becoming more and more important. Non-intrusive load monitoring is helpful to understand the operating status of electrical equipment and is of great significance to the economic and safe operation of the power grid.This paper provide a non-intrusive load safety monitoring method for smart grid based on clustering algorithm. Based on improved generalized likelihood ratio detection, this paper introduces the voting window to establish an event detector model, and introduces event detection metrics to determine the value of related parameters and obtain the best event detector. In view of the difficulty in distinguishing electrical appliances with similar power in load decomposition, this paper uses DFT to extract the harmonic characteristics of bus current signals, and establishes a load feature library combined with active power. Then affinity propagation clustering algorithm is used to establish the load feature library to realize the load decomposition. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on REDD data sets.

articleTitle: Cooperative Fire Extinguishing Technology of Battery Energy Storage Device in Cluster
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The electrochemical energy storage device is equipped with an independent fire extinguishing device and distributed independently. In this paper, a connection pipeline and a bypass solenoid valve are arranged on the fire extinguishing equipment of the electrochemical energy storage device distributed in a distributed manner to connect the fire extinguishing devices into a network. Through the standardized graph theory path selection technology, the automatic detection and control of the fire-extinguishing medium cooling of the fire-extinguishing equipment in each electrochemical energy storage device is realized, which is controlled by the solenoid valve from far to near according to the distance of the connection path. The distributed electrochemical energy storage device does not need to reserve a large margin of gas cylinders, and the distributed cooling device realizes standby mutual benefit and collaborative cooling through this technology, which improves the reliability of the fire-extinguishing device and reduces the cost of fire-extinguishing equipment of the electrochemical energy storage device.

articleTitle: Lean Operation and Maintenance Evaluation Technology of Power Grid Equipment Based on Improved Big Data Cleaning Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the extensive application of information acquisition and transmission technology in power system, the extraction of equipment basic data becomes feasible. From the perspective of lean operation and maintenance, this paper systematically combs the scale structure, equipment quality dimension, equipment efficiency dimension and operation and maintenance cost dimension of distribution network equipment assets, and uses correlation analysis and principal component analysis to deeply mine the index data to study the power grid Data relationship of equipment related information. A data stream cleaning method based on sliding window is proposed to detect abnormal data sequence and clean data. The clustering factors are calculated by principal component analysis method, and 55 kinds of data are reduced. Finally, a set of 16 principal component data processing flow of distribution network equipment status is constructed. Finally, the feasibility and effectiveness of the evaluation index system and evaluation method are verified by comprehensive evaluation of the equipment status of a certain distribution network.

articleTitle: A Novel Scenario Reduction Method for Static Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The scenario-based method has been widely used to model the uncertainty in power systems. To decrease the complexity and computational burden for the evaluation and solution of the stochastic static voltage stability problem due to the integration of renewable energy sources, we propose a novel scenario reduction method in this paper. Compared with the other scenario reduction method, the load margins of the scenarios to Saddle Node Bifurcation (SNB) are used to group all the scenarios, as well as the distances of the wind power output, which can avoid the elimination of the extreme scenarios for the voltage stability problem. The central scenarios obtained by the proposed scenario reduction method are more representative for the voltage stability problem. Two tests on the IEEE 118-bus power system are carried out to demonstrate the performance of the proposed scenarios reduction method.

articleTitle: An Improved Short-Term Load Forecasting Method Considering Thermal Inertia Effect
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the thermal inertia of the mass temperature and the inertia of human temperature perception, the load is affected by the temperatures with the coupling of multiple timescales, and load variation tends to lag behind temperature variation. In the proposed method, the temperature variable used in the short-term load forecasting model is modified as a function of present and historical temperatures. To enhance the prediction power of the modified temperature, genetic algorithm is adopted to get the optimal parameters of the thermal inertia effect modification function. The testing results show that the proposed method can improve the accuracy of short-term load forecasting.

articleTitle: Research on Low-latency Power Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy Internet, the business types of power grid are increasing day by day, and the demand of multi service bearing is prominent. The mode of multi network hybrid networking puts forward higher requirements for power communication network. Power communication network is becoming more and more important in enterprise operation, and the requirement of low delay of business interaction in power grid production is becoming more and more strict. Compared with the traditional time division multiplexing network, Internet protocol/multi-protocol label switching (IP/MPLS) can improve the performance of data transmission in multi service scenarios and ensure the security of service transmission. In order to improve the carrying capacity and operation efficiency of power communication network under the energy Internet environment, this paper carries out the technical verification of using IP/MPLS technology to build a new generation of power communication network with low delay and high reliability, so as to improve the control ability of business data transmission and further support the construction of energy Internet.

articleTitle: Security Risk Assessment of Power System Based on Latin Hypercube Sampling and Daily Peak Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continued growth of electricity demand, the power system is trending towards extreme operation increasingly. In order to analyze the impact of load changes on power system operating risks, a novel power system security risk assessment algorithm is proposed based on Latin hypercube sampling and daily peak load forecasting. Firstly, the gated recurrent neural network combining dynamic time warping is applied to forecast the daily peak load. Then a Markov-based component failure model is constructed and the component state is determined by Latin hypercube sampling. Finally, the optimal load reduction and security risk of the power system is calculated. The simulation results show that, compared to Monte Carlo sampling, Latin Hypercube sampling requires fewer samples to achieve the same accuracy. Furthermore, it can be found by observing the fluctuation of power system security risk and daily peak load that their trend of changing is basically the similar but the amplitude is different. When the load level is low, there is a “compression” effect on the power system risk changes, and when the load level is high, there is a “stretch” effect. Therefore, accurate load forecasting can determine the risk trend of the system in advance, which is beneficial to the safe and stable operation of the power system.

articleTitle: Urban Distribution Systems Planning Considering Integrated Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The implementation of integrated load forecasting has great impact on the planning of urban substations. In this context, this paper proposes a planning model of urban substations considering integrated load forecasting. Loads are consisted of traditional loads and electrified loads, wherein traditional loads are predicted by regression analysis methods on the basis of historical load data. Meanwhile, electrified loads are mainly considered to be electric vehicles, which are predicted by the system dynamics method. And then based on the obtained whole loads, multi-year planning of distribution systems is carried out in practical situation. Numerical results in some practical city show that the effectiveness of the proposed planning method.

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of Medium and Low Voltage Distribution Network Based on Power Big Data Interconnection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The equipment in medium and low voltage distribution network are complicated, located at wide range of points and their switch conditions are variable. Restricted by traditional management methods, inaccurate topological relation makes it hard to achieve lean management in medium and low voltage distribution network. The automatic identification of topological relation in medium and low voltage distribution network takes significant role in sorting out the distribution network ledger under 10kV completely and offering technical support for enhancing the management of distribution network. With respect of equipment load rate, power supply reliability, voltage qualification rate and line loss rate of the same period, we establish the goal of collecting all the data successfully and automatically, synchronizing all the files, connecting all the relation among the rates, reaching all the indexes and monitoring all the anomalies. We make unified use of the power grid information and resource, fully excavate the value of smart meters, accelerate the development of smart terminals and the promotion of new technologies such as broadband carrier over power line. We finally realize automatic acquisition, online monitoring, rapid elimination and objective evaluation in grid-based distribution network. It will provide strong support for scientific planning, intelligent control and smart operation in distribution network. It also promotes cross-border integration of distribution network and information network. The management efficiency and development quality of medium and low voltage distribution network will be comprehensively improved, as a result.

articleTitle: Review on Technology of Seawater Variable Speed Pumped Storage Generator Unit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The working principle and technical characteristics of variable speed pumped-storage generator are very different from that of conventional fixed speed pumped-storage generator. Its core technologies include variable speed mode, variable speed adjustment range, ac excitation system components and topological structure, rotor end fixed form, rotor winding wire rod and so on. Based on the Dawanshan island variable speed pumped storage generator as an example, the key technology of variable speed generator has carried on the comparison and analysis, and combined with its own requirements such as technology, economy, and development of variable speed generator, the key technical parameters and technical route were chosen, this paper provides reference for the design of the same type of variable speed generator.

articleTitle: Performance Test Method of Condenser based on Virtual Power Dispatching Techonology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Generator automatic voltage control device (AVC) is an automatic voltage and reactive power optimization control terminal on the power plant side. Aiming at improving the performance of generator automatic voltage control device, this paper introduces a detection method of AVC substation performance based on virtual dispatching terminal environment. During the testing, the upper computer of redundant power plant is connected to the virtual dispatching terminal environment to simulate the sending instructions of AVC master station, the behavior of AVC sub stations and the excitation system of generators. The performance of AVC substation is evaluated according to the feedback adjustment results, which can effectively detect the abnormal behavior of AVC substation in power plant.

articleTitle: The Designation and Development of Automatic Power Control System with Energy Storage Resources
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The automatic power control (APC) system is a real-time control system regarded as the expansion and upgrade system of the automatic generation control (AGC) system. APC controls all controllable resources whether they are generators or not, and follows the same regulation disciplines in AGC (such as control performance strategy standards, CPS). Thus, system gains more regulation capacity and cost less than built generators, leading a safer and more economical system operation mode. This paper introduces the framework of APC system, as well as its data flow. The control model modeling method and control strategy design method considering the regulation characteristics of various resources are explained in detail in this article. Especially, the strategies to control energy-store resources and their control models are described. The APC system is applied to control a province-class simulation power system. At last power system fault cases are simulated, and the results show the performances of APC system.

articleTitle: A Bi-Level Optimal Allocation and Dispatching Method of Active Distribution Network Considering Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a bi-level optimal dispatching method of active distribution network considering electric vehicles. Timing models of distribution generators, load and electric vehicles were employed. The optimal allocation and dispatching model was established. The master problem determined locating and sizing of distribution generators, capacitors banks and charging facilities and the optimization objectives were minimum investment and best stability of electrical system. The subproblem determined the state of every components at different times, such as the state of distribution generator, capacitors banks and tap of on load tap changer, and the optimization objective was the minimum operation cost. To improve the solution efficiency, the distflow branch power flow model and its second order cone transformation was employed. And CPLEX was used to solve subproblem. Finally, simulation tests based on IEEE 33 buses distribution system were carried out to verify the proposed method.

articleTitle: Self-adaption Technology for Abnormal Operation of Pumped Storage Power Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is difficult to find the defects of abnormal operation sequence or jitter of monitoring signals in the operation and maintenance of Large Pumped Storage Power Plant. With the development of this hidden defect, the main equipment may be shut down. In this paper, the adaptive diagnosis technology of pumped storage power plant equipment change is proposed, which can be used as the supplement of computer monitoring system. It can generate error code and output alarm adapt by means of automatic detection and control. It provides technical support for the operation and maintenance personnel to quickly locate the defective equipment and find the defect characterization. In addition, the standard inspection and maintenance methods for monitoring signal jitter and abnormal equipment action sequence of the equipment to which the monitoring signal belongs are also provided, which provides an effective technical means for rapid processing of defects characterized by multiple equipment action sequence abnormalities and monitoring signal jitter.

articleTitle: A Fault Detection Method for MMC-HVDC Grid Based on Transient Energy of DC Inductor and Submodule Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The DC fault protection is a key technology for the development of modular multilevel converter based high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) grid. Few of the existing fault detection methods are suitable for MMC-HVDC Grid, and the problems such as difficulty in threshold setting and high requirements on hardware are also not neglectable. In this paper, a fault detection method based on transient energy is proposed, in which the characteristics of the transient energy of capacitance of submodules and DC inductance of one converter station are used to set the DC short circuit fault detection criterion. By the proposed method, DC fault detection and fault location can be realized in a short time, and the detection threshold values are easy to set. Besides, the proposed method has a strong immunity to disturbances such as lightning strikes. Simulation results for a four-terminal MMC-HVDC Grid through PSCAD/EMTDC verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Active Dispatch Method of Wind Farm with DFIGs Considering Reactive Power Regulation Capability
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the analysis of the reactive power regulation capability of wind farm with DFIGs, this paper proposes a method of active power scheduling that maximizes the reactive power limit of wind farms. When the predicted value of the active power output of the wind farm is less than the active dispatch instruction issued by the control center station, power generation is performed according to the principle of maximum wind energy tracking; when the predicted value of the active output is greater than the dispatch instruction, the Lagrangian function method is used to prove that the average distributed active power At power, the reactive power limit of the wind farm with DFIGs is the largest. According to this principle, the active power is distributed, so as to maximize the reactive power regulation capacity of the wind farm. Finally, a simulation analysis is carried out, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by comparing with the traditional active scheduling method.

articleTitle: Ultraviolet Absorption Spectroscopy Measurement of Gas Mixture of SF6 Decomposition Components SO2 and CS2
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> are both characteristic gas components that represent the internal insulation state of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> insulated electrical equipment. Their accurate quantification is of great significance for judging the type and severity of internal insulation faults of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> electrical equipment. The ultraviolet (UV) differential absorption spectroscopy system for trace gas detection was built. The UV absorption spectral of single SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and their mixture were collected by using the system. Then through the analysis of UV absorption spectral data of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, the quantitative detection method of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixed gas was proposed and verified. The results show that the method can achieve the hybrid quantitative detection of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, and the maximum absolute detection error of CS<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> is less than 3.2nL/L. The research results laid the foundation for the application of UV differential absorption spectroscopy to the on-line monitoring of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> characteristic decomposition components and the fault diagnosis of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> electrical equipment.

articleTitle: Power Prediction Based on Drosophila Optimized Similar Day Method and Random Forest Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Short-term forecast of power load is an important work in power system. Improving the accuracy of load prediction is of great significance to the safe and reliable operation of power systems. Based on the traditional similar day method, this paper proposes to improve the Drosophila similar day method to improve the similarity calculation, and combines the improved similar day method and the random forest method to construct a combined prediction method. Combined with a load case in a certain area, through comparison with other combined prediction methods, it is found that the improved similar-day random forest method proposed in this paper has the highest prediction accuracy and the shortest time consumption, which shows the applicability and effectiveness of the combined prediction model proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Optimal Connecting Nodes Planning Based on the Risk Assessment of Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Risk assessment can obtain the risk and economic indicators of power grid, and it plays an important role on power grid planning and decision-making. Traditional load planning rarely considered the impacts of different types of load's access locations in the system from the perspective of operating risk. Therefore, this paper improved the traditional load shedding model in power grid risk assessment: Firstly, Take into account the impacts of load types on the load shedding strategy. Then, by traversing the accessible nodes and calculating the change of risk indicators under each access scheme, a planning method of optimal accessed point of load based on the results of power grid risk assessment is proposed. The results of the IEEE-RBTS test system showed that the method could obtain the optimal connecting nodes scheme with the least impact on the system risk and economic indicators effectively.

articleTitle: Bus Reactive Load Prediction Based on Random Forests
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The change of reactive load is complex and the power factor changes at any time. The establishment of accurate reactive load forecasting model can not only improve the reactive power management level of the grid, but also play an important role in intelligent dispatching, automatic voltage control and economic operation of the system. At present, reactive power optimization of online power grid mostly uses real-time data obtained by SCADA system, which belongs to post-correction control, and the control strategy has poor timeliness, so it is difficult to deal with the current situation of power grid operation with increasing uncertainty of both source and charge. In this paper, the characteristics of reactive load are analyzed, and a method of bus reactive load prediction based on Random Forest (RF) is proposed, which takes online reactive load obtained by SCADA as input and output data, uses historical data to train the RF reactive power prediction model to obtain the reactive power load the next day. The experimental results show that this method can accurately predict the reactive load of bus and makes a contribution to the initiative and refinement of power grid regulation.

articleTitle: Design of UHV Long-distance GIL Fault Location System Based on Ultrasonic Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The length of the single-phase line of the Sutong GIL tunnel is about 6km, and the length of a single gas chamber is about 100m. Because the GIL adopts a fully sealed design, it is difficult for the existing methods to accurately locate the fault when discharge and overheat faults occur during operation. In order to meet the long-distance fault location requirement of Sutong GIL, this paper analyzed the breakdown, propagation and attenuation characteristics of ultrasonic signals in GIL through test. The test results show that the frequency of the ultrasonic signal generated by breakdown should be distributed in the frequency of 40$\sim$60kHz, 100$\sim$150kHz, 230$\sim$250kHz and 500$\sim$530kHz. In addition, the attenuation of ultrasonic signal is 70% and 89% after passing through the gas chamber basin and expansion joint. Based on the above research results, this paper designed the configuration and parameters of the sensors, communication scheme and protection scheme of the long-distance GIL ultrasonic fault location system in detail, and verified the fault location function of the system through engineering app-cations.

articleTitle: Cooperative Planning Method of Distribution Network and DGs Considering Operation of Energy Storage Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to satisfy planning requirements of distribution network with high penetration renewable energy sources, a bi-level optimization problem with multiple objectives is proposed to deal with the optimization problem of distribution network planning from three different perspectives, including economy, clean energy, and reliability. Based on hierarchic optimization, in the proposed bi-level optimization model, the upper level is adopted to optimize planning scheme for networks, renewables, and energy storage systems (ESSs) cooperatively. The lower level enables us integrate operation strategies of ESSs into the upper level model. To increase the efficiency, the typical scenarios are adopted to capture the time-variable nature and deal with the uncertainty of renewables and load demands. Fuzzy multi-objective hybrid algorithm is adopted to solve the proposed multi-level mixed integer problem. Results obtained by numerical cases are presented and discussed, where the availabilities of the proposed model and method are verified.

articleTitle: Optimization of Lightning Warning Effectiveness Assessment Method for Atmospheric Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Atmospheric electric field instrument is often used for lightning warning. The lightning alert is issued by setting the threshold of electric field. Because the threshold value directly affects the accuracy of the warning, the optimal threshold can be determined by evaluating the effectiveness of lightning early warning. But the conventional evaluation method is to match the alarm information with the lightning activity information. The method does not consider the operation state and network communication of the electric field instrument itself. There is a certain deviation in the evaluation accuracy, which affecting the optimal threshold. In this paper, the effectiveness evaluation method of the conventional lightning early warning is optimized. The evaluation method based on the abnormal operation state and data reception rate of the instrument is proposed. The original evaluation results are modified. The electric field data of Jiangsu in 2017 are analyzed. The results show that the evaluation method proposed in this paper can not only evaluate the early-warning effect of the electric field instrument more accurately, but also the efficiency of the lightning early-warning algorithm based on the atmospheric electric field instrument is improved.

articleTitle: Research of Overheat Defect Detection on the Infrared Thermal Image of Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The relative temperature difference method is a quantitative analysis method for infrared image defect diagnosis of power equipment, but it is easy to misjudge or omit the defect of voltage overheat type. Therefore, this paper proposes a sliding window technology combined with the relative temperature difference method and the same kind of comparison method to diagnose and classify different types of faults. The process is that the window slides in the three-phase equipment A, B and C, and the maximum temperature value is selected respectively. The lowest temperature in the same position is taken as the normal temperature of the equipment, while the rest are taken as the hot spot temperature. According to the position of the window, the overheat type of the hot spot temperature is determined. In the process of defect diagnosis, the current transformer is taken as the research object, and the relative temperature difference of hot spot temperature or the temperature difference of the same part of the equipment is calculated according to the corresponding overheat type to diagnose the equipment. Experiments show that this method can automatically identify the defect location, defect type and defect level of CT, and realize the intelligent and efficient defect diagnosis of CT.

articleTitle: Monitoring Method of Injection-type Generator Stator-to-earth Insulation State in Neutral Point Combined Grounding Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the incompatibility of the existing protection method for the measurement of the ground insulation state under the combined grounding method of the generator stator neutral point (resistance parallel reactor on the secondary side of the grounding transformer), an injection-type monitoring method of insulation state of generator stator to ground in neutral point combined grounding mode is proposed in this paper. By connecting the variable frequency power injecting AC variable frequency signal supplied to the secondary side of the arc suppression coil reactor at the neutral point of the generator, it can search the resonance frequency of stator inductance and capacitance, and calculate the insulation state caused by the insulation damage of stator winding. So it can achieve the purpose that generator stator's insulation state can be real-time monitored. Through modeling and analysis in PSCAD/EMTDC, this method can be adapted to the measurement of the ground insulation state under the combined grounding mode of the generator stator neutral point and obtain the size of the excessive resistance.

articleTitle: Composite Error Model Analysis of Digital Metering System in Smart Substations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Digital metering systems are more widely utilized in smart substations in recent years. The research on composite error models of digital metering systems, however, is rarely conducted, which makes this type of metering systems lack of analytical basis for error tolerance fitting and disabled the legitimacy of the power-trading purpose of digital metering system. To improve this research, the errors of each components of digital metering system are analyzed and combined to render the composite error model. The results of verification tests on simulation environment proved the effectiveness of this composite error model, which could be used in design and analysis of the precision of the digital metering systems.

articleTitle: An Optimal Strategy to Generate Optimal Electricity Plans via Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The deregulation of electricity market enables residential customers to select or switch to a suitable plan with low expenditure. We proposed an optimal pricing strategy for electricity providers by considering customers' willingness to switch to another plan and competition from other electricity providers. Firstly, plan-oriented clustering is investigated. Then, new competitive plans are put forward based on objective customers classes and current plans using Weber-Fechner law. In the end, promising numerical results of profit in different objective customer classes and different situations demonstrate that the proposed strategy could effectively provide electricity providers with more competitive plans.

articleTitle: Coordination of Industrial Load Management and Micro-Turbines for Improving Renewable Energy Utilization Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
