abstract: Industrial loads take a significantly large proportion of the total energy consumption over the world. If they can be optimally scheduled to directly consume the local renewable power generation in microgrids, the overall renewable energy utilization efficiency can be boosted. On the other hand, the renewable power generation is uncertain and varying, leading to microgrid operating constraint violations. To this point, micro-turbines can adjust power generation to track the renewable power generation variations. Considering the above issues and possible solutions, this paper proposes a coordination method of the industrial load management and the micro-turbine dispatch to improve renewable energy utilization efficiency. The working shifts and production lines are scheduled in the industrial load management one week ahead to minimize the operating cost, while the micro-turbines are dispatched hourly to track the realized renewable power generation, keeping the microgrid operating constraints. The proposed coordination method is tested, and the numerical results show its high efficiency in improving the renewable energy utilization efficiency.

articleTitle: Fault Current Controller and Its Control Technology of DC Microgrid Based on Negative Pressure Source
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of AC/DC power distribution network, DC microgrids will become an important part of the future power distribution network. The DC microgrid has a small coverage area and a small line impedance. When the bipolar short circuit occurs, the fault current can reach a rated operating current of more than ten times, causing a serious impact on the system. A fault current controller based on negative pressure source is proposed in this paper. With the Control Strategy proposed by this paper, the current controller can precisely control the fault current and improve the control effect during normal operation. And the operation effect is verified by simulation. The use of fault current controller will greatly improve the controllability of DC microgrid.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Substation Measurement System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a design scheme of LoRa technology substation measurement system. Based on LoRa technology, the system which integrates the power internet of things and the smart grid is designed. Performance tests are conducted to verify the feasibility of the scheme. The results show that this solution can be applied to substation measurement systems, and can improve reliability and reduce costs.

articleTitle: Wind Farm Predictive Coordination Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the penetration of wind power increases, the operation risks of power system become serious and it is of vital importance to improve the control performance of wind power. Based on the predictive coordination control theory, a predictive coordination control framework is proposed. Three control modules, which contain wind power forecast module, online optimization module and feedback module are presented. In the wind power forecast module, the feasibility of wind turbine power forecast is analyzed and a wind turbine neural network forecast method considering the time delay of wind speed is proposed. In the online optimization module, the targets of maximizing the self-reserve and minimizing the control error considering the constraints of wind speed, wind turbine power and wind turbine model are established. In the feedback module, control errors are distributed based on the actual power shortage and regulation space of wind turbine. The simulation verifies the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Assessment Method of Electrical Cyber–Physical Interdependent Network Considering Node Heterogeneity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The vulnerability assessment of the electrical cyber-physical interdependent network is of great significance, which is conducive to the reliable energy supply and safe operation of the system. Due to the difference in topological location and tasks undertaken, the importance of each node in power grid and cyber network are different. However, previous vulnerability methods only focused on the coupling relationship between the networks, but did not consider the heterogeneity between them, which make the evaluation less accurate. In response to the above problem, this paper—from the perspective of energy flow and information flow, respectively— analyzes the node heterogeneity of the power grid and cyber network, then proposes a vulnerability assessment indicator based on the node importance—to evaluate the impact of failures to the system robustness. Case study on the standard and modified IEEE 39-bus system integrated with cyber network shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Short-Term Voltage Stability Constrained Two-Stage Dynamic Optimal Reactive Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a two-stage dynamic optimal reactive power flow (DORPD model aiming to improve short-term voltage stability and the service life of discrete devices including on-load tap changer (OLTC) and capacitor banks. In the first stage, the set values of discrete devices are obtained through solving a mixed integer quadratic programming (MIQP) model, with the consideration of the switching operation constraints of discrete devices. In the second stage, short-term voltage stability constraints are proposed firstly; then the constraints are linearized through trajectory sensitivity solved by time domain simulation; finally, linearized constraints are incorporated into DORPF model with the set values of discrete devices gained from the first stage. The effectiveness of the proposed model and method is validated on the IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: Collaborative Optimization Dispatch for Multi-Microgrids System with Combined Cooling, Heating and Power
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As distributed energy based microgrids with combined cooling, heating and power are gradually connected to the main grid, and forming a certain range of regional microgrid clusters, it is of great significance to investigate the system optimal dispatch in the microgrid interconnection scenario. In this paper, an optimal dispatch model of multimicrogrids system with combined cooling, heating and power is proposed, which considers the cross-microgrid power interaction. Through the collaborative optimization of the power interactions between microgrids and the output powers of energy devices, the overall economic benefit of the multimicrogrids system is effectively improved. The optimization objective of the model is to minimize the total operation cost of the multi-microgrids system with combined cooling, heating and power. The effectiveness of the proposed model is verified by comparing the system cost and device output powers of multimicrogrids system under no power interaction (single-microgrid) and with power interaction (cross-microgrid) mode between microgrids. Furthermore, this paper profoundly analyzes the influence of energy price and transmission cost between microgrids on the operation characteristics of multi-microgrids system.

articleTitle: Modal Frequency and Damping Evaluation of Grid Connected VSCs in Sub-Synchronous Range Based on Motion Equation Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing use of voltage source converters (VSCs), a new type of sub-synchronous oscillation problems related with VSCs have occurred when connected to weak ac grid. Several studies have tried to analyze these oscillation problems, but most used the impedance method from the circuit equivalent perspective. Actually, the circuit equivalent and mechanical equivalent can be transformed each other. To understand the sub-synchronous oscillation problems related with VSCs from the perspective of mechanical equivalent, this paper reveals that the dynamical interaction between VSC's DC-link voltage control loop and phase-locked loop (PLL) is similar to the mass interaction in SG's two-mass shaft model based on the motion equation method, and proposes a quantitative method to evaluate VSC's modal characteristics in sub-synchronous range. Results are all verified in MATLAB/Simulink. In addition to the impedance method, this paper provides another perspective to understand the sub-synchronous oscillation problems related with VSCs.

articleTitle: A Direct Method Based on Incidence Matrix for Unbalanced Three-phase Distributed Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Different from the transmission network with transposition, a distribution system usually can not be considered as a balanced network, let alone the given branch may be single or two-phase rather than three phases. This paper presents a direct power flow method for unbalanced three-phase distribution systems. A set of index matrices for multi-phase is introduced to indicate each bus and branch, simplifying the initialization of the unbalanced network treatment. Also, no extra modification is needed for meshed and radial networks. Results of tests and comparisons with 13-bus meshed and radial systems illustrate the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: An Optimal Configuration Method of APF Applied to Distributed Grid of Distributed poverty Alleviation Photovoltaic Power Supply with High Penetration Rate
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The access of large-scale poverty alleviation photovoltaic power supplies has made the power quality problem of rural distributed grid increasingly serious. Aiming at the harmonic problem caused by the grid-connected photovoltaic power supply for poverty alleviation, an APF optimization configuration method based on the sub-matrix of the admittance matrix through eigenvalue decomposition and sensitivity analysis is proposed. Initially, through the analysis of node admittance matrix of distribution grid, the correlation sub matrix affecting voltage harmonics of distribution network was obtained. On this basis, the influence of the sub-matrix eigenvalues on the voltage harmonics of the distribution grid was studied; then, under the premise of ensuring that the harmonic voltage and total distortion rate of the network nodes meet the national standard GB/T14549-1993 “Power Quality Public Grid Harmonics” standard and the access capacity of the active filter is sufficient, through the decomposition of the sub-matrix, and the sensitivity analysis of the eigenvalues of the sub-matrix, the maximum value of the diagonal elements of the sensitivity matrix was selected as the optimal installation position of APF. The effectiveness of the proposed method was verified by an example of IEEE34-node system and a grid example of a 10KV area of Gansu Power Grid.

articleTitle: DC-side Voltage Control Strategy of Dynamic Voltage Regulator Based on Nine-switch Conversion Circuit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing application of power electronic equipment in power systems, the power quality problems of power grids are becoming more and more serious. And the various precision power equipment have higher requirements for power quality. The nine-switch converter has significant advantages in terms of cost and volume, compared with the traditional back-to-back type twelve-switch converter structure. This paper introduces topological structure, pulse-modulation and the mathematical model of the DVR (Dynamic Voltage Regulator) based on nine-switch conversion. On this basis, the method to reduce the DC side voltage of the nine-switch converter is proposed, and the feasibility of the scheme is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Inter-harmonic Detection Based on Blind Source Separation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The sampling of intermediate harmonics in power system is all asynchronous. IEC gives the calculation method of inter-harmonic group and sub-group under synchronous sampling, but not the method in asynchronous condition. This paper proposes an inter-harmonic measurement method based on independent component analysis. In this paper, firstly, the inter-harmonic model of multi-frequency components is built, the frequency components of the intermediate harmonics are obtained using ICA, and the amplitude and phase angle parameters of inter-harmonics after correction are derived. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm can accurately calculate the inter-harmonic components in multifrequency component signals, and overcome the influence of spectrum interference to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Synchronous Condenser for Transient Voltage Stability of Weak Sending-end Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The continuous increase in the proportion of new energy access has led to a decline in the voltage support capacity of the sending-end power grid, and transient voltage instability problem was prone to occur under the small startup mode of synchronous power sources. Taking the Northwest Power Grid as an example, the transient voltage stability problem of the typical new energy collection and transmission end power grid was revealed. Based on the advantages of the synchronous condenser, the effect of the synchronous condenser location on the transient voltage stability problem after the accident was analyzed. Furthermore, the optimal configuration method of synchronous condenser for the sending-end power grid with less voltage support has been proposed in this paper. By coordinating and optimizing the location and capacity of the synchronous condenser before the accident, and emergency control after the accident. With the goal of minimizing the control cost, and constraint of the power system safety. Finally, the effectiveness and rationality of the configuration method was validated by actual typical power grid.

articleTitle: Dual-port Machine Imitation Control for AC-DC Interlinking Converters in Hybrid Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A hybrid microgrid can operate in three modes based on whether there are grid-forming sources connected to each bus: 1) Autonomous power mode, 2) DC voltage maintaining mode, and 3) AC voltage maintaining mode. For AC-DC interlinking converters (ILCs) that link two buses, a unified control concept named the “dual-port machine imitation (DPMI)” control concept was proposed in this research. An AC grid system and a DC grid system are essentially an inductive rotating inertial system and a capacitive static inertial system, respectively. An interlinking conversion device benefits from conforming to these energy natures for AC and DC grids. An AC machine and a DC machine with a shaft-to-shaft connection comprise such a device. DPMI control makes an ILC act as such a machine pair. Existing unified controls suffer from high complexity when setting numerous coupled control parameters. In contrast, conceptually different from conventional virtual machines, the proposed DPMI control makes an ILC imitate two machines simultaneously, and featuring significant simplicity.

articleTitle: Study on the Influence of Radio Anechoic Chamber Filter Circuit on the Smart Meter Error in Radio Frequency Immunity Test
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the smart meter cannot carry out the experiment of radio frequency immunity in the general type of Radio Anechoic Chamber, a virtual load test system filter for smart meters is designed in this paper, which solves the influence on the accuracy caused by electromagnetic leakage through input and output test lines. Based on the filter parameters and the actual measured voltage data of the smart meter, a reactance compensation circuit is designed into the test circuit to solve the problem that the smart meter errors is out of tolerance before radio-frequency radiation immunity test. Finally, the validity of this method is verified by comparing the test data of different specfications of smart meters. The test results show that the introduction of the filters and compensation circuits ensure the basic error of the tested smart meter before conducting the radio-frequency radiation immunity test, and solve the problem that the radiation electromagnetic compatibility test of the smart meter cannot be carried out according to the standard requirements in the general type of Radio Anechoic Chamber.

articleTitle: A DC Power Flow Controller for Multi-Terminal DC Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A HVDC grid based on voltage source converter (VSC) is an attractive solution for the grid integration of offshore renewable energy, interconnection of ac grids, facilitation of power markets, and energy emergency support. However, the power flow within the dc grids is determined by the line resistance and cannot be fully controlled by the VSCs only. Thus, power flow control of dc grids are needed not only to realize the economic operation and power markets, but also to prevent overload of dc lines in post-fault conditions. Four types of control devices, dc transformer, the variable resistor, series voltage source and interline dc power flow controller (IDCPFC) are presented to achieve the goal of power flow controlling. This paper presents a dc power flow controller (DCPFC) based on dc converter. This DCPFC can be extended to multi-terminal power flow control in dc power grids. The operation principle of the proposed DCPFC is analyzed. And the theoretical analysis is validated by a full-scaled simulation.

articleTitle: The Application of Unified Power Flow Controller in Smepc
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, State Grid Shanghai Municipal Electric Power Company(SMEPC) accepts power from Hubei, Anhui and other provinces through five HVAC and four HVDC channels. The proportion of incoming power outside of Shanghai is major, the load peak-valley difference is large, but the size of local power units is small. In addition, the distribution of power flow in complex interconnected power transmission channels is unreasonable. Some lines and equipment are overloaded during the peak period in summer, while some lines are under light load, which severely limits the power transmission capacity of local sections. In order to improve the operation efficiency and reliability of power supply, the power grid must adopt more flexible control methods to meet the requirements of changeable operation modes. In this paper, the working principles, operating characteristics, modeling, control scheme and dynamic characteristics of the unified power flow controller(UPFC) are introduced, the main circuit topology, control scheme and protection configuration of 220kV UPFC in SMEPC are studied, and the effects of UPFC to power system in Shanghai are verified.

articleTitle: Analysis of Multi-Time-Scale Business Models for the Development of Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an effective technical means, the virtual power plants (VPPs) plays important roles for promoting the accommodation of renewable energies through adjusting distributed resources. Therefore, it is essential to explore the business models of VPPs for their sustainable development. In this paper, multi-time-scale business models for VPPs are proposed considering the short-term, medium-term and long-term development, where subjects, technical means, effects and profits for different business models are analyzed. Four short-term business models for VPPs are proposed including agent power purchase mode, ancillary services, load aggregator model, and power demand response transaction, while the medium-term and long-term business models for VPPs include energy optimization for customers, energy financial services, agency quotation services.

articleTitle: Conditional Value-at-credibility Model for Wind Power Integrated Stochastic Optimal Power Flow Under Risk Aversion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the scenario of large-scale integration of un-certain renewable power, such as wind power, it requires additional ramping capabilities from other dispatchable units to compensate effects of the uncertain wind power in the problem of stochastic optimal power flow (SOPF), which undermines the efficiency of power system operation. In this paper, we propose conditional value-at-credibility (CVaC) model to assess the SOPF with uncertain wind power considering risk aversion. The CVaC model studies the random chanracteristic and fuzzy characteristic of wind power, which tries to reach a balance between operation risk and profit. To evaluate the effectiveness of our methodology, we carry out a simulation based analysis on a wind power integrated IEEE 30-bus system. Our case simulations show that the CVaC model can improve the operation reliability in evaluating the SOPF, in terms of providing a trade-off solution against the uncertain wind power.

articleTitle: Robust Adaptive Frequency Modulation Strategy for Variable Speed Pumped Storage in Generator Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to overcome the frequency modulation challenges in the context of promoting the integration of variable renewable energy (VRE) into the grid, pumped storage has been vigorously developed in recent years, among which the variable speed pumped storage unit (VSPSU) has become the main research object. In this paper, based on a simplified dynamic model of primary frequency modulation including VSPSU, a robust P-MRAC control strategy is proposed by combining proportional control and model reference adaptive control. P-MRAC makes better use of VSPSU's output flexibility to limit the maximum frequency deviation and depends less on the specific model. Based on a modified 9-bus test model built on Matlab Simulink, P-MRAC and virtual inertia control are compared in scenarios where there is a step change in load or wind power fluctuates. The results show that P-MRAC does better than virtual inertia control in solving the problem of power system inertia reduction and has similar effect with it in suppressing the disturbance of wind power fluctuation.

articleTitle: Research on Bearing Fault Identification of Wind Turbine Based on Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The failure of wind turbine will greatly decrease the economic benefits of the wind farm. It is thus of great significance to locate the fault in time to ensure the safety and reliability of wind power operations. In this paper, the fault recognition of motor bearing based on deep belief network (DBN) is proposed, which has the advantage that it can learn and extract features independently. The frequency-domain spectrum of motor bearing fault vibration signal collected by the sensor is obtained by Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), then the frequency-domain sequence is normalized, and the training and testing samples are obtained according to appropriate proportion. After learning the fault information contained in the training samples by Restricted Boltzmann Machine (RBM) and finely tuning the global parameters by gradient descent algorithm, the final classifier for the test samples is obtained. The case analysis is carried out on the data set of bearing fault simulation test platform. Each diagnosis scheme includes multiple complex fault condition signals, and the diagnostic results have good accuracy.

articleTitle: Improving Operational Efficiency and Benefits of the Distribution Network With Advanced Distribution Management System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper describes the latest research progress of advanced distribution management system (ADMS) in the distribution networks area. Firstly, the basic concepts, core and advanced application functions, key technologies, and the main benefits of ADMS are introduced. Further, several typical application cases of ADMS worldwide in recent years are introduced. Combined with its technical concept and actual application situation, we discussed and analyzed the multistage development route of the ADMS platform. Moreover, some suggestions for the construction of ADMS are given.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Radiation Analysis of the Potential Transfer Arc During Live Working on the UHV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The process of potential transfer is an important process during live working on the UHV transmission lines, and the arc produced during the potential transfer process may generate electromagnetic radiation interference to affect the surrounding environment. In order to study the electromagnetic radiation characteristics of the potential transfer arc, the potential transfer experiment in the process of entering equal-potential along the tension string of 1000 kV AC transmission line is conducted, and the potential transfer current is measured. The spectrum characteristics of the potential transfer current are studied by using wavelet analysis, and the main frequency band distribution of the transfer current pulse is obtained. Then, the changes of the radiated electric field and magnetic field caused by the potential transfer arc are calculated based on the dipole antenna theory. Results indicated that the frequency band of the potential transfer current is mainly in 12.5~25 MHz, and the radiated electromagnetic increases in the far-field area with the increase of potential transfer current.

articleTitle: Protection method of small current grounding system based on phase current variation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The probability of single-phase earthing fault is very high in indirectly grounding power system, so it is very important to select and trip the fault line quickly. According to the theoretical analysis, the difference between the faulty phase current's variation and the non faulty current's variation of the faulty feeder is significantly larger than that of the non-faulty feeder, which can accurately determine the fault feeder. The effectiveness and accuracy of the new method are also verified by the simulation results of PSCAD.

articleTitle: A Protection Method based on Phase Voltage Variation Characteristics for Generator Stator Ground Fault
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the ground mode of generator stator neutral point resistance shunt reactor, the existing grounding protection research cannot satisfy the requirements for development of application. Therefore, a protection method based on phase voltage variation characteristics of generator stator ground fault is proposed in this paper. This method uses the voltage magnitude of the faulted phase and the non-faulted phase before and after the stator ground fault to determine the ground fault phase. And in this method, the position of fault point and the value of transition resistance are obtained by calculating the voltage difference of each phase. In this paper, a simulation model is built to prove that this method can effectively identify the stator ground fault phase, determine the fault location and obtain the transition resistance value. Therefore, this method has great practical value.

articleTitle: Rub-impact Behavior Study of a Flywheel Rotor by Considering the Friction Coefficients Effect
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High speed rotor is the key equipment of Fly-wheel Energy Storage System (FESS). While the rotor is disturbed, rub-impact between the rotor and the stator would be considered, including the energy dissipating, and the system stability, and so on. In this paper, a set of equations of rub impact process between rotor and stator are established by a plane spring damping model with friction effect. The rotor impact behaviors under different contact stiffnesses and friction coefficients are studied by numerically solved with fourth order Runge-Kutta method. Through this model, it could be found that, under an actual contact stiffness, the stability of the rotor would firstly increase and then decrease with the increasing of the friction coefficient. In other words, for this given contact stiffness, there exists a best friction coefficient value range. This result shows that it is feasible to improve the stability of the flywheel system by optimizing the material and friction coefficient of the rubbing parts.

articleTitle: Interpretation of Immunity Time Testing Method under Voltage Sag for Sensitive Process Rated Less than 1000V
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Industrial production interruption events due to the voltage sag have occurred frequently in recent years. In order to solve the contradiction between the voltage sag problem and the sensitive industrial production process, it is necessary to obtain the sag immunity time of the sensitive process. Guangzhou Electric Power Research Institute started from the practical problems encountered in the production process considering changes in physical parameters when sensitive processes are affected. In order to obtain accurate process immunity time, a standard testing method for sensitive process voltage sag immunity time below 1000V was developed. The testing method proposed by this standard can sort through the complex production process layer by layer, and identify the weakest link and the most sensitive equipment in the entire process. This article interprets the standard layer by layer, and proves the applicability of the testing method proposed by the standard through actual case.

articleTitle: Simplified Risk Assessment of DC Bias for Ultra-High-Voltage Direct-Current Transmission
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, there are some technical difficulties in the risk assessment of DC bias in the power grid of the UHV project. A simplified assessment method for considering the risk of DC bias in the power grid of the UHV project is proposed in this paper. Firstly, a simple calculation method of earth surface potential is proposed based on the equivalent of point and source of DC grounding electrode surface based on the multi-layered earth model, and on this basis, a bias risk assessment method is proposed that only the power station/DC grounding electrode position and the system resistance network is needed to be provided. By using an calculation example, the calculation accuracy of the simple calculation method of earth surface potential is proved to meet the engineering application requirements, and by considering the DC bias risk assessment calculated-example of the Hebei South Network of the UHV project, the practicality of this method in the early warning and management of DC bias risk is proved.

articleTitle: Procurement Market for Reactive Power Reserve Considering Coupling of Energy with Reactive Power
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Reactive power support is one of the most importance ancillary services for power systems. System operators should procure sufficient reactive power services to guarantee the voltage security. Adequate reactive power reserve is necessary for maintaining the voltage stability after disturbances. Considering reactive power reserve as commodities, this paper proposes a two-step procurement market for reactive power reserve. First, energy prices along with settlement are obtained through the energy-only market. Then based on the pay-as-bid (PAB) mechanism, overall payments are minimized considering the cost of lost opportunity of reactive power reserve which is coupled with the energy prices. Case studies of IEEE 24-bus system show fair payments for reactive power reserve are necessary to incentive providers and ensure sufficient reserve especially when the demand for reserve is large.

articleTitle: An On-line Setting Self-adaptive Distance Protection Scheme for 110kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional three section distance protection is widely used in transmission lines with voltage level of 110kV and above, and the setting of impedance and time is the key. At present, the setting of three-section distance protection depends on manual calculation or off-line setting by professional software, which requires a lot of work and often leads to insufficient sensitivity or lack of coordination. In this paper, a distance protection scheme based on adaptive on-line setting method is proposed. This scheme does not need to set the impedance setting value and time setting value of the distance protection, instead, it only needs to calculate the fault distance using the local current and voltage information. On the basis of the calculated fault distance, the operation time limit can be calculated online by using the time limit calculation formula proposed in this paper. The protection operation time of the upper and lower lines can be adaptively coordinated and has an ultra-long protection range. This scheme can not only greatly improve the performance of distance protection, but also realize the cost reduction and efficiency improvement of relay protection setting, which brings considerable practical and economic benefits.

articleTitle: Credibility-based Risk Assessment of Load Loss in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Active distribution network contains a lot of uncertainty factors such as distributed generations and controllable load, so traditional risk assessment models and methods are no longer applicable. Aiming at the uncertainty in the process of load loss of active distribution network, a risk assessment method based on credibility is presented. This method comprehensively considers the randomness of the Monte Carlo algorithm, the uncertainty of load size sampling, and the dispatch of interruptible load on the demand side. The credibility is used as the convergence criterion of risk assessment, which provides a quantitative standard for the accuracy of the assessment process. Finally, combined with IEEE 14-bus example, the simulation results show that distributed generation access and demand side management can improve the security of active distribution network, which reflects the efficiency of this risk assessment method.

articleTitle: Research on Error properties and Influence Factors of Three-phase Combined Instrument Transformers Under Different Operating Conditions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the three-phase detection method, a three-phase combined transformer error verification platform is designed and the error properties of three-phase three-element combined instrument transformers, including the interaction between the voltage and current parts are studied systematically. The experimental results show that the percentage of rated voltage/current and the secondary load have a great impact on the error properties of three-phase combined transformers. When the current and voltage parts of three-phase combined transformer are excited at the same time, it is found that due to the strong electromagnetic coupling, the mutual influence between the voltage and current transformer is large. Especially under the condition of 20% of the rated current, the influence of voltage transformer on current transformer error properties has exceeded the allowable range and cannot be ignored.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model and Method on Life-cycle Comprehensive Low-carbon Benefits of Large-scale Energy Storage System From the Distribution Network Planning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy storage systems, which have flexible characteristics for electric power systems, have gained popularity in power distribution networks for many reasons including the smoothing renewable energy output. This paper proposes a method to evaluate the comprehensive low-carbon benefits of an energy storage system during its lifecycle and establishes a model for this quantitative evaluation. The lifecycle of an energy storage system is divided into five stages, namely, manufacturing & processing, system planning & design, system project construction, operation & maintenance, and scrapping & recycling. By adding the low-carbon and economy benefits of each stage the comprehensive low-carbon benefit is obtained. The carbon payback period (CPP) is also presented for evaluating the energy storage system's contribution to carbon emission reduction. The method is tested in the IEEE 14-bus case with data applied in China and the results show that the storage in distribution systems can create considerable low-carbon benefits, but the high cost of energy storage is a primary factor subtracting from these benefits.

articleTitle: A New Transmission Pricing Method of Large Scale Wind Power to Promote Wind Consumption
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The determination of transmission price and cost allocation are potential obstacles to the development of wind power. This paper analyzes the incremental cost of longdistance of wind power transmission. Considering the fixed and variable characteristics of incremental cost and the risk of cost fluctuation, a risk-based comprehensive pricing model for long-distance transmission of large-scale wind power is established. Gansu Province in China is rich in wind resources, so we take Jiuquan wind power base and 800 kV GansuZhuzhou DC transmission as examples to verify the effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: A Novel Uncertainty Characterization Method for Source and Load in Renewable Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the large-scale development utilization of wind resources and the continuous expansion of the scale of the power grid, the uncertainty of the power grid source and load has increased the instability of the power grid. This paper studies the mathematical characterization method of the source and load uncertainties of renewable power grid, and uses the prediction box theory to dynamically characterize the source and load randomness and volatility. A source scenario generation method based on Copula function and geographic correlation and load scenario generation method based on similar daily measurement are proposed. Test examples are performed to verify the accuracy of the proposed methods. Based on electrical betweenness, a rapid reduction method of the system operating scenario is proposed. The methods that we describe here can provide a large number of operation scenarios consistent with the actual operation of the system and avoid massive power flow calculation, so as to facilitate the analysis of risks brought by uncertainty to the operation of power system.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Index System and Method for County Power Supply Companies Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to guide county power supply companies to position itself accurately and develop orderly, a comprehensive evaluation index system and method for measuring the power grid development and operation level of the county power supply companies are proposed. Based on the data of 140 county power supply companies, this paper proposes a key index selection strategy using data mining to build a comprehensive evaluation index system. The improved gray correlation method and entropy coefficient method are used to build the combined weight distribution model, combining the data envelopment cross analysis to calculate the evaluation value of companies. The case analysis of 10 county c power supply companies in a province shows that the proposed index system and method can comprehensively and effectively evaluate the power grid development and operation level of county power supply companies, and provide decision support for county power supply companies to formulate development strategies.

articleTitle: Prediction Method Based on Random Forest Regression for Sympathetic Intush Peak
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem of line protection action caused by sympathetic inrush, this paper proposes to predict its peak before closing, avoid closing switch under dangerous conditions and try to apply random forest regression to the prediction of the sympathetic inrush peak. This article first comprehensively analyzes influencing factors of sympathetic inrush, then input influencing factors are screened according to characteristic importance calculated by random forest, and obtain the optimal prediction model through the grid search and cross-validation. Finally, a substation under construction in the Lingang district is taken as an example for testing, and different regression models are applied for comparative tests. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has better applicability and can accurately and rapidly predict the peak of sympathetic inrush.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Demand Response in Power System of Smart Park
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A optimization model of power system in smart park based on quasi-real-time price is proposed to improve the consumption of new energy resources and operation economy. The objective function of the model includes the cost of demand response, the operating cost of the energy storage battery, the cost of the system abandoning the wind power and photovoltaic, the cost of cutting the load, the cost of purchasing electricity from the higher power grid and carbon emission cost. Constraints of energy storage battery, power balance and switching limit with superior power grid, pricing limit and load limit of demand response are considered in the model as well. Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to solve the model. The results of the case analysis show that the model can make the users change thier electricity consumption behavior through the quasi-real-time price. By formulating the quasi-real-time price, the model can achieve the peak shaving and valley filling by collaborative adjustment of energy storage battery, effectively reduce the load cutting, improve the consumption of new energy resources, enhance the flexibility of power system regulation in the park, and improve the economy of power system operation in smart park.

articleTitle: Mechanical & Thermal Stress Analysis under Actual Condition and Test Design of 550kV High Coupled Split Reactor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The phenomenon of 500 kV line short-circuit urrent exceeding the protection scope of circuit breaker is seriously threatening the safety of power grid, and installing a suitable fault current limiter is an effective method to deal with such problem. 550 kV high coupled split reactor studied in this paper is an important component of 500kV fault current limiter that is desighed with new technology. It has the functions of withstanding and limiting short-circuit current, and has the advantages of high flexibility, easy maintenance and low loss. However, at present, there is a lack of relevant literature and standards to guide this type of equipment for the evaluation of mechanical and thermal stress under actual conditions. This paper studied the actual working conditions of 550kV high coupled split reactor, analyzed its current characteristics, and on this basis, performed steady-state temperature field simulation analysis at rated continuous current and stress calculation during short circuit, and proposed a scheme for equivalent test using a small prototype in the actual conditions of the laboratory. This paper is beneficial to the design and testing of such equipment in the future.

articleTitle: Operation and Switching Strategy Optimization of Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Integrated Energy System (IES) contains a variety of heterogeneous energy flows coupled with each other. This feature provides optimization space for system optimization. It also makes its operating mode more flexible. How to optimize the steady-state operation mode of the integrated energy system and complete the switching between steady-state operation modes, this paper proposes an IES steady-state optimization model and operation mode switching method considering the transmission characteristics of the cold and heat pipe network. First, the IES economic steady-state operation model and the green steady-state operation model that describe the steady-state transmission characteristics of the cold and heat pipe network are constructed. Then, by analyzing the transient characteristics of the cooling and heating pipe network during the IES model switching process and the response time of the energy flow conversion equipment, the optimal scheduling time range of the IES is determined. Finally, the IES steady-state mode switching problem is converted into several ultra-short-term optimal scheduling by segmenting the IES switching process. The feasibility of the steady-state operation optimization model and switching strategy is analyzed through simulation.

articleTitle: Delivery Route Optimization for Electric Logistics Vehicles based on Full Information Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve the delivery efficiency of electric logistics vehicles, it is necessary for us to take into account the time spent by the electric logistics vehicle in charging station when planning the delivery route. Firstly, the factors that affect the delivery time of running electric logistics vehicles are analyzed, and full information acquisition system based on the Internet of Things technology is designed in charging station system which can collect the information of electric vehicles in charging station, including charging as well as waiting for charging electric vehicles. Secondly, the mathematical model of the minimum delivery time of electric logistics vehicle is constructed, and availability of dynamic programming theory application is analyzed, its solving step is introduced. Finally, a case study is used in verifying the proposed model. According to the remaining battery power of the logistics vehicle battery, the available charging stations are selected, and optimal delivery route is also gotten, in which the full information including waiting time during the charging process are considered. Then, an accurate route planning scheme is provided to drivers of electric logistics vehicle.

articleTitle: Robust Frequency Lock Loop based Power Control and Harmonic Compensation Method for Bidirectional AC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The single-phase bidirectional AC/DC converter with current harmonic compensation and power flow regulation capability is the core unit in the household energy router. In this paper, an improved power flow control and current harmonic compensation method for the bidirectional AC/DC converter is presented. A robust Second-Order Generalized Integrator based Frequency Lock Loop (SOGI-FLL) with phase angle jump, DC bias and harmonic distortion rejection capability is proposed. The linearized model of proposed SOGI-FLL is analyzed. Compared with conventional power control and current harmonic compensation methods, the proposed SOGI-FLL can provide a great rejection to the grid current phase angle jump, thus makes the bidirectional AC/DC converter's current harmonic compensation more precisely and power flow control more quickly. The proposed close-loop control system based on novel SOGI-FLL for the bidirectional AC/DC converter shows a faster and smoother transient performance. Finally, the performance of the proposed close-loop control system was verified by simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Distribution Network Reconfiguration Based on Deep Q-learning Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The reconfiguration problem of distribution network is an optimization problem aims to minimize the transmission power loss. Traditional mathematical methods are difficult to solve this kind of nonlinear mixed integer problem. This paper proposes an algorithm based on deep Q-learning network (DQN) which combines deep Q-learning and artificial neural network. A new method for the distribution network reconfiguration is presented based on DQN in this paper, with the objective of minimizing transmission power loss and the consideration of the corresponding constraints. The proposed method has been proved valid by the results from the dynamic reconfiguration of the IEEE 33-bus test system.

articleTitle: Optimal Trading Strategy of Coordinating Electricity Purchase in Monthly Electricity Market and Day-ahead Market Based on CVaR
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The new round of power system reform has been carried out in China since 2015. At present, China's mediumand long-term electricity market has been basically established, but the spot market is still in the stage of exploration. As the organizers of the current power market, the grid companies have to reasonably arrange the purchase of electricity in electricity market of different time scale. In this paper, a risk-based optimization model is proposed to reasonably arrange electricity trading in monthly electricity market and the day-ahead market in order to guarantee the balance of supply and demand, and to connect the electricity markets of different time scales. CVaR is introduced to analyze the risk of forecasting error. The illustrative cases are introduced to verify the effectiveness of the strategy. The paper provides a reference for the organizers to coordinate the electricity purchasing plan in monthly electricity market and the day-ahead market.

articleTitle: Design and Test of Lithium Battery Storage Power Station in Regional Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the safety and stable operation requirements of Xing Yi regional grid, 20MW/10MWh LiFePO4 battery storage power station is designed and constructed. In order to test the performance and ensure the operation effect of the energy storage power station, this paper introduces the overall structure of the energy storage power station, including the electrical wiring diagram of the energy storage power station, the composition of the energy storage battery system and the communication network scheme. According to the test standards and specifications of the energy storage power station, the power control capacity, energy storage capacity and overload capability of the energy storage power station are tested, the test results show that the energy storage power station meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: The Interoperability Test of Off-Board Charger for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper analyzes a DC charging process and a platform was developed to test the interoperability projects in a DC charger. The test results show that the main interoperability problems in DC charging facilities as follows: (1) When the voltage error between the electric vehicle battery and the message exceeds the limit, the charger can still charge; (2) The voltage setting value of insulation test is not correct. (3) The current stop rate of passive interrupting instructions charging is low.

articleTitle: The Key Issue of Control Strategy For Large-scale Wind Power Grid Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With integration of the large wind energy bases into power grid, wind energy has gradually become an important form of power supply. In order to ensure the stable operation and safe of the power grid after the large wind energy bases are connected, the operation control technology of the power grid after the large wind enengy bases are connected will become more and more important. Therefore, it is necessary to study the operating characteristics and control strategies of large wind energy bases based on the specific problems of power grids and the large-scale centralized connect to wind power grids, combined with the large wind energy bases already constructed and planned in the Northwest and North China power grids. The technical conditions for wind farms grid-connected operation study, the impact of large wind energy bases in North and Northwest China Power Networks on the system operation and stability modes, and the control measures would be include. Technical measures for optimal allocation of reserve capacity, auxiliary decision, power balancing and frequency regulation, suppression of low-frequency oscillation and reactive voltage control for large-scale wind power grid connected power systems would be studied.

articleTitle: Shutdown Risk Assessment of Small-Size Hydropower Station Under Typhoon Disaster
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Most of the small-size hydropower stations are runoff hydropower stations and their output is determined by the upstream water supply. Consequently, the rainfall brought by typhoons will lead to the increment of runoff, increasing the output of small-size hydropower stations. The uncertain increment of the output of small-size hydropower stations will bring adverse effects on the security of power system, such as the voltage over-limit and the power overload of transmission lines. In this paper, a risk assessment method is proposed to assess the shutdown risk of small-size hydropower station under typhoon disaster. Firstly, Monte Carlo Method is employed to calculate the probabilistic load flow of power system with small-size hydropower station and the probability of node voltage over-limit and branch power overload is set to be the shutdown probability of small-size hydropower station. Secondly, the cost of load shedding which is optimized by Adaptive Particle Swarm optimization (APSO) algorithm is set to be the shutdown cost of small-size hydropower station. Finally, the IEEE-33 bus system is used to assess the shutdown risk of small-size hydropower station under typhoon disaster.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning Based Optimal Operation Strategy for Electric Taxis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale adoption of electric vehicles (EVs) is drawing great attention in recent years. The travel/charging patterns of different types of EVs, such as private EVs, electric buses (EBs), electric taxis (ETs), could greatly differ from each other. Among them, the ET plays an important role in public transportation and has rather special characteristics including long daily travel distance, highly uncertain behaviors etc., which thus needs to be further investigated independently. To address this issue, a reinforcement-learning (RL) based optimal operation strategy for the ETs is designed by this paper. Moreover, the proposed method better addressed the profit-making characteristic of ETs that were not well handled by other related works. The studied network is first evenly divided into small blocks with certain travel demands. ETs are classified according to their battery levels, and different rewards are designed for all possible actions at every state correspondingly. The Q-learning method in the RL field is then used to obtain the value tables for all actions so that to give the best operation strategies for different ET groups. Simulation results show that the proposed method not only can improve the ET system performance from the view point of the whole society, but also benefits each individual ET.

articleTitle: Microgrid Fault Detection Method Based on Sequential Overlapping Differential Transform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fault detection is unreliable when small fault angle faults and high-resistance ground faults occur in ungrounded-system microgrid. In the traditional microgrid grid, large diversity in fault components results in the current quick-action protection refusal in different operation modes, i.e. island operation and grid-connected one. In his paper, the largest energy sum of the zero-mode current transient components of each line is utilized to form a characteristic frequency band. Then a fusion criterion of characteristic frequency band and cross-overlap differential transformation (SOD) is proposed to realize AC microgrid fault detection. PSCAD/EMTDC simulation shows that the characteristic frequency band can effectively filter out signal interference and highlight fault features, also, the SOD can detect the initial traveling wave quickly that only extracts the first few sampling points of the fault current and voltage signals, which can avoid the defect of the initial traveling wave extraction perishability.

articleTitle: Study on the Induction Coupling Response Characteristics of Parallel Cables
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The lightning induction coupling experiment of parallel cables was conducted. The lightning surge current was injected into one cable, and the transient induction voltage was measured together with the current on the other parallel cable. The horizontal distance between the two cables was varied to investigate its influence on the induction coupling response of parallel cables. Obtained results show that the amplitude of the transient induction voltage and current on the other parallel cable decreases as the horizontal distance between the two cables increases. A larger horizontal distance between parallel cables corresponds to a slower decrease rate of the amplitude of the induced voltage and current. The conclusion in this paper can provide guidance for the electromagnetic protection of cables in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Workload Analysis and Microservice Placement of Energy Management Application based on Power Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous increase of integrated energy equipment and emerging application in power distribution system, great challenges have been posed to the real-time operation of distribution network. This paper describes the load and data of energy management application (EMA) in distribution network. In order to demonstrate the characteristics and logic of application, a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of EMA is established. Then, the computing and communication resources of cloud center and edge computing terminal are illustrated, and the microservices deployment problem of cloud edge system is modeled, in which the minimum service delay is taken as the objective function. Finally, this paper solves the microservices deployment problem by conducing simulations of different configurations set in edge computing terminals. The simulation results show that the configuration method can reasonably deploy microservices and reduce service delay.

articleTitle: Peer-Peer Electricity Transaction and Integrated Regulation of VPP Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual Power Plant (VPP) can offer flexible control and management of distributed power sources, energy storage system and dispatchable loads for grid supporting and economic operation. Peer-Peer electricity transaction and the integration of distributed power sources to participate in grid regulation such as frequency regulation and power reserve are two important functions for VPP. However, traditional centralized electricity transaction system is not competent due to its high trust cost, poor cyber and data security, and low execution efficiency. In this paper, an electricity transaction and regulation platform of VPP based on blockchain is proposed and designed. The platform is based on B/S structure with two typical scenarios proposed: the first one is VPP matching the internal users to facilitate the peer-peer mid-to-long-term electricity transaction, and the second is VPP integrating the different sources to participate in power system reserve services. The operability of the blockchain based management platform is verified in the above two scenarios respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Active Distribution Network Structure Planning for Multi Distributed Generation Access
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the wide access of distributed generation in active distribution network and the rise of big data, in the case of fully considering the active or passive characteristics of distributed generation, the research on the network structure and equipment configuration of active distribution network can greatly increase the absorption capacity of active distribution network to distributed energy, and ensure the power quality in active distribution network, so as to improve the reliability of power supply. In this paper, the planning objectives, principles, and processes of active distribution network planning are proposed. And a two-layer network planning method considering economy and permeability is proposed in this paper. Through the joint optimization of upper and lower layers, the optimal grid scheme is obtained. This paper analyzes the distribution network structure at home and abroad, puts forward the typical grid structure suitable for the flexible operation of active distribution network, and gives the transformation scheme and planning strategy of active distribution network structure, which provides reference for the planning design and investment decision-making of grid structure transformation of active distribution network.

articleTitle: Service Restoration Based on Interruption Loss for Resilient Distribution System Considering Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Extreme weather events arise the need for improving the resilience of power distribution systems. To this end, the distribution system restoration (DSR) is invoked to restore the critical load quickly after a major outage caused by the disaster in distribution systems. The introduction of distributed generation (DG) and microgrids in distribution system also improves the resilience of the distribution system and leads to novel and effective DSR strategies. In order to reduce the economic loss caused by outage directly and effectively, this paper proposes a load restoration method based on the interruption loss for distribution system using the distributed energy resources (DERs). The objective function is formulated by customer interruption cost (CIC) and the amount of de-energized load, aiming at minimizing the interruption loss. CIC is obtained through an indirect analytical method by using the regional production information of different categories of electrical customers in this paper. System modelling and operational constraints are applied with considering the outputs of both dispatchable and non-dispatchable DGs and system spinning reserve. In order to deal with the nonlinear part of the proposed DSR model, the piecewise linearization method is used to linearize the power flow constraints, and the proposed DSR model is finally formulated as a mixed integer linear programming (MILP) problem. The effectiveness of proposed DSR method is validated based on modified IEEE-33 distribution test systems. Numerical results show that the proposed DSR method can restore critical load, reduce the interruption loss, and improve the resilience of the distribution system effectively.

articleTitle: Modeling of Dynamic Behavior for Suspension Insulator String under Wind and Rain Loadings
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The accident caused by the wind deflection of the suspension insulator string should not be underestimated, and the reclosing rate after the wind deflection trip is low. It is of great significance to study the wind deflection of the suspension insulator string. From the statistics of trip accidents of 220kv and above transmission lines in Hubei Province, it can be seen that wind deflection is one of the main causes of trip accidents, and whether wind deviation causes tripping is determined to rainfall. Based on the rigid body model of the suspension insulator string, the wind deflection angle is calculated to obtain the critical minimum gap for the discharge of the conductor to the tower member in this work, considering the rainfall intensity correction to the allowable minimum gap. Last but not least, a practical case represents the accuracy and practicality of the model. The suspension insulator string wind deflection model under wind and rain load is beneficial to analyze the wind deflection accident of the overhead transmission line which contributes to the wind deflection prevention design and the strong power grid construction. This work describes models for the wind velocity time-histories of transient tornado and storm events leading tothe result transmission line load.

articleTitle: Analysis on Market Potential of Generation-side Contract Electricity Transfer Transaction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, most provinces in China only carry out medium and long term power transactions, so that power generation enterprises lack effective avenues to avoid risks. Moreover, because of the objective factor of low forecasting precision of renewable energy generation, the participation of renewable energy enterprises in power market is limited. In recent years, with the increase of installed proportion of renewable energy in our power system, the task of renewable energy consumption has become more arduous. In order to promote the development of renewable energy and meanwhile help power generation enterprises avoid risks, many provinces have started to carry out generation-side contract electricity transfer transactions based on the principle of clean substitution. However, due to the lack of experience of market participants, the market potential of generation-side contract electricity transfer transaction still needs to be further explored. This paper separately analyzes the initiative of generationside market participants joining in the contract electricity transfer transactions under four factors of network congestion, system peak-load regulation, risk aversion and the pursuit of self-interest maximization. Then on the basis of model optimization and calculation example analysis, the effectiveness of generation-side contract electricity transfer transaction is verified in promoting the consumption of renewable energy and enhancing the activity of power generation enterprises participating in market.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Edge-Cloud Computing Method for Short-Term Electric Load Forecasting Based on Smart Metering Terminal
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the edge node in electric Internet of Things, the application of smart metering terminal (SMT) enables the massive electric big data to be widely collected and processed on the edge. This creates a positive condition for short-term electric load forecasting, which is very important for electricity sales company under the back ground of electricity spot market. In this study, the structure of a novel hybrid edge-cloud computing framework for electric load forecasting is proposed, and the forecasting model based on extreme learning machine (ELM) is also developed. In the proposed framework, the distributed SMTs are regarded as the edge nodes and widely collect electric data inner electricity customers. Then, these original data are preprocessed in the regional SMT, and then sent to the cloud server as standard time series data. Finally, the proposed ELM forecasting model runs in the cloud server, and outputs the forecasting load demand for all the customers of electricity sales company. Experimental results show the efficiency of the proposed framework and ELM forecasting model.

articleTitle: An Improved Control Method for Suppressing Capacitor Voltage Fluctuation of Medium-Voltage Motor Drives based on Cascaded H-Bridge
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The cascaded H-bridge (CHB) has been an effective alternative to medium-voltage motor drive applications. Submodules with pulse width modulated (PWM) rectifiers have the ability of regenerating power and controlling reactive power, but capacitors of submodules suffer the problem of voltage fluctuation at twice the inverter frequency. Power decoupling control is effective to decrease pulsating voltage, but the current to generate decoupling power is complicated to calculate, which relies on real-time monitoring converter output, stator voltage and current of motor. And the use of phase-locked loops (PLL) to obtain the power angle of motor threatens the transient process stability and increases complexity. This paper proposes a simplified method to calculate decoupling current without using PLL and monitoring parameters mentioned above, and transient performance of capacitor voltage is improved. Simulation results based on 6kV,710kW motor verify the validity of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Novel Protection Method of Wind Farm Collector Line Based on Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the problem of the maloperation of the existing large-scale wind farm collector line protection. The intrinsic relationship between short circuit current and the voltage sags of the doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) with low voltage ride-through(LVRT) capability is analyzed under the fault condition. According to the characteristics of the DFIG, the paper proposed a method of wind farm collector line protection based on the clustering algorithm. The protection is realized by collecting the historical feature sample set which is composed of the decayed current component, AC component of fault current and terminal voltage under different operation conditions, utilizing the proposed clustering algorithm to characterize fault history data features and category attributes and using the distance similarity criterion to determine the real-time feature sample attribute. A large-scale wind farm model is built in DIg-SILENT to simulate the various fault conditions of collector lines. The simulation results show that the proposed protection method not only does not need to set the setting values but also does not cause maloperation of non-fault line protection affected by the DFIG feeding current under the fault condition, which effectively solves the problem of selective mismatch in wind farm collector lines protection.

articleTitle: Remote Harmonic Mitigation within Offshore Wind Power Plants by Embedded Active Filters in Grid-Side Converters
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a control system of active filter, which is embedded in the grid-side converters (GSCs) of wind turbines (WTs), to mitigate the harmonics on remote busbars within offshore wind power plants (OWPPs). Superior to the existing filters with extra devices, the proposed active filter is embedded in the control system of GSC without additional device. Firstly, the embedded active filter (EAF) detects the harmonics and calculates the compensation current based on instantaneous measurements in the time-domain. In addition, both general compensation module for total harmonic distortion (THD) and specific compensation module for selected-order harmonics are combined in EAF. Furthermore, the proposed EAF improves the power quality for remote Point of Common Couplings (PCCs). Finally, an OWPP connected with island distribution grid and external grid is implemented in DIgSILENT/PowerFactory with field measurements to validate the performance of proposed EAF.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Leakage Current Monitoring Device of MOV in UHV/EHV Series Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the working characteristics of Metal Oxide Varistor (MOV) in series capacitors, the architecture of MOV's leakage current monitoring device using for EHV or UHV series capacitors was studied in this paper. The method of extracting and correcting resistive current of each MOV based on main capacitor current was proposed. Furtherly the MOV's leakage current monitoring device and power supply based on current transformer was developed. The finite element model of the series capacitors was established and the electric field intensity and potential distribution after installing the monitoring device were simulated and analyzed. The application of MOV monitoring device was firstly implemented in China, and the leakage current data of under MOV's operation were obtained, which provides reference for the development of condition monitoring technology of series capacitors in the future.

articleTitle: Lightning Strike Ablation Characteristics of Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The accidents caused by lightning strike on transmission lines affect the power supply reliability of power system seriously. The research on strands breaking of overhead transmission lines caused by lightning strike mainly focuses on numerical simulation and accidents analysis. There are few researches on overhead transmission lines ablation characteristics. The typical types (JL/G1A-120/20-26/7, and JL/G1A-240/30-26/7) of overhead transmission lines were selected to test with simulated lightning in this paper. Tensile force (15% RTS, 25% RTS and 35% RTS) and transfer charge (50 C, 100 C, 150 C and 200C) were selected to test their influence on the test results. Through ablation morphology analysis, it can be concluded that tensile force and transfer charge are both proportional to lightning strike damage to overhead transmission lines in the case of strands twisting tightly. This paper provides the foundation for following researches about ablation characteristics of overhead transmission lines and has the guiding significance for engineering lightning protection.

articleTitle: Generation Method of Power System Test Examples Based on Complex Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper presents a methodology for the systematic generation of synthetic power grid test examples. The synthetic power grids have the same characteristics with actual power systems and do not correspond to any real grid. thus, the generated synthetic power grids are free from confidentiality requirements and available for public use. The examples constructed by this method have small world effect and their characteristics are consistent with that of China's power grid. Meanwhile, the evaluation method of the electrical characteristic parameters of the generated network is studied, and finally the test examples that can be used for various researches are generated. The statistical characteristics of the generated examples are basically consistent with the existing typical examples. The generated examples can provide help for the study of various kinds of power grid operation control methods and power flow calculation methods.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Temporal Coordination of A Multi-Energy Microgrid with Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Currently, the demand response scheme is more and more popular with the widespread installation of the smart meters. Accordingly, the multi-objective optimal coordination of a multi-energy microgrid (MEMG) is investigated considering the multi-energy DR schemes. The operation objective is minimizing the net operating cost and gas emissions simultaneously under all the system operation constraints. As for the multiple demand response scheme, for electricity, the price-based DR (PBDR) is used; for the thermal (heat or cooling) energy, as the thermal energy system has higher inertia, then it can be used as the demand response scheme.
