To solve the multi-objective problem, the weighted sum method is used given the preference from the decision makers. Besides, for high solution quality, the original nonlinear operation model is linearized as a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) one. Then it is efficiently solved by commercial solvers like Cplex and Gurobi. Finally, the validity of the proposed method is verified by a case study.

articleTitle: Research on 72-hour Thunderstorm Prediction Method for UHV Transmission Line Based on BPNN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to improve emergency protection level of ultra-high voltage (UHV) transmission line when facing large scale thunderstorm, back propagation neural network (BPNN) is adopted to establish a 72-hour thunderstorm prediction model. Firstly, standard deviation of the input meteorological parameters is standardized, and statistics of the output actual lightning activities are carried out according to unified grid division. On this basis, the three-layer back BPNN is used to complete the model training. Finally, the prediction results are evaluated by using the actual lightning activities across the prediction area and the lightning tripping events of UHV transmission lines. The results show that the 72-hour thunderstorm prediction method proposed in this paper is practical in lightning protection engineering application of power grid.

articleTitle: Traveling Wave Time Difference Based Multiterminal Transmission Network Fault Location
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the fault location accuracy of multi-terminal transmission line is not high, a fault location method based on multi-terminal traveling wave time difference is proposed. By analyzing the difference among multi-terminal traveling wave time difference in different fault locations, the multi-terminal traveling wave time difference matrix is established, which shows that the multi-terminal traveling wave time difference reflects the characteristics of different fault locations. F norm is used to analyze quantitatively the difference among the different fault location. By comparing the matrix F norm of each simulated fault point with the actual fault, the fault location is determined. Thus, the accurate fault location is calculated by the double-ended fault location PSCAD simulation result show that the proposed method is simple to implement and determine accurately the fault location. It has some certain practical vaule.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Driven Rolling Evaluation and Optimization Method of Distribution Network Asset Utilization Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of distribution network and the emergence of new load areas, scientific methods are needed to guide the expansion and planning of distribution network. Traditional investment methods are based on human experience, which tends to cause confusion in distribution network planning and low investment efficiency. In this paper, a deep learning driven rolling evaluation and optimization method of distribution network asset utilization efficiency is proposed. Stacked autoencoder (SAE) is used to evaluate the asset utilization efficiency of distribution network. The input of SAE is the current load level and investment strategy, and the output of SAE is asset utilization efficiency. SAE greatly accelerate the evaluation of asset utilization efficiency. Considering the multiyear rolling investment, the investment in the next year will be evaluated based on the investment results of the previous year, so as to achieve the optimal asset utilization efficiency of multi-year investment. The proposed method is tested on a modified IEEE 34-bus system, which shows the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Consensus-based Algorithm for Electric Vehicle Charging System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A fully distributed consensus-based approach is proposes to optimally schedule electric vehicles (EVs) charging. The framework for EV charging coordination is established. Firstly, each EV computes a local control signal and exchange the information with its neighbours. The control signal profile updates have been achieved by a consensus algorithm. Then, EVs charging profiles have been updated based on the control signal broadcast by the utility in each iteration. The iteration continues until it converges to optimal scheduling. Hence, the optimization problem is solved according to consensus control signals updates from utility.

articleTitle: Two Optical Image Fusion Model of Transmission Line Based on DCGAN
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of poor image fusion in existing image fusion and enhancement methods, a dual light image fusion model of transformer based on DCGAN is proposed. It changes the original structure which constructs a cyclic GAN to allow the generator to generate fused image. The image feature of visible and infrared light is extracts from transformer in substation through the deep discriminant convolution network. The two image features are coded in the same feature dictionary for sparse coding which is fused and used as input of generating network. The fused image of transformer is obtained by deconvolution operation. Finally, using the error of training, the model can generate a useful fusion feature. The experiments show that it reduces the hardware pressure for existing of dual light images and has a good fusion effect.

articleTitle: Vulnerability Analysis of Cyber-physical System Based on Improved Structural Entropy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous integration of the power grid and the information network, the vulnerability analysis of cyber-physical system considering the interaction between networks become more important. Based on the complex network theory, a topology model of power cyber-physical network is established, and improved structural entropy is proposed, which considering node differences, edge differences, and node dependency differences. Taking the Hunan Electric Power Cyber-Physical System as an example, the simulation results show that the improved structural entropy can identify important nodes in the power grid. the dependent network is more vulnerable than a single network, nodes with high-degree and high-betweenness play a key role in maintaining the operation of the system, and the robustness of system will also be reduced when a few nodes with low-degree and low-betweenness fail.

articleTitle: A Microgrid Controller Security Monitoring Model Based On Message Flow
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of computer technology, information technology, big data, artificial intelligence, and industrial automation technology, information technology has been widely used in the field of industrial control. However, microgrid terminals generally work in an open environment and have the computing power and wireless communication functions, making them more vulnerable to attacks and threatening the security of the power grid. This paper proposes a method of using message flow to build a safety monitoring model and evaluates it through experiments. We use the external characteristics of network traffic flow to generate the model, that is, the specific content of network traffic is not considered. We validate that it is feasible to detect attacks with a detection accuracy above 95% by using machine learning methods.

articleTitle: Locating Lightning Arrester Counters in UAV Inspection Video of Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: UAV (Unmanned aerial vehicle) is widely used in high voltage transmission lines inspection presently. Aiming at the problem of lightning arrester counters automatic recognition in UAV inspection videos, this paper proposes an image recognition solution based on deep learning, and designs a lightning arrester counter automatic recognition system. The designed automatic recognition system detects and locates the region of the arrester counters in the UAV inspection video firstly, and then recognizes the meter reading in the located region. This paper focus on the target detection and location of arrester counter in UAV inspection videos. The results show that deep learning algorithm can accurately locate the regions of the arrester counters in the images, and lay a foundation for the subsequent meter reading recognition.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Influence of Multi Source Load Connection on Distribution Network Operation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since the 21st century, with the increasing shortage of global primary energy reserves and the popularity of environmental problems, the global wave of renewable energy has been set off. As the cleanest secondary energy, electric energy is one of the most important measures to solve the global energy shortage and unbalanced energy distribution by using renewable energy distributed access and transforming it into power grid. The multi-source load access to the power grid is bound to have a certain impact on the distribution network. In this paper, in order to study the impact of distributed generation access on distribution network, the hybrid output model of distributed generation is established. The accuracy of the model is proved by an example, which lays a foundation for the future research on active distribution network structure adapting to multiple source load access.

articleTitle: Dynamic Frame Slotted ALOHA Algorithm Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) technology is more widely utilized around varieties of industries. When dealing with a large amount of labels, RFID system often encounters serious collisions due to the label response, resulting in the problem of low reading efficiency. The key to solve this problem is the speed and accuracy of label number estimation algorithm. Based on the analysis of the traditional algorithm, a new label quantity estimation algorithm is proposed, which applies the BP neural network to establish the mapping relationship between the last frame read and the number of remaining labels in the reader. The simulation results prove that the proposed algorithm can effectively reduce the time consumption and improve the system efficiency compared with the traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Two-level Capacity Optimization Strategy for Generations in Multi-energy Gathering Center Considering the Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As traditional optimal planning strategies in multi-energy gathering center are only dominated by the economic index, while the flexibility index has not been taken into consideration. This paper creatively proposes a comprehensive evaluation metric of flexibility and economic index based on the multi-scenario operation process and the optimal planning method. A two-level capacity optimization model of different generations in multi-energy gathering center is established in this paper. This model consists of two objectives, the economy index and the flexibility index. The outer model applies the capacity of two flexible resources, thermal power units and battery energy storage units, as decision variables. And the inner model aims at the operating cost and flexibility index as objectives. The combined method of NSGA-II, linear programming and quadratic optimization is adopted to solve the above two-level optimization problem on the basis of fully considering multiple scenarios. Finally, based on the actual data and energy characteristics in a multi-energy gathering center in Yunnan, the proposed planning strategy is verified. Simulation results show that, compared with the traditional planning strategy only considering the economic cost as the main index, this proposed strategy can significantly reduce the energy abandonment and loads’ cutting rate. As a result, the proposed strategy reduces the possibility of grid risks and improves the system reliability and flexibility.

articleTitle: Decomposition Characteristics of SF6/N2 Under Partial Discharge of Different Degrees
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The use of $SF_{6} / {N}_{2}$ mixed gas is a technical means to effectively alleviate the greenhouse effect and lower the liquefaction temperature, which has been applied in GIS(Gas Insulated Switchgear). During the long-term running of $SF_{6} / {N}_{2}$ GIS, some insulation defects will occur and deteriorate, and the characteristic decomposition components of $SF_{6} / {N}_{2}$ gaseous mixture under PD (Partial Discharge) can be used to accurately identify whether there are serious insulation defects in GIS. Therefore, this paper focuses on the relationship between $SF_{6} / {N}_{2}$ decomposition and PD. Firstly, an experimental platform for $SF_{6} / {N}_{2}$ mixed gas PD was built, and then PD decomposition characteristic test under the condition of needle plate defect was carried out. Finally, the correlation characteristic between the content of the generated characteristic decomposition component and the discharge quantity was analyzed. The main conclusions can be summarized as follows: the production of $SOF_{2}, SO_{2} {F}_{2}, {NO}_{2}$, and NF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> have a positive relation with PD intensity; The content and change rule of NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> can be used to identify the overall process of PD, ${SO}_{2} {F}_{2}$ can be used to determine early PD, SOF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> can be used to determine severe PD. The research results of this paper will lay the root for the fault diagnose of $SF_{6} / {N}_{2}$ gas insulation equipment by $SF_{6} / {N}_{2}$decomposition characteristics in the future.

articleTitle: Security Assessment of Intelligent Distribution Transformer Terminal Unit Based on RBF-SVM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the main security problems faced by the intelligent distribution transformer terminal Unit in the station area, this paper proposes a security situation assessment method for the intelligent distribution transformer terminal deployed in the distribution station area. By extracting key system indicators that affect terminal security, a nonlinear support vector machine(SVM) classifier based on Gaussian kernel(RBF) function is constructed, and k-fold cross validation and grid search are used to determine the optimal parameters C and g of the classifier, establishing an intelligent configuration.then Simulating and training the normalized system index data.the results show that this method can effectively identify and classify the abnormal working indexes of the terminal, so as to realize the security situation assessment, which has certain practical value.

articleTitle: Comparison of Insulated Tubular Busbars with Different Insulated Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the low-voltage insulated tubular busbars have been widely implemented due to the merit of high current-carrying capacity. Due to the uneven productive quality, failures of insulated tubular busbar occurred occasionally during operation and the consequences can be serious. In this paper, the recent industry status and technical features of different types of insulated busbars are summarized. Three mature types of insulated busbar are compared, and the advantages and disadvantages are summarized.

articleTitle: A Method of Remote Experiment for Complex Energy System: An Example for Process Control Experiment of Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the development of remote network laboratory, the online laboratories have become a new form of experiment, because it is not limited by the location and time. But most of the experimental equipment of online experiments are oriented to relatively simple control systems. And the complex and dangerous experiments are still trapped in the physics laboratories. In this paper, an online remote method for complex control system experiments is proposed. And the combustion control system in thermal process control experiment of the 1000MW thermal power plant is chosen as an example to show the online system framework and implementation process. The system provides a new form for the experiment and training of complex energy system and solves the problem that the physical experimental equipment cannot simulate part of the experimental scene. It can not only avoid the dangerous part of the actual experiment but also present the realtime operation of complex energy systems. At the same time, it can increase the flexibility and efficiency of engineering experimental education.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Fault Diagnosis Technology for Distributed Photovoltaic System Based on Ensemble Voting Fusion Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the gradual consumption of fossil energy, the development and use of renewable energy become more and more important. Distributed photovoltaic power stations have become an important means to efficiently use solar energy for power generation. Under the influence of complex environmental factors, with the continuous expansion of photovoltaic power stations, photovoltaic system accidents occur frequently, and problems in operation and maintenance gradually emerge. In order to improve the informatization level of photovoltaic system and reduce operation and maintenance costs, this paper designs an ensemble model based on cross-validation, which integrates five classical classification algorithms. Through analyzing and processing multidimensional data of photovoltaic system, it realizes the function of fault diagnosis and fault classification of photovoltaic system. By comparing the performance of single model and ensemble model in photovoltaic fault diagnosis, it is found that the ensemble model has better diagnostic performance and can be used for photovoltaic system operation and maintenance and fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Transient Hybrid Simulation of UHV AC/DC Power Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of the power system, the simulation of pure electromechanical transient and electromagnetic transient has been shown to be insufficient in the analysis of large-scale UHV AC-DC hybrid power grid. The characteristics of UHVDC transmission are related to many factors. tegaoyazhiliuIt is based on the Akhil Delhi Prathmik Shikshak Sangh (ADPSS), and analyzed the simulation of rectifier side and inverter side AC bus fault. The results show that the output of electromechanical and electromagnetic transient mathematical modeling can describe the detailed process of the whole system, and provide technical theoretical support for the stability control of the UHV AC/DC system.

articleTitle: Accuracy Evaluation Method for Electromechanical Transient Model of Dynamic Reactive Power Compensation Device Applied to Renewable Power Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the grid-connected performance of renewable power stations at home and abroad is evaluated by means of modeling and simulation, and the influence of each component model on the evaluation performance can not be ignored. In renewable power station, the model accuracy of photovoltaic inverters and wind power converters can be evaluated based on the test data of full-condition type, but the dynamic reactive power compensation device can not carry out full-condition type test because of its high voltage level and large capacity, so the model verification can not be carried out accordingly. In this paper, a model accuracy evaluation method of static var generator (SVG) based on hardware-inthe-loop(HIL) test data and model verification is proposed. By establishing a validated HIL test environment, the test data of SVG controller under full-condition power grid disturbance are obtained, and the simulation data are based on test data and evaluation model. The deviation is used to evaluate the accuracy of SVG model, which provides an accurate model support for the grid-connected performance evaluation of renewable power stations.

articleTitle: Optimizing and Controlling Building Electric Energy Using Cat Boost Under the Energy Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper describes innovative research on the data-driven control policy for building energy-saving based on a cloud platform under four-story building energy Internet of Things (IoT) architecture. The platform devotes to provide data representation and interpretability analysis for different stakeholders to achieve flexibility and scalability; simultaneously, to improve thermal comfort while reducing building power consumption. The platform manages data from the IoT devices and builds energy management systems using a cloud-based, user-friendly human-computer interaction interface. Decisions on how to optimize the operation of building energy systems are becoming increasingly complex. Data-driven predictive control (DPC) is a control technology that replaces conventional strategies, such as rule-based control and model-based predictive control (MPC). When applied to complex building operations, control-oriented data-driven models are used to implement finite time receding horizon control. This paper adopts the CatBoost algorithm for model prediction, which is highly interpretable and easy to operate for different stakeholders. A numerical simulation case study is utilized to compare the control performance, such as the residential building power consumption, R Squares, RMSE, and Test time, with other strategies: XGBoost, TDNN, LightGBM. The results show that the investigated algorithm’s performance outperforms others’, while significantly reducing the complexity and implementation cost.

articleTitle: Prediction of Photovoltaic Power Based on Entropy Weight Combination Forecasting Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) power prediction is an effective way to ensure the safe operation of the grid connected photovoltaic power station, and the prediction accuracy is very important as well as difficult. In order to improve the prediction accuracy, a combination prediction model based on entropy weight and traditional prediction methods is demonstrated. The combination prediction model used entropy weight to combine three traditional prediction methods which are persistence method, support vector machine (SVM) and prediction method based on similar data. And the entropy weight of each single prediction method is got by evaluating the amount of information of each method objectively. The prediction accuracy of entropy weight combination prediction model and these three single prediction methods are compared by simulation. Case study results show that the combination model based on entropy weight can get proper combination weights for these traditional methods. As a result, the prediction accuracy of entropy weight combination prediction model is much higher than that of single traditional prediction method for all weather types.

articleTitle: Comparison Analysis of Modulation Strategies for Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces the modular multilevel converter(MMC), analyzes five modulation strategies of the multilevel structures: carrier phase shift pules width modulation(CPS-PWM), carrier overlap modulation, carrier rotation modulation, nearest level modulation(NLM) and incremental capacitance equalization algorithm with voltage upper and lower limits. In order to analysis the dynamic performance, including harmonic component, switching loss, and characteristics of capacitor ripples of MMC, the simulation experiments were completed in PLECS. After comparison, it is found that there are different results when measuring the merits of modulation strategies from different standards. On this basis, this paper presents the optimal modulation strategies in different scenarios, and also provides a direction for future improvement.

articleTitle: Distribution System Anomaly Detection Based on AnoGAN Embedded with Cross-Stitch Units
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: We consider the anomaly detection problem in distribution systems. Many distribution systems are not observable due to their limited numbers of real-time meters, thus state estimation based approaches are not applicable. Moreover, the number of abnormal samples are usually small comparing to the diversity of anomalies, imposing challenges to machine learning based methods as well. To this end, AnoGAN, an unsupervised learning method, is applied to the distribution system anomaly detection in this paper. Only normal samples are needed during its training process. In the testing process, it generates corresponding samples based on its knowledge trained from normal ones, which are compared against real measurements to detect if there are possible anomalies. To achieve better granularity, we propose to partition a large distribution system into sub-networks, establish parallel AnoGANs, and employ Cross-stitch units to incorporate their correlations. Simulations have been done to show the satisfactory accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approach in detecting anomalies in distribution system.

articleTitle: Impact of Energy Storage on Security-Constrained Unit Commitment of Power System with Wind Power Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing of wind power penetration rate in large power grid, it is of great importance to analyze the impact of wind power on unit commitment of power system and economic dispatch. In the security-constrained unit commitment problem, the introduction of wind turbine can reduce the operating cost of thermal power units and improve the economy of system operation. Because the energy storage system has the characteristics of fast two-way regulation, it can improve the power grid’s ability to absorb wind power and the economy of the system operation. By controlling the charging and discharging of energy storage, it can provide certain flexibility for determining the system unit commitment scheme. Therefore, by considering the forecast error influences of wind power and load, this paper introduces the energy storage system into the security-constrained unit commitment of power system with wind power. Moreover, the constraint condition of rotating reserve opportunity based on trust theory is introduced to avoid over configuration of backup. Thus, the uncertainty of wind power can be effectively improved and the operation cost of the system can be reduced. In addition, the paper compares and analyzes the changes of unit commitment status and system operation cost with or without energy storage, as well as the influence of energy storage parameters and the way of access system (close to wind power side, load side and decentralized access) on the unit commitment model under wind power curtailment condition. Finally, the linearized security-constrained unit commitment model is analyzed and validated with 10 units system.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Configuration of Emergency Reserve for Fluctuation Risk of Renewable Energy Output
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the centralized interconnection of renewable energy sources has led to a surge in the reserve demand of power grids. However, relying solely on conventional reserve for risk management and control obviously cannot meet the operational requirements of grid. In view of the shortcomings of the existing optimal configuration of reserve, this paper studies the optimal configuration of unconventional reserve, namely emergency reserve, which can participate in short-term regulation of power system and has additional configuration or regulation cost. In this paper, based on the risk method, with the goal of minimizing the total cost of regional risk control, an optimal configuration model and algorithm of emergency reserve are established. Through simulation analysis of numerical examples, it is verified that the introduction of emergency reserve can improve the grid's ability to respond to emergencies. At the same time, it is also verified that the algorithm is adaptive when dealing with different prediction inputs.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Power Optimal Dispatch Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As high penetration of wind power integrated in-to the large-scale power grid via the transmission line, active power control is prone to poor tracking control construction and over the capacity of the transmission line, and it is difficult to effectively suppress the power fluctuation caused by the randomness of wind power in traditional control methods. Therefore, a novel wind power optimal dispatch based on model predictive control (MPC) is proposed. In this approach, a combined prediction model based on the variancecovariance (VC) variable weight is adopted to provide prediction information for dispatch. To maximize wind power output, a finite time domain rolling optimization and real-time feedback correction of wind power strategy is developed for intraday dispatch, and in the feedback correction procedure, the current output state of the wind power is taken as the initial value of the next round of receding horizon optimization dispatch. A case study is carried out with a regional wind farm in North China taking as an example. The simulation and experimental result analysis show that the control strategy proposed in this paper can not only suppress the power fluctuation, but also effectively maintain the safety of the transmission line.

articleTitle: Review of Power Emergency Repair Strategy after Typhoon Disaster
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Typhoon may damage the power system and cause huge economic losses. Making appropriate emergency repair strategies can greatly reduce the damage caused by typhoon. This paper presents a detailed review the previous research on power emergency repair. First of all, this paper reviews emergency repair of power system after Typhoon. How to locate the repair-unit stations and find the shortest path is the focus of this research. Secondly, this paper introduces the application of vehicle routing problem in electric power emergency repair. The combination of vehicle routing problem and power emergency repair can make the formulation of emergency repair strategy simple. Finally, this paper summarizes the solution of vehicle routing problem. Compared with the precise algorithm, heuristic algorithm is widely used because of its fast convergence. In the future, intelligence and information are the direction of electric power emergency repair process. The combination with computer intelligence can better allocate resources, help decision makers to make plans quickly and reduce the losses caused by typhoon disasters.

articleTitle: Short-term Day-to-day Maximum Load Forecasting based on Data Mining and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of energy Internet renewable energy, more uncertainty and randomness are added to power system. Accurate load forecasting will improve power generation plans and the utilization of renewable energy. A dayto-day maximum load forecasting method is proposed which uses Gaussian mixture model (GMM) clustering based on multidimensional scaling (MDS) and support vector machine (SVM) after empirical mode decomposition (EMD). MDS is used to reduce the daily load data from 24 to 2 dimensions. Different daily load data obtained by GMM clustering are formed into daily maximum load curves. EMD method is used to decompose load curves into a series of relatively stable component sequences, and then the SVM model establishes prediction models for the decomposed components. Finally, the predicted components are summed to obtain the predicted value of the maximum load. The calculation results show that the prediction accuracy of the prediction model proposed is about 3% higher than that of the traditional prediction model.

articleTitle: Distributed Generation Capacity Planning Method of AC/DC Hybrid Distribution Network Based on Different Functions of Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a distributed generation capacity planning method for AC/DC hybrid distribution network based on different functions of energy storage. The objective function is established for the purpose of economic optimization. According to the different application scenarios, the energy storage is divided into two functions: standby power supply and peak shaving and valley filling. Two optimization models are established from these two aspects. Considering the power quality of power grid, power supply reliability is introduced as a constraint. The complicated calculation process of power supply reliability of complex grid structure is solved by using Monte Carlo method. We use the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm with fast optimization speed and accurate results, and the simulation example also proves this point. This paper provides a new method for distributed generation capacity planning of AC / DC hybrid distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence of Stray Current on Grounding Grid and Corresponding Protection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Stray current, as a special current, is common in the earth, and it will have a certain impact on the grounding grid of the power system. Based on CDEGS modeling, this paper studies the distribution of stray current and its influencing factors. In addition, the stray current in the soil not only causes corrosion to buried metals, but also affects the cathodic protection system of buried metals to varying degrees. It is proved through simulation that a certain level of stray current will have a serious impact on the sacrificial anode cathodic protection method, but the external current cathodic protection method has little effect. Therefore, it is recommended to use the external current cathodic protection method in the area of stray current interference. Combined with an engineering example in a certain area, a corresponding external current cathodic protection scheme is designed according to the analysis of the factors affecting the stray current, which greatly reduces the corrosion rate.

articleTitle: Research on Planning Method of Park-level Integrated Energy System Considering Multi-objective Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integrated energy system can promote the local consumption of renewable energy, realize the rational use of resources, and improve energy efficiency by complementary advantages of multiple energy sources. The paper considers typical day system operation, and the capacity allocation optimization model is established with the objective function of the total economic cost, pollutant emission and the lowest annual primary energy consumption in the whole life cycle of the system. Finally, according to the data of a business park in Beijing, the feasibility of the proposed approach to planning has been verified through simulation, and the optimal capacity planning of the system has been realized, which provides theoretical foundation and technical support for the planning and design of the integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Dynamic Reactive Power Compensation in Multi-Infeed HVDC Power Grid Considering Transient Stability
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transient instability has become the crux threatening the safety and stability of the multi-infeed HVDC power grid. The dynamic reactive power compensation is one of the methods to solve it. However, the existing schemes of the dynamic reactive power compensation always directly select the installation location on the HVDC converter bus or the primary network bus, without considering dynamic loads in the transient stability problem. In view of the interaction between multiple HVDCs, this paper suggests locating parallel capacitors on the power flow path to block the interaction between HVDCs. Considering the transient characteristics of dynamic loads, this paper proposes a dynamic reactive power compensation scheme, where SVG is installed in the low-voltage heavy-load area to suppress the development of transient instability from the source. Simulation results show that the proposed method can effectively suppress the development of transient stability problems.

articleTitle: Research on Safety Evaluation System of Optical Storage Charging Station Based on Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of integrated solar storage and charging power stations has become the key issue in the development of new energy. The effects of insufficient power supply, effective charging time, load uncertainty and user evaluation during the operation of charging stations are comprehensively considered in this paper, and a safety evaluation index system based on fuzzy comprehensive evaluation theory is proposed. In order to ensure the accuracy of the comprehensive evaluation results, a two-layer evaluation model is used for fuzzy comprehensive evaluation to avoid too small weight values of evaluation factors. Finally, an example is given to prove the effectiveness of the evaluation model.

articleTitle: Economic Dispatch Strategy of Multi-energy System Considering N-1 Security Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of multi-energy system is motivated by the energy evolution around the world and is currently popular. MES operation is faced with reliability challenges. This paper proposes an economic dispatch strategy of MES considering N-l security constraints. The MES includes the electricity, heating, cooling, gas energy types. The N-l security constraints of all the four above energy conversion devices are modeled. We carry out a case study to simulate the proposed model. The results verify that the proposed optimal scheduling strategy can ensure the continuous supply of energy for important cooling, heating, and electric energy load regardless of the energy supply device failure.

articleTitle: Analysis on Transient Overvoltage Mechanism of Large-scale Renewable Energy Integration System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The transient overvoltage problem on wind farm side is one of the main factors constrained the transmission capacity of large-scale renewable energy integration system and interconnection capacity of renewable energy. In this paper, the sensitivity of the voltage of the wind turbine generators is firstly derived to illustrate the mechanism of the overvoltage problem. Then the simulation is performed on a prototypical system and a practical power grid in north of China respectively. The results show that the constant reactive power control of the dynamic reactive power compensators (RPCs) combined the increasing internal potential of the equivalent system result in the transient overvoltage. Finally, the impact of different control modes of RPCs is analyzed. It is concluded that the constant voltage control of the dynamic reactive power compensators or the small synchronous condensers installing in wind farm can effectively suppress the overvoltage problem.

articleTitle: Research on Multi-source Heterogeneous Data Cleaning Technology based on Integrating Neural Network with Fuzzy Rules for Renewable Energy Accommodation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to avoid conservative results, when calculating the ability of power system to accommodate renewable energy, social data need to be integrated. Data cleaning is an important step in integration. Traditional data cleaning methods rely only on data and ignore the implicit rules. This paper first analyzes the data requirements for renewable energy accommodation, and then proposes a data cleaning technology. This technology digs out the implicit associations between data, converts them into fuzzy rules in the form of Probabilistic soft logic (PSL), and builds a neural network based on this for data cleaning.

articleTitle: Radiation Influence Model of Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the current situation of imperfect network construction of electric vehicle charging facilities, the establishment of a charging station radiation influence model provides reference value for charging network planning. First, a clear definition of the radiating influence range of the charging station was established, and the comprehensive capacity evaluation system of the charging station was established. Then, the factor analysis method was used to obtain the comprehensive factor of the charging station. Finally, the radiation radius of the charging station was solved according to the Wilson model. The simulation results revealed The relative size of the radiation capacity of a charging station in a certain area has laid a foundation for the future charging network layout and distribution network construction.

articleTitle: Operation Control Strategy of Soft Open Point Based on Unified Virtual Electric Machinery Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Soft open point (SOP) mostly adopts “rigid” control strategy, which is insufficient with inertia and damping. It leads to the lack of flexibility in feeder power flow control and cannot actively participate in power adjustment of the distribution network. In addition, SOP mostly relies on feeder power to stabilize the DC bus voltage, which greatly limits the flexibility and operational reliability of feeder power flow control in distribution network. In this paper, a self-energy storage soft open point (SES-SOP) operation control strategy is proposed to solve the aforementioned problems. The AC and DC ports of the SESSOP are integrated with a unified virtual motor control, and the operating characteristics of the rotating electric machinery are simulated simultaneously on both ports, and there is no need to switch control strategies during multi-mode operation. The DC port exhibits flexible characteristics, suppresses the impulsion of the feeder exchange power to the DC bus voltage, and enhances the inertia and stability of the DC bus voltage. At the same time, the active and reactive power of the port can be adjusted actively to support the frequency and voltage of the distribution network. The simulation results demonstrate the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed operation control method.

articleTitle: Optimal Planning of Distribution Network Considering Photovoltaic Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The distributed photovoltaic consumption capacity and the corresponding development plan of distribution network have become the common concern of all parties at present. A PSO-based optimization method is proposed in this paper with the aim to evaluate the maximum distributed photovoltaic consumption ability of the distribution network, compared with the existing analysis methods, the evaluation method proposed in this paper can provide more accurate information of distribution network absorptive capacity, which is more flexible and more practical than the random scenario method. When the photovoltaic power generation consumption capacity exceeds the maximum consumption capacity of the distribution network, life cycle cost(LCC) theory is adopted and the LCC decomposition model of the planning scheme is given, that aiming at the minimum life cycle cost, and the economy of the distribution network development planning scheme is analyzed and evaluated when the high permeability distributed photovoltaic power generation is connected, so as to further improve the technical economy of the scheme. The effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method are illustrated by a specific example, which provides a strong references for the operation and planning of high permeability distributed photovoltaic in distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Low voltage ride through Control Technology Based on Dynamic Voltage Restorer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Large-scale wind power access to the power grid poses great challenges to the safe operation and management of the power grid. The new power grid guidelines require that wind turbines should be equipped with low voltage ride through (LVRT) capabilities. Considering that the dynamic voltage restorer (DVR) has the advantage of being able to quickly and accurately perform voltage compensation in a short time, this paper proposes a fault ride-through scheme for doubly-fed wind turbine based on the dynamic voltage restorer. Aiming at the detection delay and attenuation caused by the filter in DVR, an integral detection method based on the theory of instantaneous reactive power is adopted to reduce the influence of the filter. According to the control characteristics of DVR, a DVR control algorithm based on the double Q-P theory of coordinate transformation is proposed, which can compensate the transient voltage disturbance and effectively improve the compensation performance of the dynamic voltage restorer. Using PSCAD / EMTDC simulation software to establish a simulation platform, the simulation results show that when a serious short-circuit fault occurs during the transmission of electrical energy from the wind farm to the grid, the DVR can quickly detect voltage changes and accurately compensate for the required voltage to obtain the ideal transient characteristics Improves the low voltage ridethrough performance of wind turbines.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method for Single-phase Fault Processing Technology of Distribution Network based on Safety Protection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The causes and processes of personal accidents in the distribution network have extremely complicated factors. Due to the lack of scientific understanding of the basic laws of safety risks, personal accidents are repeatedly happened, leading to vicious electric shock accidents. In addition, if faults cannot be handled quickly and in a timely manner, ground faults can easily cause device overvoltage, causing equipment burnout and even causing fire accidents. Single phase grounding fault and power failure will reduce the reliability of power supply and directly affect industrial production and people's living standards. This article is mainly based on the international advanced safety management concept. By identifying the influencing factors of single-phase grounding in distribution networks and closely integrated with power grid enterprises actual field operations, using the “5M safety risk factor” theory to analyze the personal safety and equipment safety influencing factors in power supply operations, extract six major influence factors that have a greater impact on the distribution network operation and personal safety. Based on the above points, a quantitative assessment model, index, and method system for single-phase fault processing based on security protection are proposed to effectively improve the person and device safety in power grid companies. Pre-control ability has very important practical value and promotion significance. It can provide a strong reference for the primary and secondary equipment and structure design of the new distribution network and the adjustment of the operating mode of the distribution network in operation, and effectively guide the operation and maintenance of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Optimal Control Parameters of Battery Storage System for Frequency Regulation and Economic Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The independent small power grid is difficult to maintain frequency stability. To tackle this challenge, battery storage system (BSS) is employed for frequency regulation. However, due to the high cost of BSS, the economy of frequency regulation of thermal power units assisted by BSSis difficult to evaluate, which hinders the application of BSS. In this paper, an economic analysis model for joint frequency regulation is proposed considering the thermal power unit frequency regulation wear and BSS battery aging cost. According to the economic analysis model, the economic benefit of joint frequency regulation is quantified, and the operational control parameters of BSS are optimized. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, BSS greatly reduces the cost of the joint frequency regulation. At the same time, the optimal control parameters are obtained, which has important guiding significance for the actual operation of BSS.

articleTitle: LCC-HVDC System Dynamic Phasor Modeling Based on Improved Switch Function
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate modeling and dynamic simulation of integrated AC/DC grids play a fundamental role in power system stability analysis and control. Unbalanced operating conditions in AC side results in a large number of second harmonic current or voltage distortion on DC side and third harmonic on AC side. In this work, we build an advanced dynamic phasor model for the LCC-HVDC converter, which is suitable for the normal operating and unbalanced fault conditions of the system. Meanwhile, a second-order dynamic phasor model is proposed for the control system modeling and DC line. Finally, the proposed models are applied to the first CIGRE HVDC benchmark system to test the new model's validity. The simulation results are validated by PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Review on Modeling Methods of Large-Scale Wind Power Connected UHVDC Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When large-scale wind power is transmitted through ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) system, transient overvoltage (TOV) problems caused by events such as commutation failure and DC blocking seriously affect the safe operation of the system and constrain the power transmission capacity. Accurate modeling of the system is the basis for analyzing the transient overvoltage characteristics of the system. In this paper, the modeling methods of the main components of the system, especially UHVDC transmission line and large-scale wind power cluster, were sorted out in detail. The advantages and disadvantages of various modeling methods were reviewed. Feasible optimization schemes were proposed for future modeling of large-scale wind power connected UHVDC system.

Author Keywords: ultra-high voltage direct current transmission system

articleTitle: Supraharmonics Detection Algorithm Based on Bimodal Spectral Line Interpolation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The wide application of high-frequency power electronic equipment leads to the increasingly serious problem of supraharmonics in the power grid. However, the existing hamionic detection methods have some problems such as slow detection speed and more data processing when used to detect supraharmonics in a wider frequency range. In this paper, based on a comprehensive comparison of existing harmonic detection algorithms, a detection algorithm for supraharmonics, bimodal spectral line interpolation algorithm, is proposed. The algorithm can effectively suppress the spectrum leakage, and the detection accuracy is good, which provides a new idea for the accurate detection of supraharmonics.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization Based on Fuzzy C-means Cluster for Day-ahead Allocation Plan of Multiple Photovoltaic Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution power system connecting with multiple photovoltaic distributed generation (PV-DG) will bring a huge effect to the economical benefit and stable operation of the distribution power system. The scene of Distribution power system connecting with multiple PV-DGs is designed in this paper, considering with short-time economical benefit and stable operation, economical benefit cost index, voltage error index and voltage stable index of optimal objective, the output of PV-DG is multiple-objective optimizing; In order to improve the optimizing performance of multiple objective particle swarm optimization, the PSO based on fuzzy-C means cluster algorithm is proposed, the initialization of PSO is clarified with fuzzy-C means cluster, the Pareto solving method is used to analyze on the optimizing solution set of the optimization. Considering with uncertainty of PV-DG output and time-variation of load demand, the auto regressive moving average (ARMA) model is used to predict the PV-DG output and load demand, the forecasting data is used to optimize the short-time economical benefit and improve the stability of operation. Based on the illumination and load demand in the history, the simulation is carried on the matlab platform, the simulation results indicate that PSO based on fuzzy-C means cluster optimizing algorithm can optimize the economical benefit cost and stable operation in the same time.

Author Keywords: particle swarm optimization based fuzzy-C-means cluster

articleTitle: Impact Analysis of Renewable Energy Accommodation Considering Heat Pump in Peak Shaving
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the expansion of the installed capacity of renewable energy (RE), the accommodation of RE has not been completely solved yet. During the heating period in China, the electricity output of combined heat and power (CHP) units is determined by the heating load, which reduces the total shaving capacity and making the wind power accommodation more difficult. Firstly, this paper establishes the operation optimization scheduling model of the integrated electricityheating systems. Then, using the combined heat and power units and heat pumps (HP) as the coupling points of the system, the influence of heat pumps on renewable energy accommodation is analyzed based on the traditional heating network model. Finally, numerical tests are conducted on the system constructed by IEEE 33-bus distribution network and Barry Island 33-bus heat system. By comparing different results of different scenarios, this paper discusses the influence of heat pump before and after connecting to the system on the operation of each units and grid-connected wind power. It is obviously that considering heat pumps in peak shaving can improve the capacity of renewable energy accommodation.

articleTitle: Cost-Based Approach for Time of Use Pricing Decision
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Current electricity pricing menu for demand response (DR) which oriented purpose, for example TOU (Time of Use) playing more and more important role in deregulation market, especially after mass introduction of renewable energy and application of demand response mechanism in power market. However, the current studies manly focused on market mechanism and not pay attention sufficiently on the relationship between the electricity price setting menu and the actual power supply cost structure. This paper proposed a cost-based pricing scheme. First, we analyzed the cost structure of variable cost, fixed cost, and reliability loss cost of each power source based on the cost structure of the power supply configuration from long-term economic viewpoint, then conducted a basic study on the setting of electricity charges by time period considering the recovery of these costs. We use a simple example to demonstrate the applicability of this propose and concludes some useful results. The methodology proposed in this paper is one of the cost-based foundational study for actual DR pricing scheme.

articleTitle: Research on Wind Power Capacity Evaluation Based on Risk Theory and Unit Commitment Under Multi-Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power generation has aroused people's extensive concern because of the increasing wind power curtailment. In order to reduce the wind power curtailment rate, a reasonable and precise evaluation model of the consumption capacity is proposed to optimize the planning of wind power to the max extent. Nevertheless, wind power generation is in accordance with the frequency modulation, peak-load shaving ability and the wind fluctuation. Thus, the typical operation conditions need to be considered. Based on the commitment theory and vector ordinal optimization(VOO) method,, the wind farm optimal capacity model under multi scenario units is established considering operation risk with the objective of the min curtailed wind power, the min risk and the min operation cost. Based on the VOO method, the optimal energy consumption of different wind farms under different scenarios is calculated. Finally, through the simulation of IEEE RTS test system, the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed control method are verified.

articleTitle: Short-term Load Forecasting of Long-short Term Memory Neural Network Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accurate load forecasting is conducive to the reasonable arrangement of power grid dispatching plans. Traditional load forecasting methods cannot handle the time series and nonlinear characteristics of load well. Long-short term memory (LSTM) neural networks can record long-term and short-term information, which can effectively solve this kind of problem. But the parameters of LSTM network are difficult to determine. For this reason, this paper proposes a long-short term neural network based on genetic algorithm. The learning rate and iteration number of the LSTM network are used as chromosomes, and the genes are continuously selected, crossed, and mutated to obtain more good genes. Comparing this method with the standard LSTM network, the simulation results show that the LSTM network using genetic algorithm for parameter optimization improves the prediction accuracy of the standard LSTM network by 63%.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of 220kV Cross-River Cable Carrying Capacity Considering Complex Environments, Part II — Thermal Analysis of Cable in the Utility Tunnel with Ventilation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The second part of these papers is based on the first part, and further discusses the capacity calculation model of the cross-river cable in the underground traffic tunnel. Firstly, the structural model of the river-crossing traffic tunnel is introduced, and the possible installation location and layout of the river-crossing cable are analyzed. Combined with the cable ampacity results (1864A) in the first part of these papers, the actual temperature of the installation position of the cable in the river tunnel has been measured, and the environmental temperature of 35°C is determined as the boundary condition. This paper further analyzes the cable ampacity under three installation modes. Results show that the three-phase close trefoil arrangement cannot meet the requirement of power transmission. The three-phase separated trefoil arrangement and the horizontal linear arrangement are further studied. With fireproof encapsulation, the capacity of separated trefoil arrangement is lower than the required value by 122A while the capacity of horizontal arrangement is 2060A. To save space, the capacity of separated trefoil arrangement with fireproof structure and ventilation system is calculated to increase the capacity. In the end, the detailed ventilation cooling system design is also provided for reference.

articleTitle: Modelling and Control of Wind-PV-SOFC-Battery Based DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modelling and control for a DC microgrid are key technologies to ensure the reliability and stability of the DC microgrid power supply. In particular, distributed renewable energy generation is known to be unstable. There is no support from main AC network when operating in island mode, which would easily cause power imbalance in the network, and eventually leads to DC bus voltage instability and even system crash. In recent years, high temperature solid oxide fuel cells have achieved great development and are expected to be used as a flexible power source for distributed microgrids. Therefore, this paper presents a model for DC microgrids based on wind-PV-SOFC-battery. Within the DC microgrid model, a wind power generation unit, a photovoltaic power generation unit, a high temperature fuel cell, a battery unit and a load unit are established to control the operation of DC microgrid and to manage the energy of battery. The feasibility and effectiveness of this method are verified via simulation under various modes.

articleTitle: Frequency Control Strategy of Energy Storage System Based on SOC under Distributed Photovoltaic Intensive Access
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing permeability of new energy generation, a large number of conventional thermal power units have been replaced, and the equivalent inertia of the system has been reduced. The randomness and fluctuation of distributed photovoltaic output may lead to serious frequency fluctuations. It is necessary to fully exploit other frequency modulation equipment in the power grid. Because of its ability to smooth the fluctuation in new energy, energy storage systems have been widely studied and applied in power system. The energy storage system is connected to the power grid through the inverter, but there is no inertia link. This paper simulates the traditional synchronous generator operation mode, and adds virtual inertia link in the inverter control process to slow down the frequency change rate when the system fails. At the same time, the charging state of the battery energy storage system is incorporated into the inverter droop control to correct the inverter droop control coefficient in time. In this paper, the effectiveness of the algorithm is verified in the simplified model of a real power grid. The results show that the system’s frequency transient stability is improved.

articleTitle: Research on SVG Correlation Control Strategy Based on Voltage Slope Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The voltage control ability of new energy stations is an important content of the assessment of new energy stations, and reactive power support is an important means to maintain the voltage. Relevant national standards also put forward requirements for power factor and reactive power allocation of new energy stations. Static var generator (SVG) can adjust the voltage of monitoring point quickly and accurately by absorbing or emitting reactive power. When multiple sets of SVG control objectives are consistent, reactive power offset will occur, resulting in voltage oscillation. This paper proposes a SVG correlation control algorithm based on voltage slope detection, which can accurately determine the cause of voltage fluctuation and avoid the reactive power output deviation caused by the device misjudgment. The actual test results show that the algorithm proposed in this paper has a strong robustness, and has a strong reference value for solving SVG associated control.

articleTitle: Analysis on Protection Function of VSC-HVDC Projects
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, the construction of VSC-HVDC projects have been vigorously promoted in China, and its system structures and technical characteristics are quite different from LCC-HVDC projects. Therefore, this paper first describes and compares the typical system structures and technical characteristics of various projects based on the existing VSC-HVDC projects in China, and then taking actual project as an example, the protection configurations and functional principles of AC protection zone, AC connecting bus protection zone, converter protection zone and DC protection zone are analyzed. Finally, the configuration schemes of each protection function are analyzed.

articleTitle: Data Model Design of Dispatching, Operation and Maintenance of Power Information System Based on CIM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, Chinese power grid management has entered the stage of information management, and various production and management systems have emerged, but these systems generally have problems such as inconsistent data models and non-standard data access interfaces. Therefore, following the IEC61970 standard, this paper studies a grid public data model based on DMTF-CIM expansion. The model takes the integration of dispatching, operation and maintenance of power grid information system as the entry point and adopts the technical architecture based on the J2EE platform to design and implement. This paper focuses on the modeling method, data architecture, data logic and data Integrated design to realize data interoperability and integration of multiservice systems.

articleTitle: Indicator State Recognition Based on HSV Feature Transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To improve the recognition accuracy of substation inspection robots for densely arranged and colorful indicator lights, a method of indicator state recognition based on color clustering is proposed. Firstly, a holomorphic filter and calibration are adopted to overcome the influence of illumination and the shooting angle. Then, the s-component clustering segmentation method is used to locate the indicator, and row and column projections are carried out on the positioning result to extract the projection curve. Finally, the peak values are used as the basis for dividing the row and column, and the identification of the indicator array of multiple rows and columns is converted into a single indicator unit in a small area. Experimental test results showed that the recognition rate of this method could reach 98.5%.

articleTitle: Analysis of Harmonic Spatial Distribution Along AC Power Lines of Meshed Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Harmonics propagation in power systems may result in increased power losses and equipment damages. In this paper, an elliptic formula is derived to analyze the harmonic spatial propagation not only at the substations, but also along the power lines or cables and to give a system-wide overview of harmonic levels. It is observed that harmonic distortion along power lines can be higher than that at the busbars. All cases are modelled in detail by analytical geometry and analyzed using MATLAB. In this regard, a method to identify the weak positions in terms of maximum harmonic levels in a power system is presented, and its corresponding harmonic orders are determined. The accuracy of the model is tested using time-domain simulations in PSCAD/EMTDC.

articleTitle: Coordinated Frequency Control Strategy for Electric Vehicles and Air Conditioners Based on Hierarchical Control Scheme
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The large-scale access of renewable energy brings severe challenges to the stability of power grid's frequency. Flexible loads which can participate in frequency regulation (FR) provides a new solution for power grid to solve this problem. Therefore, this paper proposes a coordinated control strategy of electric vehicles (EVs) and air conditioners (ACs) based on hierarchical control scheme. The upper layer of the hierarchical control scheme focuses on the coordination of different load aggregators of EVs and ACs. According to loads' different response characteristics, a refined state classification method is proposed to calculate each aggregator's controllable capacity accurately. The lower layer concentrates on the capacity allocation between individual loads in the cluster, and the unified model of loads of different parameters is used to determine loads' action priority. Simulation results show that the proposed strategy can satisfy the users' needs and the power grid's FR requirements to the maximum extent, and the effectiveness of the strategy is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Power Spot Market Comprehensive Index System and Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the acceleration and deepening of China's market-oriented reform of electricity, the spot market of electricity has become the mainstream trend of power system reform in all provinces and regions of the country, a series of evaluation index system suitable for spot market can evaluate the operation of spot market reasonably and quantitatively, and improve the operation efficiency of power spot market. On this basis, a comprehensive evaluation method is used to realize the introduction of dimension and multi-index Quantitative Analysis. Finally, taking foreign spot market as an example, the feasibility and applicability of the index system and comprehensive evaluation index are verified. The experiment shows that the proposed method of overall evaluation and index system of spot market is of great reference significance to ensure the safe operation and market operation of power system.

articleTitle: The Impact of High-Speed Heavy Electric Railway Load on Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: After ten years of construction and development, the Jiuquan wind power base has taken shape and entered into reality, and the Hexi Corridor Lan-Xin Railway Electrification Project as well as the Lanzhou to Urumqi Pipeline Project will also start constructions and developments. It should be noted that the locations of the high-speed tracks, the heavy-duty electric railway traction power stations and the wind power 330kV/110kV substations will be electrically close. In this context, the electrified railway may result in an asymmetric operation and introducing harmonics to the power grid, endangering the reliability of the wind power system. Concentrated largescale off-grid win d power threatens not only the stability of Gansu Power Grid, but also the entire Northwest power grid. Besides, the intermittent wind power voltage fluctuations may also degrade the rehabiliy of the electric railway system power supply. To investigate these issues and problems, this work simulates and analyzes the influences of a high-speed heavy electric railway load on the wind farm performances.

articleTitle: The Shutdown Risk Assessment of Wind Farms under Typhoon Disaster
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Typhoon disaster can result in wind farms shutdown. With the large-scale integration of wind farms in power system, the wind farms shutdown may affect the operation of power system, causing the power shortage and voltage violation. In this paper, a shutdown risk assessment method is proposed to evaluate the risk of wind farms operation under typhoon disaster. Firstly, the distribution of forecast error of wind power under typhoon conditions is analyzed according to the historical data and is established as T distribution. Next, the real-time shutdown probability of wind farms is generated by the known cumulative error distribution. Then, the shutdown cost of wind farms are expressed by the cost of shedding load after wind power exiting, which is solved by particle swarm optimization method. Finally, the adjusted IEEE-33 node system with wind farms are adopted to verify the effectiveness of proposed method.

articleTitle: Deep Reinforcement Learning based Wind Farm Cluster Reactive Power Optimization Considering Network Switching
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For wind farm clusters, the overall performance of reactive power optimization can be further improved via optimal network switching. The problem can be precisely formulated as a mixed integer nonlinear programming (MINP) model, which is intractable since its non-convexity and nonlinearity. In this paper, a deep reinforcement learning (DRL) based algorithm is proposed to improve the real-time performance. There are two stages in this solution, the first stage is to train the agent. The second stage is online application using the trained agent and the MINP model can be efficiently solved. Considering the operational constraints, a learning framework containing over-limit behavior penalty and model-guided control is introduced. Furthermore, a weighted sampling method and asymptotic convergence strategy are applied to enhance the training efficiency. Numerical tests show that the proposed algorithm can solve this problem with acceptable computation time and the optimal network switching strategies can further improve the wind farms’ safety and economic level.

articleTitle: Reliability Evaluation for a Grid Connected Offshore Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Through Markov chain and sequential Monte Carlo simulation methods, the reliability model and indexes of the grid connected offshore wind farm, from wind turbines to collection system, collection bus and VSC-HVDC transmission system, are obtained, in which the influence of severe weather, switch configuration of power collection system and different spare strategies of VSC-HVDC are considered. The case study shows that the normal/severe dual weather mode is more conducive to accurately depict the reliability characteristics of offshore wind power system. Meanwhile, the reliability of maximum switch configuration is higher than that of minimum switch configuration. In addition, the cold spare can effectively improve the energy utilization rate and the hot spare can effectively reduce the failure rate of VSC-HVDC system.

articleTitle: Research on Life-cycle Comprehensive Low-carbon Benefits of Wind Power Generation from Distribution Planning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power is a kind of clean energy and wind power generation has the features of rich resources, clean and renewable, etc. So, it has enormous potential for low-carbon development. For the study of low carbon efficiency brought by wind power generation, this paper focuses on the characteristics of carbon emission and economic, considering both negative and positive factors about low carbon and economic. Carbon emissions (reduction) characteristics and economic benefits are analyzed from wind power benefits, wind power costs, the net loss improvement efficiency and spare capacity costs of four parts based on life-cycle concept and corresponding benefits analysis model is established. Then the comprehensive wind power low-carbon benefits assessment model is proposed by combining low carbon characteristics with the economic benefits of wind power. The concept of the carbon compensation time is also proposed. An example with practical operating data verified the validity of the evaluation model and methods proposed in this paper. The analysis results show that the wind power has great advantage in low-carbon, compared to conventional power generations.

articleTitle: State of Health Equalization Strategy for Retired Battery Based Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The safety of battery is of great importance in retired battery based energy storage system (ESS). When the state-of-health (SOH) of battery reaches the lower limit, the battery should be replaced to prevent accidents.
