In the energy storage power station, all the batteries are expected to be replaced at the same time so that the repair time and the maintenance cost can be reduced. This paper proposes a coordination strategy to equalize SOH among energy storage units and relieve inconsistency of batteries. Firstly, based on lithium-ion battery life cycle model, a method for SOH equalization control is derived. Secondly, an optimization model is constructed for the coordinated control in energy storage power station. Finally, the simulation shows the effect of the coordinated control strategy in this paper. This strategy can be applied to the energy management in retired battery energy storage power station for on-site control.

articleTitle: Failure Analysis of Overhead Conductors Damaged by Preformed Helical Stockbridge Damper
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A certain 220kV transmission line is arranged in the north-south direction, and the preformed helical dampers are adopted to prevent aeolian vibration of conductors. During the inspection of hidden defects of the transmission line at the beginning of 2016, it was found that a large number of conductors were worn by preformed helical clamps of the dampers, which seriously affected the safe and stable operation of the transmission line. In this paper, the failure causes of conductor wire are analyzed from several aspects including anti-vibration mechanism, damper structure, meteorological conditions along the line and anti-vibration measures. In addition, corresponding improvement measures and suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: Transparent Access Architecture for Intelligent Dispatching and Control System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the employment of the necessary information and communication technologies (ICTs) infrastructures, the smart grid evolves into a complex and large-scale cyberphysical system (CPS). Massive interacting components challenge the traditional data exchange mode. In order to meet the interaction requirements between intelligent substations and control center, the data service architecture for wide-area transparent access is proposed based on the general service protocol for electric power system. Then the key issue related to location transparency is discussed in terms of cross-domain service discovery as well as the service status analysis for ensuring the capabilities of wide-area services. Finally, the prototype of transparent access is implemented.

articleTitle: Event-Driven Fast Frequency Response for Large Active Power Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy sources, the equivalent inertia of power systems is decreasing, which leads to more drastic dynamic frequency response. This paper proposes an event-driven fast frequency response (EFFR) approach to counter frequency decline after large power disturbances. Based on the data from the wide area measurement systems, a centralized control framework is established to perform the EFFR. Then, the reference power for EFFR can be determined promptly via monitoring active power deficits. Considering the control costs and power reserves, a utility index is created to quantify the priority of each unit to participate in EFFR, on which the reference power is distributed. Furthermore, a recovery strategy is designed to restore the normal operation states of units when the power system enters the quasi-steady state. According to a droop slope, units exit the EFFR mode in sequence, of which the distributed reference power decreases gradually. A case study is presented to validate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Electric Vehicle Scheduling Based on Behavior Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The engagement and satisfaction of customers are essential for effective control of electric vehicles. This paper proposes a multi-objective optimal approach for the scheduling of large-scale electric vehicles based on customer behavior prediction. The recurrent neural network is applied to track and predict the behavior of electric vehicles which in turn helps to increase customer engagement and free them from repetitive labor. Then electric vehicles with similar behaviors are classified into the same group to form dynamic large capacity batteries for scheduling. Finally, a multi-objective optimization approach is used to optimally coordinate the benefits for electric vehicle customers and the stable operation of the power system. Simulation results verified the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: An Improved Droop Control Strategy of Distributed Energy Storage Systems in Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Load power balance between the distributed generations is an important issue in microgrid control. In order to achieve the power balance, droop control is considered to be an effective method due to the ability of plug and play. However, the traditional droop control strategy of the DC microgrid has the problems of low current sharing accuracy and voltage deviation. Aiming at this defect, an improved droop control strategy for the distributed energy storage system of microgrid is proposed. In this method, the state of charge (SOC) is estimated to realize the SOC balance in the discharge process. The simulation results show that the SOC values are balanced before the end of discharge, which verifies the effectiveness of the improved droop control strategy.

articleTitle: A Transmission Line Selection Method for Parameter Measurement Based on its Impacts on Power Flow Sensitivity and Static Voltage Stability
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Accuracies of high voltage AC overhead transmission line parameters are important for power system analysis and calculation. In order to obtain accurate transmission line parameters, field measurements of transmission line parameters are often conducted in practice. However, for a large power system, there are many transmission lines that needed to be measured. To determine the priority and significance of transmission line parameters to be measured and reduce the measurement cost accordingly, a selection method is proposed based on the parameter error influences on power system calculation including power flow and static voltage stability. In this paper, the line parameter error sensitivity on power flow is analyzed by the definition of derivation and local linearization, to investigate the positive sequence parameter influences. Then, the L-index is adopted to study the line parameter error impacts on system voltage stability. Based on the two indexes above, a selection method for transmission line parameters to be measured is proposed. The method synthesis the influences of parameter error and obtains the priority of transmission line measurements. Simulation case studies conducted on the IEEE 39 node system have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method for practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Observer Based Fault-tolerant Control for DC Microgrids with Sensor Fault
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we propose an active fault-tolerant control scheme for voltage regulation in DC islanded microgrids subjected to sensor fault. Firstly, a state observer designed by the static output feedback technique is introduced to estimate the uncorrupted states of voltage and current. Then, an observer based state feedback controller is proposed to guarantee the stability of voltage regulation under sensor fault. Simulation studies are carried out to evaluate the performance of the proposed fault-tolerant control scheme. Simulation results show that our proposed control strategy can significantly improve the reliability of the DC microgrid systems.

articleTitle: Design of Multi-Channel Integrated Platform for Electric Power Marketing Based on Microsoft Service Architecture
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the continuous advancement of power system reform and the vigorous development of the Internet industry, power marketing services are also facing higher challenges. In some scenarios, business applications using traditional monolithic architecture will become less flexible and less capable of continuous delivery, which makes business application maintenance difficult. In order to expand the multichannel service of power marketing and establish a comprehensive service platform system, this paper takes spring-boot and spring-cloud as the technical framework, divides the traditional single application into several fine-grained ones. Based on the business application characteristics of micro-service architecture, it builds a domain-driven model for the whole process of scenario, and builds a multi-channel integrated application platform for power marketing, which solves the problems of distributed data interaction caused by large business concurrency or cross-specialty in power marketing. Business applications can achieve gray-scale publishing, frequent deployment, and strong sustained delivery ability, flexible and fast to adapt to the effect of business sustainable development and change.

Author Keywords: Multi-channel Integration Platform for Electric Power Marketing

articleTitle: Coordinated Charging Strategy for Electric Vehicle Charging Station Based on Demand Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper studies the coordinated charging strategy of an electric vehicle (EV) charging station to achieve different objectives. The coordinated charging strategy considers not only the currently connected EVs but also the EVs will be connected to the charging station. The future charging demand is predicted, which is formulated in the form of a storage-like aggregated model. And a conseivative prediction method is proposed to consider uncertainty. An optimization model is built to obtain proper charging schedule which is solved as a rolling optimization problem for real-time control. Simulation results validates the effectiveness of the proposed model and solution method.

articleTitle: Frequent Itemsets Mining of SCADA Data Based on FP-Growth Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the powergrid fails, a large number of fault data will be transmitted to the dispatching center of SCADA system. Effective and fast processing of these data can minimize the loss of fault and restore the power supply quickly. In this paper, FP growth algorithm is used to mine frequent itemsets, and event folding window is used to discretize the data for easy processing. Through the correlation analysis of actual SCADA data, the results show that the method has a strong practical engineering significance for speeding up the fault analysis after the power grid fault occurs.

articleTitle: A Synchronous Iterative Method of Power Flow in Inter-Connected Power Grids Considering Privacy Preservation: A CPS Perspective
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing development of smart grid facilitates that modern power grids inter-connect with each other and form a large power system, making it possible and advantageous to conduct coordinated power flow among several grids. The communication burden and privacy issue are the prominent challenges in the application of synchronous iteration power flow method. In this paper, a synchronous iterative method of power flow in inter-connected power grid considering privacy preservation is proposed. By establishing the masked model of power flow for each sub-grid, the synchronous iteration is conducted by gathering the masked model of sub-grids in the coordination center and solving the masked correction equation in a concentration manner at each step. Generally, the proposed method can concentrate the major calculation of power flow on the coordination center, reduce the communication burden and guarantee the privacy preservation of sub-grids. A case study on IEEE 118-bus test system demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed methodology.

articleTitle: Research of Doubly Fed Induction Machine’s Optimal Reactive Power Limit Considering Junction Point’s Voltage Fluctuation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In allusion to defects of the traditional methods used to calculate the reactive power limit of doubly fed induction machine (DFIM) without considering that the variation of reactive power of the large-capacity unit will cause the voltage fluctuation of the junction point, a new calculating method of DFIM’s reactive power limit is proposed. This method, in dealing with the nonlinear problem with two influencing factors, transforms the influencing factor of junction point’s voltage by power flow calculation which calculates junction point’s voltage under different reactive power output scenes, treats the influencing factor of rotor-side converter’s current as penalty function, establishes a mathematical model taking maximum utilization of rotor-side converter current capacity as the base and maximum DFIM’s reactive power output as the goaL and calculates the optimal result based on self-learning migration particle swarm optimization (SLMPSO). The simulation results based on an improved IEEE 9-bus distribution feeder demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Energy System Evaluation Method Considering Multi-index System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important direction of energy reform, integrated energy system has become the focus of research and attention in today’s world. Building an integrated energy system can not only improve energy efficiency, but also bring good environmental benefits. At this stage, China has launched many R & D projects related to integrated energy systems, aiming to promote the construction of integrated energy systems. The evaluation of the integrated energy system is directly related to the safe and stable operation of the integrated energy system, and is an indispensable part of building an integrated energy system. In this paper, an integrated energy system is taken as the research object. According to the characteristics of multi-energy flow and multi-coupling in the integrated energy system, the indicator system is constructed according to the two levels of system operation and system equipment. Then use analytic hierarchy process to weight each level of indicators and calculate the value of each indicator, and finally make an overall evaluation of the comprehensive energy system to verify the feasibility of the established indicator system.

articleTitle: Power Safety Warning Method Based on GM-FHMM Load Decomposition Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the promotion and installation of large-scale intelligent electric energy metering devices being carried out all over the world, non-intrusive equipment load decomposition has become a research focus. Non-intrusive load decomposition refers to the process of decomposing bus data acquired by a port/node into branch data with feature identification. Decomposing the main node's load can find the non-technical attacks in the downstream nodes. In this paper, the Gaussian Factorial Hidden Markov Model (GuassFHMM) is used to construct and experiment the load decomposition model, safety warning requirements are realized by improving the accuracy of load decomposition and local optimality. A dynamic programming algorithm-the extended Viterbi algorithm is given as the core of the model to decompose the total Markov chain more precisely. The Baum-Welch algorithm is introduced to study the model parameters, and add the simulated annealing algorithm to solve the local optimal problem. Case studies based on the REDD load data set are conducted to prove the effectiveness and practicality of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Modular Multilevel Converter With Partial Energy Storage System for Frequency Support
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Frequency fluctuation becomes one of the urgent issues with the ever-increasing penetration of power electronics converters in the grid. This paper proposes a modular multilevel converter with partial energy storage system (MMC-PESS) where the arm is comprised of the normal submodule(NSM) and the energy submodule(ESM). Based on analysis of the relationship between the number proportion of ESMs and energy storage charging/discharging power, the control strategies including virtual synchronous machine (VSM) control, state of charge (SOC) equalization and the Buck/Boost control are developed for frequency support by applying the energy storage system. Finally, the theoretical analysis and frequency support performance are verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Large-scale Automatic Verification Data for Smart Meters in Non-reference Temperature
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When an electricity meter is calibrated under the condition of non-reference temperature, it is generally necessary to correct the verification result according to the actual temperature of the verification environment, and then judge whether the electricity meter is qualified. Under the mode of large-scale automatic verification, the space of workplace can reach thousands of square meters, and the temperature distribution is uneven. In order to reduce the cost of controlling verification environment temperature, the effort of trying to broaden the range of verification environment temperature has been always made by researchers. The problem is that it is difficult to make an effective judgment on the batch verification results based on the verification data. Under this circumstance, a data analysis method which helps to ensure weather the verification results are effective is needed. In this paper, the batch electricity meters verification experiment is designed and carried out firstly, then the distribution characteristics of verification data are studied, and the conclusion is obtained that the distribution type of verification data is normal distribution. On this basis, the method based on parameter test is used to analyze the data consistency, which shows that this data analysis method can make auxiliary evaluation on the validity of verification data produced in non-reference temperature environment. The data analysis method described in this paper can be applied to the operation state evaluation of large-scale automatic verification system and can also provide data analysis means for broadening the range of environment temperature for large-scale automatic verification.

articleTitle: Magnetizing Inrush Current Blocking Method for Shunt Reactor With Auxiliary Winding System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Shunt reactor with auxiliary winding system can compensate line capacitive reactive power and provide power for switching station. There are large amount of air gaps in the iron core of the reactor, leading to weak coupling relationship between shunt reactor winding and auxiliary winding. According to the special structure of shunt reactor with auxiliary winding system, an inter-turn protection principle of shunt reactor with auxiliary winding system based on zero sequence current phase and amplitude protection is proposed. And mechanism of magnetizing inrush current is analyzed, and the magnetizing inrush current blocking method of protection inter-turn protection is proposed. The protection proposed can improve the sensitivity of the inter-turn protection of the shunt reactor with auxiliary winding system, prevent the misoperation of the no-load closing and out-of-area fault, and improve the reliability.

Author Keywords: shunt reactor with auxiliary winding system

articleTitle: Finite Element Simulation Analysis of Three-phase Bridge Arm Reactor of Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of modular multilevel converter (MMC), the reactor at the bridge arm of the converter is an essential component in its topology. During the operation of MMC, because the capacitor voltage on each phase bridge arm is not equal, it is easy to cause the unbalanced voltage of bridge arm, and finally lead to the unequal DC current component in the three-phase bridge arm. The unbalance of DC component can easily lead to excessive magnetic bias of one phase in three-phase reactor, and then cause the unbalance of AC component in three-phase bridge arm, and finally lead to zero sequence circulating current inside the bridge arm. The zero sequence circulating current enters the DC side and intensifies the fluctuation of voltage, current and power at DC side. In this paper, the finite element method is used to simulate and analyze the suppression effect of three-phase bridge arm reactor on the second harmonic circulating current under the condition of unbalanced DC component, which provides a theoretical basis for the design and selection of MMC bridge arm reactor.

articleTitle: Research on Internet of Things Convergence and Access Architecture of Intelligent Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, for the operation and maintenance team (station) and grass-roots management personnel, the Internet of things convergence and access architecture of substation intelligent equipment is established, and various subsystems such as on-line monitoring of substation, video monitoring of auxiliary control system, micro meteorology, inspection robot, security, power environment and other subsystems are integrated to realize the machine replacement of substation equipment inspection, regular switching, transformer, combined electrical appliances, fire protection system State control of main and auxiliary equipment. Access node and sink node are responsible for collecting data of various meters, sensors, online monitoring devices and auxiliary control system, and transmitting them to the background of Internet of things.

articleTitle: Research on Multi Units Coordinated Phase Advance Based on Filled Function Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of reactive power surplus and main network voltage rise caused by light load operation period, this paper focuses on the reactive power distribution strategy of multi units coordinated leading phase operation. In order to maximize the overall safety margin of multi units leading phase and the similar safety margin of each unit, a multi units coordinated leading phase reactive power distribution model is established, and a filled function particle swarm optimization algorithm is designed. Firstly, a local minimum solution is obtained by using particle swarm optimization algorithm, and then the global optimal solution is obtained by constructing a filling function. Finally, the method is applied to a practical 220 kV district power grid to verify the feasibility of the model and method.

Author Keywords: filled function particle swarm optimization algorithm

articleTitle: Study on Power Flow Linearization Based on Error Correction of Voltage Profiles
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power flow linearization can tackle the challenges attributed to the inherent nonconvexities of power flow equations. Different linear models have been widely utilized in various power system applications. During the derivation, the common assumptions are flat voltage profiles and zero angle differences of branches. However, when the assumptions are not satisfied enough, the approximation of linear models deteriorates. Hence, this paper proposes a power flow linearization method based on error correction of voltage profiles. The coefficients of related terms in the linearized power flow equations are corrected according to a rough estimate of voltage profiles. The proposed method is tested extensively on benchmark systems. The results show the approximate accuracy of power flow linearization improves if the coefficients are selected appropriately. A guideline on selecting coefficients is concluded for both transmission and distribution systems.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Lightweight Manmachine Terminal Screen Interactive Client
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to the characteristics of the “physical distribution and logical integration” of the new generation dispatching automation system, this paper designs a lightweight human-machine terminal display architecture. It also proposes the componentization of the screen and its rendering technology to realize the display of electrical primitives, chart primitives, and non-viewable primitives on lightweight man-machine terminals. Besides, this paper proposes the GIS visual display technology to meet the needs of geographic information display in the dispatch automation system and put forward the interaction technology of picture linkage to improve the interaction flexibility of picture components. Relevant research results have developed prototype system and applied in the field pilot.

articleTitle: A nested Genetic Algorithm for Generation Planning in Electricity Market
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In China, the electricity industry is currently undergoing significant transform towards deregulation and competition. The long-term generation investment in electricity market has received more attention. A multi-level generation planning model in electricity market is proposed in this paper. The upper level problem of this model is the non-cooperative game equilibrium problem of generation investment decision, and the middle level problem is the profit maximization problem of multi-stage generation investment for individual generation company. Considering the fluctuation of system load, the lower level problem is a multi-scenario and multi-period market clearing problem. In view of the complexity of the model, this paper proposes a nested genetic algorithm to solve it. First, considering the integer programming characteristics of generation planning, a two-level nested genetic algorithm is used to deal with the upper level game problem and the middle level investment profit maximization problem. Then, linear programming is used to solve the lower level multi-scenario multi-period market clearing problem. The case results of graver-6 and IEEE 118 bus system validate the proposed model and the algorithms.

articleTitle: A Differential Game Approach to Distributed Energy Trading for Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper designs a distributed trading mechanism for Energy Internet in which distributed generations uncertainty is considered. In order to match up Energy Internet, We-Energy (WE) is proposed for the convenience of energy regulation, energy trading and information interaction. First, a differential game approach to distributed energy trading for energy internet is proposed. Then, in order to avoid the risk and error caused by the uncertainty and intermittency of renewable energy supply, trading mechanism based on credibility is designed. Subsequently, the offline mode and online to offline (O2O) mode are compared. Finally, the effectiveness in the offline mode and O2O mode is verified through simulations on the three connected WEs.

articleTitle: Strategy of Voltage Stress Supression and Dynamic Simulation Experiments of MMC Sub-Module on Hybrid Cascaded Multi-Terminal UHVDC Transmisson System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: When the metallic ground fault occurs at the valve side of modular multilevel converter (MMC) on hybrid cascaded multi-terminal ultra-high voltage direct current (UHVDC) transmission system, the non-fault phase and the fault phase will constitute the fault charging circuit and the rectifier side continuously injects energy into the MMC after blocking, which will cause over-voltage of the faulty MMC valve group sub module. More seriously, the converter valve equipment will be damaged. To reduce the voltage stress of MMC sub module and improve the reliability and safety of converter valve equipment, aiming at the single-phase ground fault characteristics of MMC valve side, the voltage stress suppression strategy based on controllable arrester and MMC step-by-step blocking are proposed from the perspective of consumption of surplus power and optimization of control scheme. Finally, the strategy is verified by the platform of dynamic simulation experiments. The test results demonstrate the proposed strategy is validity, and the voltage stress suppression strategy based on MMC step-by-step blocking is better.

Author Keywords: hybrid cascaded multi-terminal ultra-high voltage direct current transmission system

articleTitle: Fault-Tolerant Control of Twelve-Phase PMSM Based on Motor Model Reconstruction in FESS
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In flywheel energy storage system (FESS), multi-phase motor can be used to drive the flywheel for its high power density and fault-tolerance performance. Aiming at the two-phase fault in different sets of three-phase windings in twelve-phase permanent magnetic synchronous motor (PMSM), afault-tolerant control strategy based on motor model reconstruction is proposed in this paper. The set of three-phase windings that has phase failure is controlled as single-phase motor. Therefore, the twelve-phase PMSM is treated as an integration of two three-phase motors and two single-phase motors. The proposed strategy maintains stable torque and power during fault-tolerant operation. Theoretical analysis and simulation are carried out in this paper, and the results demonstrate that the proposed strategy has good effectiveness on two-phase faults in two sets of wingdings, no matter the two phases are orthogonal or not.

articleTitle: Study on Autotransformer’s Low Voltage Side Over-current Protection with Circulating Current
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: 500kV autotransformer has split type and integrated type. The current transformer (CT) position of low voltage side is different for these two types of autotransformer. This paper analyzes circulating current in autotransformer's delta winding when single-phase grounding fault takes place on high voltage side. Protection setting method considering circulating current in delta winding is proposed for split type autotransformer. Simulation results verify the position of two types of autotransformer's CT influences the circulation current in low voltage side protection. Protection setting for an autotransformer used in Shandong electric power grid tests the correctness of the over-current protection setting with circulating current proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Thermal Aging Characters of Silicone Oil in Cable Terminal
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to actualize the safe and reliable operation of transmission lines, it is necessary to carry out research on cable latent faults, so as to grasp the operation characteristics of cables under different fault conditions. This focuses on the thermal aging problem of silicone oil in cable terminal caused by long-term heating. The testing oil were placed in sealed pots and were thermal aging in a heating oven for 90 days at three different conditions, i.e. 30 °C, 60 °C and 90 °C. The electrical and physicochemical properties were tested to study the degradation level of the oil, and the infrared spectrum characters are tested to identify the presence of new substances. The experiments showed that the speed of degradation of silicone oil is very slow under limited thermal aging temperature (lower than 60 °C in this study) and test time. When the temperature is further raised to 90 °C, the aging process of silicone oil is accelerated. The acid value and kinematic viscosity increase, but the fluctuation range is not obvious. The whole aging process is accompanied by water generation. In addition, from the infrared spectrum results, the long chain molecule of silicone oil breaks down under the condition of thermal aging, which makes the side chain -CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> separate from the main chain of Si-O and forms a new impurity component.

articleTitle: Application of Flywheel Energy Storage Equipment in Vital Places
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Flywheel energy storage equipment can be used in vital places, for high power loads in short time duration. Multiindex is used to describe the power quality. The national standard of power quality and several kinds load characteristics are discussed in this paper. An application example of flywheel energy storage equipment was presented in actual engineering, which demonstrated that flywheel energy storage equipment could provide output with excellent power quality.

articleTitle: Identification of Key Lines of Power Grid under Typhoon Disaster Based on Situation Awareness
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Typhoon disaster may cause blackout. The key lines are closely related to the occurrence of blackout. It is of great significance for disaster prevention and mitigation to accurately identify the key lines under typhoon disaster. Based on the idea of situation awareness, the key lines in the power grid under typhoon disaster are identified by considering five situations, including line fault situation, defense situation, topology situation, operation situation and fault prone situation. By using the combination of subjective and objective AHP-entropy weight, the weight of each situation is reasonably determined. And the comprehensive situation of the line is determined. The key lines are identified according to the comprehensive situation of the line. The simulation results of IEEE 39-bus system under typhoon disaster show that the proposed method can identify the key lines in the power system under typhoon disaster reasonably and comprehensively.

articleTitle: A Quantitative Analysis Method for the Influence of Three-phase Unevenness on Line Loss Based on K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Firstly, the three-phase load is taken as the characteristic value, and the K-Means algorithm is used to cluster the unbalanced situation. Then, aiming at the problem of less sample data in the course of experiment, the adversarial generation network is used to increase the sample data. Then we calculate the increment coefficient of three-phase unbalance for the result of three-phase unbalance phenomenon. Finally, according to the relationship between the three-phase unbalance and the line loss increment coefficient, the line loss increment caused by different types of three-phase unbalance is estimated. The experimental results show that the three-phase unbalance can be classified effectively by using K-Means clustering, and the calculation of the line loss increment coefficient is improved accuracy, in which the use of adversarial generation network to increase sample data can further improve the experimental accuracy.

articleTitle: Coordinated Frequency Support and Multi-Band Oscillation Damping of Power System with GridConnected Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since intermittent bulk wind power integrating into the power grid via power electronic devices lead to new oscillation and the decrease of the system inertia, the stable and secure operation of the power grid becomes more and more complicated and challenging. This paper proposes a coordinated frequency support and multi-band oscillation damping scheme for power system connected with a double-fed induction generator based wind farm (DFIG-WF). A frequency control strategy based on tie-line power deviation feedback is designed for the wind farm to participate in the system frequency support. Moreover, in order to suppress the low-frequency oscillation and the sub-synchronous oscillation, two separate damping controllers (DC) are designed and those three supplement controllers can coordinate to achieve the system frequency support and oscillation suppression. The proposed coordinated control scheme is verified via the IEEE 16-machines 68-bus system with a DFIG-WF. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of simultaneous frequency support and oscillation damping provided from DFIG-WT under various disturbances.

articleTitle: Discussion on Reactive Power Coordination Control Technology of VSC/LCC HVDC Parallel Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, with the continuous construction of high-voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission projects in China, a new type of grid structure named VSC/LCC HVDC parallel hybrid system is formed. The structural characteristics of the system are described in this paper, and three control strategies for reactive power coordination between VSCHVDC and LCC-HVDC are proposed, so as to give full play to the structural advantages of VSC/LCC HVDC parallel hybrid system, the VSC-HVDC reactive power capacity can be reasonably utilized, the service life of LCC-HVDC related primary equipment can be prolonged and its loss can be reduced.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Energy Storage System as Black Start Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of energy storage technology and the continuous expansion of the scale of energy storage power stations, the role of energy storage power stations in improving the recovery speed and stability of the grid after a failure cannot be ignored. This paper establishes an equivalent model of the energy storage system. By analyzing the main problems of frequency and voltage stability in the initial stage of the black start, the control strategy of the energy storage system as a black start power source is proposed. Finally, using DIGSILENT software simulation verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the energy storage power station as a system black start power source, which provides a certain reference for the application of the energy storage power station in the black start of the power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis and Simulation of Functional Properties of Large Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric power industry in China develops rapidly, thus China’s grid structure tends to be complicated. This paper classifies the different functional properties of the power grid, discusses the different functional properties of the power grid and their impact on the grid structure, constructs the network optimization model based on the functional properties and conducts simulation verification, thus providing a grid planning method based on different functional properties of the grid.

articleTitle: Development Path of Future Power Grid with High Proportion of Renewable Energy in the Context of Electricity Spot Market
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The world is striving for a diversified, clean, efficient and market-oriented chain for power supply and consumption. In China, the development of clean energy, the reform of power market and the progress of Energy Internet technology make the energy and power industry in an unprecedented period of transformation. Considering that the development of power grids is a realistic problem-oriented theme, the development problems of power supply, grid and demand side in the electricity spot market is analyzed. On this basis, the development goals of the future power grid and the research direction are summarized respectively, with the future power grid development roadmap constructed. This work aims to clarify the relationship of each link of power grid development, and further promote the transformation and development of power grids to Energy Internet.

articleTitle: A Novel Traveling Wave Fault Location Algorithm for Distribution Network Based on Binary Tree Model and Multiple Time Information
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Fault location of distribution network is of great significance to power supply reliability. In view of the incapability of traditional traveling wave fault location method for transmission lines of meeting the requirement on high precision location of the distribution network that is complex and profusely branching in structure, a novel traveling wave fault location method based on multiple time information is proposed. The incidence matrix and distance matrix are built to judge the selection of fault. The time information and the structure of the distribution network are used in the algorithm to delete the ineffective arrival time of traveling wave for realizing accurate fault location, based on the model for the location binary tree. The feasibihty and effectiveness of the presented method is verified by PSCAD/EMTDC simulation results.

articleTitle: Security Analysis of Power System Network Based on Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power system network is developing towards a more intelligent and integrated direction. Compared with the past, the attack and dispatching of power system network are more diversified and antagonistic, and the security of power system network is facing more severe challenges. In this paper, we attempt to analyze the security of power system network based on complex network. Firstly, the IEEE57 power system is modeled by reactance weighted and undirected network, the cascading failure model is used to describe the relationship between nodes and edges. Then three types of attack of power system network are analyzed. According to the dynamic characteristics and damage degree of power system network, corresponding attack countermeasures are provided.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Design and Control Technology of Secondary Circuit in Substation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The secondary circuit design of substation adopts CAD design and generates DWG file. The engineering information can only be read by human. The machine can not directly obtain the circuit information, which does not meet the needs of the development of smart substation. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes a set of digital design scheme for the secondary circuit of substation to solve the digital problem of design content expression. Based on the analysis of the digital design requirements of the secondary circuit, the physical and connection properties of the secondary equipment concerned in the design are obtained. The modeling language, modeling scope and modeling object of secondary circuit are defined. Based on the results of digital design, the control scheme of digital design documents is proposed to ensure the consistency between design documents and practical application of the project.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on the Power Transmission Stability of HVDC-connected Offshore Wind Farms
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the wide application of the renewable eneragy, more attention has been paid to the abundant offshore wind energy resources. Experience in the field has shown that oscillation may occur between offshore wind farms and HVDC systems due to the internal interaction between the offshore converter and the wind farms. Therefore, it is necessary to find out the factors that may cause the oscillation between the wind farms and the offshore HVDC system, and find out the corresponding measures to eliminate these oscillations so as to improve the reliability of the system operation. Through PSCAD modeling and simulation practice, this paper points out the factors that cause the oscillations and make corresponding improvements to make the system run in a stable state.

articleTitle: Piecewise Linear Ramp based Preventive Dispatch for Intra-Interval Power Insufficiency
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power is of volatility and uncertainty, and its nonlinear characteristic will lead to the intra-interval power insufficiency (IIPI) problem which means that thermal power plus wind power is insufficient to supply total loads. Power system will encounter frequency drop and load shedding when the intra-interval power insufficiency problem occurs, and the system will even break down when the constant IIPI problem cannot be solved. Hence, a piecewise linear ramp based preventive dispatch (PLRPD) method is proposed to solve the IIPI problem in the worst case in this paper. Case study on the modified IEEE 118-bus system proves that the proposed method in the paper is effective to reduce the insufficient power to the secured threshold.

articleTitle: Symlets Wavelet Transform based Power Management of Hybrid Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Focused on the power demands of electric vehicles(EV) involving chaotic and high frequency transient component, the EV can hardly handle these power demand components due to the limitations of characteristics of the single Lithium-ion power battery. A symlets wavelet transform strategy is proposed for the power management of hybrid electric vehicles (HEV) with hybrid energy storage systems(HESS) including a Lithium-ion power battery and an ultracapacitor(UC). Firstly, the control system mechanism of multiport bidirectional DC/DC converter were presented briefly. Then the algorithm of symlets and the symlets wavelet transform based power management for HESS were analyzed. The proposed symlets wavelet transform strategy can distinguish the high-frequency components and low-frequency components in the power requirements of HEV, and allocate power to sources with different frequency characteristics to achieve the best power management control algorithm. Finally, a scaled-down experiments were performed under Highway Fuel Economy Test driving cycle(HWFET). The experimental results validated the effectiveness of symlets wavelet transform strategy management algorithm.

articleTitle: Efficient Transient Magnetic Field Computation Using Adaptive Dual-order Finite-element Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: An adaptive dual-order finite element method (FEM) for efficient transient magnetic field analysis is presented. For each time step being simulated, the proposed adaptive FEM uses both first order and second order finite element basis functions to dynamically adjust the orders of finite elements of the problem region, aiming at using less computational resources to achieve better solution accuracy. To reduce the order of basis functions for sub-regions where the solution variation is smooth, a degrees-of-freedom (DoFs) constraining algorithm is investigated to eliminate unnecessary DoFs. This method can avoid solution interpolation errors between different meshes and it can also be implemented readily in the element matrix analysis and further global matrix assembly. Numerical examples computed using the proposed method are presented to validate the algorithm and showcase its effectiveness in transient magnetic field analysis.

articleTitle: Research on the Step Response Testing Technology of DC Measuring Device in VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: According to technical requirements for the step response of DC(direct current) current measuring device in the flexible DC transmission project, we studied the measurement requirements and methods for the key technical indicators of step response, including rising time, delay time, overshoot and stabilization time. We designed a step response test scheme consisting of signal generator, transconductance amplifier, precise coaxial shunt, high-precision clock synchronization device and step response verification system. Step delay time of transconductance amplifiers and precision coaxial shunts is approximately 1$\mu$s, rising time is approximately 1.5$\mu$s. Step response verification system adopted resampling noise reduction technique and Labview measurement technique, time resolution is less than 1$\mu$s. DC current measuring devices were tested by using the step response test scheme. According to the results, magnitude of step current, rising time of step source and data calculation method all affect the key technical indexes of the step response, the test scheme meets the step response test requirements of DC current measuring device with the data sampling rate of 100kHz and the step response time less than 60$\mu$s in flexible DC transmission engineering.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy System Planning & Operation Evaluation Based on Multiple Economic Indexes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the requirement of “green energy consumption” integrated energy system (IES) appeared as one of the most significant and powerful solutions, dispatching various kinds of available distributed energy resources to meet the demand, thus promoting the renewable energy consumption, as well as reducing the green house gas emission and the generation cost. However, due to the complexity and high cost of IES construction, the selection of different kinds of equipment and the cooperation of different energy parts are still problems limiting its popularization. This paper introduces a practical approach on system configuration planning and dispatch optimization for IES, which consider multiple economic indexes simultaneously based on local demand and installation conditions. This approach optimizes the energy equipment selections from the perspective of types and installed capacities, thus offers different results of equipment combinations, operational and economic conclusions and suggestions based on the system running simulations under typical days in different seasons, including heating, cooling and regular seasons. Two case studies are shown with this proposed approach on an industrial IES project in China. The results provide the IES investors with primal configuration plan and system design for IES based on considered economic indexes, as well as detailed dispatch plans for future investment.

articleTitle: Effects of Iron Core Materials on a Single-phase Power Transformer during Out-of-Phase Synchronisation in MicroGrid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Phase locked loop (PLL) is usually used to synchronize microgrid voltage and grid voltage. However, when the detection element fails, the possibility of asynchronous switching still exists. In this paper, the finite element method is used to study the influence of core material on the performance of single-phase transformer. In the past OOPS impulse current analysis, the saturation of transformer is ignored, which is not feasible. The BH curve of the core material and the position of the switch are very important to the electromagnetic transient process of the saturated transformer. The results show that the impact current, core permeability and magnetic field are closely related to the switch position and core material. At the same time, the harmonic components of impulse current of power grid and generator are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Sampling Inspection Platform for Distribution Network Materials
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper introduces the current status of distribution network material sampling inspection in power grid. Aiming at solving the existing problems, an intelligent sampling inspection platform for distribution network materials is designed. This platform is based on the Internet of Things technology, and a machine learning algorithm, Local Outlier Factor, is employed to quantitative evaluate the inspection reports. This sampling inspection platform designed can greatly improve the efficiency of material inspection and achieve refined sampling inspection.

articleTitle: Study on Wind Induced Vibration Response of High-voltage Disconnector Switch by Wind Tunnel Test
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The disconnector switch is highly sensitive to the wind load. Under the strong wind, such structure can have a huge wind-induced vibration, which may cause its destruction and result in the loss of the high-voltage substations. In order to study this vibration characteristic, the wind-tunnel test of the GW35-550 high voltage disconnector switch has been presented. In this paper, firstly its aeroelastic model with a scale ration of 1/3.775 was well designed and manufactures through finite element analysis. Then, the wind-induced response including displacement, acceleration and wind vibration coefficients have been obtained in the wind fields specified by the China code: Building Structure Load Specification (GB50009-2012). Experimental results shows that the maximum windinduced displacement is at the top of this model, and there have a strong cross-wind vortex-induced vibration phenomenon. This study can provide useful guidance for the material selection and mechanism design optimization of the disconnector switch.

articleTitle: Characteristics of Lightning Faults of 220 kV and Above Overhead Transmission Lines in Zhejiang Province in last 15 Years
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Lightning is the most frequent reason for high voltage overhead transmission lines faults. Due to the stochastic nature of lightning, the theoretic approaches for evaluation of the performance of overhead transmission lines are far from complete. The field experiences from the practitioners are of great value in lightning performance researches. This work collected a large dataset of lightning faults happened during 2004-2018 in the 220 kV and above overhead transmission lines in Zhejiang province. The characteristics, like temporal, spatial and double circuits faults, of the lightning faults are analyzed in this work. The mechanisms behind these characteristics are also explained in this work, which hope will be helpful in the future researches in lightning performance of overhead transmission lines.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Optimized Current Control for Delta- Connected Cascaded STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: STATCOM is widely used for its good reactive power compensation performance, and its current control is the core and foundation of device control. In this paper, starting with the analysis of the factors affecting the transient support capability of the chain STATCOM, and through analyzing its mathematical model in the d-q synchronous rotating coordinate system, three methods to improve the transient support capability of the chain STATCOM are studied. It provides a strong guarantee for the rapid and effective compensation of reactive power in case of fault, and then improves the reactive power compensation ability of the power grid to ensure the safe and reliable power supply of the system. Finally, the MATLAB simulation model of the system is built, and the effectiveness and feasibility of the current optimal control of the delta-connected cascaded STATCOM is verified through the simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Heat Pumps Optimal Scheduling Based on Equivalent State Space Thermal Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Heat pump (HP) optimal scheduling can reduce the peak load, so it can make the capacity regulating transformer working on its smaller capacity mode and save consumers’ cost. In existing literatures, second-order equivalent thermal parametric (ETP) model is always used to approximate the building thermal model, but it has significant simulation errors. In this paper, we build the detailed building thermal model using Dymola, and an equivalent state space thermal model (ESSTM) is obtained from this complex model. Since the ESSTM is formulated by linear difference equations, it can be easily integrated into the optimal scheduling model. We propose a look-ahead two-stage optimal scheduling strategy to coordinate HPs and distribution networks. The simulation results show that our model is much more precise than the conventional ETP based models and can be used to reduce the peak load and mitigate voltage violations.

articleTitle: Low Voltage Risk Prediction Method of Distribution Station Area Based on Principal Component Analysis and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Risk analysis is the prerequisite for the management of low voltage problems in the distribution network. For this reason, a method of low voltage risk prediction based on principal component analysis and support vector machine is proposed. First, a sample set containing the number of low voltage consumers in the station area and 17 influencing factors is constructed. Based on the result-oriented principle, the low voltage risk level in the station area is divided according to the number of consumers who have low voltage in the station area each week. Then, the principal component analysis method is used to reduce the dimensions of the 17 influencing factors, and several uncorrelated principal component factors are obtained, which are used as the input of the support vector machine. At the same time, the low voltage risk level of the station area is used as the output of the support vector machine to establish the low voltage risk prediction model of the station area. Finally, the model is used to predict the low voltage risk of a typical station area in a certain province from June to July 2019. The accuracy of the prediction results is high, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Research on Correlation Analysis of Vibration Signals at Multiple Measuring Points and Black Box Model of Flexible-DC Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The internal structure of the flexible-DC transformer is complicated and the lack of a reliable vibration calculation model limits the application of the vibration analysis method in the fault diagnosis of the flexible-DC transformer. In response to this problem, this paper analyzes the correlation between the vibration signals of multiple measuring points and establishes a “black box” model of transformer vibration detection. Using the correlation analysis of multiple measuring points and BP neural network, a “black box” model that simulates the internal vibration transmission relationship of the transformer is established. The vibration signal of the multiple measuring points can be used to calculate the vibration signal of the target measuring point under specific working conditions. This can provide effective information for fault diagnosis and judgment of the running status of the flexible-DC transformer.

articleTitle: Fast Prediction of Cascading Commutation Failure in Multi-infeed HVDC System by Integrating Data-driven Method and Model-driven Method
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a prediction model of cascading commutation failure (CF) based on integration of data-driven method and model-driven method is proposed. The impact of AC system fault is quantified by a data-driven model, which is trained by multiple simulation cases with different fault locations and durations. Extreme learning machine (ELM) is applied in this data model for its fast calculation. Adjusted multi-infeed interaction factor (MIIF) is firstly proposed that considers nonlinearity of voltage interactions between converter stations. Then, voltage sensitivity matrix among converter stations is calculated based on adjusted MIIF, which is a simplified physics model established to compute the voltage drop in target station due to the voltage drop at neighbor stations. Afterwards, the total voltage drop on target station is obtained by adding the output of data model and physics model. Finally, the prediction of CF is given by comparing the predicted voltage with critical voltage. The method is verified in a two-infeed HVDC test system and East-China power grid. Extensive simulations are conducted in PSD-BPA and the result shows the advantage in speed and accuracy of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Self-adaption Faster-than-real-time Temperature Prediction Technology of Pumped Storage Power Unit in Start-up State
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: More than 500 analog measurement points with tripping outlet function need to be monitored by the watchman in pumped storage power plant. These analog measurement points with tripping outlet function are distributed in different pictures of monitoring system. It is an impossible task to find anomalies in advance by tracking the change trend manually. In the past, only the temperature of analog measurement point rise to the level I/II alarm value, and the watchman is reminded by the alarm signal. The time left for the watchman to handle is very short. This paper presents a self-adaption faster-than-real-time temperature prediction technology, which can acquire historical and real-time temperature data and switch data from the monitor system, and integrate time sequence of action, measure analog value and record historical statistics. The threshold value and distribution statistic are decoupled. According to the history of the operating equipment and the change trend of real-time performance measured, forewarn of the change of temperature value measured in advance can be got.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an Efficient Single Stage Three Phase AC-DC Buck Converter for Hybrid Vehicle Charging
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a new three-phase single stage AC to DC buck converter with low switch count and high power processing capability is investigated for the electric and hybrid-electric vehicle battery charging system. The modes of operation of the proposed system are investigated. Small signal modeling of the converter is derived to get the transfer function of the system. The operation of the proposed converter is verified with dynamic simulation and preliminary experiments. The efficiency and the total harmonics distortion (THD) of the proposed converter is compared with other conventional charging system. The proposed system is an attractive candidate for fast charging systems.

articleTitle: Research of the High Voltage Vacuum Circuit Breaker Motor Actuator Rotor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During the actual operation, the permanent magnet of the drive motor in the motor operating mechanism with 126kv vacuum circuit may emerge the questions of loose and fall off. This paper presents a precept about the improvement of 3 kinds of drive motor rotor, including the dovetail groove surface embedded type, the Linear embedded type and the V embedded outside type. Based on comparison and analysis of the structure of the rotors, the finite element method is used for simulated analysis about the transient magnetic properties and the dynamic mechanical properties of the various modified rotors, when the drive motor operation circuit breaker process opening and closing operation. The results improve that the modified rotors structure of the dovetail groove can effectively avoid the loose and fall off of the permanent magnet caused by mechanical impact. It can improve the work reliability of operation mechanism, and is an idea improvement design of the drive motor rotor.

articleTitle: Big Data Processing Method for Multi-dimensional Power Supply Reliability of Terminal Users
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the different requirements of different terminal users for power supply reliability and the redundancy of factors affecting power supply reliability, this study outlines an approach on the big data processing for multi-dimensional power supply reliability of terminal users. Firstly, an index system affecting power supply reliability is constructed comprehensively from five dimensions. Then, by integrating K-means and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) big data mining technology, potential correlations among power supply reliability indicators are deeply mined and the data with common indicators are clustered to achieve dimensionality reduction. Finally, the factors affecting power supply reliability of different terminal users are ranked by the Grey Relation Analysis (GRA). In this study, the data of different power supply areas in typical cities are analyzed and verified. The results show that the proposed technology can provide better data support for power supply reliability of terminal users.

Author Keywords: reliability index system of power supply

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Urban Energy Transformation Based on ISM and AHP
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The quantitative evaluation of urban energy system is helpful for the sustainable development of urban economy and society, especially for the urban energy system transition. However, the comprehensive evaluation of energy systems faces the challenges of multi-dimensional variables, multi-structure coupling and multi-level structure. Taking Suzhou as an example, this paper proposes a comprehensive evaluation system of China's industrial urban energy system based on the interpretative structural model and analytic hierarchy process, which solves the problems of direct correlation and hierarchical relationship of multidimensional variables of industrial urban energy system. On this basis, a comprehensive evaluation system for quantifying the energy system of industrial cities can be obtained through binary comparison. By substituting the statistical data of Suzhou from 2013 to 2018, the development of Suzhou urban energy system during this period is summarized and evaluated. Results: the overall development of Suzhou urban energy system is on the rise, and the most significant progress is in energy efficiency, energy structure, and industrial development. However, the self-sufficiency rate of electricity has dropped from 79% to 70%, so the pressure on energy security has increased, making the score of energy supply capacity fluctuating and rising. The score of energy consumption scale has decreased year by year from 2013 to 2017 and has increased in 2018. The energy intensity control is facing with a grim situation. The R&D intensity scores for 2017 and 2018 are lower than 2016. Further investment is required. Finally, based on the above data analysis, it provides references and suggestions for the subsequent energy development of Suzhou, And the feasibility and effectiveness of this method can be proved.

articleTitle: Analysis on New Techniques of Secondary and Auxiliary Control System in Intelligent Substation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combined with the experimental construction of Hunan 110kV Shizishan intelligent substation in State Grid Corporation of China, the whole construction framework for the substation is introduced. Further, the exploration and application of the secondary & auxiliary control system in realizing holographic perception, autonomous inspection, remote monitoring, active forewarning and intelligent decision is emphatically analyzed. Then, from an engineering perspective, the significance of in-plant joint commissioning between the secondary system and the auxiliary control system for the construction process of the intelligent substation and related tested items are elaborated. Finally, relevant suggestions on how to put new technologies of the secondary and auxiliary control system into practice are proposed.

articleTitle: Fault Identification and Protection Technology Based on Multi-source Information
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is the fundamental way to shorten the operation time of the failure and dead zone protection to apply the global information such as the action information, fault information, switch position information and DC commutation failure provided by the remote converter station to the failure and dead zone protection based on the global information. This paper analyzes the principle, logic and data demand of multi-source information-based station area failure protection, and puts forward a scheme of multi-source information-based station area failure protection to improve the operation speed of failure protection and avoid large-scale power loss.

articleTitle: Threats and Countermeasures of Doubly-fed Induction Generator High-voltage Trip-off under Short Circuit Fault
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power grid-connected capacity continues to grow rapidly in our country, the continuous and safe grid connection of wind turbines after the grid is affected by disturbances is more and more important to the stable operation of the system. Paper conducts research based on the above status, firstly, the reactive power control strategy model of GE-type doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) that packaged in PSD-BPA is analyzed, and the DFIG grid-connected test system is established. By using the large disturbance excitation method, the influence of changes in grid-connected bus voltage on the transient response of DFIG is studied. Aiming at the increase process after a sharp drop in voltage, paper reveals that the internal potential of wind turbines with voltage feedback control function has the characteristic of “callback lag”, analyzes the mechanism of this characteristic triggering the threat of DFIG high-voltage trip-off, and puts forward the countermeasures. Finally, combined with the simulation results of short-circuit fault in Hami area power grid, paper verifies the existence of the threat of high-voltage trip-off under such failures and the effectiveness of the proposed countermeasures to reduce the threat.

articleTitle: Method of Multi-Sample Maximum Correlation Wavelet High Energy Scale on Location Time Difference Calculation of Partial Discharge Source
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to minimize the influence of pulse interference and white noise on the localization time difference calculation result of partial discharge source, this paper proposed a method based on multi-sample maximum correlation wavelet high energy scale. Proposed method combines the advantages of the “maximum correlation” and “high energy scale and can effectively suppress the interference of pulse interference, especially random pulse interference, and white noise. The principle of proposed method is explained and the specifics are given, and its effectiveness is verified by experiment, results show that prosed method can effectively improve the accuracy of localization time difference of partial discharge source.

articleTitle: Research on Economic Evaluation for Typical Integrated Energy Services
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy services (IESs) contain a variety of service contents and service forms, resulting in that economic evaluation of IESs can’t rely on a single financial data. Therefore, it is necessary to establish an economic evaluation method suitable for IESs. In this study, combined with the operating characteristics and profit models of typical IESs, a set of core economic evaluation index systems was built based on the perspectives of energy flow, information flow and cash flow. The combination weight was determined by network analysis method and anti-entropy power method. By combining the sensitivity analysis and full life cycle analysis of the economic evaluation indicators, the potential profit growth point of the service project can be obtained. By applying the method to a typical fishery and light complementary scenario and combining the operational characteristics of the scenario, reasonable economic evaluation results are obtained, which proves the effectiveness of the method proposed in this study.

articleTitle: Topological Analysis and Parameter Calculation of Transfer Breakers in Multi-Terminal HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The DC transfer switch is a key switching device that converts the DC operating current in the HVDC transmission system from one operating return line to another. In a multi-terminal DC transmission system, the selection of metallic return transfer breaker and the earth return transfer breaker is closely related to the system topology. This paper analyzes the multi-terminal HVDC transmission system and refines its topology characteristics. A calculation method for determining the configuration mode, parameter selection and operation sequence of the transfer breakers is proposed. This simulation verification is carried out in combination with a three-terminal HVDC project.

articleTitle: Dynamic Estimation Algorithm for Modulation Frequency under Off-nominal Frequency and Oscillations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the wide use of power electronic devices in power systems, low-frequency oscillations and disturbances lead to a rapid decline in the accuracy of phasor measurement units (PMUs). As a result, it takes obstacles to identify and suppress oscillations effectively. In this paper, a Taylor series-based dynamic phasor measurement model is proposed for estimating the modulation frequency directly. Firstly, Taylor series is employed to characterize the supplied signal. Secondly, the least square method (LSM) is applied to estimate the various parameters of the signal, especially to estimate the modulation frequencies. Finally, the simulation results are presented to verify the advantages of the proposed algorithm in providing accurate measurement results under the conditions with off-nominal frequency and oscillations.

articleTitle: Identification of Key Transmission Section in Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Energy Internet (EI) is a product of deep integration of different energy fields. It breaks the boundary of traditional energy industries, and promotes the interconnection of various primary and secondary energy sources. Based on the basic concept and morphological character of EI, an identification method of key transmission section is proposed. AC/DC power grids and electricity-gas combined transmission lines are analyzed to clarify the transmission characteristics of EI; the transmission betweenness and Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence are modified to quantify the impact of electricity-gas transmission and power distribution; two kinds of sections are defined to classify transmission lines with different functions. Test results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sampled Value Slow-Release Verification Method in The Design of Power System Specific Processor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The digital sampling function is an important IP (Intelligent Property) in the power system specific processor. In the process of processor chip design verification, the verification of this IP cannot be completed due to the low frequency of the FPGA emulated processor. This paper proposes a method of slow release of sampled values. By delaying the release of the received SV (Sampled Value) data to the analog calculation task, the verification of digital sampling IP is implemented without modifying the protection algorithm program. And the tester is a universal digital relay protection tester.
