This method can be used not only for the verification of digital sampling IP, but also for the verification of analog sampling control IP, which speeds up the verification process of the processor chip and improves the coverage of verification.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation Strategy of Wind Farm Considering Complex Wind Speed
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of large-scale wind power into the power grid poses serious challenges to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. Wind farm participation in system frequency control is one of the important countermeasures. Based on the integrated frequency regulation control strategy of the wind turbine (WT), this paper proposes a frequency regulation control strategy for wind farms under complex wind speed conditions. Based on the total wind speed conditions, a coordinated distribution factor of deloading power is established, so that the wind farm will allocate the total deloadingpower to each WT in accordance with the established distribution factor. This method can maintain sufficient stability when the power system is disturbed, and at the same time can reduce the regulating pressure of the synchronous generator. A four-machine two-region model is established on the Digsilent/Powerfactory simulation platform. Through simulation analysis, it is concluded that the proposed control method can make good use of wind energy of different sizes in response to system changes and provide dynamic support for the power grid.

articleTitle: A Protection Method for DC Distribution Network Based on High and Low Frequency Current Amplitude Ratio
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: DC distribution network is becoming the trend of development in the future because of convenience for renewable energy accessing and better power quality compared with traditional ac distribution network. Protection is crucial for dc distribution network to operate safely but it is still at the beginning of research. A protection method applied to dc distribution network is proposed in this paper based on ratio of high and low frequency current amplitude. Firstly, topology of dc distribution network and protection object is introduced. Then fault characteristics under internal fault and external fault are analyzed in theory. Because of the hindrance properties of boundary units to high frequency components, the ratio of high and low frequency current amplitude under internal fault is much higher than which under external fault. The difference is more obvious with the gap of high and low frequency increasing. Protection criterion is proposed based on this difference. Simulation results in PSCAD/EMTDC software verify the effectiveness of this protection method.

articleTitle: The Influence of Urban Rail Transit’s Stray Current on Power Grid and Its Synchronous Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Although many researchers have carried out researches on rail transit stray current and DC magnetic bias of power grid, they are only focused on DC bias of power grid side or stray current of Metro side. There is a lack of synchronous monitoring and correlation analysis of stray current at Metro side and DC bias of power grid side. In this paper, a synchronous monitoring scheme has been proposed. The number of sensors needed for measuring has been reduced according to the current sharing coefficient. The composition of synchronous monitoring system has also been given. In future, correlation analysis will be carried out to verify the influence of stray current on power gird.

articleTitle: Dynamic Parameter Optimization of STATCOM Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A STATCOM dynamic parameter optimization method based on model predictive control (MPC) that considers automatic voltage control (AVC) coordination is proposed to improve STATCOM dynamic response performance. The proposed method established a linearized state space model with STATCOM and AVC. using multi-time rolling data as input. and MPC is proposed to replace traditional controller to achieve dynamic parameter optimization in cooperation with AVC multi-time rolling correction, finally the reactive power output of STATCOM is introduced into AVC system, which provides reference for following optimization of AVC. In this way, the control model can be simplified and STATCOM can perform better dynamic response, which effectively improves the stability of system and meet the voltage safe operation requirements. Meanwhile, dynamic reactive power can be reserved sufficiently. The validity and practicability of the method can be verified by a simple simulation example.

articleTitle: Mechanism Analysis of the Circuit Breaker Body’s Three-phase Inconsistent Protection Malfunction and Prevention Measures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the circuit breaker's three-phase inconsistent protection malfunction during the commissioning of a 500kV transformer substation, the process was abnormal suspended. In order to avoid the occurrence of the event of same kind, the paper, based on the event, analyzes the secondary circuit of breaker's three-phase inconsistent protection, illustrates the three-phase inconsistent protection action mechanism and concludes through analysis that the malfunction was caused by the mis-wiring of circuit breaker body's secondary circuit. On this basis, the paper proposes the practical measures for avoiding the three-phase inconsistent protection malfunction of circuit breaker body in the stage of acceptance and maintenance, so as to improve the stability and safety of the power grid operation.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Intelligent Identification and Control System of Large AC/DC Hybrid Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power system is one of the most complex man-made technology networks in the world today. With the development of UHV AC/ DC and large-scale new energy grid connection, the complexity and uncertainty of modern power system operation and control have increased dramatically, which has brought huge challenges to power grid security and stability analysis and control. The rapid development of AI technology has brought opportunities for intelligent identification and rapid response control of large power grid faults. In this paper, from many aspects such as regular knowledge representation method of equipment fault, the judgment technology of large power grid complex fault patterns, the quantitative evaluation method of fault impact and the control criterion, the difficulties and ideas of AI technology application are put forward and the framework of fault intelligent identification and control system for AC/DC hybrid grid is proposed. The research will effectively promote the application of AI technology in the actual production of large power grids, and lay a foundation for comprehensively improving the flexibility, reliability and efficiency of stability control of large power grid.

articleTitle: Wide Frequency Range Suppression of Subsynchronous Oscillation for DFIG Wind Farm Based on Optimal Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The subsynchronous oscillation of wind turbines is affected by many factors in the working environment and conditions and the oscillation frequency has the characteristic of broadband oscillation, which puts forward new requirements for the design of suppressing the oscillation. This paper designs a suppression method of wide frequency range for subsynchronous oscillation of doubly-fed induction generator(DFIG) wind farm based on optimal control. First, the small signal linearized model of the DFIG is established in this paper. Then based on the quadratic index in the optimal control theory, the optimal time control theory is used to determine the weight coefficient of the control variables and the state variables of the quadratic index, then the optimal feedback controller is designed. Finally the simulation shows that the feedback controller designed in this paper has a good suppression effect on the broadband subsynchronous oscillation generated by the DFIG under complicated working conditions. For a more complicated multi-machine system, the controller also has a significant suppression effect on the subsynchronous oscillation.

articleTitle: Intraday Operation Optimization Strategy of Multi-Energy Power System Based on Characteristic Parameter Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of wind, solar and hydropower abandonment existing in the current multi-energy power system, this paper constructs a multi-energy power system with wind, solar, hydropower and thermal, and formulates the intraday operation optimization strategy of the system. On the premise of ensuring the minimum technical output of thermal power and the firm output of hydropower, the priority is wind, solar and runoff power generation, and the second priority is adjustable hydropower. If the load cannot be met, the thermal power units are selected for power generation. Based on the multi-energy power system, three parameters which are stability index, peak load regulation capacity ratio and intraday operation cost are proposed to identify the characteristics of the system. Finally, a case is given to show that the optimization strategy and parameters can improve the consumption of renewable energy and produce economic benefits, and the advantages of multi-energy power system in complementary generation are proved.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors Affecting Carbon Emissions in Fujian Province
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electricity accounts for a relatively high proportion of energy consumption, and its consumption is increasing year by year with the rapid development of the economy. Fujian's electric power is dominated by coal-based thermal power, which results in a large proportion of Fujian's total carbon emissions in the province's total carbon emissions. Based on power-related data from 2000 to 2017, this paper uses Logarithmic mean Divisia index (LMDI) to analyze emission factors, energy structure, economic scale, transmission and distribution loss, conversion efficiency, and power intensity for Fujian's per capita electricity carbon emissions. The results show that in 2000-2017, the economic scale, energy structure, and transmission and distribution loss factors are the main factors for the increase of power carbon emissions. At the same time, the suggestions for energy saving and emission reduction in Fujian Province are proposed.

articleTitle: Development of Activated Liquid for Degraded Lead-Acid Batteries in Substations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The sign that lead-acid batteries used in substations age faster than their service life has become obvious. Aiming at this phenomenon, the reasons for the deterioration are analyzed in this paper. Based on the theory of lead-acid battery product regeneration and repair, an activated liquid is developed to repair the batteries using the high-current constant-voltage charging method. The test results show that the activated battery capacity has increased by 20%, the internal resistance of the battery has been reduced, and the service life has been extended to 22 months, achieving the repair of the degraded batteries. The promotion of this method can realize the recycling of resources, bringing greater economic benefits to the enterprises, and help solve environmental problems.

articleTitle: Research on Breaking Power Flow Algorithm of Offshore Platform Power Grid Based on Parameter Sensitivity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Breaking power flow analysis of offshore platform power grid (OPPG) is the premise to ensure its security. Firstly, based on the extended power flow model of OPPG in this paper, the base-case power flow is calculated by using Newton-Raphson (NR). Then, the state variable-branch admittance sensitivity matrix quantitative describing the influence of branch disconnection on state variables which is deduced in the light of submarine cables and transformers. On this basis, the breaking power flow algorithm in OPPG based on parameter sensitivity is proposed. Finally, the breaking power flow analysis on account of submarine cable and transformer disconnection according to an actual OPPG is carried out. The results show the accuracy and rapidity of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation of An Islanded Multi-energy Microgrid with Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand response (DR) scheme is more and more important nowadays as it could shift loads to reduce the total energy cost. In this regard, the coordinated operation of an islanded multi-energy microgrid (IMEMG) is studied considering the DR scheme. Here, the DR scheme is the direct load control for multiple energies. The objective is minimizing the net operating cost under the all the operational constraints. For the direct load control, if the energy generation is more than the consumption, the system will cut loads, while if less, the generation will be curtailed. In addition, to reduce the computation burden, the original nonlinear problem is linearized, thus, the operation problem is now a mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problem. Afterward, the industrial-proven solver Cplex is used to get the solution. Finally, the effectiveness of our method is compared with corresponding case studies.

articleTitle: Integrated Energy Coordinated Control System of Industrial Park and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Industrial Park is an important demand response resource. There are some problems in the industrial park, such as low energy utilization rate and lack of coordination among multi-energy resources. The key to solve these problems is to build a clean and efficient integrated energy coordination and control system. This paper introduces the integrated energy coordinated control system, which can realize the integrated control of cold, heat, electricity and other resources. Firstly, the overall architecture of the system is introduced, and then the key functions of the system are introduced in detail. The self-optimization module can help users plan and use energy reasonably, reduce energy consumption per unit product, and improve economic benefits. The adjustable ability module can further tap the response potential of users and provide dispatching basic data for the superior power grid. Finally, the application of the system in an industrial park in Guangzhou is introduced. The application data show that the integrated energy coordination control system can effectively improve the energy economy of users and further tap the response potential of users.

articleTitle: Monitoring and Application of Low-voltage Distribution Network Leakage Protector Based on Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the operation management of low-voltage distribution network leakage protectors, the “cloud-pipe-side-end” idea is adopted, based on the intelligent deployment of modular TTU, a low-voltage distribution network based on the Internet of Things is proposed System architecture, designed the configuration and monitoring scheme of the leakage protector based on the Internet of Things, to achieve remote centralized monitoring of the total leakage protection, intermediate leakage protection and user leakage protection status of the station area; according to the leakage protection monitoring status and the monitoring of the branch and user perception unit of the station area Information, realize the intelligent perception of low-voltage distribution network and the research and judgment of low-voltage faults, and give the actual application situation of under-report monitoring based on the Internet of Things in Hubei area, thereby shortening the time of fault detection and improve the level of operation, maintenance and management.

articleTitle: Analysis of Grid Interfaced Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cell Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper intends to investigate the operation of proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) under steady state operation mode and transient operation mode when it is subjected to dynamic disturbance at the point of common coupling. The mathematical modelling of PEMFC is analyzed and a PEMFC model is simulated. The PEMFC is further connected to a boost converter and a full bridge inverter to create a grid interfaced power generation system. The proposed system has also been simulated under different operation mode and certain characteristics are obtained.

articleTitle: Research on the Development and Current Status of DC Power Distribution
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper describes the research background of DC power distribution technology in combination with the development history of HVDC transmission technology. And it lists the main technical advantages of DC power distribution applications and their development inevitability. Furthermore, the key technologies such as voltage level, topology, key equipment, control protection, modeling and simulation are analyzed in the current DC power distribution research. Then, the research status and key directions of DC power distribution technology and the typical application cases existing in China are introduced.

articleTitle: Visual Intelligent Monitoring Technology of Data Center Based on SSD Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a new digital infrastructure, data center is the key to the transformation and upgrading of power grid to energy Internet. With the continuous expansion of data center scale and the increase of operation and maintenance personnel, the traditional video monitoring mode relying on manual observation is difficult to meet the increasingly complex operation and maintenance needs. This paper mainly studies the application of artificial intelligence technology in the field of intelligent security. It uses the deep learning model to identify the operation and maintenance personnel in the data center, and optimizes the network layers and window parameters of SSD (Single Shot Multi-Box Detector) algorithm to improve the operation efficiency and intelligent level of video monitoring. The experimental results show that the visual intelligent monitoring technology of the data center constructed in this paper has good target recognition performance, and effectively improves the security level of the daily management of the data center.

articleTitle: The Interoperability Test Study of Abnormal Charging State for DC Charger
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The abnormal state of charging is a common fault during the charging process of electric vehicles, and the handling measures of the abnormal state in the charger directly affect the safety of charging. At present, most studies mainly focus on the field of interoperability testing methods and platform development, and the literature on the systematic analysis of the abnormal charging process of the charging pile has not been found. This paper conducts a systematic research on the abnormal state that occurs during the DC charging process. Combined with the vehicle simulation system, the abnormal state of charging is simulated, and relevant test data are obtained and analyzed.

articleTitle: Frequency Support of a Wind Power Plant For Over-Frequency Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study addresses an improved frequency control strategy of a wind power plant for boosting the frequency control capability by using separate variable droop control characteristics when an over-frequency disturbance occurs. The test system embedded a wind power plant is employed to investigate the performance of the proposed frequency control strategy. Furthermore, to draw the realistic results, wake effects are considered in the wind power plant. Investigation results clearly indicate that the proposed frequency control strategy reduces the maximum deviation of the frequency under a scenario with different load variation disturbances.

articleTitle: Flexibility Assessment Considering The Network Dispatchability of Flexible Capacity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increase in the proportion of renewable energy, the volatility and uncertainty of the net load have increased, and flexibility has gradually gained attention. A reasonable assessment of system flexibility is urgently needed to ensure that there is sufficient flexibility to respond to changes in net load. This paper proposes an evaluation indicator for judging the adequacy of flexible resource allocation, taking into account the impact of the flexible resource spatial scheduling characteristics, and validating the validity of the indicator through an example.

articleTitle: Calculation Simulation and Experimental Verification of Current Rating Capacity for XLPE Insulated HVDC Cable
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To clarify the accuracy of calculation results between thermal analysis and finite element simulation. 525 kV XLPE insulated cable with copper conductor cross-section of 3000mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> was selected for model. The current rating capacity of HVDC cable was calculated based on thermal analysis and finite element simulation respectively, then verified by DC current loading test. The calculation current rating capacity of HVDC cable with corrugated aluminum sheath based on thermal analysis was 2836 A, which is 5.3% smaller than that based on finite element simulation and 8.6% smaller than that based on DC current loading test. For thermal analysis, the main reason of smaller current is that only thermal resistance influence of cable heat conduction is considered. This method can’t calculate heat radiation from external air convection which affects current rating capacity. In addition, the influence of internal air in the cable for heat transfer also can’t be taken in consideration. Besides heat conduction, finite element simulation has the ability to recognize thermal radiation effects. So, the calculation results based on finite element simulation are close to testing results. The main deviation is from air intervals insides cable construction and the design of corrugated aluminum sheath. Besides, the finite element simulation can’t simulate the heat radiation on the cable surface caused by air circular during test accurately.

articleTitle: Countermeasure Analysis of Power System Network Based on Markov Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power system network will be confronted with severe secure menace. Until now, the analysis of power system network is mainly based on the reliability research of complex network, but there is few research on the premeditated and multi-step strategic attack.-In this paper, we establish a Markov game model of power system attack-defense behavior and provide the attack-defense Markov strategy by using nonlinear programming. We proved that the strategy is an equilibrium strategy of attacker and defender. The results show that the correct defense strategy can effectively reduce the revenue of the attacker and weaken the attack intention of the attacker. When the total load of the system is up to 11,545 unit loads, the Markov strategy selected by the defender can enable the attacker to deduct the benefits of the attack cost and only revenue for 26.48% of the total load of the grid.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of a Power Management Chip Applied in Wireless Sensor Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly presented a power management chip named LTC3588-1, which is a complete self-powered solution optimized for high output impedance energy sources. The wide hysteresis voltage comparator and the high efficiency buck converter of the chip are very suitable for powering autonomous devices. In order to evaluate the practical operating efficiency of the voltage regulator integrated in the chip, a power testing system based on general instruments is specially developed, as well as the self-discharge model of the energy storage element based on super capacitors. The experimental results show that the voltage conversion efficiency can be enormously improved through increasing the inductance of the inductor connected from the buck switching regulator to the following powered electronic load, the practical average value of the operating efficiency is about 80% after optimizing this inductance parameter. Moreover, the maximum measured efficiency can reach as high as 99% under the given conditions. The measured results can help us to develop and optimize the future self-powered wireless sensor devices.

articleTitle: Solving 3D Low-frequency Electromagnetic Field Problems Based on FreeFem++
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this work, an introduction to a finite element (FE) programming language, FreeFem ++, is illustrated for low-frequency electromagnetic (EM) field solutions. Built for implementing abstract linear or bilinear forms on FE spaces and interpolation operators, FreeFem ++ is quite convenient to use for realizing FE scripting for 2D and 3D initial/boundary value problems with only a few lines of scripts. Supported FE spaces in Freefem ++ such as high order Whitney elements, high performance sparse direct/iterative solvers are discussed to enhance the accuracy and efficiency of EM field computations. Selected 3D applications of magnetostatic, time-harmonic eddy current, induced voltage of gas-insulated transmission line (GIL), are illustrated to show the easiness of FreeFem ++ scripting and good solution performance. It is shown that Freefem ++ is a powerful and promising finite element analysis (FEA) tool for teaching, academic research and scientific computing of realworld engineering problems.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Power Frequency Discharge of SF6 Mixture in Non-Uniform Electric Field
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas mixture is widely used in high-voltage electrical equipment, but there is rarely comparative study on different types of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas mixture, and it is difficult to evaluate the operating conditions of different types of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas mixture. In this paper, the power frequency discharge tests of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/CF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> and SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub>/N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> mixtures under non-uniform electric field are carried out. The ball-plate electrode is used to simulate the electric field distribution under normal operation, and the needle-plate electrode is used to simulate the electric field distribution when the equipment is defective. The partial discharge characteristics and breakdown characteristics of the two mixtures are obtained. The research results are of certain reference significance for the practical application of SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> gas mixture.

articleTitle: Study on Phase-leading Operation Characteristics of UHVDC Sending-end Synchronous Condensers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a rotating equipment, the condenser can not only provide short-circuit capacity for the system, but also has good reactive power output characteristics. However, the longterm phase-leading operation of the condenser will affect the safety and stability of the condenser itself and the power grid. It is necessary to study the characteristics of the voltage regulation of the condenser in terms of reducing the transient over-voltage at the DC transmission end, dealing with the DC commutation failure, bipolar blocking and three-phase permanent fault of the AC system. Based on the analysis of the operation mechanism of the condenser and the case of the long-term leading-phase operation in ZLT, the operation status of the power grid near the ZLT converter station is simulated and analyzed by PSASP. The influence of different starting mode and DC power on the supporting ability of dynamic reactive power is calculated. The research shows that the operation mode of the condenser can meet the demand of system, which provides a theoretical support for the safety and stability of the system.

articleTitle: Particle Swarm Optimization towards Data Collection in the Internet of Things with a Mobile Sink
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the characteristic that the data collection performance of energy-limited Internet of things is directly affected by its energy efficiency level, an energy optimization method of Internet of things sensing layer nodes based on particle swarm optimization was proposed. Combining location deployment of data aggregation nodes and path planning of mobile sink nodes, the simulation model for energy efficiency optimization was constructed. In this model, the node coverage rate is used as the evaluation function to calculate the deployment position of the data aggregation node by using particle swarm algorithm. Next, the energy cost function is established on account of the energy consumption of data communication and the energy consumption of sink nodes. And it was applied to the particle swarm algorithm improved by the simulated annealing algorithm to plan the movement path of sink nodes. Final simulation results show the feasibility and effectiveness of the method, which not only maintains the integrity of the network, but also meets the actual requirements for reducing energy consumption.

articleTitle: Generalized Equal Area Criterion for Transient Stability Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In power system fields, the Equal Area Criterion is of great educational importance on revealing the sufficient condition for a grid-connected synchronous machine to maintain its transient rotor angle stability under a disturbance. However, the criterion faces big challenges in stability analysis for either multi-machine power systems or increasing renewable generators that have nonlinear characteristics very different from synchronous machines even if still modeled as oscillators in the grid. This paper proposes a Generalized Equal Area Criterion for quantitative stability analysis of a more general, nonlinear oscillator under a large disturbance. Such a nonlinear oscillator can either model a renewable generator or represent an equivalent oscillator on dominant inter-area oscillations of a multi-machine system. The new criterion is tested for transient stability analysis of single-generator-infinite-bus system and an NPCC 140-bus 48-machine system.

articleTitle: Research on Outdoor Demonstration Test Technology of Photovoltaic Module
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Since 2013, China’s new photovoltaic installed capacity has been ranked first in the world for six consecutive years. Photovoltaic (PV) modules are key components for the photovoltaic power station, because its performance determines the efficiency of the photovoltaic power station. After photovoltaic modules have been tested and calibrated in laboratories, various problems will still be found during the operation in different stations every year, for example efficiency degradation exceeds design value. First, this paper introduces the outdoor demonstration test technology of photovoltaic modules, including test system architecture, test equipment, and test procedures. Second, a photovoltaic module physical model is established based on the principle of PV generation, and the key parameter extraction methods are introduced. Finally, based on the measured data of the photovoltaic outdoor demonstration, the module performance investigation is performed, including the power generation, energy efficiency ratio, efficiency degradation, voltage and current temperature coefficient.

articleTitle: Research on Nodal Energy Price of Multi-energy Flow System Considering Heat Network Loss
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For multi-energy flow systems, the introduction of node energy prices can not only improve the economics of the entire system, but also provide certain ideas for congestion management of energy networks. In this paper, the calculation method of nodal energy price is given by referring to the nodal electricity price firstly, and then an optimal dispatching model of multi-energy flow system considering the influence of heat network transmission loss and other factors is established. Finally, the nodal energy price is calculated according to an actual example, and the influence of network loss constraint on nodal energy price is analyzed.

articleTitle: Optimized Configuration Scheme of Harmonic Measuring Device Considering Practical Situations of Grid Nodes and Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A large number of distributed new energy sources are connected to the power grid, which makes the harmonic problems more complicated, deteriorates the power quality of the power grid, and brings huge economic losses to the power grid and related users. The optimized configuration of the harmonic measuring device can monitor the harmonic information in the power grid, and then estimate the harmonic state in the power grid, which is helpful for the positioning of harmonic sources and harmonic control. Considering that there are few measuring devices available for installation in the power grid, this paper first gives the configuration basis of measuring devices, and then proposes different measurement device optimization configuration schemes for four different actual situations, which reduces the number of measuring devices and ensures the maximum observability of important users and distribution network harmonics. Finally, the correctness of the proposed method is verified by case analysis.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration for Power Electronic Transformer Ports Considering the Optimization of Transfer Paths
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power electronic transformers (PET) have received widespread attention in recent years due to their flexible networking, diverse operating modes and rich control objects. In this paper, first, Considering the constraints of PET and the N-1 transfer path constraints, we established a multi-objective port capacity configuration optimization model for multi-port PET. Then, aiming at the proposed multi-objective optimization model, this paper proposes a two-layer iterative solution method to solve the proposed model. Finally, a case study is used to verify the effectiveness of the method proposed in this paper, the PET port optimization configuration method proposed in this article can reduce the dimensions of the planning model, and can solve the problems of AC/DC coordination and network-source coordination optimization.

articleTitle: New Energy Power Performance Evaluation Research Based on ITMD-FM Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote the low-carbon, safe, efficient and sustainable development of the power supply, the green power development benefit evaluation index system and the multi-attribute decision-making model are constructed to evaluate the development benefit of all kinds of green power. Firstly, considering the demands of different stakeholders, the evaluation index system of green power development benefits is constructed. Secondly, considering the interval property of index value, the Interval-value TOPSIS Multi-attribute Decision-making Model based on Fuzzy Measure (ITMD-FM) is constructed. An example shows that the evaluation model is feasible, and it can provide reference for green power development planning and investment decision-making.

articleTitle: Research on Insulation Problems of the Polymer Insulated Busbar with Tape Winding Insulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The polymer insulated busbar is a new type of current carrying equipment which is being more and more widely used all over the world. The tape winding insulation polymer insulated busbar is one of the major types of this kind of equipment which uses winded PTFE or PET tape to form its insulation. This article aims to discuss its characteristic insulation problems caused by its insulation materials and structures. An FEA (finite element analysis) was introduced to calculate the electric field distribution in a typical insulation structure. The radial and axial electrical strengths of samples of PTFE and PET tape winding insulation with different winding tensions were tested. And finally, an experiment on a real size polymer insulated busbar with prefabricated defect to observe the propagation and development of the discharge failure between tape layers. The result reveals that, the dielectric strength of the surface between the tape layers is the key point of the insulation of the tape winding insulation polymer insulated busbar; and this strength is determined by the surface pressure. Thus, the electrical performances of the whole insulation are related more firmly with the insulated tape's mechanic strength rather than its dielectric strength. The propagation processes of the discharge between tape layers are also summarized. From this research, the methods to improve the performances of the tape winding insulation polymer insulated busbar and to detective the discharge between tape layers can be concluded.

articleTitle: Delay Analysis and Improvement of Intraday Generation Schedule of an Actual Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The intraday generation schedule based on ultra-short term load forecasting has been implemented in an actual power grid. The output power instructions of units are issued through the automatic generation control system. During operation, the execution delay of the output instruction is found to have a great impact on the implementation effect. The delay of a unit is not fixed and the influencing factors are complex, so it is difficult to accurately obtain the delay. A method for estimating the average execution delay is proposed. The data of output instructions and actual outputs in a recent period are collected, and the components of the time scale of the intraday schedule are filtered. The cross correlation coefficients of the output instructions and the actual outputs under different delays are obtained. The delay corresponding to the maximum of the correlation coefficients is the average delay. Improvement suggestions considering the delay are presented. The scheduled instruction curve of a unit is moved forward with the amount of the average delay, and then the negative impact of delay is reduced by issuing instructions in advance. The method can effectively reduce the deviations between the actual outputs and the scheduled outputs, and improve the implementation effect of the intraday generation schedule.

articleTitle: Damage Differences of Carbon Fiber Reinforced Polymer under Different Lightning Current Components
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) composite materials are often used in wind turbine blades, but they have lower electrical conductivity and are prone to damage due to lightning strikes. In this paper, simulative lightning current damage tests were carried out to CFRP laminates with a dimension of 500mm $\times 300$ mm $\times 3$ mm and a 24-layer layered structure. The current component A, with a peak current of 194kA, simulating the first stroke of natural lightning, and the component C, with a transferred charge of 240C, simulating a continuing current, were separately injected into the center of the CFRP laminate. Damage characteristics are analyzed using visual inspection and ultrasonic scanning. Obtained results show that, the energy of current component A with a large current amplitude but a short duration is released instantly through the fiber layup, resulting in a fiber burst zone with a direction in accordance with the layup. The current component C, with a large amount of transferred charge and a longer ablation time, can bring circular damage to CFRP laminate. The underlying physics for different damage created by two current components are further discussed.

articleTitle: Power Flow Calculation using Integrated Circuit Simulator
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Power flow calculation is fundamental for a wide variety of power system applications. The computation accuracy and efficiency of power flow calculation is critical for downstream large-scale power system real time applications. Using very large-scale integrated (VLSI) circuit to model power system will keep power system characteristics with less assumptions and higher fidelity. And power system VLSI circuit model has a great potential for high fidelity real time transient simulation. As a preliminary exploration, this paper uses Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tool to model power system as an integrated circuit and calculate the power flow using the integrated circuit simulator. The power flow calculation accuracy and efficiency of the proposed approach are verified and demonstrated by case study on the IEEE standard systems and real large-scale power systems.

articleTitle: Failure Probability Analysis of Lightining Strike Transmission Line Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, lightining faults occur frequently with the rapid development of power grids and the increase of strong convective weather. Aiming at the problem that the calculation results of the existing calculation method of lightning strike rate of the transmission line are quite different from the actual operation situation, this paper proposes a lightning strike risk assessment model for the transmission line based on the multi-support vector machine combined classifier. This paper evaluates the risk of lightning strikes of the tower by using the actual lightning operation data of 500kV overhead transmission line tower and counting the probability output of all SVM sub-classifiers. An adaptive genetic algorithm is proposed to optimize the parameters of the SVM classifier, which effectively improves the problem of low classification accuracy of the model due to the large penalty parameter value in the conventional genetic algorithm. The results show that the evaluation results of multi-SVM combined classifier can greatly reduce the number of towers that are misjudged as high risk under the principle of evaluating the conservativeness of lightning strike risk on transmission lines.

articleTitle: Research of Insulator Fault Identification Method Based on Atlas Intelligent Computing Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Transmission line monitoring plays a crucial role in the safe operation of the power grid. The application of image recognition technology based on artificial intelligence algorithms can improve the efficiency of fault identification and reduce the labor cost. Object detection is to detect the object of interest in the given picture and is an effective method to recognize the fault location. This paper proposed an insulator fault identification method based on the Atlas intelligent computing platform aiming at the characteristics of small insulator fault data set. This method adopts the SSD300 model for training and inference and analysis is carried out based on the Atlas intelligent computing platform. The experiment results show that the SSD300 model can be ported well to the Atlas intelligent computing platform without reducing the recognition accuracy. At the same time, the model size is decreased.

articleTitle: A General Coordination Scheme for Zero-sequence Current Differential Protection on Series-compensated Multi-circuit Line
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The present study of zero-sequence current differential protection (ZCDP) with series compensation has not considered the equivalent impedance characteristic of series compensation, and meanwhile cannot put forward a universal coordination scheme feasible for multi-circuit lines. In this paper, the equivalent impedance characteristic of the series capacitor (SC) device and the effect of SC on the operating characteristics of ZCDP under single-circuit and multi-circuit conditions are analyzed. Based on the analysis, a general coordination scheme for ZCDP on series-compensated multi-circuit line is proposed, of which the presented sensitivity coefficient is able to reflect the sensitivity of current differential protection. A power grid experiment is used to demonstrate the correctness of the analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: A Risk Situation Estimation Method for Power Information Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fusion and interdependence of cyber and physical system has become the main characteristic of power system, which has brought new challenges to the risk assessment of the power information and communication network at the same time. Since the risk situation assessment of power information and communication network is a multilevel and multiple indicators issue with a deep correlation between the indicators, a comprehensive risk situation assessment model is constructed. First, the index system of risk situation assessment is constructed. Second, the model of comprehensive evaluation of risk situation is constructed based on fuzzy measure and choquet fuzzy integral. The subjective weighting calculation method combines with the objective calculation method to determine the fuzzy density of single index, and then calculate fuzzy measure based on the obtained fuzzy density. Employ choquet fuzzy integral operator to integrate comprehensive estimation value of index set. Finally, the maximum membership degree principle is adopted to obtain the comprehensive risk situation. By applying the evaluation method to the simulation analysis of a power communication network, the validity of the proposed method is shown.

articleTitle: Analysis of Renewable Energy Consumption Ability of Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distributed generator (DG) has been widely integrated into distribution networks (DN) recently, which refers to a solution to the energy crisis and environmental pollution. However, the output of DG has a strong uncertainty, which may lead to the reverse power flow and voltage violation. With the development of power electronic technology, the integration of fully-controlled devices have been brought opportunity for the improvement of the renewable energy consumption ability. In order to quantitative evaluate the renewable energy consumption ability of DN, a unified framework of quantifying renewable energy consumption ability is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the quantification method for renewable energy consumption ability is proposed, including objective function and operational constraints. The improvement of renewable energy consumption ability based on soft open point (SOP) is further discussed and the operation status of SOP are also considered in the framework. Finally, the modified IEEE 33 node system is used to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method. Results show that with the integration of SOP, the renewable energy consumption ability is effectively increased.

articleTitle: Multi-Source Partial Discharge Signal Separation and recognition Method Based on manifold Learning in Oil-pressboard Insulation System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Oil pressboard insulation system is one of the most important systems in the power system., Various insulation structures such as oil and pressboard may produce partial discharge in the oil pressboard insulation system, releasing UHF and ultrasonic signals, and even multiple parts of the oil pressboard insulation system may have partial discharge faults at the same time, which will cause the partial discharge signals to cross and overlap affecting the identification and location of partial discharge faults. In this paper, a manifold learning based ultrasonic and UHF partial discharge signal separation and recognition strategy for oil pressboard insulation system is proposed. Firstly, the high-dimensional information of each PD signal sample is projected to the two-dimensional plane by the improved t-SNE algorithm, and then the equivalent Euler distance is calculated. Then, the partial discharge pulses from different PD sources are identified by improved possible CMeans method, and the effectiveness of the separation is verified by the experiments of partial discharge UHF and ultrasonic signals in the laboratory artificial defect model. The results show that the manifold learning oil pressboard insulation system can effectively separate the suspension, oil, and tip discharge sources.

articleTitle: Research on Construction and Dispatching of Virtual Power Plant Based on Reserve Energy Storage of Communication Base Station
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the rapid development of mobile communication technology, the coverage area of mobile communication base station is becoming more and more extensive. When the power system is in normal operation, the reserve energy storage facilities inside the base station are in idle state, which can be used for power system dispatching to solve the prominent problems brought by renewable energy power generation. First of all, this paper evaluates the regulatory potential of communication base station energy storage resources (BSES) and constructs an equivalent model of BSES under the circumstance of ensuring the reserve demand of communication base stations. Secondly, based on the situation of the hierarchical and partitioned management of distribution network, the BSES facilities are dynamically aggregated via hierarchical agglomerative clustering algorithm, and a region-level virtual power plant (VPP) is constructed. Finally, the multi-regional VPPs joint optimization dispatch strategy is carefully designed to balance each area power of the stratified partition.

articleTitle: Application of Improved Coyote optimization Algorithm in Optimal Configuration of Photovoltaic Intelligent Edge Terminal
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic intelligent edge terminal(PV IET) is one of the important devices for the safe and stable operation and smart operation of PV power stations. It is powerful but expensive. Large PV power stations can conFigure this device to improve operation and maintenance level, while smaller distributed PV power stations cannot afford its high price. In order to achieve the goal of low cost of distributed PV operation and maintenance, this paper proposes an optimal configuration method of PV intelligent edge terminals based on coyote optimization algorithm, which optimizes the layout of PV intelligent edge terminals from two aspects of quantity and location. At the same time, aiming at the weak optimization performance of coyote optimization algorithm (COA), a single dimension growth strategy of coyote individuals is introduced to prevent premature algorithm. The test results of typical cases show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the cost, and the proposed ICOA performs better than COA in accuracy and stability in solving the optimal layout problem, which verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Multi-node Cooperative Sensing Model of FBG Sensor Network in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The development of smart grids also has higher requirements for online real-time monitoring of transmission lines. Fiber Bragg Grating (FBG) sensors have both sensing and transmission functions, and are gradually widely used in the field of online monitoring. However, when building a sensor network in large-scale equipment such as transmission towers and trenches, the number of sensors and optimal configuration are very important. In this paper, an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed to solve the problem of optimal sensor configuration; the optimal configuration of FBG sensors with a flat structure is simulated and analyzed, and the performance of the two PSO algorithms is compared. The results show that the improved PSO algorithm has obvious advantages in the convergence accuracy and convergence speed of the sensor optimal configuration problem. And it has the characteristics of fast convergence speed, short running time and high configuration accuracy.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Robot Application System Security Protection in Electric Power Business Hall based on Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of information technology, Internet, information technology and artificial intelligence, interconnection, sharing and standardisation have become the trend of power information system. Therefore, information security issues have attracted much attention. This paper studies and designs the security protection of intelligent service robot application system in electric power business hall. According to the basic requirements of national information security level protection and management information system security protection of State Grid Corporation, it mainly designs the protection from the aspects of boundary security, application security, data security, host security, network security respectively to ensure the intelligent robot application system industry in business hall. The service data can be safely and reliably connected to the information network of the company and it also prevents the terminal data from being counterfeited and maliciously controlled to ensure that all kinds of service data are not tampered with, to ensure the application security of the intelligent robot application system in the business hall, to prevent the counterfeiting of users, leakage of sensitive information, unauthorized access, virus attack, etc. shall be eliminated.

articleTitle: Dominant Parameter Identification for Virtual Load Model Based on Incremental Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the boom of machine learning in power system parameter identification, the increment of measured data and the lack of effective processing methods have become the bottleneck for further development. This paper introduces an incremental learning method: combine the new samples with representative samples extracted from old data, then update the parameters of neural network with them all, and generate a new representative sample library for next training batch. We apply incremental learning to the field of virtual load model dominant parameter identification. Examined with 4x500 dataset, this method not only ensures the identification accuracy, but also improves the training efficiency.

articleTitle: An N-1 Short-Time Security Constrained Dispatch for Hybrid AC/DC Power Systems: Chance Constrained Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes an optimal power flow model for hybrid AC/DC power systems based on chance constrained programming. The safe operation constraint set of hybrid AC/DC power systems is constructed with consideration of both the N-l post-contingency short-time and long-time security operation. Our model is to nearly optimize the expectation of the sum of the weighted generation costs in the normal operation and the post-contingency long-time period. The proposed stochastic model is solved by using the point estimate method and the equivalent formulations of chance constraints. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed model is validated by investigating different factors such as the uncertainty level.

articleTitle: Quantitative Detection of SO2 H2S and CS2 Based on Ultraviolet Absorption Spectrometry and Least Squares Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: $SO_{2}, CS_{2}$ and $H_{2}S$ are important decomposition gases of $SF\epsilon$. Their kinds and contents are of great significance for the diagnosis of $SF\epsilon$ gas insulation equipment. In this paper, a method combining UV absorption spectroscopy with least square fitting is proposed for the quantitative calculation of three kinds of $SF\epsilon$ decomposition components. Therefore, we have obtained the correction formula for the calculation of $H_{2}S$ concentration in the higher concentration range. Combined with this formula, we can realize the accurate quantitative detection of three gases. The detection range is 1-10ppm for SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and $H_{2}S$, and 30-300ppb for CS<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>. This paper provides a simple and efficient detection method, which is easy to integrate into the detection equipment, and provides a method support for the online monitoring of $SF\epsilon$ insulation equipment

articleTitle: The Influence of Shan-Wu HVDC System on the Operation Characteristics of Hubei Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The ±800kV Shaanxi-Wuhan HVDC system (hereinafter referred to as Shan-Wu HVDC system) with will be put into full operation in 2022. To improve the strength of the receiving-end grid and strengthen the optimal distribution of electric energy, the 1000kV Central China double-looped AC network will be put into operation simultaneously. The short-circuit current, power flow distribution, transient stability and voltage stability characteristics of Hubei power grid will be greatly affected by Shan-Wu HVDC system and the double-looped AC networks. This paper analyzes and calculates the short circuit level, power flow distribution, transient stability and voltage stability characteristics of Hubei power grid after Shan-Wu HVDC system is put into operation, and the corresponding operation management measures and optimization suggestions of power grid structure are given.

articleTitle: Impulse Current Measurement Device Based on Uniform Spiral Magnetic Induction Module
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Lightning striking power system will produce a strong impulse current, and generate a very high ground potential rise on the equipment, which seriously endangers the safety of equipment and personnel. Therefore, the accuracy of impulse current measurement is related to the safe and stable operation of power system. In order to measure impulse current efficiently, conveniently and accurately, a wide frequency magnetic field sensor based on Archimedes spiral structure is developed. Firstly, the structure design and parameter calculation of the magnetic field sensor with Archimedes spiral structure are carried out. Compared with the traditional solenoid sensor, the single-layer sensitivity of the magnetic field sensor with Archimedes spiral structure is increased by 7.18 times. Through software simulation, the capacitance to ground of the magnetic field sensor is 1.0578pf; the rise time of the step response is 20.4ns, and the overshoot is 4.4%; the upper and lower cut-off frequencies of the magnetic field sensor are 3Hz and 21mhz respectively. The simulation results show that the magnetic field sensor has excellent high-frequency characteristics and dynamic response characteristics. Compared with the standard of national high voltage measurement station, the amplitude error is better than 0.2%, the linearity of rise time error is better than 0.2%, and the linearity of half peak time error is better than 0.1%. The non-contact accurate measurement of impulse current is realized.

articleTitle: Service Pattern for Premium Power Supply Based on Combination of Leasing and Property Transfer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Premium power supply service mode is an important content to promote the application of premium power supply engineering. On the basis of existing customed power technology, this paper presents a service pattern for premium power supply combining leasing and property transfer with the goal of maximizing the interests of users and investors, considering the needs of users and the governance capacity of governance devices. Three specific implementation schemes are proposed. Through empirical analysis of the costs and benefits of users and investors under the three scenarios, this paper proves the feasibility of the combination of lease and property transfer. And it is further proved that the scheme of leasing before property transfer maximizes both parties' income, which provides an optional mode for promoting the premium power supply service.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Test of Power Compensated Energy Storage Flywheel on Drilling Platform
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the single 250kW-3kWh power-compensated energy storage flywheel which applied to the drilling platform, this paper uses finite element simulation software to perform static and dynamic analysis on the energy storage flywheel. The simulation results show that all indicators meet the design requirements. According to the actual working conditions of the drilling platform, the performance indicators required for the energy storage flywheel are listed. The actual test has passed the requirements of 200 times full-power charging and discharging in 12 hours, and the temperature rise of the motor and the magnetic bearing are below the limit of 120 degree centigrade. The charging and discharging power reaches 250KW, the full power discharge time reaches 30s, and the charging and discharging switching time is within 20ms. It fully shows that the energy storage flywheel can meet the performance requirements of power compensation of the power system of the drilling platform.

articleTitle: Study on Data Cleaning Based on Improved K-Means Clustering and Error Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Building an integrated energy system requires collecting and analyzing energy data. Due to inevitable factors such as system failures and line maintenance, data will be missing or abnormal during the collection process and cannot be converted into useful information. This type of data is mainly divided into two categories: bad data that does not meet the energy characteristics and missing data. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a data cleaning method based on improved K-Means clustering and error feedback to achieve data cleaning. First, the abnormal data is divided into two types: bad data and missing data. For bad data, this paper proposes an abnormal data recognition method based on improved K-Means clustering. Through the method of clustering validity test, Davies-Bouldin (DB) index is used to determine the optimal number of clusters; Aiming at the missing data, this paper proposes a combined interpolation method for abnormal data based on error feedback, which determines the imputation weight of a certain type of user through the calculation of the sample set. In order to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, this paper selects 40 sets of electricity consumption data of 5 users in a certain park within four months. The first 20 groups are used as the sample set to determine the imputation weight, and the last 20 groups are used as the verification set for verification and comparison. The results show that the data recognition and interpolation method proposed in this paper has higher stability and reliability.

articleTitle: Online Status Assessment o Distribution Network Transformer Based o Random Matrix Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at insufficient representation of current indicators in transformer health assessment, this paper, using random matrix theory (RMT), motivates data-driven tools to analyze and perceive the spatiotemporal correlation of distribution network transformer equipment operation data, and then constructs high-dimensional statistical characteristics as the representation quantity of equipment health status. Some actual cases are given to show that the proposed feature has a better characterization ability for the equipment health condition with consideration of sensitivity and reliability. The work through the object – data – high-dimensional statistics – health index, on the one hand, to achieve data-driven health assessment, on the other hand, to provide theoretical support and application demonstration for the implementation of big data analytics in the field of power systems.

articleTitle: Study of Over-Sampling Methods Used in Distribution Transformer Connectivity Verification
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Data-driven method has been used to carry out distribution transformer connectivity verification. The imbalanced dataset always results in bad performance of machine learning algorithms. In order to solve this problem, two kinds of over-sampling methods have been studied in this paper. Voltage curves of 3967 distribution transformer which belong to 197 10kV feeders have been collected. The performance of over-sampling methods under different sampling rate has also been studied. Pareto optimality has been carried out in order to obtain the best sampling rate. Results show that with the increase of sampling rate, the value of true negative (TN) increase and the value of true positive (TP) and accuracy decrease. The performance of synthetic minority over-sampling technique (SMOTE) is a little better compared with simple copy method (SCM). When the lower limits of TN, TP and accuracy are set as 0.93, the best sampling rate of SCM is 17 and the values for SMOTE are 16, 17 and 18.

articleTitle: Line Protection Scheme for Multiple-receiving Ends HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The following topics are dealt with: power grids; distributed power generation; power engineering computing; optimisation; wind power plants; power generation economics; power generation control; distribution networks; renewable energy sources; power markets.

articleTitle: Dispatching Methods and Strategies for Controllable Charging Pile Clusters to Participate in Grid Ancillary Services
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a load-side resource, electric vehicles(EVs) participate in grid ancillary services and can provide efficient load adjustment capabilities, however, how to control a large number of EVs is a big problem. At present, the technology for regulating the EVs load by controlling the output power of the charging pile is relatively mature. That is, charging operators have abilitity to control the EVs directly, when the operators establish contact with the power grid dispatching center, get the dispatching command from power grid, and their charging resources can be scheduled by the command, to achieve EVs orderly charge. This paper will introduce a dispatching method for operator, that is, create charging clusters and set a control strategy to ensure the charging requirements of users, and then follow the dispatching command for upper-level dispatching between clusters and lower-level dispatching within the cluster. And besides, implement charging monitoring and optimized dispatching.

articleTitle: Fine Planning Method of Power Grid Based on Principal Component Analysis and Index Correlation Degree
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the power grid development changing from high-speed to high-quality stage, the proportion of new energy increasing and the scale of power grid operation data expanding, the planning and the decision-making is becoming more and more difficult. Moreover, it is hard to deal with the big data during the high-quality development stage of power grid and the inaccuracy of grid planning brings difficulties to decision making of grid construction and investment, though the traditional grid planning method can still handle the scientific requirement of decision-making model. This paper is mainly focused on the relevance between statistical characteristics of data indicators and power grid planning. The principal component analysis method is used to reduce the dimension of data indicators, which makes the data system more efficient. Meanwhile, the project is sorted by index correlation degree method, so that the planning point is more accurate and the refinement degree of grid planning is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Line Selection Method for Single-phase Ground Fault in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the context of the rapid development of the national economy, the demand and reliability of electrical energy in all walks of life continue to increase. The large number of new energy sources has further increased the difficulty of fault line selection in the distribution network. In order to improve the accuracy of fault line selection, this paper uses new energy power generation devices to solve the problem of fault line selection. A method based on the background harmonic signal generated by the inverter to neutral point ungrounded active distribution network single-phase ground fault selection is proposed. When new energy sources such as photovoltaics are connected to the grid, due to the non-ideal dead zone of power electronic devices, certain harmonic components will be generated. When a single-phase fault occurs, the harmonic zero-sequence current is analyzed with the help of the zero-sequence current measuring device widely distributed in the distribution network, the characteristic signal energy of each measurement point is compared, the fault path is determined, and the fault judgment is completed. A simulation model of a typical active distribution network is established, and the fault characteristic information under different ground resistances is analyzed. The simulation results show that compared with the passive line selection at the fundamental frequency, the new method has a better energy measurement and can effectively improve the accuracy of line selection.

articleTitle: Coupled Optimization of Topology Reconfiguration and Voltage Source Converter Control for Enlarging Load Margin of AC/DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In the AC/DC distribution network, distributed generators, energy storages, and converter-interfaced loads can be integrated flexibly. To ensure the voltage stability of the AC/DC distribution network, it is important to enlarge the load margin of ac/dc distribution network. By changing topology of the distribution network and adjusting control settings of DC links, the AC/DC distribution network may gain surpluses of the load margin without influencing the operations of distributed generators and loads connected. In this paper, a coupled optimization method is proposed to enlarge the load margin of the AC/DC distribution network, where both the topology reconfiguration and the regulation of control modes of voltage source converters (VSCs) are considered. The model of AC/DC power flow and continuous power flow (CPF) is introduced. Based on this, the optimization model for the enlarging load margin of ac/dc distribution network is presented. Then, the solving algorithm for the optimal problem is presented. Test results on a modified IEEE 33-node AC/DC hybrid system validate the effectiveness of the proposed method. Compared with optimization results using only topology reconfigurations or regulations control modes of VSCs, the load margin has been increased 14.4% and 3.8%.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Distributed Energy Systems Under Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Uncertainty complicates the optimization model of distributed energy systems, whereas it is favorable to address the fragility of optimal solutions. This work presents a two-stage stochastic programming model to optimize the economic and environmental objective simultaneously, considering the uncertainties including energy demands and renewable energy resources. Meanwhile, the single-objective optimization is combined with the epsilon-constraint method in order to obtain the Pareto frontier, and then the decision making method is introduced to identify the tradeoff solution considering the both objectives. The results shows that, compared with the deterministic model, the stochastic model leads to an underestimation of the total cost, but a similarity of carbon emission. In addition, the computational cost of the stochastic model is significantly higher than that of the deterministic model, which means that the designers need to take their computational resources into account when modeling DES under uncertainty.

articleTitle: Security and Stability Problems Faced by the Transformation of Full Clean Energy in the Power Grid at the Transmission End and Countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the problem of energy shortage and environmental pollution becoming more and more serious, the realization of full clean energy power generation has become the goal of energy development in the world. Firstly, this paper introduces the characteristics of power grid structure, clean energy development planning and power mutual aid in Europe and China, and points out the problems of limited grid carrying capacity, safety and stability, and new energy consumption faced by the high proportion of clean energy development in the "Three North" region of China. Based on this, taking a provincial power grid in China as an example, this paper analyzes the security and stability problems of peak load regulation, overload, frequency and voltage existing in the power grid in the phase of gradual decommissioning of thermal power and realization of full clean energy transformation, which are verified by the actual power grid. Finally, based on the experience of European power grid planning and new technology application, this paper discusses the measures and suggestions of realizing full clean energy transformation of provincial and regional power grids in China.

Author Keywords: Security and stability of power grid
power source and power grid plan

articleTitle: Cloud Terminal for Bulk Power Grid Dispatching System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to realize the undifferentiated browsing of the cloud terminal for the large power grid dispatching system, this paper proposes a framework design of the cloud terminal to support the local/remote undifferentiated browsing.
