First, a standardized storage specification for interactive interfaces is proposed, which expands the existing CIM/G specifications to achieve cross-system and cross-software analysis and display of interactive interfaces; Then, it provides a graphical development tool for applications (APP), which can be used to achieve rapid and fine-grained development of applications that comply with cloud terminal specifications, and explores the use of cloud terminals for full life cycle management of application services; Finally, the standard human-computer interaction specification is discussed, and the undifferentiated invocation of data and services is realized by standardizing the structure of interactive messages. The developed human-machine cloud terminal can break the limitation of the existing localization of the dispatching system, realize the undifferentiated display of the dispatching interface and the undifferentiated call of the cloud platform application service.

articleTitle: A Piecewise Function based Equivalent Aggregation of Photovoltaic Array Considering Partial Shading Situation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Photovoltaic (PV) grid-connected system is a complicated project which is composed of large numbers of PV cells with different series and parallel connection and relating power electronic converters. To simplify it, the equivalent model of PV unit is essential to build. Thus, the paper proposes an equivalent aggregation model of PV array based on piecewise function. By building the typical industrial mathematic model of PV cell and analyzing the working mode of PV cells with series connection, a unified expression of output voltage and current of PV array based on piecewise function is determined. The proposed model is suitable for PV array either in normal or partial shading conditions and brings certain simplicity in calculation. The simulation in Plecs platform verifies the correctness and effectiveness.

articleTitle: Prevention and Maintenance Technology for Equipment Family Defects Based on Account Data Map
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Function location type, category, model, manufacturer, equipment parameter, defect information and operation/maintenance information are key fields of electrical power system equipment account data, which are organized with account data ID as the main keyword. In the past, there was a lack of mining methods and a large amount of account data was not analyzed. In this paper, a standardized technique for computer implementation is proposed, which transforms any account data table into sparse adjacency matrix, and then transforms adjacency matrix into map. With the same functional location type in the account data map, according to the equipment model, manufacturer and technical parameters associated, the information of potential spare parts and the quality of account data can be got. With the same category and model, according to the function position type, defect appearance, defect reason and treatment measure field, family defects of equipment is got. According to the treatment measure field, the prevention and maintenance method for family defect of equipment can be formed.

articleTitle: Service Restoration Strategy of Active Distribution Network Based on Power Router
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power router (PR) based on power electronics technology can flexibly control the power flow, coordinate the power transmission among AC power, distributed generator (DG), distributed energy storage device (DS) and load, and also replaces the traditional tie switch, so it will play a significant role in the service restoration stage of the distribution network. This paper proposes a service restoration strategy considering frequency stability for active distribution network based on PR. Firstly, considering the fuel reserve limitation of DG and residual energy limitation of DS, the objective of service restoration is proposed to ensure the continuous power supply of as many high of priority loads as possible. Then, considering the time-varying characteristics of photovoltaic power generation, wind power generation and load, a service restoration strategy, which can balance the active power and stabilize the frequency, is proposed to ensure the power supply quality in the fault recovery stage. Finally, a system with a PR managing DG, DS and local load is utilized to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Analysis on On-site Artificial Grounding Fault Test of MMC-HVDC Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, test scheme and results of artificial grounding short circuit test for Zhangbei MMC–HVDC power grid are analyzed. Formation principle of artificial grounding short-circuit current is analyzed according to the structure of MMC-HVDC power grid. An estimation method of short-circuit current is proposed. Comparison between estimation results and field artificial grounding short circuit test results shows that, short current can be calculated approximately using method proposed. Which provides a preliminary basis for equipment stress check before field test.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimal Operation of Integrated Energy Station Considering Auxiliary Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cooperating optimization of Multi-energy systems have been paid more and more attentions in recent years. This paper focuses on the optimal operation of a CCHP integrated energy station. An optimization model considering the on/off linkage of auxiliary equipment consumption is proposed. The models of the main equipment in the energy station, such as LiBr absorption chiller, ground source heat pump, gas boiler, electric chiller, etc. are improved with piecewise linear method to get more precise description of efficiency curve. The operation cost and exergy efficiency are introduced as the evaluation indexes for the operation of CCHP integrated energy station. The simulation cases are presented to investigate effect of the proposed model compared with the traditional model. The results show the proposed model in this paper could get lower operation cost and higher efficiency than the traditional one.

articleTitle: Research on Three-dimensional Comparison and Selection Strategy of Sequential Control transformation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the improvement of the economic and safety requirements of substations, it is particularly important to implement sequential control transformation of the equipment in the traditional substation to improve the automation level of the substation. However, the transformation of sequential control in substations generally involves a wide range of transformation areas, and the time and method of transformation have a greater impact on the effect of sequential control transformation. It is difficult to make decisions on the transformation plan from all aspects of economy, safety and reliability by traditional economic decision-making models. Therefore, this paper proposes a safety efficiency cost comparison model suitable for sequential control transformation. Based on the characteristics of equipment failure rate, the model updates safety indicators and cost indicators, and proposed the calculation method of the efficiency index by “Monte Carlo Sampling” and “Optimal The Load Reduction Model”, finally evaluating the transformation results from the three aspects of transformation time, site and mode. Finally, this paper uses the IEEE 24 node network as an application scenario to verify the effectiveness of the model

articleTitle: Study on Method of User’s Comprehensive Energy Use Behavior Decision Based on Evolutionary Game
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing diversification of human energy use forms in the integrated energy market, how to analyze the decision of comprehensive energy use behavior for different user groups according to the changing characteristics of their energy demand is an important issue to be urgently addressed. To solve this problem, a method of user's comprehensive energy use behavior decision based on the evolutionary game is proposed in this paper. Firstly, considering three types of users that include residents, large industry, and business users, a utility model which takes into account energy use characteristics of users and user comfort factors is constructed based on subjective and objective combination weighting method. Then, a game model is proposed to describe the dynamic process of user's energy selection based on the evolutionary game method; Finally, the model is solved by distributed iterative method. The correctness and validity of the proposed method are verified by the simulation results.

Author Keywords: decision of user’s comprehensive energy use behavior
subjective and objective combination weighting method

articleTitle: Design of Fault Line Selection Method for Distribution Network Based on Correlation of Characteristic Quantities
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the problem of weak ground fault signals in distribution network and difficulty in fault line selection, a method of fault line selection in distribution network based on correlation analysis of characteristic quantities is designed. Principal component analysis is used to optimize multiple fault characteristics, and they form historical sample sets and real-time characteristic samples. These samples are analyzed by using cluster analysis intelligent algorithm. With this method, highly correlated fault characteristics can be flexibly selected for line selection according to the actual situation. This method effectively improves the reliability of fault line selection and accurately selects the ground fault of the distribution network. A typical distribution network is built in the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation environment to verify the proposed line selection method. The simulation results show that the method can effectively amplify the ground fault characteristics and realize accurate single-phase ground fault line selection.

articleTitle: A Multi-objective Optimization Charging Strategy for Lithium Ion Battery Based on Lithium-plating Inhibited Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the popularization of electric vehicles, the problem of safe and fast charging of lithium ion batteries must be settled urgently. The existing fast charging minimize charge time, whereas battery health is out of consideration. Constantcurrent (CC) charging with large charge rate (C-rate) leads to irreversible damage to battery life, which reduces chargedischarge cycles and increases cost. In this study, a multi-stage constant-current charging strategy considering charge speed, charge loss and the safety of battery is proposed, which is based on lithium-plating inhibited (LPI) model and optimized by particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. Compared with traditional CC charging methods at different C-rate, the results show that this approach can charge the battery quickly without lithium-plating, which holds promising for longer battery life.

articleTitle: Line Protection Scheme for Multiple-receiving Ends HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The concept of multiple receiving ends HVDC systems is described in this paper. Based on PSCAD/EMTDC, a simulation model of multiple receiving ends in series connection mode has been established, with which the characteristics in fault conditions of each line are simulated and analyzed. And, based on this new connection of multi-ends system, a new protection scheme has been proposed to identify the fault segment of transmission line and verified through simulation.

articleTitle: The Edge Computing Aided Security Information Transformation via Relay
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the growth of power demand and the development of modern information technology, smart grid has been widely concerned. It is challenging for smart devices to transmit power data safely in smart grid environment. Edge computing has the advantages of real-time data processing and low delay. In order to improve the security of information transmission, a physical layer security communication model based on edge computing for smart grid cooperative jamming (CJ) relay node selection is proposed in this paper. The results show that the proposed relay node selection scheme can improve the transmission security of smart grid communication system.

articleTitle: A Calculation Method of Network Charge Based on the Shortest Path of Typical Topology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The traditional transmission and distribution pricing mechanism cannot adapt to the complex distributed trading market. In this paper, based on the analysis of the existing research on the distribution network charges, a practical and easy-to-use method for seeking the shortest path charge based on the typical topology of distribution network is proposed, the transaction consumption scenarios of distributed energy and users under different feeders are fully considered. A case study is given to show the effectiveness of this method in promoting distributed energy trading.

articleTitle: Technical Structure and Operation Principle of Mechanical Elastic Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing proportion of renewable energy in the power system, energy storage technology is gradually developed and updated. The mechanical elastic energy storage is a new physical energy storage technology, and its energy storage form is elastic potential energy. Compared with other physical energy storage forms, this kind of energy storage system has its own characteristics and advantages. Firstly, the structure and working principle of mechanical elastic energy storage system are introduced in this paper. Secondly, the modular push-pull mechanical assembly technology of series linked energy storage tank group is designed, which greatly simplifies the installation process of energy storage tank group. And the mathematical model of the energy storage tank group is established, which provides the design criteria for the operation power/energy storage capacity of the energy storage system. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed energy storage technology is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: A Data Repair Method for Missing Voltage Data of Smart Meter Users
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a method to repair the missing voltage data of smart meter users, which includes four steps: acquiring the user voltage data of a power distribution area through the power consumption information acquisition system; calculating the average values of voltage difference at corresponding time between each user and others; making user groups according to the average values of user voltage difference; and repairing the user missing voltage data according to the grouping result. The case study shows that the method can repair the missing voltage data of smart meter users, which provides an important data basis for the development of related business.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Current Splitting Device in Nonlinear Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The current splitting device (CSD) proposes a new method that can be used to verify the nonlinear characteristics of installed meters and reference meters that comply with current industry standards and trace the source to sine wave reference equipment. By using the CSD, the nonlinear characteristics of two different types of measuring instruments are tested. In this paper, we evaluate the potential errors during the measurement and its causes; then we propose a practical and reliable measurement method of nonlinear characteristic and help improve the design of CSD.

articleTitle: Multi-energy Energy Hub Configuration Method Containing New Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a configuration method of a multi-energy energy hub containing new energy consumption. The method take the annual operating cost as the optimization goal, and use the capacity of the equipment as a decision variable to build an energy hub model. This paper separately calculates the configuration results of each equipment capacity in the energy hub model before and after the new energy is added. By comparing the operating status of each equipment in three typical days of spring, summer and winter before and after the new energy is added. Analyze the impact of capacity configuration of each equipment in the energy hub by adding new energy and the equipment in the three typical days. The results show that the increase in installed capacity of new energy will reduce the capacity configuration of gas turbines and waste heat boilers, but will not affect the capacity configuration of heat pumps.

articleTitle: The Multiple Solution Problem of Static Power Flow in AC/DC Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There is growing HVDC systems in modern power system. This paper aims to discuss the multi solution problem of power flow (PF) in AC/DC hybrid system. The multi solution phenomenon of PF originates from the nonlinear characteristic of power system. Fora set of nonlinear equations, the mathematical solution is usually not unique. Up to now, it is still a challenging problem to find out all the PF solutions or predict the exact operation point for power system absolutely. In this paper, a modified IEEE standard 57-node case containing three high voltage direct current (HVDC) lines are investigated. Through Newton-Raphson (NR) iterative method with different initial values, we can obtain multiple PF solutions in mathematics. The corresponding convergence basin of these solutions is presented to show the relationship between the performance of NR method and the selection of initial guess. Then the feasibility and rationality of these solutions are evaluated on the physical characteristics.

articleTitle: Study on Main Factors of Dynamic Stability for Regional Interconnected Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing scale of power system, the complex and ever-changing structure and the flexible operation modes, dynamic instability has become one of the main problems threatening the security and stability of power grid and restricting the transmission capacity of key transmission lines. In this paper, the influence of power grid structure, operation mode and parameters of generator excitation control system on the dynamic stability of regional interconnected power grid is analyzed theoretically. Then, the conclusions are validated by the case study of Central China power grid. The research in this paper has certain guiding significance for the planning and operation of interconnected power system.

articleTitle: Real-time Rapid Simulation Model for Faults Near the DC Drop Point Based on Dynamic Phasor Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to realize the real-time rapid calculation of faults near the DC drop point, a detailed modeling of the complete high-voltage direct-current (HVDC) system is proposed based on dynamic phasor theory. Firstly, the calculation method of actual firing angle under asymmetrical faults is analyzed, and the improved switching function model is established. Subsequently, by fully considering the dominant frequencies of harmonics and taking into account the phase shifting effect of converter transformer, the improved dynamic phasor model of converter is reconstructed to ensure the calculation accuracy at the interface between AC and DC systems. On this basis, by modeling the DC transmission line and control system, the entire HVDC system is equivalent to voltage-controlled current sources, which can output the three-phase AC fault current by only inputting three-phase AC voltage data. Applying it to the CIGRE Benchmark system, simulation results further prove the high speed and precision of the proposed model.

Author Keywords: faults near the DC drop point

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Transient Model of Multi-infeed DC System Based on Accurate Modeling of Converter Valve
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, in the simulation of large-scale AC/DC systems, electromechanical transient simulation cannot accurately describe the dynamic characteristics of the system due to the limitations of its models and parameters. And the traditional electromagnetic transient simulation lacks accuracy and real-time in the simulation analysis due to the limitation of simulation speed. Therefore, it is necessary to propose an accurate electromagnetic transient real-time simulation method. Based on the BPA dynamic equivalent data of the East China AC/DC power grid, this paper establishes a real-time simulation model of the multi-feed DC power system in HYPERSIM. First, the accurate converter valve module of the DC system is modeled to reflect the characteristics of the converter valve more accurately while ensuring the simulation speed. After that, the modeling method of the generator, load and other modules is given. Simulative results show that the steady-state and transient characteristics of the system are consistent before and after the conversion, which verifies the validity of the proposed modeling method. The research results give reference for the accurate simulation of large-scale multi-feed DC projects in the future.

articleTitle: The Design of Substation Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of power distribution network needs to match development patterns in order to achieve highend positioning of urban construction. The target of development of smart power grids is to construct loop closing operation more mashing and bicyclo-loop, which is more suitable for high-end district. The construction of power distribution network require standardization, integration and intelligence, for making network management more distinct and fluency in regard to scope of business, which realize the target of innovation, security, reliability, economy and energy conservation.

articleTitle: LSTM Recurrent Neural Network Based Interactive Behaviour Learning of Microgrid Under Incomplete Information
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The interactive operation of Microgrid (MG) in energy market is facing more and more incomplete information decision-making requirements due to the enhanced privacy of users, which brings great challenges to the participation flexibility of MG in demand response program. To address this problem, this paper proposes a novel LSTM recurrent neural network (RNN) based method for MG interactive operation, the proposed method uses LSTM-RNN to map the relationship between tie-line power and the available resources data outside of MG, and improves the prediction accuracy through iteratively learning of the accumulated operating data. On this basis, the interactive behaviour learning and interactive operation of MGs under incomplete information is effectively realized. The example analysis and test are carried out on a typical MG system, the validity of the proposed method is verified by comparing with traditional model-based method.

articleTitle: A Multi-Port and Reconfigurable Hybrid AC/DC Microgrid Architecture with Hierarchical Power Control for Nearly/Net Zero Energy Buildings
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the major energy consumers in the world, buildings contribute to 40% of global energy consumption. Hybrid AC/DC microgrid provides a desirable solution for buildings to improve the energy efficiency, thereby achieving the target of nearly/net zero energy buildings (nZEBs). This paper presents a multi-port and reconfigurable hybrid AC/DC microgrid architecture and corresponding hierarchical control scheme for nZEBs. The central component of this architecture is the new interlinking converter (ILC) called smart interlinking unit (SIU), which is characterized by multiple AC/DC ports, reconfigurable topology and various control functionalities. Besides, a hierarchical control strategy, which composes of local control and power flow control in respective primary and secondary control level, is proposed for this architecture. This control approach could implement a flexible power exchange among AC sub-grid, DC sub-grid and utility grid. Additionally, an improved exploitation and local consumption of renewable energy resources (RESs) could also be achieved. The validity of the introduced architecture and hierarchical control scheme is verified by comprehensive cases.

articleTitle: Analysis and Correction Methods for Network Time-delay Error of IEEE 1588 Synchronization Clock
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) 1588 synchronous clock based on Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP) is used for communication networks timing in substations. The path time-delay error of synchronous message is caused by the communication network transmission. The precision error of IEEE 1588 clock synchronization is analyzed, where the correction methods of path time-delay error of synchronous message are proposed with the diffserv-based packets scheduling model (DPSM). The bandwidth adjustment factor, urgent degree mechanism and the time-delay of synchronous message are determined by setting the priority of the service message queue of the network node. Then the correction methods of oscillation frequency of clock generator are proposed. The IEEE 1588 synchronization clock error is thus corrected. Finally, the high precision network clock hardware platform is built and the test is completed. Experiment results show that the clock has the synchronization precision of nanosecond, and it can satisfy the time synchronization precision requirements of International Electro-technical Commission (IEC) 64850 standard for smart substations.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Reactor Internal and External Vibration Based on Sum Squared Residual
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The vibration of electric equipment, such as reactor, can reflect the condition of the equipment. It is very important to measure and analyze the information of reactor vibration for the diagnosis of reactor operation. The vibration of the inner winding and core of the reactor cannot be measured directly, and the vibration measuring points are usually set on the external surface of the oil tank. In this paper, by comparing the vibration signals of reactor, the relationship between the vibration of external and internal measuring points is explored. Firstly, several vibration sensors are set on oil-immersed large reactor outside surface and inside, and different voltages are applied to the reactor to obtain the internal and external vibration signals of the reactor under the corresponding operating condition. Then, the effectiveness of PCC (Pearson Correlation Coefficient) and RSSR (Reciprocal of Sum Squared Residual) on the vibration correlation analysis is compared and analyzed. Finally, the average value of RSSR under different voltage levels is selected as the basis for evaluating the correlation, and the correlation between reactor external and internal measurement points is analyzed. The correspondence law between the external vibration measurement point and the internal measurement point is proposed.

articleTitle: Calculation of Wide-Area Earth Surface Potential of HVDC Grounding Electrodes
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to further reduce the theoretical difficulty of wide-area earth surface potential by DC ground electrodes, a simple calculation formula of the wide-area earth surface potential is derived based on the transmission line theory. In view of the infinite integral formula of surface potential, a fast Hankel transform is proposed to transform the infinite integral formula into a sum of finite terms, which greatly reduces the complexity of the solution algorithm. In the case of large number of layers or singular parameters of the earth, This paper lists examples and compares them with the calculated results of the high-order complex image method and the grounding standard calculation software CDEGS. The simulation results show that the method proposed in this paper is consistent with the high-order complex image method, and can quickly and accurately solve the wide-area surface potential of DC grounding electrodes.

articleTitle: Networking Scheme of Electric energy router for Dispersive End Consumers in Remote Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The problems of low-voltage at the end of 10kV transmission line in remote rural area can be well solved by the electric energy router (EER). In this paper, the optimal configuration model of distribution network based on different networking schemes of EER are proposed to solve the low-voltage issue for dispersive end consumers in the remote distribution networks. Two typical EER networking schemes are discussed, including the series mode of EER scheme in which the EER performs voltage regulation directly and the parallel mode of EER scheme in which the EER acts as reactive compensator. The effects of the two typical networking schemes are compared by the evaluation indexes of daily total cost, system efficiency, voltage fluctuation and photovoltaic (PV) installation capacity. The results show that the series mode could make the PV installation capacity larger and get the less cost, and the parallel mode could make the system capacity of EER smaller and get the higher system efficiency. Furthermore, the impact of external factors, such as irradiance and load level, on the cost of the two typical networking schemes are investigated. The results show the series mode is more sensitive to the irradiance and have lower cost on different load level than the parallel mode.

articleTitle: Influence of Micro-water on Decomposition Characteristics of C4F7N/CO2 Mixed Gas
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Preliminary research shows that $C_{4}F_{7}N$ has good insulation properties and environmental protection characteristics, and has great potential as a substitute for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> in gas-insulated equipment. According to the allowable value of the micro-water content in the equipment, the micro-water content is set to 0 and $1000\mu L/L$, and the sphere electrodes are used to simulate the quasi-uniform electric field. The influence of micro-water on the decomposition characteristics of $C_{4}F_{7}N/CO_{2}$ mixed gas was studied through experiments. The experimental results show that there is no significant difference between the decomposition products under the two conditions, and they are mainly $C_{2}F_{6}, C_{3}F_{8}, C_{3}F_{6}, CF_{4}, CF_{3}CN$, CO, $C_{2}N_{2}, COF_{2},C_{2}F_{5}CN$. The production of $C_{2}F_{5}CN$ has increased while the production of $C_{3}F_{6}$ and $C_{2}N_{2}$ has been inhibited after adding micro-water. The relevant research can provide the basis and reference for the engineering application of $C_{4}F_{7}N/CO_{2}$ mixed gas. If $C_{4}F_{7}N/CO_{2}$ mixed gas is used as a gas medium for insulating equipment, try to ensure that the inside of the equipment does not contain moisture or less moisture.

articleTitle: A Study on Operation of Heat Pump Cluster Based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To solve the operation challenge of heat pump clusters in district energy systems, this paper introduces the operation optimization approach based on the hybrid model of the heat pump clusters consisting of both mechanism-based and data-driven modeling. First, we use graph theory to build the mechanism-based heating network model. Second, we use the water supply temperature, water flow rate and load of heat pump as variables to build the data-driven model. The two models are used together as the basis of cluster operation optimization. Third, we introduce particle swarm optimization algorithm to search the optimal operation schemes of a target district energy system driven by heat pumps. The target district energy system locates in “Zhongtian Future Ark” park in Guiyang. The testing results show that such an approach could realize energy-saving around 8% once the optimized scheme is applied.

articleTitle: Electric Field Joint Checking Method for Isolated Power Supply Transformer of 535kV DC Circuit Breaker Considering Air Conductivity
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As an important part of DC circuit breaker, isolated power supply transformer belongs to AC/DC hybrid equipment. It is necessary to adopt appropriate field types in the electric field check of isolated power supply transformer to ensure the accuracy of the results. In this paper, the difference between electrostatic field and constant electric field is analyzed from the basic electromagnetic field theory. The electric field joint checking method for this kind of AC/DC hybrid equipment is put forward. The finite element model of 535kV isolated power supply transformer is constructed, and the method of outsourcing entity is used to partition. The solution is completed in electrostatic field and constant electric field. The influence of air conductivity on electric field calculation results is also considered in constant electric field. The results show that the surface electric field strength of fittings in electrostatic field is greater than that in constant electric field. And in constant electric field, surface electric field strength of metal fittings and other conductors almost does not change with the change of air conductivity, but the surface electric field strength of external insulating materials such as post insulator will decrease first and then increase with the increase of air conductivity. It is suggested that the electrostatic field calculation results should be used in the electric field check of fittings, and the constant electric field calculation results considering the change of air conductivity should be used in the external insulation electric field check according to the actual environment.

articleTitle: Joint Dispatching Strategy of Distributed Generation and Electric Vehicle Based on Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper mainly studies the joint optimization scheduling method of distributed generation and electric vehicle based on virtual power plant. Considering the randomness of distributed generation output and the controllability of electric vehicle charging and discharging, this paper proposes to use virtual power plant to optimize the resource allocation of distributed generation and electric vehicle within the scope, making full use of the complementary advantages of different energy forms in space and time. Firstly, according to the real-time data of the external power grid connected to the control area of each virtual power plant, the grid dispatching department takes the voltage deviation rate and load curve variance as the optimization objectives, and sends the voltage operation range and the total power range of distributed generation and electric vehicle to each virtual power plant. Then, according to the instructions and data issued by the superior power grid, each virtual power plant takes the voltage deviation rate of each distributed generation node, the complementary ratio of distributed generation and electric vehicle and the income of electric vehicle users as the optimization objectives, and optimizes the selection of distributed generation output and electric vehicle charging and discharging time and quantity. The solution strategy adopts a dynamic real-time adjustment of double-layer rolling optimization algorithm. The algorithm can give the optimal operating voltage range, the total power range in the region, the optimal distributed generation output and electric vehicle charging in the control area of the virtual power plant Discharge time and quantity. Finally, the effectiveness of the joint scheduling model and control strategy is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Extreme Risk Assessment in Power System Considering Cyber Attacks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Recently, wide concern of extreme risk events in power system has been aroused due to several big blackouts at home and abroad. The present study is designed to assess the extreme risk of power system considering cyber attacks, which can not be reflected by using traditional risk assessment method. Based on the theory of value at risk(VaR) and extreme value theory(EVT) in financial terms, a method to evaluate and quantize extreme risk of power system is proposed to determine the potential risk resulted from extreme events with low probabilities and serious consequences. The method is applied to evaluate the extreme risk of cyber attacks in power system and comparisons between evaluation results of commom risk and extreme risk are conducted. Statistically significant results have justified the validity of extreme risk assessment method, which could be regarded as a complement and improvement to traditional risk assessment. It is recommended that further study is needed to be conducted for risk prevention so as to enhance the operation security and reliability of power system.

articleTitle: Capacity Limitation Service for Multi-Energy Virtual Power Plants Based on Multi-Parametric Programming
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multi-energy virtual power plants intend to aggregate multi-energy distributed resources and provide ancillary service to the power system. To exploit more flexibility of the synergy of multi-energy, multiple types of energy conversion equipment and thermal inertia of the commercial buildings are considered in this paper. A capacity limitation service model based on multi-parametric programming is proposed to overcome the difficulty that the power of the demand side distributed resources is difficult to be accurately controlled. Case studies based on an actual multi-energy industrial park in Beijing are conducted to validate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Multilevel Dispatch and Control for Grid Interconnected Wind-CAES Hybrid Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High penetration wind integrated into bulk power systems challenges the power system operation. To maximize wind energy production, hybrid wind systems combining wind farms with compressed air energy storage (CAES) are designed and controlled in this paper. An approach for designing hybrid wind systems is presented. A multi-level dispatch and control strategy are developed to utilize the storage capacity with maximum benefits by managing the state-of-charge of the storage device. A novel storage predictive controller is designed to predict SOC saturation, control storage power output, and avoid control capability loss of storage. A numerical case study demonstrated that the proposed approach is effective to reduce variability of wind-CAES hybrid system power generation.

articleTitle: Coordinated Operation of Multi-line Power Transmission for Hydrodominated Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a method for coordinated operation of hydropower plants is proposed. This method considers medium and long-term optimal dispatching and transmission constraints of hydropower plants, with the maximum total output as the goal. Based on the Panxi Power Grid as the background, the medium and long-term transmission complementary optimization model of the sending power grid is developed, where the power is obtained by reasonably simplifying the network structure of Panxi Power Grid. The optimal allocation strategy of quantity in each transmission line is used. By using the allocation strategy, an integrated method with progressive optimization algorithm and dynamic programming successive approximations is presented to carry out medium and long term optimal operations of hydropower plants to provide the required operational solutions. The results of a real case show that the method we proposed can effectively improve the total power output, reduce the abandoned water caused by channel blockage, thereby promoting large-scale hydropower integration.

articleTitle: Study on the Economic Operation of the Main Transformers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: On the consideration of security operation and meet the power supply reliability, this paper calculates the critical economic load of the main transformers to reduce distribution network power loss. The power losses of transformers in separate and parallel modes under different loading conditions are calculated respectively. Thus the criterion of transformers operation mode conversion to reduce power loss is given. The critical economic loads of substations with the same and different capacities of double main transformers are discussed. To verify the loss reduction of transformers economic operation, transformers shut down judgment are made for a real power grid. The power flow of the power gird under different transformer operation modes are solved by Matpower and the power losses of the power grid at several times are compared to illustrate the loss reduction effectiveness.

articleTitle: Noninttusive Load Monitoring and Analysis Based on Power Disturbance Data
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposed a method of monitoring typical load and analyzing load composition using disturbance data of substation. Firstly, correlation analysis method is used to analyze the correlation between substation power quality index fluctuation and user switching equipment, typical users with positive correlation will be screened out. Then, the harmonic index feature library of typical users is established by hierarchical clustering, and the monitoring of typical users is realized by using Bayesian classifier. Finally, the validity of the method is verified by real data.

articleTitle: Nonparametric Modeling Method for Correlation Analysis of Performance Indexes against the Load Loss Caused by Power System Cascading Failures
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper study and analyze the correlation relationship between performance indexes of power system and the load loss caused by cascading failures by nonparametric correlation model. A simulation platform is firstly established based on a multi-layer time-series operation evolution model to generate a large amount of representative cascading failures samples. In general, electric state indexes, network structural indexes and distribution entropy indexes, as three kinds of most commonly utilized power system performance indexes, are investigated by this paper to extract their inner correlation relationship with power loss. The weakly coupled indexes are deleted by nonparametric independence screening method, and then the strongly coupled indexes are further studied by Group Lasso nonparametric regression analysis to extract the correlation relationship with load loss. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed nonparametric modeling method perform well to discover the performance indexes that have strong correlation relationship with load loss caused by cascading failures. Moreover, these correlation rules can further serve as alarms for cascading failures of power systems.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of Community Energy Consumption Based on Multi-agent Modeling
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A community energy consumption model is established in this paper based on the multi-agent system modeling method, which comprehensively considers the influence due to the randomness and uncertainty of the energy use behavior of occupants in residential buildings. The residents in the community are first categorized into different types of households, the energy consumption of which is simulated. The results are then used with the basic information of the residential community to calculate the community energy consumption. On this basis, a community in Shanghai is selected as a test case for verification, and the simulation results are consistent with the actual energy consumption. In addition, this method has great flexibility on the time scale, and the relevant simulation results can be further used to guide the planning and design of integrated energy systems.

articleTitle: The Control Experience of the AC-DC Interconnected Power System in China and Its Reference Significance to Brazilian Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In recent years, large-scale blackouts have occurred in several countries due to the lack of power system analysis and catastrophic failure defensive, which caused a worldwide concern. In comparison, Chinese power grid has a richer set of predicted faults and a more complete fault defense strategy. This article focuses on the Brazilian power grid. Firstly, the similarities and differences between the Brazilian power grid and the Chinese power grid in terms of grid structure, power supply composition, stability characteristics, and control strategy are studied. Then, combined with the requirement of the Brazilian power grid, some excellent experiences of the Chinese power grid are summarized. Point out the weakness part in Brazilian power system security and stability guidelines, which will give reference to Brazilian power grid. At last, some preliminary suggestions on the safety and stability analysis and control of the Brazilian power grid are put forward in the paper.

articleTitle: Research and Characteristic Analysis of Flame Retardant Test Methods for Solid Insulation Materials of Converter Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to quantify grade and evaluate the flame retardant performance of solid insulating materials for converter transformers effectively, a 50W flame test method is proposed to test insulating paperboard, epoxy resin, glass fiber reinforced plastics. The test results show that the materials have the highest HB (horizontal burning) rating in the horizontal combustion test, while they are basically unable to be rated in the horizontal combustion test. The research results have important engineering reference value for the selection of insulation materials for converter transformers.

articleTitle: The Modified Thermal Circuit Model for Three-phase Unbalanced Operation of Distribution Transformers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Distribution transformers (DT) are the core equipment of distribution power network. During the operation of DT, the internal temperature distribution is not uniform. Hotspot temperature is the most representative parameter. It can reflect the temperature change and insulation aging rate of the DT to guide the actual operation. The hot-spot temperature can be calculated by building the thermal circuit model of transformers. Both the IEEE and IEC standards provide methods for building the thermal circuit model based on the top oil temperature rise and the bottom oil temperature rise. These thermal circuit models are all single-phase model. They assumed that there is no heat exchange for each phase of transformers when the three-phase load are same. However, these models are not applicable to the three-phase unbalanced transformers. The three-phase unbalanced operation of DT is unavoidable in practice. In order to solve this problem, a modified three-phase thermal circuit model for DT was proposed in this paper. It considered the influence of the three-phase unbalanced operation. It modified the traditional thermal circuit model which is based on the top oil temperature rise. The modified model was compared with the standard models through the actual examples. The results showed that the modified model proposed in this paper can reflect the hot-spot temperature of each phase for DT. Compared with the traditional thermal circuit models, the modified model considered the effect of three-phase unbalanced operation. It can accurately calculate the hot-spot temperature of the DT in theory.

articleTitle: Thermoelectric Coupling Characteristics of 1100kV GIS/GIL Basin Insulators Under AC and DC Voltage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The basin insulator is key element of gas-insulated metal-enclosed switchgear (GIS) and transmission lines (GIL), the material properties and geometry directly affects the electric field distribution in the apparatus, further affecting its insulating properties. The insulator in operation is affected by the heating of the conductor and the external environment, and has a large temperature gradient. The dielectric constant and conductivity of the insulating material are different at different temperatures, which affects the electric field distribution. In this paper, the dielectric constant and electrical conductivity of insulating materials are measured as a function of temperature, and the factors such as the transport and diffusion of charged particles in the gas space under DC voltage and the accumulation of surface charges on insulators are considered. A temperature-coupled AC / DC electric field simulation model was established to analyze the distribution characteristics of the electric field of the basin insulator under extreme temperature conditions. This study provides a theoretical basis for the optimization and design of the insulation characteristics of GIS / GIL equipment.

articleTitle: Protection Scheme for Collector Lines Based on the Current Amplitude Ratio with Spectrum Index
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Considering the various low voltage ride-through (LVRT) strategies of the doubly fed induction generator (DFIG), the fault currents supplied by each collector line equipped with DFIGs are complicated and changeable. As a result, there is a maloperation risk for the conventional overcurrent protection that is generally employed for the collector line. To address this issue, this paper proposes an improved protection scheme for the collector line based on the current amplitude ratio criterion with spectrum index. The main idea of the proposed protection scheme is using the amplitude difference features of the sequence current to differentiate the fault and healthy collector line. Besides, the proposed protection scheme also introduces the spectrum index to further revise the operation threshold of the amplitude criterion. The simulation results show that combined with the conventional overcurrent protection, the proposed protection scheme can accurately identify the fault line on the one hand and with the high reliability and sensitivity on the other hand.

articleTitle: Spatial Correlation Based Short-term Wind Speed Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The accuracy of wind speed prediction restricts the integration of wind power. However, it's difficult to make a precise prediction for the randomness and nonlinearity of wind speed series. In this paper, a novel hybrid model for wind speed forecasting considering spatial correlation correction is illustrated. Firstly, the various meteorological data are clustered preliminarily by the self-organizing feature map (SOM). Then, the Elman radial neural network (ERNN) is applied to mine the internal relationship between wind speed and meteorological data. Subsequently, a spatial correlation correction model is established to revise the errors caused by the peak value of wind speed. Finally, the proposed model is applied to a wind speed prediction case in Zhejiang, China. The result indicates that the proposed model has a better performance compared with the traditional one like BP Neural Network.

articleTitle: Feasibility Analysis of Single-end Equivalent Modeling to LCC-HVDC Transimission System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The commutation failures seriously threaten the safe operation of hybrid AC/DC grid. Considering that commutation failure occurs only on the inverter side, it is very important to study the voltage controlled current source model of LCC HVDC single terminal measurement information with high equivalent accuracy, which is very important for the practicality of real-time electromagnetic transient simulation of LCC HVDC dynamic phasor model. In order to this problem, this paper further discusses the single terminal equivalent model of LCC HVDC system which does not depend on the measurement information of DC sending end AC system, and explores the estimation method of single terminal fast transient response of complex AC/DC coupling faults induced by AC side fault of LCC HVDC inverter station and participation of DC control separation. The error distribution of single terminal equivalent calculation is quantitatively analyzed to lay a foundation for the follow-up protection and control technology research.

articleTitle: A Fast Calculation Method Supporting Price Arbitrage for Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As one kind of energy storage (ES) applications, ES can respond to electricity prices and help electricity users obtain economic benefits. In detail, by storing electricity during low price period and releasing power energy during high price period, ES can obtain price arbitrage or lower the energy cost for power consumers. However, among the existing ES arbitrage methods, most of them should build sophisticated modeling considering the power prices and several other ES constraints, including battery charge and discharge constraints, State-of-charge (SOC) constraints, state changes constraints, etc. The calculation is comparatively complicated and needs to be solved rely on some intelligent algorithms or professional computing tools. In this work, a fast calculation method supporting arbitrage under Time-of-Use (TOU) price for ES is proposed. The electricity price signal and ES operation factors are comprehensively considered, with a heuristic and adaptive principle suitable for ES response under electricity prices proposed. A simulation case towards an ES station considering a regional power grid is performed, presenting the proposed approach can help ES determine the optimal charging/discharging scheduling options. The calculation method needs very few computational efforts and is easy to be implemented, thus offering an effective means for ES to obtain price arbitrage.

articleTitle: Research on Coordination between Single Phase-to-Ground Fault Protection Equipment and Distribution Terminal Unit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To deal with the single phase-to-ground fault quickly in neutral point non-effectively grounded system, a dynamic weighted line selection and automatic sequential isolation protection scheme is designed. At present, the single phase-to-ground fault protection equipment based on the scheme has been widely used in China Southern Grid (CSG) and has achieved very good performance. The application related to the distribution terminal unit is more and more popular because of its good fault isolation by section. The coordination between the single phase-to-ground fault protection equipment and the distribution terminal unit is very important. If the coordination becomes weaker, more trips, which may emerge, cause lower reliability of power supply and breaker close and open alternately. To address the problems, this paper mainly analyzes the typical distribution terminal unit including zero sequence voltage blocking and zero sequence voltage tripping. Furthermore, this paper makes a full risk assessment on the coordination between the single phase-to-ground fault protection equipment and the typical distribution terminal unit combined with 180 typical application scenarios. Considered that a lot of analysis and demonstration, the coordination capabilities of the single phase-to-ground protection equipment and the distribution terminal unit can be effectively improved by optimizing the post-acceleration logic functions. Accordingly, the breaker close and open alternately can be avoid greatly.

articleTitle: Generation Plan Liberalization Scheme: A Method Based on Multi-objective and MPEC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Planned electricity (as opposed to market electricity) plays an important role in China’s electricity market reform process. This article provides a multi-objective and mathematical programs with equilibrium constraints (MPEC) based method for power generation plan liberalization from power grid company’s perspective. As a decision maker, power grid companies pursue their own profit maximization and consider the market survival of high-cost units. The weighted method is used to transform the multi-objective to a single objective. The proposed method combines power grid company decision and power market clearing together, through the bilevel optimization approach to make the liberalization scheme can satisfy the power grid companies own profit maximization as well as the market existence problem of high-cost units. An illustration case is designed to show how the method works. At the same time, different parameters also be simulated. Case study shows that the proposed method can help power grid companies to make the decision of power generation liberalization scheme according to its preference. At last, the conclusion of the example analysis and the prospect of the future research are given.

articleTitle: A Random Matrix Theory Based Systematic Condition Assessment Method for Integrated Highpower PEMFC System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The configuration of integrated high-power proton exchange membrane fuel cell (PEMFC) systems is such complex that it is still a promising challenge for the systematic condition assessment. In this paper, a random matrix theory based systematic condition assessment method is proposed for integrated high-power PEMFC systems. By using cluster transformation, the random characteristics of measured signals can be enhanced to formulate the streaming random matrices. On this basis, high-dimensional eigenvalue analysis for random covariance matrices can be conducted with recursive eigenpairs' updating. Finally, a mean function radius-based statistical indicator is proposed to achieve systematic condition assessment. The experiment results with real duty cycle demonstrate that, the derived systematic condition awareness indicator is more sensitive to system anomaly than traditional threshold-based condition assessment method, and the system operation condition evaluation can be more effective with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Cyber Security Risk Identification in Power Internet of Things System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For Energy Internet, Ubiquitous Power Internet of Things (UPIoT) not only promotes its digital and intelligent level, but also brings uncertain social factors, which provides a new environment for its cyber risk brewing and diffusion. Correctly, understanding and evaluating the cyber security risk of UPIoT is an important guarantee for Energy Internet Construction. A method to evaluate and quantize cybersecurity risk of UPIoT is proposed to determine the potential risk. Using AHP algorithm and security state to quantify the risk of network unit, the cyber security risk assessment of network is evaluated combined with the network unit importance. Experimental results show that this method can not only reflect the security status of network unit, but also identify the key risks in the network.

articleTitle: A Distributed Coordination Scheme for Periodic Loads for Demand Side Management
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Demand side management (DSM) is a means to improve the energy efficiency and reduce the greenhouse gas emission, the consumers' cost and the power grid investments. Due to the energy shortage and environmental problems, DSM has received more attention in recent decades. In this paper, a micro grid consisted of 100 fridges is constructed to simulate the approach of DSM. The thermodynamic model of refrigeration system is simulated. A cooperative scheduler is designed, implemented and programmed to execute the load switching based on the power curves. Results are analyzed and discussed based on the overall power consumption, average power and temperature.

articleTitle: The Research and Engineering Practice on the Protection and Control Method of the DG System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to promote the practice on the DG (distributed generation) technology, this paper introduces the theory research and engineering practice on the protection and control method of the DG system, based on an IDC DG engineering. The basic information and the characteristic of the engineering is described. The general control target and the operation mode under different condition is analyzed, considering the operative characteristics and the requirements of the power substation, the DG and the customer. The coordination scheme between the power grid, the DG and the load is proposed innovatively. The priority and the logical sequence of the control from different part are determined. The practical experiment proves that the protection and control system can provide reliable and efficient power and refrigeration supply for the IDC data central via the coordinated control method of the operation mode shift, SPAS (spare power automatic switchover), load transferring and the black-start, with the coordination of the power grid, the DG and the load. Under the extreme case that the outside power is totally lost, the power and refrigeration supply can be recovered within 155 seconds.

articleTitle: Research on Differential Distribution Price of Incremental Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the results of my country's transmission and distribution price verification are not reasonable enough to achieve differentiated electricity prices for users with different load characteristics, an incremental distribution network differential distribution price model is proposed. The model divides the distribution price into two parts: the basic distribution price and the additional distribution price. The basic distribution price is verified according to the principle of “permissible cost plus reasonable benefit”, based on the project's life cycle cost and the benchmark benefit; the additional distribution price is verified according to the difference of load characteristics of different users, the model is solved by using the life cycle cost theory and the comprehensive weight calculation method. Finally, the validity of the model is verified by a case study.

articleTitle: A Multi-functional Converter Electrical Tests System Scheme and Research in Its Digital Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As the increasingly prominent environmental problems caused by energy development and the urgent need for high-quality power supply, renewable energy and DC distribution network technologies have been rapidly developed. A large number of applications of converter products will inevitably become a development trend. The test technology of converters should also receive more attention. This paper designs a scheme of multi-functional converter electrical tests system based on full/half bridge hybrid MMC technology, and verifies the feasibility of its function based on digital simulation. It can conveniently meet the electrical test requirements of DC/DC converters, DC/AC and AC/DC converters (single-phase and three-phase). And based on its own characteristics, it can meet the test requirements of unidirectional converter and bidirectional converter.

articleTitle: Optimized Model of an Inset-Permanent Magnet Machine with Low-Cost Ferrite Magnet to Acquire Improve Electro-mechanical Performances
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper offers an optimized design of the Inset-Permanent Magnet Machine (Inset-PMSM) using a low-cost ferrite magnet to get reduced cogging torque and improved efficiency. To maximize the efficiency and to reduce the torque ripple, this study includes four different types of Inset-PMSM that are chosen according to their length of air-gap (i.e., 0.35mm and 0.70mm) and thickness of permanent magnets (i.e., 4mm and 6mm) embedded in the rotor. Electromechanical performances were calculated with MATLAB and Finite Element Analysis software (FEMM 4.2). Based on the results from MATLAB and FEM analysis, finally, an optimized designed model is proposed.

articleTitle: Two-level Correction Method of Load Parameters Based on an Aggregation-identification Structure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of the existing parameter identification algorithms in precision and time, a two-level correction method of load parameters based on an aggregation-identification structure is proposed. Firstly, according to the historical statistical data of the load group, an equivalent aggregation model is established by the weighted aggregation algorithm which takes into account the load rate and critical slip of induction motors. Then, based on the parameter trajectory sensitivity analysis, with the parameter values of the aggregation model as the initial values, particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to identify the dominant parameters to establish a synthesis load model and calculate the root mean square error between the measurement data and system response. Finally, the improved EPRI-36 node system is built by the power system analysis and synthesis program for system simulation, and the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method is verified.

articleTitle: Research on Active Current Suppression Control Strategy of Photovoltaic Generation System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the proportion of DC-connected photovoltaic (PV) power supply to the power supply capacity of the grid is increasing, its impact on the grid is also gradually increasing. In this paper, inter-pole short circuit fault and pole-to-ground short circuit fault of the PV generation system in the micro-grid are studied. Firstly, the inter-pole and monopolar short circuit fault characteristics in the DC micro-grid are analyzed. Secondly, the fault state detection method is improved by combining the fault characteristics. It is proposed to control the power electronic element IGBT in the converter to keep it on during faults, so as to shunt the current provided by PV cell, and finally achieve the purpose of suppressor the fault current. The proposed scheme is verified, and the simulation results prove that the control strategy can effectively suppress the fault current of the PV generation system.

articleTitle: Power Optimization Method for Interactive Operation of Integrated Energy Distribution System and Superior Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Integrated energy distribution system (IEDS) plays an important role in improving energy utilization efficiency, promoting efficient utilization of renewable energy, and enhancing system reliability. IEDS can respond to the instructions of the superior power grid and realize the effective cooperation with the superior power grid. The interactive power optimization with the superior power grid is conducive to the stable operation of the superior power grid, and reflects the flexible characteristics of energy coupling. Firstly, a distribution system model considering system power flow constraints, node voltage constraints and branch current constraints, a gas distribution system model considering gas flow constraints, gas pressure constraints and pipeline flow constraints, and an energy station model considering energy flow constraints and equipment output constraints are established. Then, this paper introduces the optimization method of interactive power between IEDS and the superior power grid. This method takes the minimum deviation between the set value and the actual value of interactive power between IEDS and superior power grid as the optimization objective, and considers the operation and security constraints of IEDS, and uses YALMIP toolbox to solve the problem. Finally, the results of the upper and lower limits of interactive power, power of energy station equipment and interactive optimization are analyzed through an example. The results show that this method can better respond to the superior power grid instructions, so as to further guarantee the safe and stable operation of the superior power grid.

articleTitle: Decentralized Optimal Gas-Power Flow Calculation via Modified Generalized Benders Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The increasing coupling between the power system and the natural gas system raises the necessity of joint dispatch of two systems. This paper proposes a modified generalized Benders decomposition (GBD) method to solve the optimal gas-power flow (OGPF) problem without privacy reveal for the operators of the two systems. Compared with the conventional GBD method, it has sharply faster convergence speed by modifying the generating strategies of optimal cuts and feasible cuts. Compared with the widely used alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM), it avoids issues of parameter-sensitivity and oscillation. Numerical tests of two cases indicate that the proposed modified GBD method calculates the OGPF in a decentralized manner effectively and outperforms other baseline methods in terms of convergence and efficiency.

articleTitle: Research and Demonstration of Planning and Decision-making Tools Based on Power Grid Full -Cost Chain
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is urgent to change the development mode of power grid enterprises, comply with the development trend of the new round of power system reform, and plan ahead to carry out research on new models, new models and new methods of investment planning decisions in the market environment, and promote the improvement of transmission and distribution network planning. Scientific and effective, comprehensively improve the level of optimal allocation of power resources. First of all, this paper studies the calculation method of full-cost chain and full-cost node electricity price. Then, the functional module of planning decision tool based on the full cost chain of the power grid is proposed. Finally, the selected project is determined based on the sensitivity of the investment ceiling.

articleTitle: Compressed Sampling and Reconstruction Method of Transient Power Quality Signal
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of Compressed Sensing theory in power quality is mainly focused on steady-state signals. For transient power quality signals, the application is limited due to low compression ratio and large error. In this paper, an Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD) combined with Compressed Sensing is proposed to compress and reconstruct transient power quality signals. First, the original signal is decomposed into a series of Intrinsic Mode Functions to realize the stabilization of transient disturbance using the advantage of EMD to process non-stationary signals. Then, the Compressed Sensing theory is applied to sparse representation and coding measurement of each component, so as to reduce the amount of sampling points and realize the compression of signal. Finally, the OMP algorithm is used to reconstruct the signal with high precision and complete the decompression. Five common transient power quality signals, such as voltage spike, swell, sag, interrupt and transient pulse, are simulated and calculated. The results show that the EMD-OMP algorithm has better compression performance than using OMP algorithm alone, which can reduce the reconstruction error and significantly improve the compression ratio of transient power quality signals.

articleTitle: Multi-Energy System Planning for Low-Carbon Park Considering Supply and Demand Interaction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of coordinated planning for distributed generation penetrating to the distribution network and demand side response in a multi-energy system, the paper establishes a bi-layer planning model considering the supply and demand interaction. The lower layer minimizes the active power loss of the multi-energy system as objective function, and the upper layer minimizes the active power loss of the thermal energy network in each period as objective function. Using k-means to extract a set of typical operating scenarios to deal with uncertainty. Finally, the influence of supply-demand interaction on the planning scheme is analyzed by a typical multienergy system. The results show that the model can effectively optimize DG capacity and reduce energy consumption, which achieve economic and environmental protection operation.

articleTitle: A Data-Driven Approach for Fast Reliability Calculation Under a Given Investment Strategy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It's critical to guarantee the reliability of distribution networks in the system planning and operations for development and improvements of distribution networks. In this paper, a data-driven based method is proposed for a Distribution Network Company to calculate the reliability metrics under a given investment strategy quickly. In other words, the better investment strategy can be quickly pointed out among a list of strategies. Firstly, an OpenDSS-MATLAB environment platform, which can be used to simulate realistic and detailed distribution network model, is built. Then, Latin hypercube sampling was used to generate a list of investment strategies and the platform was adopted to obtain their reliability metrics. Next, Back-propagation (BP) neural network is used to obtain a relationship between investment plans and reliability metrics. Finally, in the case study, a modified IEEE 13-bus system is used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Discharge Monitoring System of Parallel Gap Device Based on LoRa Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In view of the fact that the current online monitoring device for lightning arresters cannot effectively monitor and judge the shortcomings of subsequent power frequency current technologies and the influencing factors such as communication blind zone in special environments such as remote mountain areas, a parallel gap discharge monitoring system based on LoRa technology is proposed. The system is based on the MSP430 or STM32 microcontroller and it is made up of two types of sensor node devices (master node device and child node device) and background receiving and processing platform. The system deploys the corresponding sensor node devices on the spot to realize the monitoring and transmission of the sensor data. The mesh network topology is used to carry out the relay transmission of the monitoring data in the ad hoc network and upload it to the corresponding background for analysis and processing. The system provides the data for quickly finding out the position of the action pole and tower of the parallel clearance device and the time of flashover.
