articleTitle: Design and Application of Intelligent Sensing Terminal for Distribution Transformer
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, an intelligent sensing terminal for the distribution transformer is designed. The intelligent sensing terminal consists of the high-voltage sensing ontology and the edge computing terminal. The high-voltage sensing ontology is used for the voltage and current sensing measurement of the high voltage incoming line of distribution transformer. The edge computing terminal collects a variety of transformer (including the high-voltage sensing ontology) sensing information to the transformer loss calculation, fault detection and other edge computing based on the multi-information sensing. In this paper, the sensing principle of high-voltage sensing ontology is introduced in detail and the error principle of voltage sensing is analyzed. In addition, the accuracy of voltage and current sensing is tested, and several typical applications of using the sensing terminal are given. The sensing terminal is a typical device in the sensing layer of the Power Internet of Things, which is of great significance to achieve the safe, economic operation and efficient power consumption of distribution transformer.

articleTitle: Harmonic Management for Wind Power Plant Using Embedded Filter Control in Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a filter control system embedded in the control system of the wind turbine, which adopts the d-q transformation to detect harmonics, and then controls the output of the wind turbine to generate harmonic compensation signal to achieve the purpose of harmonic management of the wind power plant. Moreover, it is also proposed and proved that the detection of harmonics by d-q transformation will cause the problem of harmonic confusion and multiple embedded filter control systems will influence each other. Finally, this paper uses DIG-SILENT/PowerFactory to establish a wind power plant model with multiple wind turbines, simulating and verifying the above content.

articleTitle: Research on Interchangeability of Intelligent Electronic Device Based on Plug and Play in Intelligent Substations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The interchangeability of devices in intelligent substations is one of realization goals of the IEC 61850 standards. In this regard, this paper conducted research on interchangeability of intelligent electronic devices (IEDs) based on plug-and-play (PnP) in intelligent substations, and a method to realize the interchange of IEDs in intelligent substations is proposed. Firstly, we refer to Universal Plug-and-Play (UPnP) and IEC 61850 standards to implement the PnP of IEDs in the network, and realize PnP for IEDs in the system in combination with the management and control platform. Then, according to the actual operation and maintenance in intelligent substations, we divide the scenarios of IEDs' interchange into special scenario and general scenario from the perspective of system configuration. The research in this paper can provide technical guidance for advancing the implementation of IED interchangeability projects in intelligent substations.

articleTitle: Improved Magnetic Force Computation Method Using Parameterized Multi-layer Mesh Techniques
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To enhance the numerical accuracy of the magnetic force computed by finite element method (FEM) is highly useful in real-world applications. In this work, a force calculation method by introducing multiple mesh layers surrounding the force object, is further improved by adopting a parameterized mesh technique in order to generate better magnetic force results. The basic idea of the parameterized-multi-layer force calculation method is realized by taking the mean value of the force results, for each mesh layers and also for each layer thickness parameters, in order to make the force insensitive to the mesh and also accurate. For the object whose force is to be computed, by introducing parameterized layered objects around it, the additional overhead of preparing the meshes for different parameters is almost totally saved by using the parameterized mesh method. Numerical validations are presented to demonstrate the accuracy of this proposed method and the accuracy of this method is found to be improved to a great extent.

articleTitle: A New Backup Protection for Transmission Lines Based on Substation-area Current Information
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, when current transformer (TA) circuit of transmission line is broken, the method of blocking backup protection is usually adopted, which will cause short-circuit faults to be unable to be cleared in time. To solve the problem, a new transmission line backup protection based on substation-area current information is proposed in the paper. Based on the TA non-fault phase current information and substation-area current information, the breaking phase current of TA can be reconstructed by the new protection. By judging the reconstructed current and zero-sequence voltage of transmission line, it is determined whether the backup protection will be unblocked after TA circuit breaking. Finally, the effect of new protection is verified by simulation. The simulation results show that the impedance and zero-sequence current of transmission line can be calculated accurately by the new protection after TA circuit breaking, and ensures that short-circuit faults can be cleared timely and accurately by backup protection.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of Factors Affecting Photon Number of Ultraviolet Charge Detection in Power Equipment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the influence of various factors such as gain, observation distance and discharge voltage of UV detector, the number of photons measured by different instruments or the same instrument when discharging electrical equipment has different degrees. How do the various factors in UV charging detection? The in-depth analysis of the photon number measurement problem was carried out. The laboratory corona discharge test and OFIL’s SUPERB UV image detector were used to analyze the influence of the gain, observation distance and discharge voltage of the UV detector on the photon number measurement. The corresponding conclusions provide a reference for the actual measurement of the project.

articleTitle: Design and Control of Battery Energy Storage System Based on Cascaded Multilevel Converter with Reduced Low-Frequency Battery Current Ripple
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A novel battery energy storage system (BESS) topology is proposed in this paper which is based on the combination of cascade multilevel converter (CMC) and power switch multiplexing technique. The low-frequency ripple in battery current which is pulsating at twice the output frequency can be significantly reduced. While only four power switches are required in each submodule, and no extra power decoupling circuits are needed. This topology possesses the advantages of lower number of power switches, simpler circuit structure, and higher reliability. The circuit configuration and operation principle are analyzed. The individual phase current control (IPCC) is also presented which can make BESS adapted to unbalanced conditions automatically. Finally, simulation results performed in PSCAD/EMTDC can verify the circuit performance and control strategy.

articleTitle: Integrated Planning of Urban Electricity and Gas Distribution Systems Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, we developed an optimal planning model for an integrated urban energy system in order to explore the potential for integrated operation between different energy forms. Both the respective modes of operation of the grid and the natural gas network are considered, as well as the application of coupling units and demand response. Nonlinearities in the operation of the energy network are handled by the piecewise linearization methods. Therefore, a mixed-integer linear planning (MILP) model is developed that can be efficiently solved by existing solvers. A case study of 26 electric nodes and 20 gas node systems is conducted to validate the effectiveness of the method. The case results show that the integrated demand response can reduce system cost and improve the load curve.

articleTitle: Power Grid Fault Diagnosis Based on Immune RBF Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Radial basis function (RBF) has achieved good application in power grid fault diagnosis because of its uncomplicated network structure, strong self-learning ability and good generalization ability. The selection of RBF center point is always one of the main problems of RBF neural network algorithm. The existing selection methods of RBF center point are mainly based on K-means algorithm, but K-means clustering suffers from the low performance due to the low accurate initial value. In order to get the RBF neural network with better diagnosis effect, immune algorithm is used to calculate RBF center point, and then immune RBF neural network is obtained and used in power grid fault diagnosis. The numerical results verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed algorithm for diagnosing the fault location of power grid.

articleTitle: Practices and Suggestions on the Construction of Port Shore Power in the Context of “Protection of the Yangtze River”
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The construction of shore power in the ports of the Yangtze River Basin is an important measure to implement General Secretary Xi Jinping’s concept of “protection of the Yangtze River”. State Grid Hubei Electric Power Co., Ltd. has finished five shore power pilot projects in the Three Gorges Dam area, and established the first professional shore power operation service company in China. This paper expounds the systematic practices of the construction, promotion and operation of shore power in the ports of Three Gorges Dam area of the Yangtze River Basin from two dimensions, namely, building a promotion platform for shore power construction and constructing an ecological circle for shore power operation and use, and puts forward countermeasures and suggestions for further promotion and use.

articleTitle: Effect of O2 on The AC Breakdown Characteristics Of C5F10O/CO2
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: $C_{5}F_{10}O$ has received attention from domestic and foreign researchers due to its excellent insulation properties and very low global warming potential (GWP). There are few studies on the influence of O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> on the insulation and decomposition properties of $C_{5}F_{10}O/CO_{2}$ ternary gas mixtures. In this paper, the impact of oxygen on the breakdown and self-recovery properties of the gas mixture was analyzed by the breakdown test of $C_{5}F_{10}O/CO_{2}$ with a high frequency breakdown test platform. Secondly, gas chromate-graphy-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) was used to analyze the gas components in the gas chamber before and after the breakdown test, the addition of O2 did not affect the type of decomposition products, but with the addition of oxygen, the concentration of decomposition products increased in different degrees, among which the small molecule fluoride, such as $CF_{4},C_{2}F_{6}$, the most obvious increase in concentration, indicating that the addition of O2 will promote the decom-position of $C_{5}F_{10}O/CO_{2}$, should be increased in the decom-position of $C_{5}F_{10}O/CO_{2}$. The oxygen content in $C_{5}F_{10}O/CO_{2}/-O_{2}$ is properly controlled while the insulation properties of the gas mixture are maintained.

articleTitle: Anomoly Detection for PLC Based on Magnetic Side Channel
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Programmable logic controller (PLC) is one of the critical infrastructure in industrial control system, which is therefore vulnerable to a variety of cyber-attacks. To mitigate this issue, we design an anomaly detection system, a novel non-invasive intrusion detection method for PLC. Our system utilizes the magnetic side-channel information around the power supply module of PLC and analyzes the running status rely on the fact that different programs will result in various magnetic characteristic. We design a classification algorithm which can extract representational features from the raw signal, as well as avoid the interference of environmental noise. To validate the idea, we design 3 types of attacks and implement on the prototype of thermal power plant in laboratory. The evaluation shows our system is feasible to detect attacks and achieve an overall detection accuracy above 90%.

articleTitle: Safety Assessment of Charging Stations Connected to the Power Grid Considering Distribution Network Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The problem of harmonics and voltage fluctuations in the distribution network leads to prominent safety problems during the operation of the charging station. Aiming at this problem, a Norton equivalent circuit of the DC charger of the charging station is constructed, and the constraints of the charging station's access to the power grid under the background of grid harmonics are analyzed; From the flow calculation, the constraints of charging stations connected to the grid under the background of grid voltage fluctuations are analyzed; Considering the constraints of voltage and current and the constraints analyzed above, a safety evaluation index system for charging stations connected to the power grid was constructed, and a gram correlation method was used to analyze the calculation examples of charging stations connected to the power grid. The results show that the method can improve the rationality of the planning and operation of the charging station, effectively avoid the safety risks of the charging station operation.

articleTitle: Energy Demand Forecasting for an Office Building Based on Random Forests
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A random forest (RF) is a classifier consisting of an ensemble of decision trees and has already been demonstrated to have effective predictive classification capabilities in many fields. Currently, however, few scholars have considered using RFs to forecast the energy consumption of buildings without historical load data. In this paper, RFs were applied to forecast the energy demand of an office building in Shanghai. A predictive model was obtained by training on 30 office buildings that were also located in Shanghai. Then, the trained predictive model was used to forecast the energy demand of an unknown building. The results demonstrated the feasibility of using RFs to forecast the energy demand of unknown office buildings.

articleTitle: Optimal Dispatching of Regional Integrated Energy System Based on SMPC
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Along with the rapid development of energy internet, a regional integrated energy system consisting of wind turbine, photovoltaic, combined heat and power system, electric boiler, electrical energy storage and heat energy storage is widely used around the world. In order to deal with the uncertainty of renewable energy output and load demand, an optimal dispatching method of regional integrated energy system based on stochastic model predictive control (SMPC) is proposed in this paper. First, the uncertainty of renewable energy output and load demand at each time section is described with typical scenario sets via scenario analysis. Then, the minimum operating cost is taken as objective to establish the dynamic rolling optimal dispatching model of regional integrated energy system. The validity and feasibility of the method proposed in this paper are verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of Mechanical Stress & Thermal Stress Test of 550kV High Coupled Split Reactor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on the modeling of the structural parameters of the 550kV high coupled split reactor, the electromagnetic coupling method are used to establish the 3D mechanical stress and thermal stress calculation model of the high coupled split reactor, and the mechanical stress and thermal stress distribution characteristics of the overall and encapsulation of the high coupled split reactors are studied. The simulation results of this paper show that: the direction of the electric power in the single arm current limiting is mainly distributed axially symmetrically outward, and symmetrically about the middle of the vertical height, the radial force from the inside to outer encapsulation is gradually reduced, and the outermost side has a weaker contrat tendency. In general, each encapsulation has an outward expansion tendency. At the same time, the temperature distribution of the high coupled split reactor shows that the upper region is higher than the lower region, and the intermediate encapsulation is higher than the encapsulation trend of the two sides. The highest hot spot temperature is 10-cated in the upper region of the middle of the high coupled split reactor. The research results provide a theoretical basis for the design and optimization of the 550kV high coupled split reactor test scheme.

articleTitle: LSTM Based Quantile Regression Method for Holiday Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Holiday load forecasting is a tough part of load forecasting, since it's related to complicated factors, including holiday policy and custom activities. Typical short-term prediction methods can't achieve satisfactory results due to lack of historical data and flexible holiday arrangements. This study proposes a LSTM based quantile regression method for holiday load forecasting. The holidays are classified into three groups according to their day-to-day variation characteristic and different similar day selection scheme is presented for each group. Based on “the closer the larger” principle, Quantile Regression is applied to combine LSTM networks with different time correlations. Adam stochastic gradient descent method is also introduced to optimize the parameters of the LSTM networks under different quantile conditions. Analysis of practical systems shows that the proposed method can cover the actual value more accurately and has certain reference value in engineering application.

articleTitle: Edge-Cloud Collaboration Architecture of Virtual Power Plant for Large-scale EV Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Today, the energy structure is accelerating to adjust, so that countries all over the world are committed to the efficient development of renewable energy. However, renewable energy will pose a serious challenge to the power grid's acceptance and peak regulation. In this case, virtual power plant is a practical and effective technical means with great potential and optimistic prospect. The main task of virtual power plant is to deal with massive distributed resources. In order to improve efficiency and ensure the safe and stable operation of power system, it is necessary to rationally allocate distributed resources within the virtual power plant, so as to give play to the value of resources and reduce the waste of resources. These are the technical difficulties faced by the internal scheduling of virtual power plants.This article has carried on the studies of edge-cloud collaboration system. Starting from the structure and function of the virtual power plant, it analyzes the scheduling and control of the virtual power plant's internal distributed power generation resources, and integrates edge computing and cloud computing. A system integrating edge-cloud collaboration and VPP is proposed. The edge layer makes real-time processing computing, controlling the charging and discharging management and the safe operation of EV. The cloud layer disperses key non-real-time information to each cloud server, reduces data transmission distance and data errors during transmission, and improves data access speed. Based on the above background, this paper studies the architecture of the new generation virtual power plant.

articleTitle: Design Parameters and Application of a 160kV Mechanical HVDC Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Nan'ao Multi-Terminal Flexible HVDC demonstration project is the world's first multi-terminal flexible HVDC system. The fault current interruption of the DC system is more difficult than that of the AC system. Therefore, to design a reliable DC circuit breaker is one of the key issue of improving the stability and reliability of the DC system power supply. In this study, the principle, application and design parameters of a 160kV mechanical DC circuit breaker in the Nan'ao project was introduced.

articleTitle: Effect of Synchronous Compensator in Leading-Phase Operation on Transient and Steady State of the Hunan Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: There are two synchronous compensators (SCs) with the capacity of 300 MW in Hunan network. At present, a SC is normally controlled within ± 50 Mvar and the other one operates in spare. There are rarely participates in regional voltage control. However, the problem of high voltage occurs frequently in the central Hunan during low load periods. Under the voltage safety premise of the most serious three phase fault, the SC participating in the regional voltage control method will improve the grid operating characteristics, and improve the safety and economics of the grid operation. In addition, this paper analyzes the relationship between the SC output reactive power and the number of thermal powers must on and its rotation reserve. By replacing the thermal power units and its rotation reserve which are the requirements for system stable operation, the SC in leading-phase operation can therefore improve the operation flexibility of power grid, increase the maximum transmission power of DC and the power supply capacity of Hunan power grid.

articleTitle: Analysis about Potential Distribution of the Ur 780kV Metal-oxide Surge Arrester for 1000kV Substation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Decrease the rated voltage of the arrester can optimize insulation coordination, and reduce 1000kV substation over-voltage level or lower insulation level of equipments, which can improve the economy of project. But lower rated voltage on behalf of the higher chargeability on internal resistance of the arrester, which will affect the MOA potential distribution. In order to study the potential distribution characteristics of the lower rated voltage MOA on 1000kV substation, using the software Ansys with finite element method to build 3-D model of Y20W - 780/1526 type arrester. Analysis and calculated the potential distribution of the arrester on five different kinds of grading shunt capacitors configuration scheme, selecting the optimal configuration scheme to test. The curve of potential distribution shows that the simulation results and the test results are basic consistent, the maximum relative deviation is 7.32%. This paper verified the potential distribution non-uniform coefficient of the rated voltage decreased surge arrester which used at 1000kV substation can match the engineering specification requirement, less than 1.15, by rational allocation of the grading shunt capacitors under the equalizing ring, flange and coat condition such as size structure unchanged. The research results can provide reference for the design of rated voltage decrease for UHV surge arresters.

articleTitle: Principle and Design Parameters of a ±160kV Resistive DC Superconducting Current Limiter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: All the time the DC transmission system is faced with the problem of difficulty in interruption the fault current. DC superconducting fault current limiter (SFCL) technology is one of the promising means to solve this problem. In the study, the principle and characteristics of DC SFCL is introduced. Then the key issues in development and the desired economic benefits are summarized. At last, the main paramete is of the current limiter are introduced with a ± 160kV prototype as an example, the main components including superconducting current limiting unit, cryogenic container, high voltage outlet unit and refrigeration system are illustrated, which can be used as a reference for technicians.

articleTitle: Research on Reactive Power Coordinated Control Strategy of Doubly-Fed Wind Farm Considering STATCOM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The stability problem caused by the integration of wind farms into the power grid is becoming more and more serious. Reactive power shortage is an important reason for this problem. However, simply using reactive power compensation equipment will greatly increase the investment cost of wind farms. In view of the above problems, this paper puts forward the principle that the wind farm's own reactive power source is the first choice and the external reactive power source is the supplement, and the corresponding coordination is proposed for the two reactive power sources of the double-fed wind turbine grid-side converter and the reactive power compensation device STATCOM Control strategy, and a 3machine 9-node system including doubly-fed wind farm and STATCOM was built in the software DIgSILENT/Power Factory, and two typical fault types were set up. The simulation results show that, compared with the traditional wind farm constant power factor control In contrast, the proposed coordinated control model can ensure sufficient reactive power support in certain emergencies, which plays a very good role in supporting the transient voltage stability of the wind power access system and reduces the installed capacity of STATCOM, Which saves the investment cost of wind farms, and also verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the reactive power coordinated control model.

articleTitle: Data Interactive Access Gateway for Internal and External Networks in Dual Network Isolation Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper designs and provides an internal and external network data interactive access gateway for dual-network isolation architecture. Based on asynchronous communication and advanced queue technology, the external mobile applications can efficiently access the intranet business service data by transforming and reconstructing the transmission content of the entire internal and external network interaction link. It can not only reuse the existing intranet service data, but also ensure data security and reduce the difficulty of development and deployment. The response time is shortened by request concurrent monitoring and advanced queue technology, which can meet the control requirements of the production environment for response time and server pressure during high concurrency. The interaction of TCP long connections between internal and external networks is realized through the sorting and assembly of data packets and the one-to-one matching of internal and external network sessions. At the same time, it also provides security control functions such as service registration and identity authentication to ensure the safety and credibility of the transmitted data.

Author Keywords: internal and external network data interaction

articleTitle: Optimized Tie-line Planning of Distribution Networks with Explicit Reliability Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: To enhance the reliability of power supply, mesh-designed distribution network configurations now become common in urban area. A mesh-constructed network structure is composed of excessive tie-lines which serve as backups for rerouting power once a failure occurs in the main branches. Compared with radial-constructed networks, it performs better and has higher reliability of power supply. By implementing distribution expansion planning, tie-lines are going to be built for radial networks to improve the connection and coordination between feeders. However, existing planning approaches for tie-lines often use metaheuristics to implement the actions of post-fault network reconfiguration or perform posterior Monte Carlo simulations to assess the reliability of planned networks, which is time consuming and suboptimal. In this paper, a reliability-constrained planning model for tie-lines in distribution networks is proposed based on an analytical reliability assessment model, where post-fault network reconfiguration strategies are implemented to explicitly count the reliability indices. Moreover, the proposed model can also consider different reliability requirements for different load nodes. The planning model is formulated as an MILP problem and can be solved by commercial solvers. A 54-node system is utilized to test the performance of proposed model. Simulation results show that the equipment of tie-lines in distribution networks can evidently reduce the systematic average interruption duration and enhance the reliability of the distribution systems.

articleTitle: Measurement Technology of Ground Parameters Based on Tap Adjustment of Grounding Transformer Winding for Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The measurement results of the traditional method of measuring the ground parameters of the distribution network have large errors, because the influence of the damping resistance and the short-circuit impedance of the voltage transformer cannot be eliminated during the measurement process. In addition, the traditional method of measuring ground parameters of the distribution network is greatly affected by the system grounding method, and different neutral point grounding methods are different. Based on this, an accurate measurement method of ground parameters that is not affected by the grounding method of the distribution network is proposed in this paper. The special $Y / \Delta$ wiring of external grounding transformer with winding tap in distribution networks is used and its winding tap is grounded to change the zero sequence voltage measured by the open delta voltage transformer for distribution networks. The zero sequence current of the feeder is measured by the zero sequence current transformer. The ground capacitance current and leakage resistance current of the system are calculated by the measured voltage and current. The proposed ground parameter measurement technology is simulated and analyzed in the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation environment. Simulation results prove that the proposed method has high measurement accuracy, where the parameter measurement process is safe, simple and economical.

articleTitle: The Research on Infrared Spectrum of C4F7N by Combined Experimental and Theoretical Study
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture is a new type of environmentally friendly insulating medium, which has the potential to replace SF<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sub> and has received extensive attention from researchers. The insulation performance of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture is closely related to the concentration of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N. Meanwhile, the gas-insulated electrical equipment with C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture has been gradually been put into practical application. Therefore, it is of great engineering significance to quickly and accurately measure the concentration of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N in the gas mixture. The gas quantitative detection based on spectroscopy has the advantages of fast detection speed, simple device and high reliability, which can meet the demand of gas detection technology in the power industry. However, as a new type of synthetic gas, it is currently unable to find the information of absorption spectrum of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N in the spectral database, so it is impossible to realize the concentration detection of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture based on spectroscopy. In this paper, the infrared spectrum of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N molecule is theoretically calculated by density functional theory, its molecular structure has been analyzed, and the spectral information of the infrared band is obtained. The accuracy of the calculation results is verified by experimental comparison. By analyzing the infrared absorption spectrum, the bands which are easy saturation or have large error in the detection of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture are excluded. The source band based on infrared spectroscopy for the detection was determined. This research provides a theoretical basis for the development of detection devices based on infrared spectroscopy for quantitative detection of C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sub>N/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> gas mixture.

articleTitle: Virtual Power Plant Trading Strategy Based on Block-chain to Satisfy Clean Energy Partiality
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Block-chain-based virtual power plant can realize the coordination and integration of distributed energy resources in accordance with peer-to-peer energy transactions. In particular, the smart contract function of the Block-chain can assist energy transactions in the virtual power plant and can enable the local network to meet the clean energy partiality. In order to achieve the above functions, firstly, a virtual power plant transaction model based on smart contracts was constructed, including energy index, energy transaction partiality, and physical constraints. Secondly, a pre-distributing strategy for energy transactions was proposed with smart contracts designed based on the Minimum Cost Programming, using the automatic settling function of smart contracts to omit energytrading transfer stations and to achieve weakly-centralized energy peer-to-peer transactions. Finally, a building virtual power plant was established as a transaction scenario with a typical distribution network topology. The simulation results illustrated that the strategy could satisfy the clean energy partiality of energy transactions to a certain extent, and it could realize weakly-centralized transactions by Block-chain.

articleTitle: Optimization of Maintenance Interval Based on Equal Deterioration Rate Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The task of electric power companies is to achieve their economic targets and social responsibilities. As one of the promising methods to make these targets come true, asset management is attracting more and more attention, and the life cycle cost management (LLCM) is an effective tool of asset evaluation. In order to optimize the electrical equipment life cycle, and aiming at some problems in the current equipment maintenance research, which includes ignoring the influence of maintenance on equipment failure rate, ignoring the trend of continued deterioration during the operation of equipment and so on, this paper introduces the deterioration theory in the field of mechanical engineering. This essence of this method can be regarded as searching the balance between the value of equipment themselves and the benefits brought by the power systems, between LCCM and equipment maintenance, and finally, between technologies and management of power system. Based on this method, this article deduces the relationship of the reliability of equipment in each maintenance circle, and constructs the maintenance strategy optimization model of equipment based on risk combined with the definition of risk and service age reduction factor. In the end, this paper employs the theory into a practical example and calculates the optimal maintenance interval, and finally compares it with traditional preventive maintenance.

articleTitle: Bi-level Collaborative Expansion Planning for Power Grid and Plants Considering Operational Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The penetration of large-scale renewable energy such as wind power requires increasing improvements of operational flexibility of power system to handle undesired uncertainties. However, operational flexibility enhancement should be located in a holistic framework including both generation and grid side. In this paper, the global operating margin containing reserve, ramping and transmission ability is used to describe operational flexibility facing the uncertainties. Based on this, a bi-level collaborative expansion planning model is proposed to provide the appropriate solution of generators retrofit and transmission lines enhancement. The upper model forms the network line extension decision considering investment constrains. The lower model calculates the site and capacity of thermal power units based on the new network from upper layer. KKT condition are used to transform the bi-level model into MILP problem. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed planning model are proved by the simulation of an actual power grid case.

articleTitle: Development of Operation Support Platform for Chongqing-Hubei Flexible HVDC Transmission Project
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The Chongqing-Hubei back-to-back flexible HVDC transmission project has operated for over one year. The importance of its operation, maintenance, system commissioning, and fault analysis are increasing continuously. It is necessary to build an operation support platform that support its routine works. In this paper, a real-time digital simulation operation support platform for this project is established based on RT-LAB. The simulation of some key commissioning tests and fault analysis in the Chongqing-Hubei project is simulated, and the simulation results are verified according to the comparison with the waveform recording of actual commissioning and fault. The platform can be used for operation, maintenance and commissioning planning, and also for studies on the control & protection principles, faults analysis of flexible DC transmission project.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Power Fluctuation Suppression Converter in Pulse Load Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fluctuation of the input power of the radar system has affected the stability of the power supply system. The load in the phased array radar is a typical pulse load with a certain pulse width. The long pulse width, which is more than 2 milliseconds will make the input power fluctuate from zero to full load. The Power Fluctuation Suppression Converter (PFSC) is introduced and the nonlinear controller is proposed to reduce the fluctuation of the input power. The stability of the PFSC, which is a nonlinear system, is proved by the Lyapunov Theory. The system is global asymptotically stable under the nonlinear controller. The minimal controller gain is derived according the output voltage under the normal power. The filter parameter is determined by the minimal frequency and the magnitude of the fundamental wave of the input current is analyzed with the proposed filter parameter. The relationship between the energy storage capacitor and the peak-to-peak value of the output voltage is presented. The minimum and the empirical value of the capacitor are shown by the analytical expression. The Peak-Peak to Average Power Ratio (PPAPR) index is defined to measure the fluctuation of the input power and the approximation of PPAPR is derived analytically. The main results are verified by an example. The achievements lay an important foundation for the power supply system design with the long pulse width pulse load in the modern large scale phased array radar.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control for Power Balance Based on Per-Unit Voltage for Multivoltage-Level DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Multivoltage-level DC microgrid (MLDG) is composed of several DC submicrogrids (SMGs) with different voltage levels. In order to avoid power surplus or deficit of a DC SMG caused by the change of renewable sources and loads and lack of power control among SMGs, it is vital to realize the coordination among DC SMGs. In this paper, a coordinated control method based on per-unit voltage for power balance in MLDG is proposed. In this method, the compensation value is calculated by per-unit bus voltages at secondary control level, and sent to the dual active bridge (DAB) converter control loop which connects different DC SMGs. Thus, the per-unit bus voltages of each SMG can be controlled to be equal, which contributes to the global power balance. Finally, the validity and effectiveness of proposed control method are verified in Matlab/Simulink.

articleTitle: Research on Load Modeling Considering Distributed Photovoltaic Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A comprehensive load model structure considering distributed photovoltaic generation is proposed in this paper. On the basis of this, an integrated load model parameter aggregation equivalence method considering distributed photovoltaic generation is proposed to accurately simulate the integrated load characteristics of distribution network with photovoltaic power generation. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed load modeling method with distributed photovoltaic power generation system.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Distribution Calculation of UHV Shunt Capacitor Unit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: High-voltage shunt capacitors play a very important role in power systems. With the continuous improvement of manufacturing technology, the electrical breakdown performance of foil-film capacitors has been greatly improved, while thermal aging is still one of the key factors that influences the life of foil-film capacitors. In this paper, the temperature distribution of the BAM7.88-668-1W capacitor unit for Ultra High Voltage engineering is calculated by numerical simulation method. The heating power of the capacitor is calculated and the boundary conditions are set under the ambient temperature of 55°C. The results show that the hottest spots of the capacitor core and shell both appear around the discharge resistors.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling of Natural Gas Pipeline Using Electric Circuit Equivalents
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, a method for modeling and simulation of pneumatic transients of natural gas pipelines is proposed. The partial differential equations (PDEs) that describe the dynamics of the gas pipeline are converted to the ordinary differential equations (ODEs) based on the difference approximation. Electrical analogies for pneumatic and thermal quantities are exploited, and the natural gas pipelines are modeled using basic electric circuit elements. The pipeline model can be simulated with any available power-system and circuit simulation tools. Detailed studies are performed to demonstrate the accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed equivalent circuit model.

articleTitle: Review and Prospect of Flexible Loads for Participating in Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The rapidly increasing renewable energy sources (RESs) in the power system bring a large number of disturbances due to the intermittent and random characteristics of power generation. At the same time, most of the RES units are composed of power electronic devices, which can reduce the system inertia and impact the stable operation of the power system. Therefore, more operating reserve resources are required to participate in the rapid regulation in the power system with a high proportion of RES. The rapid development of information and communication technologies make it easier and lower cost to control flexible loads. Based on the new network resources, for example, 5G, flexible loads can be regulated rapidly to participate in power system frequency control. In this paper, the models, categories, and functions of typical flexible loads are analyzed. Then, the research status of various flexible loads for participating in frequency regulation (FR) is combed in detail. On this basis, the advantages and disadvantages of various load control methods and their application scenarios are discussed. Finally, the development prospects of flexible loads for FR are proposed, so as to provide references for practical application.

articleTitle: Dynamic State Estimation for Power System Based on M-UKF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to reduce the influence of system time-varying noise on state estimation, an M estimation based Unscented Kalman Filter (M-UKF) is proposed, which combines the Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF) with the equivalent weight of M estimation. This method obtains the optimal estimation value of the state variable by introducing the M estimation weight in the UKF process, which improves the accuracy of the model and reduces the state estimation error. The simulation results of IEEE 30-node system verify the feasibility of the proposed method, M-UKF performs a better prediction in accuracy than the Adaptive Unscented Kalman Filter (AUKF) algorithm. The M-UKF also shows its adaptability to noise.

articleTitle: Black Start Process Simulation of Isolated Power Grid Based on PSASP
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the black start process of isolated power grid, the capacity of black start system is small, and the ability of anti disturbance and impact is weak. The starting impact of asynchronous motor in black start stage has great influence on system voltage and frequency stability. The best choice is to simulate the established scheme of black start through whole process simulation to verify its safety and reliability. In this paper, based on PSASP electromechanical transient calculation and analysis software, taking the black start design scheme of Indonesia Weda Bay industrial park's thermal power project as the background, the electrical topology of the black start process is modeled. And also the model parameters of diesel governor and Automatic Voltage Regulator are debugged, and the actual model data is restored as much as possible. The influence of governor and automatic voltage regulator on system stability performance is analyzed accurately. The reliability of the established scheme is verified through the comparison of field wave recording data and simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the Correlation between the Moisture Content and Insulation Performance of XLPE Cables
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cables are widely used in urban distribution networks, but the inside structure of the cables tends to be damp after being mechanically damaged in the underground pipe corridors, resulting in deterioration of insulation performance and possible further accidents, which is not conducive to the safety and stability of the energy system. In this paper, the long-term damp process of the XLPE cables is simulated by manufacturing cable samples with different defects and placing them in a constant humidity environment. Then moisture content of the insulation layers and the insulation performance of these cables are tested to obtain the relationship between the insulation parameters and the damp extent. According to this relationship, the water content of the insulation layer in a XLPE cable can be evaluated through the detection of insulation characteristics, so as to measuring the dampness degree of the cable. This research can provide a reference for formulating the disposal methods of moist XLPE cables, and is beneficial to the operation and maintenance of the power distribution of the energy system.

articleTitle: Non-cooperative-game-based Multi-agent Collaborative Planning Method for Distributed Generations
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The diversification of market subjects has become one of the most significant characteristics of power grids with the opening of power market policies. According to the theory of non-cooperative complete information game, this study focused on distributed generation (DG) operators, the distribution network operator (DNO) and power users. Considering the system economy and the power consumption satisfaction, a multi-agent collaborative planning method for DGs depended on non-cooperative games is proposed to achieve stable and friendly interaction between agents. CPLEX is used to solve the model to obtain the location and capacity of DGs. The simulation results indicated that the proposed method could balance the economic benefits of the main agents, and improve user comfort effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electric Vehicle Load Storage Resource Potential Based on R-ANN Activity Behavior Model
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Electric vehicles have extensive and flexible energy dispatch potential. The difference in user behavior results in different temporal and spatial distribution characteristics of electric vehicle charging demand. In order to be able to quickly and accurately calculate the charging power of large-scale electric vehicles and the potential of the storage resources it can provide, it is necessary to explore the temporal and spatial characteristics and laws. Analyze the travel time and space data of electric vehicles, and get the probability distribution of travel start and end time. A new neural network (R-ANN) prediction model based on a space-time activity, the use of rough set theory, activity data to predict the behavior of the electric vehicle travel mileage by historical time and launch the required charging time can solve the time and mileage do not match Under the circumstances, the probability model is used to calculate the charging power of a single vehicle to realize the quantitative calculation of the storage capacity of electric vehicle clusters. Finally, the simulation obtains the charging law of large-scale automobile clusters, and predicts the potential of electric vehicle storage resources at different times of the day through calculation examples.

Author Keywords: potential analysis of storage resources component

articleTitle: Research on Partial Discharge Detection Technology for Power Transformers
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: It is well-known that operation faults of power transformer occurs in the event of partial discharge (PD) phenomenon. Therefore, it is essential to perform research on the live detection and localization technology for PD in power transformers so as to ensure the security and stability of power system. The principle and characteristics of PD detection technology for power transformers are described herein. Four kinds of commonly used PD detection techniques, the pulse current method, the ultrasonic method, the UHF method and the HF current method, are introduced. The localization method of PD in transformers is analyzed then to explore how to choose the optimal PD detection method under different circumstances.

articleTitle: The Research on Temperature Control Load Modeling and Aggregate Simulation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, temperature-controlled loads, as a main type of flexible loads, can actively participate in demand side management in a clustered manner to realize auxiliary services such as peak and valley filling, frequency adjustment, and power balance maintenance. In this paper, the research on temperature-controlled load aggregation modeling technology is carried out: for a single temperature-controlled load, the thermodynamics and operating state are modeled; for a large number of temperature-controlled loads, the heterogeneity of the internal parameters of the model is considered, and the load aggregation model is established. For different types of temperature-controlled loads, the aggregation modeling accuracy at different initial temperatures is discussed. The simulation results show that the feasibility and accuracy of the state alignment aggregation model are relatively high, compared with the monomer model.

articleTitle: Interactive Trading and Profit Sharing among Multiple Micro-energy Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The existing energy consumption structure needs to be changed facing the problem of global energy shortage and environmental pollution. It is an important measure to increase the proportion of renewables in energy consumption for achieving sustainable development strategy. Combined with microgrid technology and CCHP system, micro-energy grid(MEG) effectively solves the problem of grid interconnection for distributed renewable energy power system and realizes the integrated production of cooling, heating and power. On this basis, the multiple micro-energy grid cluster can improve the penetration of renewables on a large scale, so this paper proposes the optimal operation strategy based on cooperative game of multipleMEGs considering power sharing. Firstly, the basic structure of MEG and the physical model of coupling devices are established. Then establishing the cooperative game model of multiple MEGs and proposing an improved Shapley value method for profit sharing. Finally, an example is given to verify the economy and environmental protection of this method. Furthermore, it shows the fairness and rationality of the profit sharing scheme.

articleTitle: Thermal Behavior Analysis of Wireless Electric Vehicle Charging System under Various Misalignment Conditions
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Concerning thermal safety, the surface of ground assembly (GA) is deemed as the most critical part of wireless charging device for electric vehicles (EVs). As a result of accumulated losses in the charging process, its temperature gradually climbs, which may lead to dermal injury to children and ignition of combustible debris. In practice, it is very usual that the GA and vehicle assembly (VA) are not perfectly aligned, wherein its temperature rise will be even higher as a penalty of efficiency deterioration. However, it rarely attracts attention as a safety hazard. This article is devoted to risk evaluation of the GA surface. The temperature-rise-related losses are derived. The thermal distribution is simulated in a transient-state way by JMAG. On the basis of IEC specification, a four-temperature level framework is established as evaluation criteria. The results signify severe impact of GA-VA misalignment on the thermal performance. Moreover, sensitivity analysis of three kinds of misalignments to the temperature rise is conducted. When the horizontal misalignment is larger than 81.12 mm or the angular counterpart exceeds 6.83 degree, the highest hazard level will be reached, revealing over-temperature risk.

articleTitle: Dual Laser Cantilever Enhanced Photoacoustic Spectroscopy Detection System for SF6 Decomposition Components
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A dual laser cantilever enhanced photoacoustic spectroscopy detection system is proposed to simultaneously detect H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> S and CO. A beam combiner is used to combine the laser sources for the two gases detection into the photoacoustic cell, and distinguish the photoacoustic signals corresponding to the gas detection according to the different modulation frequencies, and finally simultaneous detection of two SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> decomposition components is realized. Under the condition of single component and mixed component, the linear relationship between the different concentration of each component and the photoacoustic signal under its detection wavelength and frequency is studied through experiments, which proved the effectiveness of the detection method.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Stand-alone Photovoltaic System Considering Controller Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The mathematical model and small signal model of a simplified DC stand-alone photovoltaic system are established, which considers time delay caused by digital control. The small signal stability criterion and control parameter design criterion of the system are proposed. The accuracy of the stability criterion is verified by SIMULINK simulation. The transient instability phenomenon of system under the switching of working state or sudden load change is studied. The reason for the instability is theoretically analyzed, on which a new control strategy is proposed. The transient stability during switching of working state, environment change or load sudden change is greatly improved, and the new control strategy does not need additional hardware equipment.

articleTitle: Short-term Tie-line Power Prediction Based on CNN-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wind power output has randomness and volatility, which is easy to cause frequency and tie-line power fluctuation of interconnected power grid, and even lead to tie-line out of limit, affecting grid assessment. For this reason, this paper proposes a short-term tie-line power prediction method based on CNN-LSTM, which inputs historical tie-line power into a convolutional neural network (CNN),extracts the data features, generates the feature map, and inputs them into the long-short term memory network (LSTM) for tie-line power prediction. The proposed method is applied to predict tie-line power of a certain regional power grid. The results indicate that the prediction result of the method presented is close to the real power data and has higher prediction accuracy than the traditional prediction method.

articleTitle: Sequence Optimization of Auxiliary Load in Black Start of Isolated Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the black start problem of isolated power grid, we should not only pay attention to the black start process under the condition of unexpected power outage caused by fault, but also pay attention to the start-up of auxiliary power load and subsequent turbine impulse starting at the beginning of construction of isolated power grid and power plant operation. Based on the background of the initial operation of isolated power grid, this paper studies the optimization of the start-up sequence of auxiliary engines before unit start-up. Considering the change of the number of diesel engines, the problem is considered as a mixed integer nonlinear programming problem. The problem is considered as a mixed integer nonlinear programming problem. Through the MATLAB solver yalmip and gurobi optimization solver, the optimized load start-up sequence is solved offline. The model of isolated power grid is built by PSASP, and the simulation results before optimization are compared to verify the effectiveness of the planning model for the sequence optimization of auxiliary load.

articleTitle: Adjustable Robust Economic Dispatch: Case Study on its Application and Evaluation in Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Adjustable robust economic dispatch has been studied to consider uncertainties of renewable energy and AGC control in operation of power system. This paper proposes practical supplements for theoretical dispatch model based on existing research to facilitate application of robust dispatch algorithm. We also develop evaluation framework to simulate the real-time control of power system in random scenario of renewable generation after economic dispatch. The adjustable robust economic dispatch and accompanying evaluation algorithm are implemented and applied in real world power system. Case study demonstrates that robust dispatch is more cost-efficient under fluctuations of renewable generation and suitable for power system with high penetration rate of renewable energy.

articleTitle: A Two-Step Multi-objective Optimization Frame-work for Microgrid Scheduling Problem Based on Cloud-edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The application of smart metering terminals (SMTs) can collect online data of electricity customers, which would help microgrid system to obtain more accurate information of electricity load demand by edge-computing. Hence reasonable dispatch schemes can be made. In this paper, a two-step multi-objective optimization framework for microgrid scheduling problem is proposed based on cloud-edge computing. A typical microgrid structure with smart metering terminals (SMTs) is introduced and the cloud-edge computing framework is designed, in which the central energy management system (CEMS) is utilized to compute the day-ahead microgrid economical/environmental scheduling problem on the cloud side by forecast data, and the edge-computing servers are applied to re-compute the local optimum schemes on the edge-side during the operation process. Thereafter, the two-step multi-objective optimization strategy is proposed taking advantages of the global computing in cloud-side and the distributed computing in edge-side. The day-ahead global optimization model and the online local optimization model are employed to meet different goals by the two steps. Experimental results show that the proposed strategy is efficient in dealing with the microgrid scheduling problem to reduce cost and emission and can take account of the forecast data errors as well as the global optimum information.

articleTitle: Fault Mechanism Analysis And Ride-Through Strategy of Adjustable Speed Drive to Voltage Sag
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage sag and voltage interruption are common power quality disturbances in modern industry, which affects the performance of adjustable speed drives (ASDs). This paper analyzes the waveforms of the DC voltage and output current of ASD, motor torque and speed during voltage sag. It is concluded that the DC side voltage fluctuation is the key factor that causes the ASD to stop. In addition, a low-voltage ride-through strategy based on flywheel energy storage system (FESS) is proposed, which is suitable for large-capacity ASD. The strategy can effectively reduce the impact of voltage sag on ASD by ensuring that the DC side voltage of ASD is constant. Compared with the current common voltage sag mitigation equipment, FESS has the advantages of long service life, high efficiency, less maintenance, good stability and fast response speed. And the simulation method is used to verify the effectiveness of the strategy.

articleTitle: Profit Evaluation for Virtual Power Plant in Power Load Response: From the Perspective of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Virtual power plant (VPP) is a new generation of intelligent control technology and interactive model integrating power resources, power network and power load in power system. Based on advanced modern information and communication technologies, VPP can efficiently integrate and manage distributed power resources, flexible power load, energy storage and other assets under its control. However, the construction of VPP requires certain investment in equipment transformation, technology upgrade, etc. Scientific calculation for VPP potential benefits is therefore helpful to VPP development. Among existing VPP profit evaluation methods, however, most approaches focus on VPP internal cost and its whole life expense, while the influence from the power grid side is normally ignored. Without considering the power grid demand and constraints, the economic value brought by VPP operation cannot be comprehensively assessed. In this work, a method for assessing VPP revenue in participating into load response from the power grid perspective is proposed. It considers the load response percentage, annual load data, and incentive prices, and can reasonably evaluate VPP benefits providing load demand response. A simulation case presents the application of this method. In addition, the calculation is simple and convenient, thus provide an effective means for comprehensively evaluating VPP benefits.

articleTitle: Generation of Large-Scale Convergent Power Flow Samples Through A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The developments of renewable energy and electricity market have significantly increased the complexity and stochastics of power system’s operation, and the increasing possibility of unpredictable power flow scenarios’ occurrence can lead to the instability of electric system while coping strategies are not prepared. Through the analysis of diverse power flow samples, the possible status of the system can be simulated and related control method can be scheduled. In order to deal with the diversity and convergence problems occurred in traditional method, this paper proposed a fully data-driven method for power flow samples generation by using a two-stage strategy, where GAN-based model is used for initial samples generation and linear SVM is used to fine-tune some key variables for convergence. The application of proposed method in New England 39-bus system shows its advantages in generating convergent power flow samples.

articleTitle: Price Demand Response Model Based on Consumer Psychology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Based on consumer psychology, a price-based demand response load model is established, which divides the load into two parts: the basic load and the response load. The basic load uses the distance space method to filter the load of the five characteristic quantities of the week, the holiday, the season, the date difference, and the weather from the historical load. The response load is modeled based on user psychology, and the sigmoid function is used to describe the psychological change process of the user in the response process, and the load transfer rate is represented by a triangular fuzzy number. The simulation of the actual data in the United States shows the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Dynamic Load Shedding Strategy Using Distributional Deep Reinforcement Learning in Power System Emergency Control
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the uncertainty and complexity of power system control improved, emergency control strategies are facing significant challenge on adaptiveness and robustness. This paper applies a distributional deep reinforcement learning method in dynamic load shedding, which allow agents at different buses take collaborative actions in a distributed way. These agents are centrally trained and separately executed, which can have mutual collaboration with others. To validate the effectiveness of DDRL, our simulations are implemented on an open-source platform named Reinforcement Learning for Grid Control. Furthermore, we make comparisons and analysis in the IEEE 39-bus system to evaluate the performance of distributional deep reinforcement learning, and the results have demonstrated that the proposed method have satisfied adaptiveness and robustness.

articleTitle: Study on Stability of Low-voltage Multi-terminal DC System Under Electric Vehicle Integration
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The integration of the growing number of electric vehicles through the existing DC power distribution systems can reduce new power lines construction and save investment in power distribution equipment. The integration of electric vehicles will affect the stability of the system. In this paper, the state space model of low-voltage multi-terminal DC system is constructed. On this basis, the influence of electric vehicles as constant power load on system stability during integration is analyzed, as well as the sensitivity of variation of integration parameters to system stability, and the key parameters affecting the electric vehicles integration are determined. Furthermore, the key parameter configuration scheme for increasing the number of electric vehicles integrations is proposed, and the maximum number of electric vehicles integrations is analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of the stability analysis method for the low voltage multi-terminal DC system which integrates electric vehicles is revealed through the example verification and simulation analysis.

articleTitle: Periodic Narrow-Band Noise Denoising of Partial Discharge Signal Through Time-Frequency Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In high voltage engineering, partial discharge (PD) is an important topic. PD measurement is frequently used to monitor the status of critical equipment such as power transformer, gas insulated switchgear, and cable. The measured PD signal is of great importance for insulation evaluation and fault diagnosis. However, PD signal easily gets corrupted by periodic narrow-band noise, which will cause interference and finally lead to misjudgment of insulation status. Therefore, it is necessary to denoise it in the measured PD signal. In this paper, time-frequency analysis is proposed for denoising. Instantaneous frequency (IF) is also introduced. Due to the different IF characteristics between pure PD signal and periodic narrow-band noise, it is possible to distinguish and separate them. Numeric simulation experiments have been carried out to verify the feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Day-head Peak-shaving Model for Coordinated Wind-photovoltaic-pumped-storage-hydropower Generation Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The fluctuating and anti-peak-shaving characteristics of renewable energy (RE) challenges secure and reliable operation of power systems. Pumped storage hydropower with variable speed pumps (VS-PSH) can regulate power in both generating and pumping modes, which provides flexibility for accommodating intermittent RE generation. In this context, the optimal operation strategies of VS-PSH plants is developed considering RE accommodation priority. Firstly, the scheme of the coordinated wind-photovoltaic-pumped-hydropower-storage (WPPHS) generation is presented. Then, an optimal day-ahead peak-shaving model is proposed based on the principle of using PSH plants to compensate for fluctuating wind and photovoltaic power. A head-dependency model is proposed to describe the effect of water head on generation/consumption characteristics of VS turbine-pump Units. Finally, a case study is conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Resource Scheduling Strategy of Edge Computing Based on Bloom Filter Classification for on-site Sensing Tasks
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the increasing amount of data and computing scale processed by terminal equipment, in order to reduce the task processing delay and meet the priority scheduling requirements of tasks, bloom filter is used to sense all kinds of data in the field, and then a scheduling algorithm based on task priority is used to schedule edge computing resources. The algorithm calculates the priority of the task according to the processing value and the amount of data of the task, and formulates the resource matching scheme combined with the task deadline and server scheduling times, which solves the problem that the server allocates computing resources for users with different priorities in the edge network.

articleTitle: Consortium Blockchain-based Decentralized Energy Trading Mechanism for Virtual Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: As a new data structure, blockchain has the characteristics of decentralization, high security and information disclosure, which integrates and innovates a variety of computer technologies. Virtual power plant (VPP) is able to increase the operational flexibility of the energy resources and plays an important role in the aggregation of distributed generation resources. For the problem of scheduling difficulty and low transaction efficiency of VPP, this paper proposes a VPP transaction mechanism based on blockchain, which considers the stability on matching supply and demand and priority of renewables. The consortium blockchain is used to allow qualified users to participate in the energy transaction. A market trading platform for VPP based on peer-to-peer (P2P) network in the environment of Ethereum is designed. The incentive mechanism is added to improve the transaction efficiency and the transaction process of VPPis simulated. It shows that the blockchain-based VPP trading mechanism has excellent economy and traceability.

articleTitle: A Double-ended Contactless Current Traveling Waves Scheme for Fault Location in Overhead Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This study presents a contactless current traveling wave fault location scheme for a two-terminal overhead transmission line based on a tunnel Magnetoresistive sensor. The proposed method is implemented by installing a tunnel Magnetoresistive sensor array at both ends of the line for current traveling wave measurement. The measured data is transmitted to a remote monitoring unit (RMU) for analysis. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated for different fault situations using an experimental set-up.
