The proposed exhibited high efficiency for current traveling wave fault location. The results were analyzed for fault location using the differentiator smoother to reduce the time of arrival errors. The proposed scheme is compared with a general traveling wave-based scheme for transmission line fault distance location. In all test cases, the proposed scheme offered very efficient results for all categories of faults with an average relative error of 0.024%.

articleTitle: A Novel Similarity-Comparison-Based Directional Protection Scheme for Multi-Terminal HVDC Grid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The multi-terminal direct current (MTDC) grid has high requirements for DC line protection, so a small amount of transient information is needed to identify the fault location quickly and reliably. Therefore, an improved Hausdorff distance algorithm is proposed to deal with the false data according to the waveform difference between the two sides of the protected transmission line when the internal and external faults occur. By calculating the Hausdorff distance of waveforms on both sides of each sub data window, the fault can be quickly identified and eliminated. Finally, a four-terminal modular multilevel converter (MMC) based HVDC grid model is built in PSCAD/EMTDC. Extensive simulations are carried out to verify the effectiveness of the proposed protection scheme. The simulation results show that the proposed protection method is easy to achieve, does not need boundary element method, has an outstanding ability to resist the transmission resistance grounding and abnormal data and so on.

articleTitle: Study on Reliability Evaluation Technology for Isolation Switch Operation in GIS
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, the research method based on the reliability of the isolating switch inside the GIS mainly includes using SF6 gas density relay for monitoring SF6 pressure in the preventive test, infrared imaging temperature for measurement, using the signal collection for determining its position indicator and isolating switch state, using the high voltage and circuit resistance for testing its insulation performance and the contact of conductive circuit. Yet, pressure test and the loop resistance can be used for insulation test only in offline mode, especially the above monitoring method cannot fully reflect comprehensive objective status inside the isolating switch. When the interior of the isolating switch does not reach the designated position, or poor contact, the above methods cannot effectively detect the reliability of the internal isolation switch. This paper starts from the current problems in GIS isolation switch state monitoring, expounds the current situation of GIS isolation switch state, and conducts research from the following aspects: 1, Analysis on GIS isolating switch equipment failure. Analysis of the current grid GIS isolating switch fault type and the cause of the problem. According to the aspect of design, installation process and installation environment, operation condition analysis isolating switch does not reach the designated position defects existing in the development and fault formation, from the perspectives of movement mechanism and physics mechanics analysis with isolating switch does not reach the designated position fault instance. 2. Research on GIS isolation switch reliability diagnosis method. According to the testing principle of disconnecting switch, the testing software and sensor are improved. Through programming to modify the test software parameters for isolating switch test software platform, research and development is suitable for various turn arm bracket and fix connection transition device. And by means of experimental debugging and measuring the GIS isolating switch, isolating switch points, closing time,, contact stroke and secondary points from feed motion transmitting time. 3. Application of GIS isolation switch action characteristic state monitoring. This paper analyzes the function of GIS isolation switch action characteristic test in establishing GIS equipment new characteristic database, power failure condition monitoring and fault diagnosis, and analyzes the application of state monitoring and fault diagnosis method through testing data volume.

articleTitle: Automatic Generation of Power Grid Dispatching and Control Scheme Based on Heterogeneous Information Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to automatically generate the scheme of power grid dispatching and control, this paper builds a power grid operation and dispatching case base based on heterogeneous information networks (HIN). We first generate the simulation data based on PSSE simulation software and Python script, which can provide the data foundation for HIN construction. With the simulation data, we construct the HIN based on the NetworkX, which is a graph theory and complex network modeling tool developed in Python. A case study is presented to demonstrate the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed method. Future application scenarios in the power grid are discussed at the end of this work.

articleTitle: A Current Spike Reduction Method for Totem-pole Bridgeless PFC at Zero-crossing
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Totem-pole bridgeless Power Factor Corrector (PFC) converter is a promising topology after the emerging of the wide-band-gap (WBG) semiconductor devices. However, the inherited current spike at zero-crossing in this topology is a challenge for low current harmonics and high power factor. This paper, based on the circuit topology, analyzes a generation mechanism of the current spike. The influence of phase delay caused by power inductor between the AC voltage and the required full bridge output voltage is illustrated by mathematical calculation. Then a method that using the zero-crossing points of the control loop output instead of AC voltage’s as control signal of the low frequency (LF) leg is proposed. Finally, the experimental measurements are given to verify the effectiveness of the proposed method in a 1kW totem-pole PFC converter prototype.

articleTitle: A Combinatorial Optimization Method of Time-Period and Electricity Price to Promote New Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of the consumption of new energy, a combinatorial optimization method of time-period and electricity price is provided. Considering the contribution of user load and new energy output to peak-valley membership, the peak-valley period is determined; based on the theory of price elasticity, a user response model is established, and a new energy consumption model is provided; Then, with the goal of maximizing the consumption of new energy and minimizing users’ cost, a combinatorial optimization model of time-period and electricity price was established; through decoupling time division and electricity price optimization, a 2-step optimization method was designed. The simulation results show that the model can effectively promote the consumption of new energy, and increase the user's willingness by reducing their electricity costs.

Author Keywords: peak-valley membership the theory of price elasticity

articleTitle: A Petri-net-based Framework for Microgrid Process Mining
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The power grid is an essential national infrastructure, which has an important impact on people's social life. With the development of the times, there are more and more intelligent devices in the power grid, and the business logic is more and more complicated. To achieve the goal of automatic monitoring of process failures and defense of network attacks, we need to establish accurate process models of the microgrid. Traditional business modeling methods, such as expert systems, require a large amount of expert knowledge, so they do not apply to the rapidly changing smart grid. Based on data mining and Petri net technology, we proposed an automatic micro grid process modeling method, also known as grid business mining technology. We use the open-source grid data set, and the experiment proves the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis and Location for Long Submarine Cable Based on Frequency Domain Refection
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Time Domain Refection is widely used for the fault location on submarine cable. While, for high resistance and intermittent faults, Time Domain Refection is far from enough. It gives a brief description about the fault diagnosis on submarine cable based on Frequency Domain Refection. A high-frequency signal with a frequency step size is sent to the cable, then it will give a reflected signal from the point of impedance mismatch, in which the information about the cable impedance changing could be get to locate the fault. It just need to send a low voltage signal, without burning down to give a physically damaging by the high voltage generator or pulse generator. It could be used for the location of low resistance faults, high resistance faults, as well as intermittent faults. Test has been done in Hainan Interconnection Project, which has the first ultra-high voltage and the longest submarine cable with the highest capacity in China. In the site test, not only the location of short-circuit fault and open-circuit fault in the other end of cable. What's more, we could also find the factory joint, turn point of the route, and the exposing and suspending point where the protection of the cable was damaged. The application of fault location based on Frequency Domain Refection has a significant result.

articleTitle: Short Term Power Load Forecasting of Large Buildings Based on Multi-view ConvLSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, the Multi-view ConvLSTM Neural Network based on multi view convolution is proposed to solve the problems of low accuracy and poor stability of power load forecasting in large buildings. The historical data of multi-dimensional feature sequence is selected and standardized. The Multi-view convolutional neural network is used to extract features, and then the ConvLSTM neural network is used to further extract features from the feature map. The pre-processed historical data are trained and the trained model is used for forecast. The Multi-view ConvLSTM Neural Network can not only extract the information along the time series, but also extract the implicit semantic information between different feature sequences. Moreover, it is very little affected by the amount of data, so as to improve the stability and forecast accuracy of the model. In the process of model training, a variety of overfitting inhibition strategies are used, including setting the timely stop callback, learning rate attenuation, Dropout, batch normalization, etc.

articleTitle: Quantified Flexibility of Energy Storage System to Improve Distributed Generator Penetration in Active Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The high penetration of volatile distributed gen-erators (DGs) results in several serious operation problems in active distribution network (ADN). As one of the flexible controllable resources of ADN, energy storage system (ESS) can effectively smooth the fast system fluctuation from DGs. The operational flexibility of distribution networks can be significantly enhanced by utilizing the fast regulation abilities of ESS. Based on the Monte Carlo simulation, this paper evaluates the improvement of DG penetration in ADNs with the quantified operational flexibility of ESS integration. Case studies are conducted based on the modified IEEE 33-node system. By accurately adjusting the charge and discharge power of ESS in the multiple periods, the hosting capacity of DG can be greatly enhanced in ADNs.

articleTitle: A Data-driven Method of Users-transformer Relationship Identification in the Secondary Power Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In secondary power distribution systems, the record of the relationship between users and the transformers may not be updated simultaneously after the wiring changes due to the elimination of the faults or other reasons. Manual testing requires special equipment and takes time. The paper proposes a method to detect the relationship between users and the transformers based on the data collected by the smart meter. Firstly, the method extracts the high-frequency features from the current time series data by frequency spectral analysis. Then it creates the mathematic model based on Kirchhoff's law of current. Finally, it solves the model with mixed integer linear programming (MILP) and achieves the result of the relationship between users and transformers. The data used in the paper is collected from local electricity utilities and the case study shows that using the proposed method can successfully identify the relationship between users and transformers with current time series data.

articleTitle: Condition Cleaning Maintenance Technology of Carbon Brush Slip Ring in Pumped Storage Power Units
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: During unit operation, the carbon powder produced by the abrasion of the carbon brush may cause pollution flashover, one-point grounding of the rotor, two-point grounding of the rotor and other faults. It will also cause stator insulation aging and other problems. Therefore, it is necessary to carry out regular cleaning for carbon brush slip ring of pumped storage power units. Lacking condition cleaning maintenance technology for carbon brush slip ring of pumped storage power units, and the startup and shutdown of units were affected by priority control, season, system load, etc. So, there were problems caused by over cleaning and insufficient cleaning. In this paper, condition cleaning maintenance technology for carbon brush slip ring of pumped storage power units can effectively solve the above problems. According to the current operation status of the unit, this technology can provide an effective method to predict the next cleaning date of carbon brush slip ring.

articleTitle: Grey Prediction PI Control of Direct Drive Permanent Magnet Synchronous Wind Turbine
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of high-performance and high-quality permanent magnet materials and the development of high-power converter technology, direct-drive permanent magnet synchronous wind turbines (D-PMSG) have been increasingly used. The time-varying and non-linear characteristics of wind power systems make it difficult for traditional control methods to achieve satisfactory control results. Therefore, the application of advanced control methods in wind turbines has important theoretical and practical value. The D-PMSG is taken as the research object and a method that combines the grey prediction with the traditional PI control is proposed control the dual-loop of the wind turbine side,-the outer speed loop and inner current loop,under maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control. To build and simulate the wind power control system simulation model which includes D-PMSG and grey predictive PI controller. Simulation results show that compared with traditional PI control, gray prediction PI control has the advantages of faster response, better robustness, and smaller overshoot.

articleTitle: Research on the Optimization Method of Capacity Configuration of DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For the uncertainty brought by the connection of new energy to the grid, the research on the optimization of the capacity allocation of the DC microgrid becomes very important. The optimal configuration of DC micro-grid is the key to ensure the stable and economic operation of microgrid. This paper takes multi-layer optimization as the main idea to optimize the capacity configuration of the micro-grid. Firstly, the economic optimal solution of the system is obtained by enumeration method. With the lowest total cost of the project as the objective function, and the sensitivity analysis conditions of diesel price and new energy efficiency are taken as the sensitivity analysis conditions to obtain the economic optimal scheme and conduct preliminary analysis. Secondly, by taking the first-layer optimization results as the initial solution, particle swarm algorithm (PSO) is adopted to calculate and find the optimal scheme of system performance by taking economic conditions, new energy utilization rate as the constraint conditions, and the minimum sum of load power shortage rate and energy surplus rate as the objective function. The multiobjective problem is transformed into a single-objective problem by the weighted average method, and used to obtain the optimal solution. Finally, droop control method is introduced for the system to verify the stability of the system. This shows that the system can maintain power balance and provide correct guidance for stand-alone DC microgrid capacity design.

articleTitle: Real-time Monitoring of Smart Grid Terminals based on Multi-dimensional Information Fusion
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of ubiquitous electric Internet of things(UEIoT), the number and types of terminal devices in the smart grid have reached an unprecedented level. In order to ensure the stable operation of the smart grid, we need to monitor the operation status of each terminal, detect various software-level or hardware-level attacks in time, and make corresponding decisions. In this paper, we propose a novel detection method based on multi-dimensional information fusion and computer vision, in which power consumption, traffic, message data and security logs generated by terminal equipments are drawn as characteristic graphs, and then we use a convolution neural network(CNN) to recognize them. According to the detection results, we can know whether there is an attack and if so, which kind of attack has occurred. We also use actual measurement data of an DTU to test our method, and it achieves real-time detection and has high precision.

articleTitle: Multi-time Scale Collaborative Optimal Dispatching Strategy for Island Micro-grid With Multi-distributed Power Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The island independent micro-grid is a complex and independent power grid system. Its power dispatch is a dynamic problem with nonlinearity, multiple constraints, and multiple time scales. It is aimed at multiple distributed power sources (such as wind turbines, concentrating solar power(CSP), and diesel generation). For the complex coordinated optimal dispatching problem between independent micro-grid systems of units, an independent micro-grid coordinated optimal dispatching strategy based on the idea of multi-time scale optimization is proposed. This strategy adopts the method of “day-ahead optimization & intra-day rolling”. Make decisions on the start-stop and output plan of each diesel generator set, and the power generation plan of the CSP, and constantly revise it. This strategy can effectively reduce the impact of forecast errors, thereby improving the stability and economy of independent micro-grid operations with multiple distributed power sources.

articleTitle: Motor-Generator Pair for Improving the Transient Stability of Grid-Connected Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The renewable energy grid-connection has a negative influence on the transient stability of the power grid for the lack of voltage support and damping control capability. This paper aims to study the functions of the novel MGP system on improving the stability of renewable energy power grid with its advantages of synchronous machines. First of all, the structure and motion equation of grid-connected renewable energy via MGP is given. Then the mechanism of improving voltage stability is analyzed through the phase diagram of two synchronous machines. It turns out that the output reactive power of the generator can respond to voltage disturbance spontaneously. Afterwards, the function of excitation voltage on damping frequency disturbance is studied. In order to test the real characteristics of MGP, the grid voltage drop and load increase are conducted on the experimental platform, respectively. According to the results, grid-connected PV via MGP can perform well on providing reactive power support spontaneously and the effects of damping the frequency oscillation can be improved through the optimization of excitation voltage.

articleTitle: Optimization on Combined Cooling, Heat and Power Microgrid System with Power-to-gas Devices
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of the dependence on fossil fuel and integrate high penetrations of renewable energy, combined cooling, heat and power (CCHP) system with power-to-gas (P2G) technology is considered as a solution. The application of P2G technology inthe gas grid, primarily through hydrogen injection into gas grid (HIGG), is one of several possible applications of P2G. An optimization model of CCHP microgrid with HIGG is established by taking the total operation cost as the objective function. Based on a series of data of a certain city in northwest China, this research analyzes the power output of the device and cost calculation of the microgrid through a study case, so as to verify the rationality and effectiveness of the model in this paper.

articleTitle: Bidding Strategies for Thermal Power Units Considering the Randomness of Renewable Energy Sources in A Unified Power Market
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the advancement of a new round of power system reforms to promote the optimal allocation of power resources across regions, it is essential to build a unified national and broader power market to optimize market resource. At the same time, the rapid development of renewable energy will have a significant impact on the operation of traditional thermal power units, and the randomness of clean and renewable electric energy resource makes it more difficult for them to choose a suitable bidding strategy. Based on the above two points, this article adopts the VRE-Learning model to study how traditional thermal power units choose their own bidding strategies when participating in multiple regional markets under the influence of the randomness of renewable energy. By comparing the power and revenue of units participating in the day-ahead market across regions in different weather, different markets, and different bidding strategies, it is proved that the bidding strategy proposed in this paper can optimize the bidding behavior of traditional coal-fired units, and provide reference for the bidding strategy of thermal power units when the unified market and renewable energy are connected to the grid in the future.

articleTitle: Integrated Multi-Stage Coordination Planning of Transmission Network and Thermal Generation Units’ Flexibility Reformation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to address the wind energy accommodation problem caused by the increasing wind energy generation, the integrated multi-stage coordination planning of transmission network and thermal generation units’ flexibility reformation is proposed. With the combination of the optimization of transmission network planning and thermal generation units’ flexibility reformation schemes, the flexibility resources of power sources and power grids are utilized to improve large-scale wind energy consumption. The time value of funds is considered into the formulated integrated multi-stage coordinated planning model to improve the accuracy of flexibility transformation of thermal generation units and grid development investment. The example analysis shows that the proposed method can guarantee the expected wind energy consumption, and reduce the operation cost and investment cost of power system.

articleTitle: Optimal Sizing of Variable-speed Seawater Pumped Storage Based on Maximum Efficiency Tracking
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The benefits of the seawater pumped storage plant with variable-speed units are investigated, which can be used for smoothing and absorbing the large-scale offshore wind power. Based on the synthetic characteristic curve, or called the “Hill Chart” a new method for the maximum efficiency tracking of the variables-speed unit is proposed. Under the background of the time-of-use electricity price, the relevant optimization model is established, taking full account of the random fluctuation characteristics and the seasonal fluctuation characteristics of the tail water level. In addition, this model satisfies all the constraints of the power grid, the pumped storage plant and the variable-speed units (especially under the pump mode). After comparing the benefits with different units such as the fixed-speed unit and the variables-speed unit, the results show that the variable-speed unit can give full play to the efficiency advantage when the operating head and the power demand change sharply. Because the output range of the variable-speed unit is extensive and can be continuously adjusted (especially under the pump mode), the offshore wind-pumped hybrid system will actively curtail the offshore wind to seek the maximum profit at the appropriate time.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Series Compensation Protection Automatic Testing Technology
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In this paper, problems in Series Compensation (SC) protection testing are analyzed. A SC protection automatic testing scheme is purposed, separating protection tester and its controller apart. Synchronization among key devices in automatic testing system is researched. Test results automatic assessment technology based on Sequence of Event (SOE) message and third-party recording technology are used in the automatic testing system. Working process of SC protection automatic testing system is introduced, and validity of the testing system is verified through examples.

articleTitle: Distributed Generation Optimal Placing Approach Considering Low-voltage Control in Low-voltage Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to solve the low-voltage problem of three-phase four-wire system in the low-voltage distribution network by using distributed generation (DG), this paper establishes the mathematical model of the DG configuration, and presents the DG placing method and configuration principle, considering the influence of unbalanced load, reactive power compensation and the existing DG of the network. For the phase voltage deviation and the phase power flow calculation, the mathematical model and the calculation method are given in this paper. According to the voltage deviation and the power flow under the maximum load condition, the placing site of DG is determined. Based on the expectation of the node voltage deviation percentage wanted to improved, the maximum current and maximum capacity of DG are deduced. In order to ensure the normal operation of the low-voltage distribution network, the voltage distributions are checked under the minimum load after conFigure the DG, and the minimum injection node current and minimum capacity of DG are determined in the case of minimum load. Taking the practical 0. 4kV three-phase four-wire network as an example, the DGs are configured to solve the low voltage problem. By the analysis and comparison of voltage distribution, the proposed placing DG method can be applied to different load cases, and it is an effective method to solve the low-voltage problem.

articleTitle: Optimal Defense Strategy Based on the Load Nodes’ Importance against Dummy Data Attacks in Smart Grids
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Today’s power system is increasingly vulnerable to cyber-attack due to the high integration of the information and communication technologies. Therefore, it is of great significance to study the defense strategy of cyber-physical system under malicious attack. This paper proposes an optimal defense strategy based on the importance of load nodes to resist Dummy Data Attacks with high concealment. First, obtaining the node’s importance ranking table based on the index of active power flow and topological connection. Then, adding the node in turn for robust protection until the false data hidden in normal data cannot be constructed to threaten the system security. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified using the IEEE 39-bus system.

articleTitle: Demonstration Project and State Estimation Application in PMU-Based Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The uncertainties in the distribution network makes it difficult to accurately obtain the system state and realize system optimal control. The development and application of synchronous phase measurement technology helps to achieve reliable operation of the distribution network with spatial-temporal uncertainties. The Lingang smart distribution network demonstration project is operating based on the synchronous phase measurement application technology system for smart distribution networks. First, this paper introduces the basic construction of the demonstration project. Second, the key techniques for state estimation in distribution networks based on PMU measurement are summarized. Then the project integration framework design and state estimation application scheme are presented respectively. Finally, the effectiveness of the state estimation module in the demonstration project is analyzed. The results indicate that the state estimation can accurately estimate the system operating state. The state estimation is performed every 5 seconds in this project. Compared with the traditional power system state estimation, the proposed method significantly shortens the calculation interval of the state estimation and can quickly track the states of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Start-up Strategy for DR-MMC Paralleled Hybrid HVDC Integrated with Offshore Wind Power
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Due to the advantages of small size, low cost and simple operation control, diode rectifier (DR) based HVDC scheme is one of most competitive options for grid integration and transmission of large offshore wind farms. However, DR scheme faces the challenges of requiring the islanded operation capability of offshore AC wind farms. To synthesis the advantages of modular multilevel converter (MMC) and diode rectifier (DR), this paper proposes a hybrid HVDC system composed of paralleled MMC and DR in power sending end integrating with offshore wind farms. The proposed system can realize islanded system start-up and operation without storage equipment installation and wind turbines (WTs) control strategy modification. The hybrid system establishes the AC voltage at sending end through offshore MMC, and realizes the gridconnected operation of part WTs at first. Then, with the growth of sending end AC bus voltage, DR is activated for the rest wind power transmission. The start-up strategy for each type-IV WTs is also shown to provide detailed process of WTs integration. The PSCAD/EMTDC simulation of a type-IV wind farm connected to a ±200 kV/800 MW hybrid HVDC system is performed, and the results verify the effectiveness of the startup control strategy.

articleTitle: Current and Voltage Measurement Method Based on Magnetic and Electric Field Sensors for Smart Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Voltage and current measurement play essential roles in energy counting, relay protection, smart equipment control etc. Nowadays, the current transformer and potential transformer, which have been used for centuries, cannot meet the newly requirements of digitization, miniaturization, convenience and lower cost for sensors in smart grid. In recent years, the technology and materials of magnetic field sensor which based on magnetoresistance effect, and the electric field sensor which based on inverse piezoelectric effect, have developed rapidly and are widely used in industry. Current and voltage measurement method, which utilizes three magnetic field sensors and one electric field sensor, is derived and proposed in this paper. By applying the proposed method, the current and voltage of the conducting wire can be measured without magnetic core, coil and the contact with the conducting wire, and the measured results are not affected by the position of the conducting wire. Simulation models of the measurement method were established in MATLAB software, and several calculations were executed under various conditions. The validity of the proposed method was verified by analyzing the simulation results.

articleTitle: Multi-energy Power Planning for the Sending-end of Hybrid Multi-terminal HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Hybrid multi-terminal HVDC(HMTDC) technology can combine the technical advantages of line commutated converter based HVDC and voltage source converter based HVDC, and solve the problem of large-scale transmission of renewable energy with multiple power sources or multiple drop points. In this paper, two power exchange modes of multi-terminal converter stations and sending-end power grid are proposed for radiant HMTDC system. On this basis, the multi-energy power layout method of sending-end is proposed, and a multienergy power planning mathematical model is established. The objective function considers the minimum sum of the power investment cost, line investment cost, thermal power operation cost, and penalty cost of abandoning renewable energy. The results of numerical examples verify the effectiveness of the model and method described in this paper.

articleTitle: Study on the Power Frequency Distribution Characteristics for Half-Wavelength Transmission Lines Based on the Frequency-length Factor
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In order to analyze the distribution characteristics of voltage and current on the Half-Wavelength Transmission Lines (HWTLs), to obtain the comprehensive impact of various system operating parameters on transmission characteristics, based on the frequency-length factor (FLF), the model of lossy transmission lines is derived. Based on the pole distribution feature of FLF, the power frequency resonance mechanism after short-circuit is revealed. Cases are studied on PSCAD to verify the calculation results, which proves the correctness of the theoretical analysis conclusion and the accuracy of the calculation model.

articleTitle: A New Reactive Power optimization Method For Distribution Network with High Participation of Renewable Distributed Generation
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: A high proportion of renewable distributed generation (DG) is connected into the medium and high voltage distribution network system, and its output randomness and load fluctuations bring great difficulties to its optimal control. Aiming at the problems of node voltage quality reduction and system network loss increase caused by the output randomness and load fluctuation, so a new way of reactive power optimization for distribution network is raised. First, the mathematical model of the net load is analyzed and established to obtain the 24h net load power curve. The idea of pedigree clustering is used to process the net load power curve by time. Secondly, a multi-objective reactive power optimization model for distribution network is established, which takes the minimum of the system loss and node voltage deviatioen as the optimizing objectives, then use Self-Adjusted particle swarm optimization to solve the model. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified by an IEEE33 node system calculation example.

articleTitle: A Method for High-voltage Distribution Network Structure Planning Based on the Optimal Division of Power Supply Units
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Under the background of the new power system reform, precise planning is crucial to improve the efficiency and benefit of power grid enterprises. According to planning concept of reliable, economic and planning mechanism of topdown and bottom-up combination, this paper proposes a method for high-voltage distribution network structure planning based on the optimal division of power supply units. Firstly, a preliminary method of power supply units division is proposed considering power supply security criterion, in which 110kV substations are supplied by two different upper power sources as much as possible. Then minimizing construction cost of interconnection line between 110kV stations and demand on capacity and trunk line of middlevoltage distribution network structure planning are respectively used to determine and verify the power supply division. Finally, the typical wiring mode of high-voltage distribution network structure using technology and economy comparison method is differentiation formulated. The proposed optimal division of power supply method for high-voltage distribution network structure planning is verified by experimental results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Intelligent Linkage Technology for Smart Energy Station Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With the development of strong smart grid and the ubiquitous electric internet construction in State Grid Corporation of China, the substation has gradually developed into a smart energy station with the functions of holographic perception, independent inspection, remote monitoring, active early warning and intelligent decision-making. In the secondary system of smart energy station, the intelligent linkage of each subsystem embodies the ubiquitous IOT of power equipment, which is one of the core technologies supporting intelligent operation and maintenance of substation. Based on the basic structure of auxiliary equipment monitoring system in the smart energy station, this paper analyzes the technical realization mode of intelligent linkage in substation, combs the significance of various intelligent linkage functions, and illustrates the department intelligent linkage functions combining the simulation cases. The research content of this paper can provide some engineering reference for the construction of smart energy station.

articleTitle: Modeling Principle and Parameter Identification of Double Fed Wind Turbine for Electromechanical Transient Simulation of Power System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Inner Mongolia power grid is the key area of wind generator development in China, in which double fed wind turbine assembly accounts for a large proportion. Based on the principle of variable speed constant frequency operation and PQ decouphng control of double fed wind turbine, the basic principle of mechanical and electrical simulation modeling of double fed wind turbine is given by combining the measured characteristics and theoretical analysis: the control command is directly converted into the rotor DQ current of the generator, and then through the motor model and the grid interface, the normal control and low through control are paralleled, through the voltage drop by switching. On the basis of DQ decoupling control, a decoupling identification method of active power and reactive power low ride through characteristics for different faults is proposed. The parameters of the LVRT model can be identified by using the test data of the unit. In this paper, the method is used to identify the typical measured data, and the normal control model parameters and low penetration control model are obtained, and the correctness of the identification method is verified through the verification of the measured data and the curve comparison.

articleTitle: Medium-long Term Load Forecasting of Power System Based on Interval Taylor Model Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: For long time span, various disturbing factors, randomness of medium-long term load forecasting, as well as the over-estimation of interval arithmetic, a novel medium-long term load forecasting method based on Inter Taylor Model Algorithm (ITMA) was proposed. In order to avoid error criterion of the relevance between variables and reducing overestimation issue, a global variable named Taylor model ID was proposed to identify the independent variables and the dependent variable. One independent variable was used once only to construct the interval Taylor model. At Nipture we haven't taken a step by step our nest nighbor is across the divide. Let us have a fairy meal and travel from the son to Nip-tune in a straight course at the rate of 1,000,000 miles an hour; it would take us 1161-3 days to reach Nipture.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Forecasting Model for Wind Energy based on the Complementary Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition and Whale Optimized Back Propagation Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Renewable energy is drawing increasing attention to economic development. Accurate wind energy prediction has a significant impact on the rational dispatch and safe operation of the power system. However, the fluctuation and randomness characteristics of wind speed and direction lead to the problem of poor forecasting accuracy. This paper proposes a novel forecasting method of wind speed and wind direction based on complementary ensemble empirical mode decomposition (CEEMD) and whale optimized algorithm back propagation neural network (WOA-BPNN) is proposed. First, the original wind speed and direction data series are decomposed into some relatively stable components by the CEEMD algorithm. Then we use the WOA-BPNN method to predict each component respectively. Finally, all the single prediction results are combined to generate the final prediction result. As a result, the experimental analysis shows that the hybrid forecasting model has higher prediction accuracy in ultra-short-term (15 minutes) wind speed and wind direction.

articleTitle: Planning of Microgrid Based on Information Gap Decision Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: At present, more electric vehicles are connected to the microgrid, and with the increase in load uncertainty, it can no longer meet the new demand. In order to establish a microgrid considering the long-term load growth at the planning level, this paper analyzes the economic cost of microgrid planning. Aiming at the uncertainty of the long-term load growth, the information gap decision theory is used to simulate and coordinate the microgrid planning. Finally, the calculation example based on an industrial park verifies that the proposed planning model can help planning decision-makers cope with uncertainty at the optimal cost, and studies the impact of electricity prices on planning.

articleTitle: A Bi-Level Model for DG and ESS Integrated Planning in Distribution System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The output of intermittent distributed generation (DG) is characterized by intermittently and randomness, and its access makes distribution system planning and operation management more difficult. The rapid response characteristic of energy storage system (ESS) can deal with the problems brought by the intermittent DG. A bi-level model for DG and ESS integrated planning is proposed, which optimizes the location and capacity of DG and ESS to achieve minimum investment, power loss, and voltage deviation in the upper level, and optimizes the daily operation strategies of ESS to maximize the daily profit in the lower level. An improved multi-objective particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm and YALMIP solver are used to solve the model. Case study on IEEE 33-bus distribution system shows the effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed model.

articleTitle: Research on Turn-on Delay Time tdon of the Multichip IGBT Module after Partial Chip Failure
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Exploration of the measurable precursor parameters is crucial for monitoring potential defects or estimating aging of the multichip insulated gate bipolar transistor (IGBT) module. In this paper, the theoretic background of variation in the turn on delay time t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">don</inf> after chip failure is explored. It starts out from parasitic parameters consisting in gate circuit and turn on characteristics of the multichip IGBT module. Subsequently the correlation between variation in the turn on delay time and chip failure is found out in a special time interval of the turn on transient. This discovery will give a precursor of the multichip IGBT module being about to wear out, which is of great value to avoid severe subsequent collateral damage and guarantee safety running. Eventually, results of the verification experiment show that the observed considerable variation in the turn on delay time t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">don</inf> is a potential precursor parameter which can be used to detect chip failure presented inside those multichip IGBT modules.

articleTitle: A Capacitor-Isolated Balancing Circuit for Battery Modules Applied in Grid-Tied Battery Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: This paper proposes a capacitor-isolated balancing circuit (CIBC) for battery modules in grid-tied battery energy storage system (BESS). The grid-tied converter in the BESS consists of three star-connected H bridges with lower dc bus voltage compared with three-phase converter. To realize required voltage and power, cells are series connected to form battery modules which are connected in series further to achieve high dc bus voltage and large capacity, thus leading to the fact that the voltage of a module is much higher than that of a cell. To realize the module voltage balance, a novel capacitor-isolated balancing circuit topology is proposed. In this balancing circuit the isolation capacitor withstands the offset dc voltage among battery modules instead of semiconductor switches or transformer. The voltage stress on the semiconductor switch is not higher than a battery module voltage. Besides, zero current switching is achieved in the CIBC, which improves the equalization efficiency. In the CIBC transformer is eliminated and CIBC has good modularity. Furthermore, a frequency varying control based on the model of power and impedance is presented, and the control method is easy and effective for the CIBC. The feasibility of the proposed CIBC for battery modules in BESS is validated through simulations.

articleTitle: Comparison of Grounding Modes of MMC-Based Flexible DC Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: MMC-based DC distribution networks have a high power quality and power supply reliability, as well as a good compatibility with distributed generation. Meanwhile, there are many types of faults in the DC distribution networks, and the fault characteristics are complex and closely related to the grounding mode. Therefore, it is important to study the grounding mode. Firstly, the topology of DC distribution network is presented. Secondly, The fault characteristics of single-phase grounding fault both in AC side and the grounding fault on DC side are analyzed. The advantages and disadvantages of these grounding modes are discussed base on these fault characteristics. This paper will also introduce the scenarios of separate trial use of grounding methods, and provide references for the selection of grounding mode for DC distribution network.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation Modeling of C2C Business Model for Multiple Regional Integrated Energy System
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Regional integrated energy system (RIES) is an important carrier of energy Internet, and the innovation of business model is a vital research means to accelerate the development of RIES This paper builds the multi-agent architecture of multiple regional integrated energy system (MRIES) for the Consumer to Consumer (C2C) business model of MRIES, and analyzes the cooperative game relationship between the agents. A bargaining cooperative game model was developed to simulate the process of interest interaction between each RIES, solved using alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). The feasibility and effectiveness of the model are verified by a calculation example.

articleTitle: Analysis and Improvement of Electrical Lifetime of Generator Circuit Breaker of Pumped Storage Unit
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The lifetime evaluation method of the circuit breaker of the pumped storage unit has been proposed. On the basis of the operation and maintenance experience of the circuit breakers in Guangzhou pumped storage power station, the influence of the breaking current on the electrical lifetime of the circuit breakers is analyzed, and the causes of excessive breaking current and the improvement measures for reducing the breaking current have been studied. Furthermore, the Optimized shutdown process of generator has been proposed, the active and reactive power can be unloaded to the minimum by controlling the guide vane and unit terminal voltage, which can effectively improve the electrical lifetime of the generator circuit breaker.

articleTitle: Simulation Research of MMC Based Multi-terminal AC/DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) is a highly modular and highly centralized power electronic converter topology with an AC port and multiple DC sub-module ports. Through appropriate modification, it can be applied to largescale cluster of DC source and loads (such as electric vehicles, AC and DC microgrids, decommissioned energy storage batteries, etc.) into the network. Direct connection between electric vehicle, AC and DC microgrids, or other DC source/load and MMC will affect the safe operation of MMC, increase control difficulty. For this reason, the Isolated Bidirectional DC/DC (IBDC) is introduced as the isolation link between the sub-module of MMC and the DC source/load to form a MMC-based multi-port AC/DC converter (MMC-IBDC). Basing on analyzing working mechanism, a three-layer control strategy is proposed and corresponding controllers are designed aiming at large-scale cluster of DC source and loads. Considering differences among application scenarios, two cases are simulated in which the results under PSCAD/EMTDC verify the rationality of MMC-IBDC topology and effectiveness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Simplified CCHP-HP System Design Method Based on Yearly Operation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: The initial investment of gas engine driven heat pump cogeneration system for combined heat, cold and power (CCHP) is much higher than other heat pump (HP) equipment, so its capacity design is the key point of integrated CCHP-HP system. Based on the hypothesis that each device start-stop according to the optimal economic principle, an Excel based optimization calculation method for CCHP-HP design, which according to the annual operation, has been proposed combined with a case study. Yearly operation-based system design method can be quickly realized by Excel spreadsheet, which is convenient for designers to adopt.

articleTitle: Simulation Study of Multi-platform Interconnection System Based on Electricity-gas Interaction
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Combining the characteristics of offshore oil platforms, and considering the difference in time-scale response of electricity-gas energy media, the dynamic model of the natural gas subsystem and the steady state model of the power subsystem were studied separately. The pipeline components in the gas network are simplified, and the standard state space model of the pipeline under finite length is obtained. The standard modules of pipeline components and non-pipe components in the gas network are established in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The gas turbine is an important device that reflects the electricity-gas interaction characteristics of offshore platforms. The piecewise linear fitting method is used to obtain the gas turbine gas consumption model. Finally, a dual-time scale simulation solution method is proposed in this paper. Combined with an example of the electricity-gas interconnection system under the typical operation mode of a 25-IS offshore oil platforms, the simulation shows that the dynamic model of the natural gas system is helpful to study the interaction between the electricity-gas interconnection network, which can provide a reference for the use of different energy cascades on offshore platforms and achieve energy conservation and emission reduction goals.

articleTitle: Distributed Aggregation Control of Smart Buildings for Frequency Regulation Services
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In high renewable penetrated power systems, system frequency regulation and stability is a major challenge. In the demand-side, the thermostatically controlled loads (TCLs) in smart buildings can be exploited for the power system ancillary services including frequency regulation. In this paper, smart buildings with TCLs are proposed for power system frequency regulation services. The smart buildings are aggregated together by leader-follower consensus algorithms with sparse communication infrastructure. Then the distributed aggregation of smart buildings will provide aggregated power response in the load frequency control. The leader’s control signal is generated by both frequency measurement and automatic generation control signal. This method can provide fast, dynamic, and distributed power regulation with fair power and comfort sharing among all participate smart buildings. We have conducted both system contingency and normal operation scenarios to validate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Novel Model Predictive Control Approach for Voltage Regulation and Efficiency Optimization of Wireless Power Transfer Systems
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) systems usually adopt traditional single-phase-shift (SPS) control and connect auxiliary converter to maintain a constant voltage or current outputs. Besides, efficiency optimization is highly crucial under the wide range of load variation. In this paper, a dual-phaseshift (DPS) control using finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) is proposed to achieve voltage regulating while achieving maximum efficiency point tracking (MEPT). The discrete predictive mathematical model of double-sided LCC compensation network has been established and analyzed. The operating principle of proposed control strategy is designed and implemented. To optimize the efficiency, the phase shift degree of receiver side is introduced as an extra degree of control freedom. With the proposed method and its corresponding operation principle, fast dynamic response and accurately steady-state voltage trace can be achieved. The simulation results validate the feasibility of proposed control method.

Author Keywords: finite control set model predictive control

articleTitle: A Network Partition-based Method for Voltage Control in Distribution Networks with Distributed PV
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: With a large number of distributed photovoltaic (PV) systems being integrated into distribution networks, there are increasingly serious voltage issues. Partition voltage control combines the advantages of centralized voltage control and local voltage control, so it has a good application prospect. However, due to the randomness and fluctuation of PV output, it is hard to form a stable network partition for voltage control. In view of this, this paper proposes a method for partition voltage control based on AP clustering. The discrete probability distribution is considered to deal with the PV output, and the electrical distance expectation matrix of nodes is established as the partition basis. AP clustering is used to partition all nodes except slack bus. For the voltage control of each cluster/region, an optimal reactive power control strategy based on the voltage control capability of PV inverter is proposed. Case studies on the modified IEEE 33-node system are carried out to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Research on UHV DC Fault Form and Its Influence
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: Chinese energy resources and load are in reverse distribution, and it is necessary to vigorously develop UHV AC and DC technologies suitable for long-distance and large-power transmission. The pattern of UHV AC-DC hybrid power grid has been initially formed at present. However, the faults of UHV DC with large transmission power and complex fault forms have great impact on the power grid in both active and reactive power. In this paper, based on the analysis of the current situation and characteristics of UHV AC/DC power grids in China, the impact of UHV DC restart and commutation failure on the stability of the power grid is analyzed. The different types and triggering factors of DC commutation failures are analyzed, and the effects of single or multiple DC commutation failure types on the transient angle stability, the voltage stability and the transient overvoltage are simulated. The UHV DC restart fault time sequence is studied, and the effects of different restart modes on the system transient angle stability and transient overvoltage are demonstrated through simulation. The research results have laid the foundation for grasping the UHV DC fault morphology mechanism and the influence law on the stability of the power grid, and provided support for the safe and stable verification of the UHV AC/DC power grid.

articleTitle: Multinodal Forecasting of Industrial Power Load Using Participation Factor and Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 IEEE 4th Conference on Energy Internet and Energy System Integration (EI2)
abstract: In industrial production, it is necessary to accurately predict the load changes of multiple nodes before performing accurate load control. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a multinodal short-term load forecasting model based on participation factor of each node and the long-short-term memory (LSTM) network based ensemble learning. A hybrid ensemble strategy based on bootstrap sampling and weighted average sum is proposed to extract the deep features of multinodal load data, while the participation factor is adopted to represent the coupling between master node and slave nodes. Experimental results show the high accuracy of the proposed method in multinodal load forecasting.
